1027 <!-- v1.6: pantalla de carga con las fases reales (se ve antes de que llegue el motor 3D). -->
1028 <div id="boot" role="status" aria-live="polite">
1029   <div class="boot-card">
1030     <svg class="boot-logo" viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M32 3 57 17.5v29L32 61 7 46.5v-29z" fill="#1a2834" stroke="#f2ab38" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M26 50h12l-2-24h-8z" fill="#eef1f3"/><path d="M27.2 40h9.6l.5 5h-10.6zM28 31h8l.4 4h-8.8z" fill="#c0392b"/><rect x="27" y="20" width="10" height="6" rx="1" fill="#f2ab38"/><path d="M26 20l6-6 6 6z" fill="#eef1f3"/><path d="M37 21l15-6v10z" fill="#f2ab38" opacity=".55"/><path d="M27 21 12 15v10z" fill="#f2ab38" opacity=".35"/></svg>
1031     <h1 class="boot-title">Faro de <span>Ámbar</span></h1>
1032     <!-- v1.7: tres pasos con su estado real (UI 0.4 del usuario). -->
1033     <ol class="boot-steps" id="boot-steps">
1034       <li data-step="1" class="now"><i>1</i><b>Recursos esenciales</b><span>Cargando…</span></li>
1035       <li data-step="2"><i>2</i><b>Tu perfil</b><span>En espera</span></li>
1036       <li data-step="3"><i>3</i><b>La partida</b><span>En espera</span></li>
1037     </ol>
1038     <p class="boot-phase" id="boot-phase">Abriendo el juego…</p>
1039     <div class="boot-bar" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0" id="boot-bar"><i id="boot-fill"></i></div>
1040     <p class="boot-detail" id="boot-detail">&nbsp;</p>
1041     <div class="boot-btns"><button class="boot-retry" id="boot-retry" type="button" hidden>Reintentar</button>
1042       <button class="boot-retry boot-alt" id="boot-alt" type="button" hidden>Empezar de nuevo</button></div>
1043   </div>
1044 </div>
1045 <script>
1046 // Fases de la carga y su peso en la barra: motor 3D, modelos, cielo y tu perfil.
1047 window.FaroBoot = (function () {
1048   var W = { page: 5, engine: 9, models: 58, sky: 8, profile: 10, game: 10 };
1049   var order = ['page', 'engine', 'models', 'sky', 'profile', 'game'];
1050   // v1.7: los tres pasos que ve el jugador y las fases reales que cubre cada uno.
1051   var STEPS = [['page', 'engine', 'models', 'sky'], ['profile'], ['game']];
1052   var stepErr = 0;
1053   function steps() {
1054     var prevDone = true;
1055     var out = [];
1056     for (var i = 0; i < STEPS.length; i++) {
1057       var all = true, any = false;
1058       for (var j = 0; j < STEPS[i].length; j++) { var v = done[STEPS[i][j]] || 0; if (v < 1) all = false; if (v > 0) any = true; }
1059       var st = stepErr === i + 1 ? 'error' : all ? 'done' : (prevDone && (any || i === 0)) ? 'now' : 'wait';
1060       out.push(st);
1061       prevDone = all;
1062     }
1063     var lis = document.querySelectorAll('#boot-steps li');
1064     var TXT = { done: 'Listo', now: 'Cargando…', wait: 'En espera', error: 'No se pudo leer' };
1065     for (var k = 0; k < lis.length; k++) { lis[k].className = out[k]; lis[k].lastElementChild.textContent = TXT[out[k]]; }
1066     return out;
1067   }
1068   var done = { page: 1 };
1069   var log = ['page'];
1070   var hist = [];
1071   var el = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
1072   function paint(text, detail) {
1073     var pct = 0;
1074     for (var i = 0; i < order.length; i++) pct += W[order[i]] * Math.min(1, done[order[i]] || 0);
1075     pct = Math.round(pct);
1076     hist.push({ pct: pct, text: text || el('boot-phase').textContent, detail: detail || '', steps: steps().join(',') });
1077     el('boot-fill').style.width = pct + '%';
1078     el('boot-bar').setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(pct));
1079     if (text) el('boot-phase').textContent = text;
1080     el('boot-detail').textContent = detail || ' ';
1081     return pct;
1082   }
1083   paint('Abriendo el juego…');
1084   var failed = false;
1085   // Si en 90 s no terminó, se dice en vez de quedar esperando para siempre.
1086   var guard = setTimeout(function () { if (!failed && el('boot')) api.fail('La carga tarda demasiado. Revisa la conexión y toca «Reintentar».'); }, 90000);
1087   var api = {
1088     log: log,
1089     hist: hist,
1090     pct: function () { return paint(); },
1091     set: function (phase, k, text, detail) { done[phase] = k; if (log[log.length - 1] !== phase) log.push(phase); return paint(text, detail); },
1092     fail: function (msg) {
1093       if (failed) return;
1094       failed = true;
1095       clearTimeout(guard);
1096       log.push('error');
1097       var b = el('boot'); if (!b) return;
1098       b.classList.add('failed');
1099       el('boot-phase').textContent = 'No se pudo abrir el juego';
1100       el('boot-detail').textContent = msg;
1101       var r = el('boot-retry'); r.hidden = false;
1102       r.onclick = function () { location.reload(); };
1103     },
1104     // v1.7: una pregunta durante la carga (perfil que no se pudo leer): «Reintentar» vuelve a abrir la página y el otro
1105     // botón sigue con lo que decida el juego. Mientras tanto la carga espera.
1106     ask: function (msg, altLabel, onAlt) {
1107       clearTimeout(guard);
1108       log.push('pregunta');
1109       var b = el('boot'); if (!b) { onAlt(); return; }
1110       stepErr = 2;
1111       b.classList.add('failed');
1112       el('boot-phase').textContent = 'Tu perfil no se pudo leer';
1113       el('boot-detail').textContent = msg;
1114       steps();
1115       hist.push({ pct: paint(), text: 'Tu perfil no se pudo leer', detail: msg, steps: steps().join(',') });
1116       el('boot-phase').textContent = 'Tu perfil no se pudo leer';
1117       el('boot-detail').textContent = msg;
1118       var r = el('boot-retry'); r.hidden = false;
1119       r.onclick = function () { location.reload(); };
1120       var a = el('boot-alt'); a.hidden = false; a.textContent = altLabel;
1121       a.onclick = function () {
1122         a.hidden = true; r.hidden = true;
1123         stepErr = 0;
1124         b.classList.remove('failed');
1125         onAlt();
1126       };
1127     },
1128     finish: function () {
1129       clearTimeout(guard);
1130       log.push('listo');
1131       var b = el('boot'); if (!b) return;
1132       paint('Listo');
1133       b.classList.add('out');
1134       setTimeout(function () { if (b.parentNode) b.parentNode.removeChild(b); }, 450);
1135     },
1136   };
1137   return api;
1138 })();
1139 </script>

1318         <button class="btn" type="button" data-bigtext="toggle" id="btn-bigtext" aria-pressed="false">Letra grande: no</button>

1320       </div>
1321       <p class="small-note">Ahorro de batería: unos 30 cuadros por segundo y menos efectos. Daltonismo: colores que se distinguen y una forma por jugador en el minimapa. Reducir destellos: sin fogonazos de disparo y con el destello del misil muy suave.</p>
1322       <div class="uiscale" id="ui-scale-wrap">

1324         <input type="range" id="ui-scale" min="100" max="130" step="5" value="100" aria-describedby="ui-scale-note">

1337     <ul class="help" id="help-list">
1338       <li><b>Mover el mapa:</b> arrastra con un dedo. Zoom y giro con dos dedos (o rueda, Q y E).</li>
1339       <li><b>Ordenar:</b> toca una tropa y luego un destino o un enemigo. Doble toque elige todas las del mismo tipo.</li>
1340       <li><b>Varias tropas:</b> botón Recuadro y arrastra (o Mayús + arrastrar).</li>
1341       <li><b>Grupos 1, 2 y 3:</b> con tropas elegidas, «Guardar en 1/2/3». Toca 1, 2 o 3 junto al minimapa para elegirlas; dos toques llevan la cámara. Teclado: número elige; Ctrl o Mayús + número guarda.</li>
1342       <li><b>Avanzar atacando:</b> en el panel de tropas, y luego toca el destino: pelean con lo que encuentren en el camino (tecla F).</li>
1343       <li><b>Formación:</b> «bloque» las junta; «línea» las pone una al lado de otra, de frente al destino.</li>
1344       <li><b>Repetir tropa:</b> en el Cuartel, la Fábrica, el Puerto o el Helipuerto, «Repetir» y «×5» ponen otra vez la última tropa.</li>
1345       <li><b>Botón Constructores</b> (junto al minimapa o tecla C): elige primero a los que no trabajan.</li>
1346       <li><b>Campaña:</b> 6 misiones en el vestíbulo. Cada una da hasta 3 estrellas.</li>
1347       <li><b>Constructores:</b> empiezas con uno; entrena más en el Núcleo. Levantan y mejoran los edificios; el Ingeniero va el doble de rápido y el Barco constructor hace las obras de mar.</li>
1348       <li><b>Gráficos:</b> «Automática» baja la calidad sola si el juego va lento. «Contador de cuadros» muestra cuántos cuadros por segundo da tu iPad.</li>
1349       <li><b>Construir:</b> elige un edificio, toca una casilla dorada, revisa la vista previa y «Construir». El constructor libre más cercano va solo; también puedes tocar la obra con él seleccionado.</li>
1350       <li><b>Lugares:</b> Granjas en tierra fértil, Minas en vetas de oro, Bombas en petróleo de tierra y Plataformas en petróleo del mar.</li>
1351       <li><b>Energía:</b> Solar, Eólica, Hidráulica, Mareomotriz y Undimotriz. La gastan vehículos, aeronaves, buques, la Fábrica y el Helipuerto.</li>
1352       <li><b>Mejorar:</b> toca un edificio terminado y «Mejorar»: niveles 1 a 3 (la Casa llega a nivel 2: Apartamento). Con el Núcleo en nivel 3 se compra la Cúpula.</li>
1353       <li><b>Capturar:</b> lleva infantería junto a una Bandera o al Faro y despeja la zona de enemigos durante 12 s.</li>
1354       <li><b>Reparar:</b> selecciona un Constructor o Ingeniero y toca un edificio tuyo dañado.</li>
1355       <li><b>Demoler:</b> devuelve el 75 % si la obra no estaba terminada y el 40 % si ya lo estaba, más las tropas en cola y la mejora en curso.</li>
1356       <li><b>Cruzar el mar:</b> selecciona tropas, toca tu Barcaza y luego «Desembarcar» junto a otra isla.</li>
1357       <li><b>Salir:</b> «Salir al menú» deja la partida en pausa; vuelves con «Volver a la partida». También se guarda sola cada minuto y al pausar o cambiar de app.</li>
1358       <li><b>Ganar:</b> destruye todos los Núcleos enemigos.</li>
1359     </ul>

1364       <button class="btn danger" id="btn-quit" type="button">Salir al menú</button>
1365     </div>

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Utilidades: azar con semilla, matemática hexagonal, ruido y montículo binario.
  3 
  4 function mulberry32(seed) {
  5   let a = seed >>> 0;
  6   return function rand() {
  7     a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
  8     let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
  9     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
 10     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
 11   };
 12 }
 13 
 14 // Hexágonos de cara plana con coordenadas axiales (q, r). Radio de casilla = 1.
 15 const HEX_DIRS = [[1, 0], [1, -1], [0, -1], [-1, 0], [-1, 1], [0, 1]];
 16 
 17 function hexDist(aq, ar, bq, br) {
 18   const dq = aq - bq;
 19   const dr = ar - br;
 20   return (Math.abs(dq) + Math.abs(dr) + Math.abs(dq + dr)) / 2;
 21 }
 22 
 23 function hexToWorld(q, r) {
 24   return { x: 1.5 * q, z: SQ3 * (r + q / 2) };
 25 }
 26 
 27 function hexRound(q, r) {
 28   const x = q;
 29   const z = r;
 30   const y = -x - z;
 31   let rx = Math.round(x);
 32   let ry = Math.round(y);
 33   let rz = Math.round(z);
 34   const dx = Math.abs(rx - x);
 35   const dy = Math.abs(ry - y);
 36   const dz = Math.abs(rz - z);
 37   if (dx > dy && dx > dz) rx = -ry - rz;
 38   else if (dy > dz) ry = -rx - rz;
 39   else rz = -rx - ry;
 40   return { q: rx, r: rz };
 41 }
 42 
 43 function worldToHex(x, z) {
 44   return hexRound((2 / 3) * x, (-1 / 3) * x + (SQ3 / 3) * z);
 45 }
 46 
 47 // Desplazamientos ordenados por distancia, para buscar casillas libres en espiral.
 48 const SPIRAL = (() => {
 49   const out = [];
 50   const R = 9;
 51   for (let q = -R; q <= R; q++) {
 52     for (let r = -R; r <= R; r++) {
 53       const d = hexDist(0, 0, q, r);
 54       if (d <= R) out.push({ q, r, d });
 55     }
 56   }
 57   out.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d || a.q - b.q || a.r - b.r);
 58   return out;
 59 })();
 60 
 61 function hash2(ix, iz, seed) {
 62   let h = Math.imul(ix, 374761393) ^ Math.imul(iz, 668265263) ^ Math.imul(seed, 1442695041);
 63   h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177);
 64   h ^= h >>> 16;
 65   return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296;
 66 }
 67 
 68 function valueNoise(x, z, seed) {
 69   const ix = Math.floor(x);
 70   const iz = Math.floor(z);
 71   const fx = x - ix;
 72   const fz = z - iz;
 73   const sx = fx * fx * (3 - 2 * fx);
 74   const sz = fz * fz * (3 - 2 * fz);
 75   const a = hash2(ix, iz, seed);
 76   const b = hash2(ix + 1, iz, seed);
 77   const c = hash2(ix, iz + 1, seed);
 78   const d = hash2(ix + 1, iz + 1, seed);
 79   return a + (b - a) * sx + (c - a) * sz + (a - b - c + d) * sx * sz;
 80 }
 81 
 82 function fbm(x, z, seed) {
 83   return valueNoise(x, z, seed) * 0.6 + valueNoise(x * 2.1, z * 2.1, seed + 7) * 0.3 +
 84     valueNoise(x * 4.3, z * 4.3, seed + 13) * 0.1;
 85 }
 86 
 87 class MinHeap {
 88   constructor() {
 89     this.items = [];
 90     this.prio = [];
 91   }
 92 
 93   get size() {
 94     return this.items.length;
 95   }
 96 
 97   push(item, p) {
 98     const it = this.items;
 99     const pr = this.prio;
100     let i = it.length;
101     it.push(item);
102     pr.push(p);
103     while (i > 0) {
104       const parent = (i - 1) >> 1;
105       if (pr[parent] <= p) break;
106       it[i] = it[parent];
107       pr[i] = pr[parent];
108       i = parent;
109     }
110     it[i] = item;
111     pr[i] = p;
112   }
113 
114   pop() {
115     const it = this.items;
116     const pr = this.prio;
117     const top = it[0];
118     const lastI = it.pop();
119     const lastP = pr.pop();
120     const n = it.length;
121     if (n > 0) {
122       let i = 0;
123       for (;;) {
124         const l = i * 2 + 1;
125         const r = l + 1;
126         let m = i;
127         let mp = lastP;
128         if (l < n && pr[l] < mp) { m = l; mp = pr[l]; }
129         if (r < n && pr[r] < mp) { m = r; mp = pr[r]; }
130         if (m === i) break;
131         it[i] = it[m];
132         pr[i] = pr[m];
133         i = m;
134       }
135       it[i] = lastI;
136       pr[i] = lastP;
137     }
138     return top;
139   }
140 }
141 
142 function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
143   return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
144 }
145 
146 function lerpAngle(a, b, t) {
147   let d = b - a;
148   while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
149   while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
150   return a + d * t;
151 }

167 // Escudos en 3 etapas (v0.9): azul = bien, amarillo = a medias, rojo = débil.
168 function SHIELD_CSS(k) {
169   return k > 0.66 ? '#4aa8ff' : k > 0.33 ? '#f2c94c' : '#ef5350';
170 }

175 // v1.8: SHA-256 (para la contraseña de la zona de creadores: el juego guarda solo su huella, no la contraseña).
176 function sha256Hex(str) {
177   const K = [0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01,
178     0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174, 0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f,
179     0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da, 0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
180     0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70,
181     0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070, 0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a,
182     0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2];
183   const bytes = Array.from(new TextEncoder().encode(str));
184   const bitLen = bytes.length * 8;
185   bytes.push(0x80);
186   while (bytes.length % 64 !== 56) bytes.push(0);
187   for (let i = 7; i >= 0; i--) bytes.push(i >= 4 ? 0 : (bitLen >>> (i * 8)) & 0xff);
188   const h = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
189   const rotr = (x, n) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
190   const w = new Array(64);
191   for (let o = 0; o < bytes.length; o += 64) {
192     for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) w[i] = (bytes[o + i * 4] << 24) | (bytes[o + i * 4 + 1] << 16) | (bytes[o + i * 4 + 2] << 8) | bytes[o + i * 4 + 3];
193     for (let i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
194       const s0 = rotr(w[i - 15], 7) ^ rotr(w[i - 15], 18) ^ (w[i - 15] >>> 3);
195       const s1 = rotr(w[i - 2], 17) ^ rotr(w[i - 2], 19) ^ (w[i - 2] >>> 10);
196       w[i] = (w[i - 16] + s0 + w[i - 7] + s1) | 0;
197     }
198     let [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, hh] = h;
199     for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
200       const t1 = (hh + (rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25)) + ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) + K[i] + w[i]) | 0;
201       const t2 = ((rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22)) + ((a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c))) | 0;
202       hh = g; g = f; f = e; e = (d + t1) | 0; d = c; c = b; b = a; a = (t1 + t2) | 0;
203     }
204     h[0] = (h[0] + a) | 0; h[1] = (h[1] + b) | 0; h[2] = (h[2] + c) | 0; h[3] = (h[3] + d) | 0;
205     h[4] = (h[4] + e) | 0; h[5] = (h[5] + f) | 0; h[6] = (h[6] + g) | 0; h[7] = (h[7] + hh) | 0;
206   }
207   return h.map((x) => (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')).join('');
208 }

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Generación del mapa hexagonal, pasabilidad y búsqueda de caminos (A*).
  3 
  4 class GameMap {
  5   constructor(seed, kind, nPlayers, pairs = false) {
  6     this.seed = seed;
  7     this.kind = kind;
  8     this.n = nPlayers;
  9     // v1.1: Dúos: las bases de cada pareja (0-1, 2-3, 4-5) quedan juntas y las parejas, separadas.
 10     this.pairs = pairs;
 11     this.R = nPlayers > 4 ? 22 : 21;
 12     this.cells = [];
 13     this.lookup = new Map();
 14     this.homes = [];
 15     this.points = [];
 16     this.startFarms = [];
 17     this.hubs = [];
 18     this.generate();
 19   }
 20 
 21   key(q, r) {
 22     return (q + 50) * 128 + (r + 50);
 23   }
 24 
 25   get(q, r) {
 26     const i = this.lookup.get(this.key(q, r));
 27     return i === undefined ? null : this.cells[i];
 28   }
 29 
 30   atWorld(x, z) {
 31     const h = worldToHex(x, z);
 32     return this.get(h.q, h.r);
 33   }
 34 
 35   dist(a, b) {
 36     return hexDist(a.q, a.r, b.q, b.r);
 37   }
 38 
 39   generate() {
 40     const rng = mulberry32(this.seed);
 41     const seed = this.seed;
 42     const R = this.R;
 43     const n = this.n;
 44     // v1.2: las variantes se generan como su mapa base y después se les cambia el terreno.
 45     const kind = MAPS[this.kind] && MAPS[this.kind].base ? MAPS[this.kind].base : this.kind;
 46 
 47     for (let q = -R; q <= R; q++) {
 48       for (let r = -R; r <= R; r++) {
 49         if (hexDist(0, 0, q, r) > R) continue;
 50         const w = hexToWorld(q, r);
 51         const cell = {
 52           i: this.cells.length, q, r, x: w.x, z: w.z, t: 'deep', h: 0, land: false,
 53           owner: -1, ownerD: 99, ownerId: 0, bld: null, nb: [], comp: -1, bridge: false,
 54         };
 55         this.lookup.set(this.key(q, r), cell.i);
 56         this.cells.push(cell);
 57       }
 58     }
 59     for (const c of this.cells) {
 60       for (const [dq, dr] of HEX_DIRS) {
 61         const nb = this.get(c.q + dq, c.r + dr);
 62         if (nb) c.nb.push(nb.i);
 63       }
 64     }
 65 
 66     // Islas: una por jugador en un anillo, una central y varias pequeñas.
 67     const ringHex = n > 4 ? 15 : 14;
 68     const ring = ringHex * SQ3;
 69     const a0 = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
 70     const blobs = [];
 71     const homePos = [];
 72     const homeXZ = [];
 73     if (this.pairs && n % 2 === 0) {
 74       // Dúos: cada pareja en su zona del anillo, separadas 20° a cada lado del centro de la zona.
 75       const zones = n / 2;
 76       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 77         const z = Math.floor(i / 2);
 78         const ang = a0 + (z * Math.PI * 2) / zones + (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * (Math.PI / 9);
 79         homeXZ[i] = [Math.cos(ang) * ring, Math.sin(ang) * ring];
 80       }
 81     } else if (kind === 'reef') {
 82       // Arrecife Doble: dos grupos de islas, uno a cada lado, separados por agua navegable.
 83       const side = [[], []];
 84       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) side[i % 2].push(i);
 85       for (let g = 0; g < 2; g++) {
 86         const sx = g === 0 ? -1 : 1;
 87         const k = side[g].length;
 88         side[g].forEach((pid, j) => {
 89           const zz = k === 1 ? 0 : (j - (k - 1) / 2) * (ring * (k === 2 ? 1.1 : 0.72));
 90           homeXZ[pid] = [sx * ring * 0.82, zz];
 91         });
 92         this.hubs.push({ x: sx * ring * 0.42, z: 0 });
 93       }
 94     } else {
 95       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 96         let ang = a0 + (i * Math.PI * 2) / n;
 97         let rad = ring;
 98         if (kind === 'bay') {
 99           // Bahía Gris: posiciones irregulares.
100           ang += (rng() - 0.5) * 0.55;
101           rad *= 0.86 + rng() * 0.2;
102         }
103         homeXZ[i] = [Math.cos(ang) * rad, Math.sin(ang) * rad];
104       }
105     }
106     // v1.5: en Dúos el Arrecife usa el anillo de parejas, pero igual necesita sus dos islas centro.
107     if (kind === 'reef' && !this.hubs.length) for (const sx of [-1, 1]) this.hubs.push({ x: sx * ring * 0.42, z: 0 });
108     for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
109       const cell = this.atWorld(homeXZ[i][0], homeXZ[i][1]);
110       this.homes.push(cell.i);
111       homePos.push({ x: cell.x, z: cell.z, ang: Math.atan2(cell.z, cell.x) });
112       blobs.push({ x: cell.x, z: cell.z, r: 4.8 * SQ3 });
113     }
114     const centerR = kind === 'open' || kind === 'reef' ? 3.2 : 4.3;
115     blobs.push({ x: 0, z: 0, r: centerR * SQ3 });
116     const small = [];
117     const addSmall = (ang, dist, rad) => {
118       const c = this.atWorld(Math.cos(ang) * dist * SQ3, Math.sin(ang) * dist * SQ3);
119       if (!c) return;
120       small.push({ x: c.x, z: c.z, r: rad * SQ3, i: c.i });
121       blobs.push(small[small.length - 1]);
122     };
123     if (kind === 'reef') {
124       for (const h of this.hubs) {
125         const c = this.atWorld(h.x, h.z);
126         small.push({ x: c.x, z: c.z, r: 2.6 * SQ3, i: c.i, hub: true });
127         blobs.push(small[small.length - 1]);
128       }
129       addSmall(Math.PI / 2, ringHex * 0.78, 1.8);
130       addSmall(-Math.PI / 2, ringHex * 0.78, 1.8);
131     } else if (n === 2) {
132       addSmall(a0 + Math.PI / 2, 10, 2.4);
133       addSmall(a0 - Math.PI / 2, 10, 2.4);
134       addSmall(a0 + Math.PI / 2, 17, 1.7);
135       addSmall(a0 - Math.PI / 2, 17, 1.7);
136     } else {
137       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
138         const ang = a0 + ((i + 0.5) * Math.PI * 2) / n;
139         addSmall(ang, ringHex + 1, 1.9);
140         if (kind !== 'continent') addSmall(ang, 8.6, 1.5);
141       }
142       if (kind === 'bay') {
143         for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) addSmall(rng() * Math.PI * 2, 6 + rng() * 10, 1.3 + rng() * 0.6);
144       }
145     }
146 
147     // Valor de tierra por casilla.
148     const lakes = [];
149     if (kind === 'continent') {
150       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
151         const ang = a0 + ((i + 0.5) * Math.PI * 2) / n;
152         lakes.push({ x: Math.cos(ang) * ring * 0.92, z: Math.sin(ang) * ring * 0.92, r: 2.7 * SQ3 });
153       }
154     }
155     const bigR = (ringHex + 5.5) * SQ3;
156     for (const c of this.cells) {
157       const noise = (fbm(c.x * 0.17 + 100, c.z * 0.17, seed) - 0.5) * 0.6;
158       let v;
159       if (kind === 'continent') {
160         v = 1 - Math.hypot(c.x, c.z) / bigR + noise;
161         for (const l of lakes) {
162           const d = Math.hypot(c.x - l.x, c.z - l.z) / l.r;
163           if (d + noise * 0.8 < 1) v = -1;
164         }
165       } else {
166         v = -1;
167         for (const b of blobs) v = Math.max(v, 1 - Math.hypot(c.x - b.x, c.z - b.z) / b.r);
168         v += noise;
169       }
170       c.land = v > 0.08;
171       if (hexDist(0, 0, c.q, c.r) >= R - 1) c.land = false;
172     }
173     // El centro de cada isla de inicio siempre es tierra firme.
174     for (const hi of this.homes) {
175       const h = this.cells[hi];
176       for (const c of this.cells) if (this.dist(c, h) <= 2) c.land = true;
177     }
178     if (kind !== 'continent') {
179       for (const s of small) {
180         const sc = this.cells[s.i];
181         sc.land = true;
182       }
183       const cc = this.get(0, 0);
184       for (const c of this.cells) if (this.dist(c, cc) <= 1) c.land = true;
185     }
186 
187     // Puentes de arena: hacia la isla central (Archipiélago; en Bahía Gris solo algunos)
188     // o hacia el centro de cada grupo (Arrecife Doble).
189     const bridge = (ax, az, bx, bz) => {
190       const dx = bx - ax;
191       const dz = bz - az;
192       const len2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1;
193       for (const c of this.cells) {
194         const t = clamp(((c.x - ax) * dx + (c.z - az) * dz) / len2, 0, 1);
195         const d = Math.hypot(c.x - (ax + dx * t), c.z - (az + dz * t));
196         if (d <= 0.95 && !c.land) {
197           c.land = true;
198           c.bridge = true;
199         }
200       }
201     };
202     if (kind === 'archipelago') for (const hp of homePos) bridge(hp.x, hp.z, 0, 0);
203     if (kind === 'bay') homePos.forEach((hp, i) => { if (i % 2 === 0) bridge(hp.x, hp.z, 0, 0); });
204     if (kind === 'reef') homePos.forEach((hp, i) => { const h = this.hubFor(i); bridge(hp.x, hp.z, h.x, h.z); });
205 
206     // Bahía: agua dentro del territorio inicial para poder construir un puerto.
207     homePos.forEach((hp, idx) => {
208       const home = this.cells[this.homes[idx]];
209       const ox = Math.cos(hp.ang);
210       const oz = Math.sin(hp.ang);
211       let best = null;
212       let bestD = Infinity;
213       for (const c of this.cells) {
214         if (this.dist(c, home) !== 4) continue;
215         const d = Math.hypot(c.x - (home.x + ox * 4 * SQ3), c.z - (home.z + oz * 4 * SQ3));
216         if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = c; }
217       }
218       if (best) {
219         best.land = false;
220         best.bridge = false;
221         for (const ni of best.nb) {
222           const nc = this.cells[ni];
223           if (this.dist(nc, home) >= 4) { nc.land = false; nc.bridge = false; }
224         }
225       }
226       hp.bay = best;
227     });
228 
229     // Agua: poco profunda cerca de la costa, profunda lejos.
230     const waterDist = this.bfsDistance((c) => c.land);
231     for (const c of this.cells) {
232       if (!c.land) c.t = waterDist[c.i] <= 2 ? 'shallow' : 'deep';
233       else {
234         const coastal = c.nb.some((ni) => !this.cells[ni].land);
235         c.t = c.bridge || coastal ? 'sand' : 'grass';
236       }
237     }
238 
239     const nearHome = (c, d) => this.homes.some((hi) => this.dist(c, this.cells[hi]) <= d);
240     const cc0 = this.get(0, 0);
241     for (const c of this.cells) {
242       if (c.t !== 'grass' || nearHome(c, 2)) continue;
243       if (fbm(c.x * 0.3 + 40, c.z * 0.3 - 20, seed + 11) > 0.66 && this.dist(c, cc0) > 2) c.t = 'mount';
244       else if (fbm(c.x * 0.36 - 60, c.z * 0.36 + 10, seed + 3) > 0.58) c.t = 'forest';
245     }
246 
247     // Vetas de oro.
248     const pick = (list, k) => {
249       const out = [];
250       const pool = list.slice();
251       while (out.length < k && pool.length) {
252         const i = Math.floor(rng() * pool.length);
253         const c = pool.splice(i, 1)[0];
254         if (out.some((o) => this.dist(o, c) <= 1)) continue;
255         out.push(c);
256       }
257       return out;
258     };
259     for (const hi of this.homes) {
260       const h = this.cells[hi];
261       const cand = this.cells.filter((c) => c.land && !c.bridge && this.dist(c, h) === 3 && c.t !== 'mount');
262       for (const c of pick(cand, 2)) c.t = 'gold';
263     }
264     if (kind !== 'continent') {
265       const cand = this.cells.filter((c) => c.land && !c.bridge && this.dist(c, cc0) <= 2 && this.dist(c, cc0) > 0);
266       for (const c of pick(cand, 3)) c.t = 'gold';
267     } else {
268       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
269         const ang = a0 + ((i + 0.5) * Math.PI * 2) / n;
270         const c = this.atWorld(Math.cos(ang) * ring * 0.55, Math.sin(ang) * ring * 0.55);
271         if (c && c.land) c.t = 'gold';
272       }
273       const cand = this.cells.filter((c) => c.land && this.dist(c, cc0) <= 2);
274       for (const c of pick(cand, 3)) c.t = 'gold';
275     }
276     // Islas pequeñas: bandera en el centro y una veta de oro al lado.
277     for (const s of small) {
278       const sc = this.cells[s.i];
279       if (!sc.land || this.points.some((pt) => this.dist(this.cells[pt.cell], sc) < 4)) continue;
280       if (this.homes.some((hi) => this.dist(this.cells[hi], sc) < 6)) continue;
281       sc.t = 'grass';
282       this.points.push({ type: 'flag', cell: sc.i });
283       const nb = sc.nb.map((ni) => this.cells[ni]).find((c) => c.land && !c.bridge);
284       if (nb) nb.t = 'gold';
285     }
286 
287     // Lugares de recursos: tierra fértil (Granjas) y petróleo en tierra (Bombas).
288     const spot = (center, dmin, dmax, k, type, loose = false) => {
289       const cand = this.cells.filter((c) => (c.t === 'grass' || (loose && (c.t === 'forest' || c.t === 'sand'))) &&
290         !c.bridge && this.dist(c, center) >= dmin &&
291         this.dist(c, center) <= dmax && !this.points.some((pt) => pt.cell === c.i) && c.i !== center.i);
292       const got = pick(cand, k);
293       for (const c of got) c.t = type;
294       return got;
295     };
296     // Tierra fértil en zonas grandes (v0.9): dos manchas de hasta 4 casillas juntas por base.
297     const patch = (center, dmin, dmax) => {
298       const seeds = spot(center, dmin, dmax, 1, 'fertile');
299       for (const sc of seeds) {
300         const nb = sc.nb.map((ni) => this.cells[ni]).filter((c) => c.t === 'grass' && !c.bridge && c.i !== center.i &&
301           !this.points.some((pt) => pt.cell === c.i) && !this.homes.includes(c.i));
302         for (const c of nb.slice(0, 3)) c.t = 'fertile';
303       }
304     };
305     for (const hi of this.homes) {
306       const h = this.cells[hi];
307       const first = spot(h, 2, 2, 1, 'fertile');
308       this.startFarms.push(first.length ? first[0].i : -1);
309       spot(h, 2, 4, 3, 'fertile');
310       patch(h, 3, 4);
311       patch(h, 3, 5);
312       // Al menos 8 casillas fértiles a 4 de cada Núcleo (si el agua tapó una mancha, se completa al lado).
313       const fert = () => this.cells.filter((c) => c.t === 'fertile' && this.dist(c, h) <= 4).length;
314       for (let tries = 0; tries < 3 && fert() < 8; tries++) patch(h, 2, 4);
315       if (fert() < 8) spot(h, 2, 4, 8 - fert(), 'fertile', true);
316       if (!spot(h, 3, 4, 1, 'oilland').length) spot(h, 2, 4, 1, 'oilland', true);
317     }
318     const hubCells = small.filter((s) => s.hub).map((s) => this.cells[s.i]);
319     for (const hc of hubCells) {
320       spot(hc, 1, 2, 2, 'fertile');
321       spot(hc, 1, 2, 1, 'oilland');
322     }
323     if (kind !== 'continent') {
324       spot(cc0, 1, 3, 3, 'fertile');
325       spot(cc0, 1, 3, 2, 'oilland');
326     } else {
327       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
328         const ang = a0 + ((i + 0.5) * Math.PI * 2) / n;
329         const c = this.atWorld(Math.cos(ang) * ring * 0.45, Math.sin(ang) * ring * 0.45);
330         if (c) { spot(c, 0, 2, 2, 'fertile'); spot(c, 0, 2, 1, 'oilland'); }
331       }
332     }
333 
334     // Manchas de petróleo junto a islas pequeñas, la isla central y fuera de cada bahía.
335     const waterNear = (center, dmin, dmax) => this.cells.filter((c) => !c.land && c.t !== 'oil' &&
336       this.dist(c, center) >= dmin && this.dist(c, center) <= dmax && waterDist[c.i] <= 2);
337     for (const s of small) pick(waterNear(this.cells[s.i], 2, 3), 1).forEach((c) => { c.t = 'oil'; });
338     if (kind !== 'continent') pick(waterNear(cc0, centerR + 1, centerR + 3), 2).forEach((c) => { c.t = 'oil'; });
339     homePos.forEach((hp) => {
340       if (!hp.bay) return;
341       const target = this.atWorld(hp.bay.x + Math.cos(hp.ang) * 1.6 * SQ3, hp.bay.z + Math.sin(hp.ang) * 1.6 * SQ3);
342       if (target && !target.land) target.t = 'oil';
343     });
344     for (const l of lakes) {
345       const c = this.atWorld(l.x, l.z);
346       if (c && !c.land) c.t = 'oil';
347     }
348 
349     // Banderas: tierra fértil y petróleo cerca, para que valga la pena tomarlas.
350     for (const pt of this.points) {
351       const pc = this.cells[pt.cell];
352       spot(pc, 1, 2, 2, 'fertile');
353       spot(pc, 1, 2, 1, 'oilland');
354     }
355 
356     // Continente: banderas entre las bases, a medio camino del centro.
357     if (kind === 'continent') {
358       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
359         const ang = a0 + ((i + 0.5) * Math.PI * 2) / n;
360         for (const k of [0.7, 0.62, 0.78]) {
361           const c = this.atWorld(Math.cos(ang) * ring * k, Math.sin(ang) * ring * k);
362           if (!c || !c.land || c.t === 'gold' || c.t === 'mount') continue;
363           if (this.points.some((pt) => this.dist(this.cells[pt.cell], c) < 4)) continue;
364           if (this.homes.some((hi) => this.dist(this.cells[hi], c) < 6)) continue;
365           c.t = 'grass';
366           this.points.push({ type: 'flag', cell: c.i });
367           break;
368         }
369       }
370     }
371 
372     // El Faro ocupa el centro del mapa.
373     const center = this.get(0, 0);
374     center.land = true;
375     center.bridge = false;
376     center.t = 'grass';
377     for (const ni of center.nb) {
378       const c = this.cells[ni];
379       if (c.t === 'mount' || c.t === 'gold' || c.t === 'fertile' || c.t === 'oilland') c.t = 'grass';
380     }
381     this.points.unshift({ type: 'faro', cell: center.i });
382 
383     if (this.kind === 'mesa') this.makeMesas(rng, a0, ring, n);
384     if (this.kind === 'dunes') this.makeDunes();
385     for (const c of this.cells) c.h = TERRAIN[c.t].h;
386     this.computeComponents();
387 
388     // Garantiza los caminos a pie que el mapa promete (al centro, o al centro de cada grupo).
389     if (kind === 'archipelago' || kind === 'continent' || kind === 'reef' || kind === 'bay') {
390       const target = this.get(0, 0).comp;
391       const bad = kind === 'reef'
392         ? this.homes.some((hi, i) => this.cells[hi].comp !== this.atWorld(this.hubFor(i).x, this.hubFor(i).z).comp)
393         : kind === 'bay'
394           ? this.homes.some((hi, i) => i % 2 === 0 && this.cells[hi].comp !== target)
395           : this.homes.some((hi) => this.cells[hi].comp !== target);
396       if (bad) {
397         for (const c of this.cells) if (c.t === 'mount') { c.t = 'forest'; c.h = TERRAIN.forest.h; }
398         this.computeComponents();
399       }
400     }
401   }
402 
403   // Mesetas de Cobre (v1.2): mesetas altas entre las bases y alrededor del centro.
404   makeMesas(rng, a0, ring, n) {
405     const free = (c) => (c.t === 'grass' || c.t === 'forest' || c.t === 'sand') && !c.bridge &&
406       !this.points.some((pt) => this.dist(this.cells[pt.cell], c) <= 1) && !this.homes.some((hi) => this.dist(this.cells[hi], c) <= 3);
407     const plateau = (x, z, rad) => {
408       for (const c of this.cells) if (free(c) && Math.hypot(c.x - x, c.z - z) <= rad * SQ3) c.t = 'high';
409     };
410     for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
411       const ang = a0 + ((i + 0.5) * Math.PI * 2) / n;
412       plateau(Math.cos(ang) * ring * 0.55, Math.sin(ang) * ring * 0.55, 2.6);
413     }
414     for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
415       const ang = a0 + rng() * Math.PI * 2;
416       plateau(Math.cos(ang) * ring * 0.25, Math.sin(ang) * ring * 0.25, 1.6);
417     }
418   }
419 
420   // Dunas Rojas (v1.2): lejos de las bases, el pasto y los bosques son dunas.
421   makeDunes() {
422     for (const c of this.cells) {
423       if ((c.t === 'grass' || c.t === 'forest') && !c.bridge && !this.points.some((pt) => pt.cell === c.i) &&
424         !this.homes.some((hi) => this.dist(this.cells[hi], c) <= 3)) c.t = 'dune';
425     }
426   }
427 
428   bfsDistance(isSource) {
429     const dist = new Int32Array(this.cells.length).fill(999);
430     const queue = [];
431     for (const c of this.cells) if (isSource(c)) { dist[c.i] = 0; queue.push(c.i); }
432     for (let h = 0; h < queue.length; h++) {
433       const ci = queue[h];
434       for (const ni of this.cells[ci].nb) {
435         if (dist[ni] > dist[ci] + 1) { dist[ni] = dist[ci] + 1; queue.push(ni); }
436       }
437     }
438     return dist;
439   }
440 
441   // v1.5: isla centro de grupo del Arrecife para el jugador i (en Dúos, la del lado donde está su casa).
442   hubFor(i) {
443     if (this.pairs) return this.cells[this.homes[i]].x < 0 ? this.hubs[0] : this.hubs[1];
444     return this.hubs[i % 2];
445   }
446 
447   // Componentes conexas: tierra (sin montañas) y agua por separado.
448   computeComponents() {
449     for (const c of this.cells) c.comp = -1;
450     let id = 0;
451     for (const c of this.cells) {
452       if (c.comp !== -1 || c.t === 'mount') continue;
453       const isLand = TERRAIN[c.t].land === true;
454       const stack = [c.i];
455       c.comp = id;
456       while (stack.length) {
457         const ci = stack.pop();
458         for (const ni of this.cells[ci].nb) {
459           const nc = this.cells[ni];
460           if (nc.comp !== -1 || nc.t === 'mount') continue;
461           if ((TERRAIN[nc.t].land === true) !== isLand) continue;
462           nc.comp = id;
463           stack.push(ni);
464         }
465       }
466       id++;
467     }
468   }
469 
470   isCoast(c) {
471     return TERRAIN[c.t].water && c.nb.some((ni) => TERRAIN[this.cells[ni].t].land);
472   }
473 }

 12 const GEO = {
 13   box: new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1),
 14   cyl6: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 6),
 15   cyl8: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 8),
 16   cyl12: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 12),
 17   cone4: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 4),
 18   cone6: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 6),
 19   cone8: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 8),
 20   prism: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 3),
 21   sphere: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 8, 6),
 22   half: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 10, 1, false, 0, Math.PI),
 23   dodeca: new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1, 0),
 24   octa: new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0),

 27 const _v = new THREE.Vector3();
 28 const _q = new THREE.Quaternion();
 29 const _e = new THREE.Euler();
 30 const _s = new THREE.Vector3();
 31 
 32 class PartBuilder {
 33   constructor() {
 34     this.parts = [];
 35   }
 36 
 37   add(geo, color, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, rx = 0, ry = 0, rz = 0) {
 38     const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
 39     m.compose(_v.set(x, y, z), _q.setFromEuler(_e.set(rx, ry, rz)), _s.set(sx, sy, sz));
 40     this.parts.push({ g: geo, c: color, m });
 41     return this;
 42   }
 43 
 44   // Caja apoyada en y (la base queda en y).
 45   box(w, h, d, color, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, ry = 0) {
 46     return this.add(GEO.box, color, x, y + h / 2, z, w, h, d, 0, ry, 0);
 47   }
 48 
 49   cyl(r, h, color, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, geo = GEO.cyl8) {
 50     // Los prismas de 6 lados se giran 30° para alinearse con las casillas.
 51     const ry = geo === GEO.cyl6 ? Math.PI / 6 : 0;
 52     return this.add(geo, color, x, y + h / 2, z, r, h, r, 0, ry, 0);
 53   }
 54 
 55   // Tejado a dos aguas a lo largo del eje x, con la base en yBase.
 56   roof(len, halfDepth, height, color, x, yBase, z) {
 57     return this.add(GEO.prism, color, x, yBase + height * 0.5, z, halfDepth / 0.866, len, height,
 58       -Math.PI / 2, 0, Math.PI / 2);
 59   }
 60 
 61   build() {
 62     const pos = [];
 63     const nor = [];
 64     const col = [];
 65     const tmp = new THREE.Color();
 66     for (const p of this.parts) {
 67       const g = (p.g.index ? p.g.toNonIndexed() : p.g.clone()).applyMatrix4(p.m);
 68       const pa = g.attributes.position;
 69       const na = g.attributes.normal;
 70       tmp.set(p.c);
 71       for (let i = 0; i < pa.count; i++) {
 72         pos.push(pa.getX(i), pa.getY(i), pa.getZ(i));
 73         nor.push(na.getX(i), na.getY(i), na.getZ(i));
 74         col.push(tmp.r, tmp.g, tmp.b);
 75       }
 76       g.dispose();
 77     }
 78     const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 79     geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
 80     geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
 81     geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
 82     geo.computeBoundingSphere();
 83     return geo;
 84   }
 85 }

 87 function shade(color, f) {
 88   const c = new THREE.Color(color);
 89   if (f >= 0) c.lerp(new THREE.Color(0xffffff), f);
 90   else c.multiplyScalar(1 + f);
 91   return c.getHex();
 92 }

435 // ---------- Modelos de Blender (GLB incrustados) ----------
436 // Cada GLB trae partes ('main', 'turret', 'rotor', 'blades', 'rocker', 'crystal'); los materiales
437 // EQUIPO y EQUIPO_OSC se pintan con el color del jugador.
438 const GLB = {};
439 const GLB_MAT = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.72, metalness: 0.06 });
440 // v0.9 «Más fluido»: materiales Lambert, mucho más livianos para la tarjeta gráfica del iPad.
441 const GLB_MAT_FAST = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ vertexColors: true });
442 const MODEL_MAT_FAST = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ vertexColors: true });
443 let FAST_MATS = false;
444 function fastMat(mat, fast) {
445   if (fast) return mat === GLB_MAT ? GLB_MAT_FAST : mat === MODEL_MAT ? MODEL_MAT_FAST : mat;
446   return mat === GLB_MAT_FAST ? GLB_MAT : mat === MODEL_MAT_FAST ? MODEL_MAT : mat;
447 }
448 const PART_NAMES = ['main', 'turret', 'rotor', 'blades', 'rocker', 'crystal', 'legl', 'legr', 'shinl', 'shinr'];
449 // Caminar y correr de CMU (v0.8): ángulos de cadera y rodilla, inclinación y rebote por ciclo.
450 const CMU_GAIT = typeof FARO_ANIM !== 'undefined' && FARO_ANIM && FARO_ANIM.walk && FARO_ANIM.run ? FARO_ANIM : null;
451 
452 function _b64ToBuffer(b64) {
453   const bin = atob(b64);
454   const out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
455   for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
456   return out.buffer;
457 }
458 
459 function _readGLB(name, gltf) {
460   const model = { parts: {} };
461   gltf.scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
462   gltf.scene.traverse((node) => {
463     if (!node.isMesh) return;
464     // El objeto de Blender se llama como la parte; los meshes con varios materiales cuelgan de él.
465     let holder = node;
466     while (holder && !PART_NAMES.includes(holder.name.replace(/[._]\d+$/, '')) && holder.parent) holder = holder.parent;
467     const part = PART_NAMES.includes((holder.name || '').replace(/[._]\d+$/, '')) ? holder.name.replace(/[._]\d+$/, '') : 'main';
468     const g = node.geometry.index ? node.geometry.toNonIndexed() : node.geometry.clone();
469     // Geometría relativa al pivote de la parte.
470     const rel = new THREE.Matrix4().copy(holder.matrixWorld).invert().multiply(node.matrixWorld);
471     g.applyMatrix4(rel);
472     const matName = (node.material && node.material.name) || '';
473     const team = matName.startsWith('EQUIPO_OSC') ? 2 : matName.startsWith('EQUIPO') ? 1 : 0;
474     const base = node.material && node.material.color ? node.material.color.clone() : new THREE.Color(0xaaaaaa);
475     const entry = model.parts[part] || (model.parts[part] = { chunks: [], pos: holder.position.clone() });
476     entry.chunks.push({ g, team, base });
477   });
478   GLB[name] = model;
479 }

481 // Carga todos los modelos. Si falta el cargador o algo falla, el juego usa los modelos de código.
482 // v1.6: onProgress(listos, total) para la pantalla de carga.
483 function loadGLBModels(onProgress) {
484   if (typeof FARO_GLB === 'undefined' || !THREE.GLTFLoader) return Promise.resolve(0);
485   const loader = new THREE.GLTFLoader();
486   const names = Object.keys(FARO_GLB);
487   let done = 0;
488   const tick = () => { done++; if (onProgress) onProgress(done, names.length); };
489   return Promise.all(names.map((name) => new Promise((resolve0) => {
490     const resolve = () => { tick(); resolve0(); };
491     try {
492       loader.parse(_b64ToBuffer(FARO_GLB[name]), '', (gltf) => {
493         try { _readGLB(name, gltf); } catch (err) { console.warn('[Modelos] No se pudo leer', name, err); }
494         resolve();
495       }, (err) => {
496         console.warn('[Modelos] Error en', name, err);
497         resolve();
498       });
499     } catch (err) {
500       console.warn('[Modelos] Error en', name, err);
501       resolve();
502     }
503   }))).then(() => Object.keys(GLB).length);
504 }
505 
506 // Luz de ambiente (IBL) a partir del cielo de Poly Haven. Se calcula una vez por WebGLRenderer.
507 let ENV_MAP = null;
508 function loadEnvMap(gl) {
509   if (typeof FARO_ENV === 'undefined' || !FARO_ENV || !gl) return Promise.resolve(null);
510   return new Promise((resolve) => {
511     new THREE.TextureLoader().load(FARO_ENV, (tex) => {
512       try {
513         tex.mapping = THREE.EquirectangularReflectionMapping;
514         tex.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;
515         const pmrem = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(gl);
516         ENV_MAP = pmrem.fromEquirectangular(tex).texture;
517         pmrem.dispose();
518         tex.dispose();
519         GLB_MAT.envMapIntensity = 0.55;
520         resolve(ENV_MAP);
521       } catch (err) {
522         console.warn('[Modelos] Sin luz de ambiente:', err);
523         resolve(null);
524       }
525     }, undefined, () => resolve(null));
526   });
527 }

529 function glbKey(type) {
530   if (GLB[type]) return type;
531   if (GLB[type + '_1']) return type + '_1';
532   return null;
533 }

535 // Aspectos de la Tienda: solo cambian los colores del modelo (vida, daño y velocidad iguales).
536 const SKIN_LOOKS = {
537   selva: { name: 'Selva', tints: [0x4e6b34, 0x6b5a3a, 0x3d5530], mix: 0.55 },
538   artico: { name: 'Ártico', tints: [0xeef4f7, 0xc9dde8], mix: 0.62, teamDark: 0xdfe9ef },
539   castillo: { name: 'Castillo', tints: [0x8c7b63, 0x6e6252, 0xa39478], mix: 0.6 },
540   neon: { name: 'Neón', tints: [0x1b1830, 0x231d3d], mix: 0.8, glow: true },
541   dorado: { name: 'Dorado', tints: [0xf2c14e, 0xd9a638], mix: 0.72, teamDark: 0xb8862a },
542   // v1.2: colecciones nuevas.
543   frente: { name: 'Frente 1940', tints: [0x5b5a3a, 0x8a7f55, 0x5a4632], mix: 0.62 },
544   marea: { name: 'Marea', tints: [0x2a6f9e, 0xf08a7a, 0x7fd0d8], mix: 0.58 },
545   // Brigada Tóxica: cambia la forma (capucha y máscara de gas), no solo el color.
546   toxico: { name: 'Tóxico', tints: [], mix: 0, geo: true },
547 };

549 function _skinColor(base, look, i) {
550   const L = SKIN_LOOKS[look];
551   if (!L || !L.tints.length) return base;
552   return base.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color(L.tints[i % L.tints.length]), L.mix);
553 }
554 
555 function _buildPart(entry, color, look) {
556   const pos = [];
557   const nor = [];
558   const col = [];
559   const L = SKIN_LOOKS[look];
560   const team = new THREE.Color(color);
561   const teamDark = new THREE.Color(shade(color, -0.3));
562   if (L && L.glow) {
563     team.lerp(new THREE.Color(0xffffff), 0.25);
564     teamDark.copy(team);
565   } else if (L && L.teamDark) teamDark.set(L.teamDark);
566   entry.chunks.forEach((ch, idx) => {
567     const pa = ch.g.attributes.position;
568     const na = ch.g.attributes.normal;
569     const c = ch.team === 1 ? team : ch.team === 2 ? teamDark : L ? _skinColor(ch.base, look, idx) : ch.base;
570     for (let i = 0; i < pa.count; i++) {
571       pos.push(pa.getX(i), pa.getY(i), pa.getZ(i));
572       if (na) nor.push(na.getX(i), na.getY(i), na.getZ(i));
573       col.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
574     }
575   });
576   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
577   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
578   if (nor.length) geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(nor, 3));
579   else geo.computeVertexNormals();
580   geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
581   geo.computeBoundingSphere();
582   return geo;
583 }

585 const _modelCache = new Map();
586 function getModel(type, color, look) {
587   const key = type + ':' + color + ':' + (look || '');
588   let m = _modelCache.get(key);
589   if (m) return m;
590   // Algunos aspectos traen su propio modelo (por ejemplo «rifle@toxico»).
591   const gk = look && GLB[type + '@' + look] ? type + '@' + look : glbKey(type);
592   if (gk) {
593     const src = GLB[gk];
594     m = { glb: true, partPos: {} };
595     for (const [part, entry] of Object.entries(src.parts)) {
596       m[part] = _buildPart(entry, color, look);
597       m.partPos[part] = entry.pos;
598     }
599   } else {
600     const base = type.replace(/_\d+$/, '');
601     const fn = UNIT_MODEL[type] || MODEL_BUILDERS[type] || UNIT_MODEL[base] || MODEL_BUILDERS[base];
602     m = fn ? fn(color) : MODEL_BUILDERS.house(color);
603   }
604   _modelCache.set(key, m);
605   return m;
606 }
607 
608 function _partMesh(geo, mat, out, group, name, pos) {
609   const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
610   mesh.castShadow = true;
611   if (pos) mesh.position.copy(pos);
612   group.add(mesh);
613   out[name] = mesh;
614   return mesh;
615 }
616 
617 // Crea el grupo 3D de una entidad. Devuelve { group, main, turret, rotor, blades, rocker, crystal }.
618 function createVisual(type, color, look) {
619   const m = getModel(type, color, look);
620   const group = new THREE.Group();
621   const out = { group, main: null, turret: null, rotor: null, crystal: null, rocker: null, blades: null, type };
622   const mat = fastMat(m.glb ? GLB_MAT : MODEL_MAT, FAST_MATS);
623   _partMesh(m.main, mat, out, group, 'main', null).receiveShadow = true;
624   const pp = m.partPos || {};
625   if (m.blades) _partMesh(m.blades, mat, out, group, 'blades', pp.blades || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.bladesY, m.bladesZ));
626   if (m.rocker) _partMesh(m.rocker, mat, out, group, 'rocker', pp.rocker || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.rockerY, m.rockerZ || 0));
627   if (m.turret) {
628     _partMesh(m.turret, mat, out, group, 'turret', pp.turret || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.turretY || 0, m.turretZ || 0));
629     out.turretBaseY = out.turret.position.y;
630   }
631   if (m.rotor) _partMesh(m.rotor, mat, out, group, 'rotor', pp.rotor || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.rotorY, 0));
632   // Piernas de los soldados (se mueven al caminar).
633   if (m.legl) _partMesh(m.legl, mat, out, group, 'legl', pp.legl);
634   if (m.legr) _partMesh(m.legr, mat, out, group, 'legr', pp.legr);
635   // La pierna cuelga del muslo: gira en la rodilla y sigue a la cadera.
636   if (m.shinl && out.legl) _partMesh(m.shinl, mat, out, out.legl, 'shinl', pp.shinl.clone().sub(pp.legl));
637   if (m.shinr && out.legr) _partMesh(m.shinr, mat, out, out.legr, 'shinr', pp.shinr.clone().sub(pp.legr));
638   if (m.crystal) {
639     const cmat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
640       color, emissive: color, emissiveIntensity: 0.55, flatShading: true, roughness: 0.4,
641     });
642     _partMesh(m.crystal, cmat, out, group, 'crystal', pp.crystal || new THREE.Vector3(0, m.crystalY, 0));
643     out.crystalBaseY = out.crystal.position.y;
644   }
645   if (m.scale) group.scale.setScalar(m.scale);
646   return out;
647 }

649 // El Faro y las Banderas: partes neutras + piezas que cambian de color según el dueño.
650 const NEUTRAL = 0xd9dcdf;
651 function createPointVisual(type) {
652   const group = new THREE.Group();
653   const own = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: NEUTRAL, flatShading: true, roughness: 0.7 });
654   const out = { group, own, beam: null, lamp: null };
655   const b = new PartBuilder();
656   if (type === 'faro') {
657     b.cyl(0.95, 0.18, PAL.stone, 0, 0, 0, GEO.cyl6);
658     b.cyl(0.62, 0.22, shade(PAL.stone, 0.12), 0, 0.18, 0, GEO.cyl6);
659     const levels = 5;
660     for (let i = 0; i < levels; i++) {
661       const r0 = 0.42 - i * 0.035;
662       b.add(GEO.cyl12, i % 2 ? 0xc0392b : PAL.white, 0, 0.4 + i * 0.36 + 0.18, 0, r0, 0.36, r0);
663     }
664     b.cyl(0.34, 0.06, PAL.dark, 0, 2.2, 0, GEO.cyl12);
665     for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
666       const a = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
667       b.box(0.03, 0.34, 0.03, PAL.dark, Math.cos(a) * 0.24, 2.26, Math.sin(a) * 0.24);
668     }
669     b.add(GEO.cone8, PAL.dark, 0, 2.78, 0, 0.3, 0.32, 0.3);
670     b.box(0.2, 0.3, 0.02, PAL.wood, 0, 0.4, 0.44);
671     const main = new THREE.Mesh(b.build(), fastMat(MODEL_MAT, FAST_MATS));
672     main.castShadow = true;
673     group.add(main);
674     const lamp = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.17, 12, 10),
675       new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffc35a, emissive: 0xffa21f, emissiveIntensity: 1.4 }));
676     lamp.position.y = 2.42;
677     group.add(lamp);
678     const beamGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.7, 5, 16, 1, true);
679     beamGeo.translate(0, -2.5, 0);
680     beamGeo.rotateZ(Math.PI / 2);
681     const beam = new THREE.Mesh(beamGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
682       color: 0xffc35a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.22, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
683       blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
684     }));
685     const pivot = new THREE.Group();
686     pivot.position.y = 2.42;
687     pivot.add(beam);
688     group.add(pivot);
689     const band = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.64, 0.64, 0.08, 6, 1, false, Math.PI / 6), own);
690     band.position.y = 0.42;
691     group.add(band);
692     out.beam = pivot;
693     out.lamp = lamp;
694   } else {
695     b.cyl(0.32, 0.1, PAL.stone, 0, 0, 0, GEO.cyl6);
696     b.cyl(0.035, 1.25, PAL.dark, 0, 0.1, 0);
697     b.add(GEO.sphere, PAL.yellow, 0, 1.38, 0, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05);
698     const main = new THREE.Mesh(b.build(), fastMat(MODEL_MAT, FAST_MATS));
699     main.castShadow = true;
700     group.add(main);
701     const cloth = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 0.3, 0.02), own);
702     cloth.position.set(0.27, 1.16, 0);
703     cloth.castShadow = true;
704     group.add(cloth);
705     out.cloth = cloth;
706   }
707   return out;
708 }

710 // Miniaturas para los menús: se renderizan una vez con un renderizador pequeño.
711 const Thumbs = {
712   cache: new Map(),
713   renderer: null,
714   scene: null,
715   camera: null,
716 
717   init() {
718     try {
719       const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
720       this.renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
721       this.renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
722       this.renderer.setSize(112, 112);
723       this.scene = new THREE.Scene();
724       this.scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x445566, 0.9));
725       const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
726       sun.position.set(3, 5, 4);
727       this.scene.add(sun);
728       this.camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(30, 1, 0.1, 50);
729     } catch (err) {
730       console.warn('[Thumbs] Sin miniaturas:', err);
731       this.renderer = null;
732     }
733   },
734 
735   get(type, color, look) {
736     const key = type + ':' + color + ':' + (look || '');
737     if (this.cache.has(key)) return this.cache.get(key);
738     let url = '';
739     if (this.renderer) {
740       const isPoint = type === 'faro' || type === 'flag';
741       const v = isPoint ? createPointVisual(type) : createVisual(type, color, look);
742       if (isPoint) {
743         v.own.color.set(color);
744         if (v.beam) v.beam.visible = false;
745       }
746       v.group.scale.setScalar(1);
747       this.scene.add(v.group);
748       const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(v.group);
749       const size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).length();
750       const center = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
751       const d = size * 1.75;
752       this.camera.position.set(center.x + d * 0.62, center.y + d * 0.55, center.z + d * 0.62);
753       this.camera.lookAt(center);
754       this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
755       url = this.renderer.domElement.toDataURL('image/png');
756       this.scene.remove(v.group);
757     }
758     this.cache.set(key, url);
759     return url;
760   },
761 
762   // Portada (v0.9): una escena con los modelos del juego, dibujada una sola vez como imagen.
763   coverUrl: '',
764   cover(w = 1400, h = 440) {
765     if (this.coverUrl || !this.renderer) return this.coverUrl;
766     try {
767       const r = this.renderer;
768       const scene = new THREE.Scene();
769       const sky = document.createElement('canvas');
770       sky.width = 4;
771       sky.height = 256;
772       const sctx = sky.getContext('2d');
773       const grad = sctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 256);
774       grad.addColorStop(0, '#16283a');
775       grad.addColorStop(0.55, '#d9874a');
776       grad.addColorStop(1, '#f6c46a');
777       sctx.fillStyle = grad;
778       sctx.fillRect(0, 0, 4, 256);
779       scene.background = new THREE.CanvasTexture(sky);
780       scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xe0a060, 12, 30);
781       if (ENV_MAP) scene.environment = ENV_MAP;
782       scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffe2b8, 0x2d4a5a, 0.75));
783       const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffc98a, 1.05);
784       sun.position.set(-6, 5, 3);
785       scene.add(sun);
786       const water = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(80, 40),
787         new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2b6f93, roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.1 }));
788       water.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
789       water.position.y = -0.12;
790       scene.add(water);
791       // Isla de casillas hexagonales.
792       const hexGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.98, 0.98, 0.3, 6);
793       const grass = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6f9c55, roughness: 0.95, flatShading: true });
794       const sand = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xd8c38a, roughness: 0.95, flatShading: true });
795       const rock = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8b8f87, roughness: 0.95, flatShading: true });
796       for (let q = -6; q <= 14; q++) {
797         for (let rr = -5; rr <= 4; rr++) {
798           const x = q * 1.5;
799           const z = rr * 1.732 + (q & 1) * 0.866;
800           const d = Math.hypot((x - 4.5) * 0.48, z);
801           if (d > 5.6 || z > 3.6) continue;
802           const edge = d > 4.6 || z > 2.6;
803           const hill = q >= 6 && q <= 7 && rr <= -1;
804           const t = new THREE.Mesh(hexGeo, edge ? sand : hill ? rock : grass);
805           t.position.set(x, hill ? 0.18 : 0, z);
806           scene.add(t);
807         }
808       }
809       const blue = PLAYER_COLORS[0];
810       const red = PLAYER_COLORS[1];
811       const put = (type, x, y, z, yaw = 0, s = 1, color = blue, look) => {
812         const v = createVisual(type, color, look);
813         v.group.position.set(x, y, z);
814         v.group.rotation.y = yaw;
815         if (s !== 1) v.group.scale.multiplyScalar(s);
816         scene.add(v.group);
817         return v;
818       };
819       const faro = createPointVisual('faro');
820       faro.own.color.set(0xf2ab38);
821       faro.group.position.set(9.9, 0.33, -3.4);
822       faro.group.scale.setScalar(0.85);
823       scene.add(faro.group);
824       put('core_3', 0.8, 0.15, -2.4, 0.3);
825       put('aadef_4', 3.0, 0.15, -3.2, 0.8);
826       put('turret_4', 1.8, 0.15, 0.4, 1.0);
827       put('apc', 3.2, 0.15, -0.6, 1.2, 1.15);
828       put('heavytank', 4.4, 0.15, 0.9, 1.15, 1.15);
829       put('tank', 6.0, 0.15, -0.2, 1.25, 1.15);
830       put('launcher', 7.6, 0.33, -2.2, 1.3, 1.1);
831       ['rifle', 'rocket', 'rifle', 'medic', 'sniper', 'rifle'].forEach((k, i) =>
832         put(k, 4.6 + i * 0.6, 0.15, 2.2 - (i % 2) * 0.4, 1.4, 1.5));
833       const heli = put('heli', 3.6, 1.8, 0.8, 1.3, 1.2);
834       if (heli.rotor) heli.rotor.rotation.y = 0.5;
835       const apache = put('apache', 6.8, 2.2, -0.6, 1.25, 1.2);
836       if (apache.rotor) apache.rotor.rotation.y = 1.1;
837       const jet = put('fighter', 8.6, 2.85, 0.8, 1.9, 1.3);
838       jet.group.rotation.z = -0.35;
839       put('frigate', 11.2, -0.1, 2.6, -0.4, 1.2, red);
840       // v1.0: Bombardero y segundo Caza en vuelo con estela, y el Portaaviones en el mar.
841       const bomb = put('bomber', 4.6, 3.35, -2.2, 1.75, 1.3);
842       bomb.group.rotation.z = 0.12;
843       const jet2 = put('fighter', 1.8, 2.9, -0.2, 1.95, 1.1);
844       jet2.group.rotation.z = 0.3;
845       put('carrier', 13.6, -0.1, -0.4, 1.2, 1.25);
846       const trailMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false });
847       const trailGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 1);
848       const trail = (v, len) => {
849         const yaw = v.group.rotation.y;
850         const m = new THREE.Mesh(trailGeo, trailMat);
851         m.scale.z = len;
852         m.rotation.y = yaw;
853         m.position.set(v.group.position.x - Math.sin(yaw) * (len / 2 + 0.4), v.group.position.y + 0.18, v.group.position.z - Math.cos(yaw) * (len / 2 + 0.4));
854         scene.add(m);
855       };
856       trail(jet, 4);
857       trail(jet2, 3);
858       trail(bomb, 3.5);
859       const cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(30, w / h, 0.1, 80);
860       cam.position.set(5.2, 3.4, 10.4);
861       cam.lookAt(5.6, 1.3, 0);
862       r.setSize(w, h);
863       // v1.6.1: la portada se dibuja siempre con sus reflejos de siempre, sea cual sea la iluminación del juego.
864       const keepEnv = [GLB_MAT.envMapIntensity, MODEL_MAT.envMapIntensity];
865       GLB_MAT.envMapIntensity = 0.68;
866       MODEL_MAT.envMapIntensity = 1;
867       r.render(scene, cam);
868       GLB_MAT.envMapIntensity = keepEnv[0];
869       MODEL_MAT.envMapIntensity = keepEnv[1];
870       this.coverUrl = r.domElement.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86);
871       hexGeo.dispose();
872       [grass, sand, rock, water.material, trailMat].forEach((m) => m.dispose());
873       trailGeo.dispose();
874       water.geometry.dispose();
875       scene.background.dispose();
876       r.setSize(112, 112);
877     } catch (err) {
878       console.warn('[Thumbs] Sin portada:', err);
879       this.coverUrl = '';
880     }
881     return this.coverUrl;
882   },
883 };

   7 // Partida personalizada: jugadores 2-6, equipos opcionales, monedas iniciales y reglas.
   8 function customMode(c) {
   9   const n = clamp(c.players || 4, 2, 6);
  10   const teams = [];
  11   for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) teams.push(c.teams ? (i < Math.ceil(n / 2) ? 0 : 1) : i);
  12   return {
  13     name: 'Personalizado', players: n, teams, coins: c.coins || START_COINS, energy: c.energy || START_ENERGY,
  14     fog: !!c.fog, speed: c.turbo ? 2 : 1, king: !!c.king, custom: true, strategic: !!c.strategic,
  15   };
  16 }

  18 class Game {

  27     this.fog = !!(opts.fog || mode.fog);
  28     this.creator = !!opts.creator;
  29     // v1.4: regla especial del desafío semanal ('nofactory', 'noair'...).
  30     this.rule = opts.rule || null;
  31     // v1.7: Arsenal estratégico (solo en Personalizado): un uso estratégico por jugador y partida.
  32     this.strategic = !!mode.strategic;
  33     this.elimOrder = [];

  42     this.radZones = [];

  44     this.history = [];

  46     this.removed = [];

  51     this.objDone = {};

  55 
  56     this.kingTime = {};
  57     this.players = [];
  58     for (let i = 0; i < mode.players; i++) {
  59       this.players.push({
  60         id: i, team: mode.teams[i], team0: mode.teams[i], name: PLAYER_NAMES[i], color: PLAYER_COLORS[i],
  61         coins: (i === 0 && opts.startCoins) || mode.coins || START_COINS, energy: mode.energy || START_ENERGY, energyRate: 0,
  62         human: i === 0, alive: true, income: 0, popUsed: 0, popCap: 0, coresKilled: 0,
  63         emergencyUsed: false, dome: null, stratUsed: 0,
  64         stats: { built: 0, trained: 0, lost: 0, kills: 0, earned: 0, captures: 0, upgrades: 0, hitBy: {} },
  65       });
  66     }
  67     // Puntos de captura: el Faro y las Banderas.
  68     this.points = this.map.points.map((pt, i) => {
  69       const c = this.cells[pt.cell];
  70       const point = {
  71         id: i, type: pt.type, def: POINTS[pt.type], cell: pt.cell, x: c.x, z: c.z, y: c.h, alive: true, kind: 'point',
  72         owner: -1, prog: 0, capTeam: -1, contested: false,
  73       };
  74       c.point = point;
  75       return point;
  76     });
  77     this._pointT = 0;
  78     this.chat = [];

  82     // Inicio: Núcleo, 1 Granja, 2.000 monedas y (desde la v0.6) 1 Constructor para arrancar rápido.
  83     for (const p of this.players) {
  84       const home = this.cells[this.map.homes[p.id]];
  85       p.core = this.addBuilding(p.id, 'core', home.i, true);
  86       const sf = this.map.startFarms[p.id];
  87       if (sf >= 0 && !this.cells[sf].bld) this.addBuilding(p.id, 'farm', sf, true);
  88       const spawn = this.freeCellsNear(home.i, 'land', p.id, START_UNITS.length + 1);
  89       START_UNITS.forEach((t, k) => { if (spawn[k] !== undefined) this.addUnit(p.id, t, spawn[k]); });
  90       if (this.mode.tutorial && p.id !== 0) {
  91         // Tutorial: un bot lento con un Núcleo débil para practicar.
  92         p.core.maxHp = 3000;
  93         p.core.hp = 3000;
  94         p.core._w = { ...BUILDINGS.core.weapon, dmg: 8, range: 3 };
  95         p.core._wLv = 1;
  96       }
  97     }
  98     this.recomputeTerritory();
  99     // v1.8: Campo de pruebas: tus productores ya construidos y dos Ingenieros más.
 100     if (mode.sandbox) this.setupSandbox();
 101     this.refreshEconomy();
 102     // Personalidades repartidas según la semilla del mapa: cada bot es distinto.
 103     const order = PERSONALITY_ORDER.slice();
 104     const rng = mulberry32(opts.seed + 77);
 105     for (let i = order.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 106       const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
 107       [order[i], order[j]] = [order[j], order[i]];
 108     }
 109     this.bots = this.players.filter((p) => !p.human).map((p, i) => {
 110       p.persona = opts.personas && opts.personas[p.id] ? opts.personas[p.id] : order[i % order.length];
 111       return new Bot(this, p.id);
 112     });
 113     // v1.8: en el Campo de pruebas el rival no juega.
 114     if (mode.sandbox) this.bots = [];
 115     // Campaña (v0.7): preparación de la misión y seguimiento de su meta.
 116     this.camp = null;
 117     if (opts.mission) Campaign.setup(this);
 118   }

 120   setupSandbox() {
 121     const p = this.players[0];
 122     const home = this.cells[p.core.cell];
 123     for (const t of SANDBOX_BUILDINGS) {
 124       const c = this.cells.filter((x) => !this.placeInvalid(0, t, x.i, true)).sort((a, b) => this.map.dist(a, home) - this.map.dist(b, home))[0];
 125       if (c) this.addBuilding(0, t, c.i, true);
 126     }
 127     for (const ci of this.freeCellsNear(home.i, 'land', 0, 2)) this.addUnit(0, 'engineer', ci);
 128   }

 130   // ---------- consultas básicas ----------
 131   isEnemy(a, b) {
 132     return this.players[a].team !== this.players[b].team;
 133   }

 135   // ---------- alianzas (v1.1, modos de todos contra todos) ----------
 136   alliancesAllowed() {
 137     return !!this.mode.alliances && !this.camp && !this.mode.tutorial;
 138   }

 140   // Fuerza aproximada de un imperio: vida de su ejército y de sus edificios.
 141   strengthOf(pid) {
 142     let s = 0;
 143     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && u.owner === pid && u.def.weapon) s += u.hp;
 144     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.alive && b.owner === pid) s += b.hp * 0.25;
 145     return s;
 146   }

 148   // El bot decide si acepta la alianza; devuelve { ok, text } con su respuesta.
 149   proposeAlliance(from, to) {
 150     const A = this.players[from];
 151     const B = this.players[to];
 152     if (!this.alliancesAllowed()) return { ok: false, text: 'En este modo no hay alianzas' };
 153     if (!B || !B.alive || !A.alive || from === to) return { ok: false, text: 'Ese imperio ya no está' };
 154     if (A.team === B.team) return { ok: false, text: `${B.name} ya es tu aliado` };
 155     A.allyAsk = A.allyAsk || {};
 156     if (this.time - (A.allyAsk[to] ?? -999) < 60) return { ok: false, text: `${B.name}: «Ya te contesté. Pregúntame más tarde.»` };
 157     A.allyAsk[to] = this.time;
 158     const teams = new Set(this.players.filter((p) => p.alive).map((p) => p.team));
 159     if (teams.size <= 2) return this.allyNo(to, 'Solo quedamos nosotros: uno tiene que ganar.');
 160     if (this.time - ((B.hurtBy || {})[from] ?? -999) < 90) return this.allyNo(to, 'Hace poco me atacaste. No confío en ti.');
 161     // Ganas de aliarse: según su forma de ser, si tienen un rival en común más fuerte y si está en apuros.
 162     const base = { aggro: 0.3, admiral: 0.45, builder: 0.65, keeper: 0.55 }[B.persona] ?? 0.5;
 163     const sA = this.strengthOf(from);
 164     const sB = this.strengthOf(to);
 165     let score = base;
 166     const strongest = this.players.filter((p) => p.alive && p.team !== A.team && p.team !== B.team)
 167       .reduce((m, p) => Math.max(m, this.strengthOf(p.id)), 0);
 168     if (strongest > Math.max(sA, sB)) score += 0.25;
 169     if (this.time - (B.underAttackAt ?? -999) < 45) score += 0.2;
 170     if (sA > sB * 2.2) score -= 0.25;
 171     if (score < 0.6) return this.allyNo(to, B.persona === 'aggro' ? 'Yo peleo solo.' : 'Todavía no. Muéstrame que vale la pena.');
 172     this.formAlliance(from, to);
 173     this.say(to, 'Trato hecho: ahora somos aliados. ¡Vamos por los demás!', { force: true, toMe: true });
 174     return { ok: true, text: `${B.name} aceptó la alianza` };
 175   }

 177   allyNo(pid, text) {
 178     this.say(pid, text, { force: true, toMe: true });
 179     return { ok: false, text: `${this.players[pid].name}: «${text}»` };
 180   }

 182   // Une a «b» (y a sus aliados) al equipo de «a».
 183   formAlliance(a, b) {
 184     const ta = this.players[a].team;
 185     const tb = this.players[b].team;
 186     for (const p of this.players) if (p.team === tb) p.team = ta;
 187     this.allianceChanged();
 188     this.emit('alliance', { a, b, ok: true });
 189   }

 191   // «pid» sale de su alianza y vuelve a su equipo de siempre.
 192   breakAlliance(pid, by = pid) {
 193     const p = this.players[pid];
 194     if (!this.alliancesAllowed()) return 'En este modo no hay alianzas';
 195     const mates = this.players.filter((q) => q.id !== pid && q.team === p.team);
 196     if (!mates.length) return 'No tienes aliados';
 197     p.team = p.team0;
 198     // Si su equipo era el de la alianza, los demás toman el equipo del primero de ellos.
 199     if (mates.some((q) => q.team === p.team0)) {
 200       const t = mates[0].team0;
 201       for (const q of mates) q.team = t;
 202     }
 203     this.allianceChanged();
 204     this.emit('alliance', { a: pid, ok: false, by });
 205     return null;
 206   }

 208   allianceChanged() {
 209     // Nadie sigue atacando a un nuevo aliado; la vista compartida se recalcula.
 210     for (const u of this.units) {
 211       if (u.target && u.target.alive !== undefined && !this.isEnemy(u.owner, u.target.owner)) { u.target = null; if (u.state === 'attack') u.state = 'idle'; }
 212       if (u.autoTarget && !this.isEnemy(u.owner, u.autoTarget.owner)) u.autoTarget = null;
 213     }
 214     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.autoTarget && !this.isEnemy(b.owner, b.autoTarget.owner)) b.autoTarget = null;
 215     this.territoryDirty = true;
 216     this.allianceVersion = (this.allianceVersion || 0) + 1;
 217   }

 227   // Mensaje de un bot. Se guarda siempre; la interfaz muestra los que te afectan.
 228   say(pid, text, opts = {}) {
 229     const p = this.players[pid];
 230     if (!p || p.human) return false;
 231     if (!opts.force && this.time - (p.lastSay || -99) < 20) {
 232       // Guarda el mensaje más importante y lo dice en cuanto pueda.
 233       if (opts.queue && (!p.pendingSay || p.pendingSay.opts.queue <= opts.queue)) p.pendingSay = { text, opts };
 234       return false;
 235     }
 236     p.lastSay = this.time;
 237     const me = this.players[0];
 238     const msg = {
 239       pid, text, time: this.time, x: opts.x, z: opts.z, kind: opts.kind || 'info',
 240       ally: p.team === me.team, toMe: !!opts.toMe, public: !!opts.public,
 241     };
 242     this.chat.push(msg);
 243     if (this.chat.length > 60) this.chat.shift();
 244     this.emit('chat', { msg });
 245     return true;
 246   }

 248   // v1.2: mensaje tuyo al chat de aliados; los bots aliados contestan.
 249   playerSay(text) {
 250     const me = this.players[0];
 251     const msg = { pid: 0, text, time: this.time, kind: 'info', ally: true, mine: true, toMe: false, public: false };
 252     this.chat.push(msg);
 253     if (this.chat.length > 60) this.chat.shift();
 254     const replies = {
 255       '¡Gracias!': ['¡De nada!', '¡Para eso estamos!', 'Cuando quieras.'],
 256       '¡Bien hecho!': ['¡Gracias, compañero!', '¡Seguimos así!', '¡Juntos somos fuertes!'],
 257       '¡Cuidado!': ['¡Atento! Pongo defensas.', '¡Visto! Vigilo mi lado.', '¡Gracias por avisar!'],
 258     }[text];
 259     let n = 0;
 260     if (replies) {
 261       for (const p of this.players) {
 262         if (p.id === 0 || !p.alive || p.human || p.team !== me.team) continue;
 263         this.say(p.id, replies[(n + Math.floor(this.time)) % replies.length], { force: true, toMe: true });
 264         n++;
 265       }
 266     }
 267     return n;
 268   }

 270   // Alerta para el jugador con ubicación (para el botón «Ver» y el pulso del minimapa).

 273     this._alertT[key] = this.time;

 278   passable(cell, mover, owner) {
 279     if (mover === 'air') return true;
 280     const T = TERRAIN[cell.t];
 281     const b = cell.bld;
 282     // v1.8: Puente modular: lo cruzan las tropas de tierra y los anfibios (de cualquiera); los barcos ya no pasan.
 283     if (b && b.type === 'bridge') return mover !== 'sea';
 284     // v1.8: anfibios (Infante de marina, Transporte anfibio, Aerodeslizador): tierra y agua poco profunda.
 285     if (mover === 'amphib') {
 286       if (!T.land && !(T.water && cell.t !== 'deep')) return false;
 287     } else if (mover === 'land' ? !T.land : !T.water) return false;
 288     if (b) {
 289       if (b.def.walkable) return true;
 290       // Puerta reforzada: abierta como el Muro (pasan los tuyos y aliados); cerrada, nadie.
 291       if (b.type === 'gate') return !b.closed && !this.isEnemy(b.owner, owner);
 292       return b.type === 'wall' && !this.isEnemy(b.owner, owner);
 293     }
 294     return true;
 295   }
 296 
 297   // v1.8: ¿esta tropa puede «estar» en esa casilla? (para no quedar parada en el agua o en tierra por cortar un borde)
 298   standsOn(u, c) {
 299     if (u.mover === 'air') return true;
 300     const T = TERRAIN[c.t];
 301     if (c.bld && c.bld.type === 'bridge') return u.mover !== 'sea';
 302     if (u.mover === 'amphib') return !!T.land || (!!T.water && c.t !== 'deep');
 303     return !!T[u.mover === 'land' ? 'land' : 'water'];
 304   }
 305 
 306   groundY(u, cell) {
 307     if (u.mover === 'air') return u.dropT > this.time ? 0.3 + (u.dropT - this.time) * 1.6 : 2.3;
 308     if (u.mover === 'sea') return u.cls === 'sub' ? -0.1 : 0.02;
 309     if (cell.bld && cell.bld.type === 'bridge') return 0.29;
 310     // Anfibios en el agua: el barco flota y los soldados y vehículos van medio hundidos.
 311     if (u.mover === 'amphib' && TERRAIN[cell.t].water) return u.cls === 'ship' ? 0.04 : -0.06;
 312     // Paracaidista: baja desde el cielo.
 313     if (u.dropT > this.time) return cell.h + (u.dropT - this.time) * 1.8;
 314     return cell.h;
 315   }

 317   freeCellsNear(ci, mover, owner, count) {
 318     const c0 = this.cells[ci];
 319     const out = [];
 320     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 321       if (off.d === 0 && mover !== 'air') continue;
 322       const c = this.map.get(c0.q + off.q, c0.r + off.r);
 323       if (!c || !this.passable(c, mover, owner)) continue;
 324       out.push(c.i);
 325       if (out.length >= count) break;
 326     }
 327     while (out.length < count) out.push(out[0] ?? ci);
 328     return out;
 329   }

 331   // ---------- A* ----------
 332   findPath(start, goalI, mover, owner) {
 333     const cells = this.cells;
 334     const N = cells.length;
 335     if (!this._g) {
 336       this._g = new Float32Array(N);
 337       this._from = new Int32Array(N);
 338       this._stamp = new Uint32Array(N);
 339       this._closed = new Uint32Array(N);
 340       this._run = 0;
 341     }
 342     const run = ++this._run;
 343     const G = this._g;
 344     const F = this._from;
 345     const S = this._stamp;
 346     const C = this._closed;
 347     const goal = cells[goalI];
 348     const goalOk = this.passable(goal, mover, owner);
 349     const heap = new MinHeap();
 350     S[start] = run;
 351     G[start] = 0;
 352     F[start] = -1;
 353     heap.push(start, 0);
 354     let best = start;
 355     let bestH = this.map.dist(cells[start], goal);
 356     let iter = 0;
 357     while (heap.size) {
 358       const cur = heap.pop();
 359       if (C[cur] === run) continue;
 360       C[cur] = run;
 361       const hc = this.map.dist(cells[cur], goal);
 362       if (hc < bestH) { bestH = hc; best = cur; }
 363       if (cur === goalI || (!goalOk && hc <= 1)) { best = cur; break; }
 364       if (++iter > 5000) break;
 365       for (const ni of cells[cur].nb) {
 366         if (C[ni] === run) continue;
 367         const nc = cells[ni];
 368         if (!this.passable(nc, mover, owner)) continue;
 369         const slow = mover === 'land' ? TERRAIN[nc.t].slow || 1 : 1;
 370         const ng = G[cur] + slow;
 371         if (S[ni] !== run || ng < G[ni]) {
 372           S[ni] = run;
 373           G[ni] = ng;
 374           F[ni] = cur;
 375           heap.push(ni, ng + this.map.dist(nc, goal) * 1.01);
 376         }
 377       }
 378     }
 379     const path = [];
 380     let c = best;
 381     while (c !== -1 && c !== start) {
 382       path.push(c);
 383       c = F[c];
 384     }
 385     path.reverse();
 386     return path;
 387   }

 416   // Arma según el nivel: láser del Núcleo, Air Defense más fuerte, etc.
 417   // Escudo propio de cada edificio (v0.9): 20 % de su vida máxima.
 418   resetShield(b) {
 419     b.shieldMax = Math.round(b.maxHp * BLD_SHIELD.pct);
 420     b.shield = b.shieldMax;

 423   weaponOf(b) {
 424     const d = b.def;
 425     if (!d.weapon) return null;
 426     if (b._wLv === b.level && b._w) return b._w;
 427     let w = d.weapon;
 428     if (d.aaLevel && b.level >= d.aaLevel) {
 429       // Torreta nivel 4: también es antiaérea.
 430       w = { ...w, mult: { ...w.mult, ...d.aaMult } };
 431     }
 432     if (d.levels && d.levels[b.level].laser) {
 433       const L = d.levels[b.level].laser;
 434       w = { ...w, dmg: L.dmg, range: L.range, beams: L.beams };
 435     } else if (b.level > 1) {
 436       w = { ...w, dmg: w.dmg * lvlMult(b.level), range: w.range + (b.type === 'aadef' ? 1 : 0) };
 437     }
 438     b._w = w;
 439     b._wLv = b.level;
 440     return w;
 441   }
 442 
 443   healOf(b) {
 444     const d = b.def;
 445     if (!d.heal) return null;
 446     if (d.healLevels) return { cls: d.heal.cls, pct: d.healLevels[b.level].pct, range: d.healLevels[b.level].range };
 447     if (d.heal.rate) return { ...d.heal, rate: d.heal.rate * lvlMult(b.level) };
 448     return d.heal;
 449   }

 451   // v0.9: cada nivel entrena un 40 % más rápido.
 452   prodRate(b) {
 453     return 1 + 0.4 * (b.level - 1);
