 456   // ---------- creación de entidades ----------
 457   addBuilding(owner, type, ci, instant = false) {
 458     const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 459     const cell = this.cells[ci];
 460     const built = instant || def.build === 0;
 461     const hp0 = this.bMaxHp(def, 1);
 462     const b = {
 463       id: _nextId++, kind: 'bld', type, def, owner, cell: ci, x: cell.x, z: cell.z, y: cell.h, level: 1, upgrading: null,
 464       hp: built ? hp0 : hp0 * 0.1, maxHp: hp0, built, progress: built ? 1 : 0, workAcc: 0, lastWork: -99,
 465       miniCd: [0, 0, 0], shield: 0, shieldMax: 0,
 466       coastal: !!TERRAIN[cell.t].water || cell.nb.some((ni) => TERRAIN[this.cells[ni].t].water),
 467       queue: [], rally: -1, alive: true, cd: 0, scanT: Math.random() * 0.3, autoTarget: null,
 468       onWater: !!TERRAIN[cell.t].water, healT: 0, aimYaw: 0, lastHit: -99, visible: true,
 469       rot: Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) * (Math.PI / 3),
 470       // v1.8: guarnición del Búnker (soldados adentro).
 471       cargo: def.garrison ? [] : null,
 472     };
 473     if (type === 'core' || type === 'harbor') b.rot = 0;
 474     // v1.8: el puente se orienta hacia la tierra más cercana.
 475     if (type === 'bridge') {
 476       const land = cell.nb.map((ni) => this.cells[ni]).find((c) => TERRAIN[c.t].land);
 477       if (land) b.rot = Math.atan2(land.x - cell.x, land.z - cell.z);
 478     }
 479     if (built) this.resetShield(b);
 480     cell.bld = b;
 481     this.buildings.push(b);
 482     if (def.claim) this.territoryDirty = true;
 483     // Aparta a las unidades que estaban sobre la casilla (no hace falta en puentes ni minas).
 484     for (const u of def.walkable ? [] : this.units) {
 485       if (!u.alive || u.cell !== ci || u.mover === 'air') continue;
 486       const free = this.freeCellsNear(ci, u.mover, u.owner, 1)[0];
 487       const fc = this.cells[free];
 488       u.x = fc.x + u.offX;
 489       u.z = fc.z + u.offZ;
 490       u.cell = free;
 491       if (u.state !== 'idle') this.setPath(u, u.dest >= 0 ? u.dest : free);
 492     }
 493     return b;
 494   }
 495 
 496   addUnit(owner, type, ci) {
 497     const def = UNITS[type];
 498     const cell = this.cells[ci];
 499     const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
 500     const rr = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * 0.33;
 501     const u = {
 502       id: _nextId++, kind: 'unit', type, def, owner, cls: def.cls, mover: def.mover, cell: ci,
 503       offX: Math.cos(a) * rr, offZ: Math.sin(a) * rr, x: 0, z: 0, y: 0, hp: def.hp, maxHp: def.hp,
 504       alive: true, state: 'idle', path: [], pathI: 0, dest: -1, target: null, autoTarget: null,
 505       aggroTarget: null, cd: Math.random() * 0.5, scanT: Math.random() * 0.3, yaw: Math.random() * 6,
 506       aimYaw: 0, moveYaw: 0, moving: false, repathT: 0, resume: -1, foundCell: -1, role: 'home',
 507       lastHit: -99, visible: true, inside: null, cargo: def.capacity || def.hangar ? [] : null, boardTarget: null,
 508       buildTarget: null, shield: 0, shieldMax: 0,
 509     };
 510     u.x = cell.x + u.offX;
 511     u.z = cell.z + u.offZ;
 512     u.y = this.groundY(u, cell);
 513     // v1.7: el Lanzador nuclear móvil sale «preparando» y con su único misil sin usar.
 514     if (def.strategic) { u.armAt = this.time + STRATEGIC.prep; u.spent = false; }
 515     // v1.8: investigación «Blindaje»: +10 % de vida a los vehículos.
 516     const res = this.players[owner] && this.players[owner].research;
 517     if (res && res.armor && def.cls === 'veh') { u.maxHp *= 1 + RESEARCH.armor.pct; u.hp = u.maxHp; }
 518     this.units.push(u);
 519     return u;
 520   }
 521 
 522   // ---------- territorio ----------
 523   recomputeTerritory() {
 524     for (const c of this.cells) {
 525       c.owner = -1;
 526       c.ownerD = 99;
 527       c.ownerId = 0;
 528     }
 529     const claimers = this.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.def.claim)
 530       .map((b) => ({ owner: b.owner, cell: b.cell, claim: b.def.claim, id: b.id }));
 531     for (const pt of this.points) {
 532       if (pt.owner >= 0) claimers.push({ owner: pt.owner, cell: pt.cell, claim: pt.def.claim, id: 1e6 + pt.id });
 533     }
 534     for (const b of claimers) {
 535       const bc = this.cells[b.cell];
 536       for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 537         if (off.d > b.claim) break;
 538         const c = this.map.get(bc.q + off.q, bc.r + off.r);
 539         if (!c) continue;
 540         if (off.d < c.ownerD || (off.d === c.ownerD && b.id < c.ownerId)) {
 541           c.owner = b.owner;
 542           c.ownerD = off.d;
 543           c.ownerId = b.id;
 544         }
 545       }
 546     }
 547     // v1.7: territorio máximo de cada jugador en la partida (para el resultado: al perder, el actual siempre es 0).
 548     const land = this.players.map(() => 0);
 549     for (const c of this.cells) if (c.owner >= 0) land[c.owner]++;
 550     for (const p of this.players) p.peakLand = Math.max(p.peakLand || 0, land[p.id] || 0);
 551     this.territoryDirty = false;
 552     this.territoryVersion++;
 553   }
 554 
 555   // ---------- economía ----------
 556   refreshEconomy() {
 557     for (const p of this.players) {
 558       p.income = 0;
 559       p.popCap = 0;
 560       p.popUsed = 0;
 561       p.energyRate = 0;
 562       p.bonus = 0;
 563     }
 564     for (const b of this.buildings) {
 565       if (!b.alive) continue;
 566       const p = this.players[b.owner];
 567       if (b.built) {
 568         p.income += this.bIncome(b);
 569         p.popCap += this.bPop(b);
 570         p.energyRate += this.bEnergy(b);
 571       }
 572       for (const q of b.queue) p.popUsed += UNITS[q.type].pop;
 573     }
 574     for (const pt of this.points) {
 575       if (pt.owner < 0) continue;
 576       const p = this.players[pt.owner];
 577       p.income += pt.def.income;
 578       p.bonus += pt.def.bonus;
 579     }
 580     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive) this.players[u.owner].popUsed += u.def.pop;
 581     for (const p of this.players) {
 582       p.popCap += this.popBonus(p);
 583       if ((this.creator || this.mode.sandbox) && p.id === 0) p.popCap = MAX_POP;
 584       p.popCap = Math.min(MAX_POP, p.popCap);
 585       p.baseIncome = p.income;
 586       p.income = Math.round(p.income * (1 + p.bonus));
 587     }
 588   }
 589 
 590   incomeMult(p) {
 591     return p.human ? 1 : this.diff.income;
 592   }
 593 
 594   count(pid, type) {
 595     let n = 0;
 596     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.alive && b.owner === pid && b.type === type) n++;
 597     return n;
 598   }
 599 
 600   hasBuilt(pid, type) {
 601     return this.buildings.some((b) => b.alive && b.built && b.owner === pid && b.type === type);
 602   }
 603 
 604   // ¿Ve el jugador esa casilla? (con niebla: alguna tropa o edificio de su equipo cerca)
 605   seesCell(pid, c) {
 606     const team = this.players[pid].team;
 607     const near = (e, r) => (e.x - c.x) ** 2 + (e.z - c.z) ** 2 <= (r * SQ3) ** 2;
 608     return this.units.some((u) => u.alive && this.players[u.owner].team === team && near(u, u.def.vision || 3)) ||
 609       this.buildings.some((b) => b.alive && this.players[b.owner].team === team && near(b, b.def.vision || 3));
 610   }
 611 
 612   limitFor(pid, type) {
 613     const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 614     if (type === 'house') return HOUSE_LIMIT + 2 * this.players[pid].coresKilled;
 615     return def.limit || 0;
 616   }
 617 
 618   placeInvalid(pid, type, ci, ignoreCost = false) {
 619     const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 620     const c = this.cells[ci];
 621     const p = this.players[pid];
 622     if (!c) return 'Casilla no válida';
 623     // v1.4: reglas del desafío semanal (solo para ti).
 624     if (pid === 0 && this.rule) {
 625       if (this.rule === 'nofactory' && type === 'factory') return 'Desafío: sin Fábrica';
 626       if (this.rule === 'noair' && (type === 'helipad' || type === 'airport')) return 'Desafío: sin Helipuerto ni Aeropuerto';
 627     }
 628     // v1.8: el Complejo estratégico solo existe con «Arsenal estratégico».
 629     if (def.strategic && !this.strategic) return 'Solo con «Arsenal estratégico»';
 630     // Las estructuras de mar se ponen en su lugar del mar aunque esté fuera de tu territorio (punto 15).
 631     // v1.8: el Puente modular también (si no es territorio enemigo).
 632     if (def.sea || def.anyTerritory) {
 633       if (c.owner >= 0 && c.owner !== pid && this.isEnemy(c.owner, pid)) return 'Es territorio enemigo';
 634     } else if (c.owner !== pid) {
 635       return 'Fuera de tu territorio';
 636     }
 637     if (c.point) return `Aquí está ${c.point.type === 'faro' ? 'el Faro' : 'una Bandera'}`;
 638     if (c.bld) return 'Casilla ocupada';
 639     const reserved = { gold: 'Las vetas de oro son para Minas', fertile: 'La tierra fértil es para Granjas',
 640       oilland: 'El petróleo en tierra es para Bombas de petróleo' };
 641     const nearWater = c.nb.some((ni) => TERRAIN[this.cells[ni].t].water);
 642     if (Array.isArray(def.on)) {
 643       if (!def.on.includes(c.t)) return 'Solo en ' + def.on.map((t) => TERRAIN[t].name.toLowerCase()).join(' o ');
 644     } else if (def.on === 'land' || def.on === 'landcoast') {
 645       if (!TERRAIN[c.t].land) return 'Debe ir sobre tierra';
 646       if (reserved[c.t]) return reserved[c.t];
 647       if (def.on === 'landcoast' && !nearWater) return 'Debe ir en tierra junto al agua';
 648     } else if (def.on === 'coast') {
 649       if (c.t !== 'shallow' || !this.map.isCoast(c)) return 'Debe ir en el agua, junto a la orilla';
 650     } else if (def.on === 'shallowcoast') {
 651       if (c.t !== 'shallow' || !this.map.isCoast(c)) return 'Debe ir en agua poco profunda junto a la costa';
 652     } else if (def.on === 'deep') {
 653       if (c.t !== 'deep') return 'Debe ir en mar profundo';
 654     }
 655     const limit = this.limitFor(pid, type);
 656     if (limit && this.count(pid, type) >= limit) return `Límite alcanzado (${limit})`;
 657     if (!ignoreCost && p.coins < def.cost) return 'Monedas insuficientes';
 658     if (!ignoreCost && def.energyCost && p.energy < def.energyCost) return `Energía insuficiente (${def.energyCost}): construye energías (Solar, Eólica...)`;
 659     return null;
 660   }
 661 
 662   place(pid, type, ci, rot) {
 663     const err = this.placeInvalid(pid, type, ci);
 664     if (err) return err;
 665     const p = this.players[pid];
 666     const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 667     p.coins -= def.cost;
 668     p.energy -= def.energyCost || 0;
 669     const b = this.addBuilding(pid, type, ci);
 670     if (rot !== undefined) b.rot = rot;
 671     // v1.3: el edificio cuenta para las misiones cuando se termina la obra (no al colocarlo).
 672     if (b.built) p.stats.built++;
 673     this.emit('sound', { name: 'place', pid });
 674     if (!this.assignSite(b) && pid === 0) this.warnNoBuilder(b);
 675     return null;
 676   }

 678   // ---------- obras: constructores, ingenieros y barcos constructores ----------
 679   needsWork(b) {
 680     return b.alive && ((!b.built && !b.def.selfBuild && !b.selfBuild && b.type !== 'outpost') || !!b.upgrading);
 681   }
 682 
 683   canBuildSite(u, b) {
 684     const by = b.def.builtBy || 'land';
 685     if (!u.def.builds) return false;
 686     if (by === 'engineer') return u.type === 'engineer';
 687     return u.def.builds === by;
 688   }
 689 
 690   // ¿Puede la unidad llegar a una casilla junto a la obra?
 691   reachesSite(u, b) {
 692     const bc = this.cells[b.cell];
 693     const comp = this.cells[u.cell].comp;
 694     if (bc.comp === comp && TERRAIN[bc.t].water === (u.mover === 'sea')) return true;
 695     return bc.nb.some((ni) => this.cells[ni].comp === comp);
 696   }
 697 
 698   builderFor(b, onlyIdle = true) {
 699     let best = null;
 700     let bd = Infinity;
 701     const bc = this.cells[b.cell];
 702     for (const u of this.units) {
 703       if (!u.alive || u.inside || u.owner !== b.owner || !this.canBuildSite(u, b)) continue;
 704       if (onlyIdle && u.state !== 'idle') continue;
 705       if (u.role === 'cap' || u.role === 'wave') continue;
 706       if (!this.reachesSite(u, b)) continue;
 707       const d = this.map.dist(this.cells[u.cell], bc);
 708       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = u; }
 709     }
 710     return best;
 711   }
 712 
 713   assignSite(b) {
 714     const u = this.builderFor(b);
 715     if (!u) return false;
 716     this.orderBuild([u], b);
 717     return true;
 718   }
 719 
 720   warnNoBuilder(b) {
 721     const by = b.def.builtBy || 'land';
 722     const has = this.units.some((u) => u.alive && u.owner === b.owner && this.canBuildSite(u, b));
 723     const who = by === 'sea' ? 'un Barco constructor (en el Puerto)' : by === 'engineer' ? 'un Ingeniero (en el Cuartel)'
 724       : 'un Constructor (en el Núcleo o el Cuartel)';
 725     const text = has ? 'Obra en espera: tu constructor está ocupado; irá al terminar.' : `Obra en espera: necesitas ${who}.`;
 726     this.alert('nobuilder' + by, text, 'bad', b.x, b.z, 8);
 727   }
 728 
 729   orderBuild(units, b) {
 730     let n = 0;
 731     for (const u of units) {
 732       if (!u.alive || u.inside || !this.canBuildSite(u, b)) continue;
 733       u.state = 'build';
 734       u.buildTarget = b;
 735       u.target = null;
 736       u.repairTarget = null;
 737       u.repathT = 0;
 738       n++;
 739     }
 740     return n;
 741   }
 742 
 743   // Cada segundo: las obras sin nadie reciben al constructor libre más cercano.
 744   assignBuilders() {
 745     const busy = new Set();
 746     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && u.state === 'build' && u.buildTarget) busy.add(u.buildTarget);
 747     for (const b of this.buildings) {
 748       if (!this.needsWork(b) || busy.has(b)) continue;
 749       if (this.assignSite(b)) busy.add(b);
 750     }
 751   }
 752 
 753   // Trabajo de un constructor junto a la obra (se aplica en el siguiente paso del edificio).
 754   workOn(u, b, dt) {
 755     b.workAcc += (u.def.buildRate || 1) * dt;
 756     b.lastWork = this.time;
 757     u.workingAt = this.time;
 758     u.aimYaw = Math.atan2(b.x - u.x, b.z - u.z);
 759     // Martilleo de obra (solo tus constructores suenan).
 760     if (u.owner === 0 && Math.random() < dt * 1.3) this.emit('sound', { name: 'build', x: b.x, z: b.z });
 761     if (Math.random() < dt * 1.5) this.fx.push({ k: 'spark', x: b.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7, y: b.y + 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.4, z: b.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7, s: 0.18 });
 762   }
 763 
 764   demolish(b) {
 765     if (!b.alive || b.type === 'core') return;
 766     const p = this.players[b.owner];
 767     const back = b.built ? 0.4 : 0.75;
 768     p.coins += Math.floor(b.def.cost * back);
 769     p.energy += Math.floor((b.def.energyCost || 0) * back);
 770     for (const q of b.queue) {
 771       p.coins += UNITS[q.type].cost;
 772       p.energy += UNITS[q.type].energy || 0;
 773     }
 774     b.queue = [];
 775     // v1.3: la mejora en curso se devuelve entera (se pagó y no llegó a terminarse).
 776     if (b.upgrading && b.upgrading.paid) p.coins += b.upgrading.paid;
 777     b.upgrading = null;
 778     b.alive = false;
 779     const c = this.cells[b.cell];
 780     if (c.bld === b) c.bld = null;
 781     if (b.def.claim) this.territoryDirty = true;
 782     this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x: b.x, y: b.y + 0.3, z: b.z, s: 0.9 });
 783   }
 784 
 785   foundInvalid(pid, ci, how) {
 786     const c = this.cells[ci];
 787     if (!c || !TERRAIN[c.t].land) return 'Elige una casilla de tierra';
 788     if (c.t === 'gold') return 'No sobre vetas de oro: ponlo al lado';
 789     if (c.point) return 'Ese punto se captura con infantería';
 790     if (c.bld) return 'Casilla ocupada';
 791     if (c.owner >= 0 && this.isEnemy(c.owner, pid)) return 'Es territorio enemigo';
 792     if (how === 'sea' && !c.nb.some((ni) => TERRAIN[this.cells[ni].t].water)) return 'Debe estar en la costa';
 793     return null;
 794   }
 795 
 796   enqueue(b, type) {
 797     const def = UNITS[type];
 798     const p = this.players[b.owner];
 799     if (!b.built) return 'Aún en construcción';
 800     if (!b.def.produces || !b.def.produces.includes(type)) return 'No se produce aquí';
 801     if (b.queue.length >= 5) return 'Cola llena (5)';
 802     if (def.strategic) {
 803       if (!this.strategic) return 'Solo con «Arsenal estratégico» (Personalizado)';
 804       if (this.strategicLeft(b.owner) <= 0) return 'Uso estratégico agotado (0/1)';
 805     }
 806     if (def.limit) {
 807       const have = this.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === b.owner && u.type === type).length +
 808         this.buildings.reduce((s, x) => s + (x.owner === b.owner ? x.queue.filter((q) => q.type === type).length : 0), 0);
 809       if (have >= def.limit) return `Límite alcanzado (${def.limit})`;
 810     }
 811     if (p.coins < def.cost) return 'Monedas insuficientes';
 812     if (def.energy && p.energy < def.energy) return `Energía insuficiente (${def.energy}): construye energías (Solar, Eólica...)`;
 813     this.refreshEconomy();
 814     if (p.popUsed + def.pop > p.popCap) return 'Población llena: construye o amplía Casas';
 815     p.coins -= def.cost;
 816     p.energy -= def.energy || 0;
 817     b.queue.push({ type, t: 0 });
 818     b.lastType = type;
 819     p.popUsed += def.pop;
 820     return null;
 821   }
 822 
 823   cancelQueue(b, idx) {
 824     const q = b.queue[idx];
 825     if (!q) return;
 826     b.queue.splice(idx, 1);
 827     const p = this.players[b.owner];
 828     p.coins += UNITS[q.type].cost;
 829     p.energy += UNITS[q.type].energy || 0;
 830   }
 831 
 832   // Mejoras (punto 6): todos los edificios suben a nivel 3; la Casa a 4. Las hace un constructor.
 833   upgradeCost(b) {
 834     const d = b.def;
 835     const lv = b.level;
 836     if (lv >= d.maxLevel) return 0;
 837     if (d.levels) return d.levels[lv + 1].cost;
 838     if (b.type === 'house') return HOUSE_LEVELS[lv];
 839     return Math.max(50, Math.round(d.cost * LEVEL_UP_COST[lv]));
 840   }
 841 
 842   upgradeInvalid(b) {
 843     if (!b.built) return 'Aún en construcción';
 844     if (b.upgrading) return 'Ya se está mejorando';
 845     if (b.level >= b.def.maxLevel) return b.def.maxLevel === 1 ? 'Este edificio no se mejora' : `${b.def.name}: nivel máximo`;
 846     if (b.def.l4Limit && b.level === 3) {
 847       const n = this.buildings.filter((x) => x.alive && x.owner === b.owner && x.type === b.type && (x.level >= 4 || (x.upgrading && x.upgrading.level >= 4))).length;
 848       if (n >= b.def.l4Limit) return `Solo ${b.def.l4Limit} ${b.def.name} pueden llegar a nivel 4`;
 849     }
 850     if (!this.creator || b.owner !== 0) {
 851       if (this.players[b.owner].coins < this.upgradeCost(b)) return 'Monedas insuficientes';
 852     }
 853     return null;
 854   }
 855 
 856   // v1.0: «Mejorar todo» y «Mejoras automáticas», solo con el Núcleo en nivel 3.
 857   massUpgradeInvalid(pid) {
 858     const p = this.players[pid];
 859     if (!p.core || !p.core.alive || p.core.level < AUTO_UP.coreLevel) return `Necesita el Núcleo en nivel ${AUTO_UP.coreLevel}`;
 860     return null;
 861   }
 862 
 863   // Edificios que todavía se pueden mejorar (sin contar el dinero), del más barato al más caro.
 864   upgradeCandidates(pid) {
 865     const out = [];
 866     for (const b of this.buildings) {
 867       if (!b.alive || b.owner !== pid || !b.built || b.upgrading || b.level >= (b.def.maxLevel || 1)) continue;
 868       const why = this.upgradeInvalid(b);
 869       if (why && why !== 'Monedas insuficientes') continue;
 870       out.push(b);
 871     }
 872     return out.sort((a, c) => this.upgradeCost(a) - this.upgradeCost(c));
 873   }
 874 
 875   // Un clic: pone a mejorar todo lo que alcanza el dinero (del más barato al más caro).
 876   upgradeAll(pid, reserve = 0) {
 877     const why = this.massUpgradeInvalid(pid);
 878     if (why) return why;
 879     const p = this.players[pid];
 880     let n = 0;
 881     let spent = 0;
 882     for (const b of this.upgradeCandidates(pid)) {
 883       const cost = this.upgradeCost(b);
 884       if (p.coins - cost < reserve) continue;
 885       if (typeof this.upgrade(b) === 'string') continue;
 886       n++;
 887       spent += cost;
 888     }
 889     return { n, spent };
 890   }
 891 
 892   // Mejoras automáticas: siguen mejorando hasta dejar todo al máximo, como mucho tantos edificios
 893   // a la vez como Constructores tenga el imperio, y sin bajar de la reserva.
 894   updateAutoUpgrade(dt) {
 895     this._autoUpT = (this._autoUpT || 0) - dt;
 896     if (this._autoUpT > 0) return;
 897     this._autoUpT = AUTO_UP.every;
 898     for (const p of this.players) {
 899       if (!p.alive || !p.autoUpgrade || this.massUpgradeInvalid(p.id)) continue;
 900       const busy = this.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.owner === p.id && b.upgrading).length;
 901       const builders = this.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === p.id && u.def.builds).length;
 902       if (busy >= Math.max(1, builders)) continue;
 903       const b = this.upgradeCandidates(p.id).find((x) => p.coins - this.upgradeCost(x) >= AUTO_UP.reserve);
 904       if (b && typeof this.upgrade(b) !== 'string') {
 905         p.autoUps = (p.autoUps || 0) + 1;
 906         if (p.id === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: `Mejora automática: ${b.def.name} a nivel ${b.level + 1}`, kind: 'info', x: b.x, z: b.z });
 907       }
 908     }
 909   }
 910 
 911   upgrade(b) {
 912     const err = this.upgradeInvalid(b);
 913     if (err) return err;
 914     const p = this.players[b.owner];
 915     const paid = this.upgradeCost(b);
 916     p.coins -= paid;
 917     b.upgrading = { level: b.level + 1, progress: 0, paid };
 918     p.stats.upgrades++;
 919     this.emit('sound', { name: 'place', pid: b.owner });
 920     if (!this.assignSite(b) && b.owner === 0) this.warnNoBuilder(b);
 921     return b;
 922   }
 923 
 924   // Lo que da un edificio en su nivel actual (para la tarjeta «Qué mejoró»).
 925   snapshot(b) {
 926     const w = this.weaponOf(b);
 927     const heal = this.healOf(b);
 928     return {
 929       hp: b.maxHp, income: this.bIncome(b), pop: this.bPop(b), energy: this.bEnergy(b), prod: b.def.produces ? this.prodRate(b) : 0,
 930       dmg: w ? Math.round(w.dmg) : 0, range: w ? w.range : 0, beams: w && w.beams ? w.beams : 1,
 931       guns: b.def.minigun ? Math.max(0, b.level - 1) : 0, aa: !!(b.def.aaLevel && b.level >= b.def.aaLevel),
 932       heal: heal ? Math.round((heal.pct || 0) * 100) : 0, shield: b.shieldMax,
 933     };
 934   }
 935 
 936   upgradeLines(b, before, after) {
 937     const out = [];
 938     const n = (v) => fmt(Math.round(v));
 939     if (after.hp > before.hp) out.push(`Vida ${n(before.hp)} → ${n(after.hp)}`);
 940     if (after.shield > before.shield) out.push(`Escudo ${n(before.shield)} → ${n(after.shield)}`);
 941     if (after.income > before.income) out.push(`Monedas ${n(before.income)} → ${n(after.income)} por min`);
 942     if (after.pop > before.pop) out.push(`Comunidad +${after.pop - before.pop}`);
 943     if (after.energy > before.energy) out.push(`Energía ${before.energy} → ${after.energy} cada 10 s`);
 944     if (after.prod > before.prod) out.push(`Entrena ${Math.round((after.prod / before.prod - 1) * 100)} % más rápido`);
 945     if (after.dmg > before.dmg) out.push(`Daño ${before.dmg} → ${after.dmg}`);
 946     if (after.range > before.range) out.push(`Alcance ${before.range} → ${after.range}`);
 947     if (after.beams > before.beams) out.push('Doble láser');
 948     if (after.guns > before.guns) out.push(`${after.guns} minigun${after.guns > 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
 949     if (after.aa && !before.aa) out.push('Ahora dispara a aeronaves');
 950     if (after.heal > before.heal) out.push(`Cura ${after.heal} % por segundo`);
 951     if (b.type === 'core' && b.level === 3) out.push('Ya puedes comprar la Cúpula');
 952     if (b.type === 'aadef' && b.level === 4) out.push('Puede lanzar el misil nuclear');
 953     if (b.def.levelNames) out.unshift(`Ahora es ${b.def.levelNames[b.level]}`);
 954     return out;
 955   }
 956 
 957   // v0.9: qué daría la próxima mejora (se muestra antes de pagar).
 958   upgradePreview(b) {
 959     if (b.level >= (b.def.maxLevel || 1)) return [];
 960     const before = this.snapshot(b);
 961     const keep = { level: b.level, maxHp: b.maxHp, shieldMax: b.shieldMax };
 962     b.level++;
 963     b.maxHp = this.bMaxHp(b.def, b.level);
 964     b.shieldMax = Math.round(b.maxHp * BLD_SHIELD.pct);
 965     const after = this.snapshot(b);
 966     const lines = this.upgradeLines(b, before, after);
 967     Object.assign(b, keep);
 968     return lines;
 969   }
 970 
 971   finishUpgrade(b) {
 972     const lv = b.upgrading.level;
 973     const before = this.snapshot(b);
 974     b.upgrading = null;
 975     const ratio = b.hp / b.maxHp;
 976     b.level = lv;
 977     b.maxHp = this.bMaxHp(b.def, lv);
 978     b.hp = Math.min(b.maxHp, Math.max(b.hp, b.maxHp * ratio));
 979     this.resetShield(b);
 980     this.refreshEconomy();
 981     this.emit('built', { b, upgraded: true });
 982     if (b.owner === 0) {
 983       const lines = this.upgradeLines(b, before, this.snapshot(b));
 984       this.emit('upgraded', { b, level: lv, lines });
 985       this.emit('toast', { text: `${b.def.name}: nivel ${lv}`, kind: 'good' });
 986       this.emit('sound', { name: 'done' });
 987     }
 988   }
 989 
 990   cargoSlots(t) {
 991     let n = 0;
 992     for (const u of t.cargo) n += u.cls === 'veh' ? 2 : 1;
 993     return n;
 994   }
 995 
 996   orderRepair(units, b) {
 997     let n = 0;
 998     for (const u of units) {
 999       if (!u.alive || !u.def.repairs || u.inside) continue;
1000       u.state = 'repair';
1001       u.repairTarget = b;
1002       u.target = null;
1003       u.repathT = 0;
1004       n++;
1005     }
1006     return n;
1007   }
1008 
1009   repairBuilding(u, b, dt) {
1010     u.aimYaw = Math.atan2(b.x - u.x, b.z - u.z);
1011     if (this.time - b.lastHit < REPAIR.pause) return;
1012     b.hp = Math.min(b.maxHp, b.hp + REPAIR.rate * dt);
1013     if (Math.random() < dt * 2) this.fx.push({ k: 'heal', x: b.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6, y: b.y + 0.6, z: b.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6 });
1014   }
1015 
1016   repairAround(u, dt) {
1017     const uc = this.cells[u.cell];
1018     for (const ci of [uc.i, ...uc.nb]) {
1019       const b = this.cells[ci].bld;
1020       if (b && b.alive && b.built && b.owner === u.owner && b.hp < b.maxHp) {
1021         this.repairBuilding(u, b, dt);
1022         return;
1023       }
1024     }
1025   }
1026 
1027   // ¿Puede esta tropa subir a ese transporte? Jeep y Transporte blindado: solo soldados.
1028   // Portaaviones: solo Cazas (en su hangar).
1029   canBoard(u, t) {
1030     if (!u.alive || u.inside || u === t || !t.alive || this.isEnemy(u.owner, t.owner)) return false;
1031     if (t.def.hangar) return !!u.def.plane && u.type === 'fighter';
1032     // v1.8: Búnker de guarnición: solo tus soldados, en un Búnker terminado.
1033     if (t.kind === 'bld') return !!t.def.garrison && t.built && t.owner === u.owner && u.cls === 'inf';
1034     // v1.8: los anfibios de tierra (Infante de marina) también suben.
1035     if (!t.def.capacity || (u.mover !== 'land' && !(u.mover === 'amphib' && u.cls !== 'ship'))) return false;
1036     if (t.def.carries === 'inf' && u.cls !== 'inf') return false;
1037     if (u.def.capacity) return false;
1038     return true;
1039   }
1040 
1041   capacityOf(t) {
1042     return t.def.capacity || t.def.hangar || t.def.garrison || 0;
1043   }
1044 
1045   orderBoard(units, t) {
1046     for (const u of units) {
1047       if (!this.canBoard(u, t)) continue;
1048       u.state = 'board';
1049       u.boardTarget = t;
1050       u.boardWait = 0;
1051       u.target = null;
1052       u.repathT = 0;
1053     }
1054   }
1055 
1056   // v1.5: recuerda por unos segundos que no puede llegar a ese objetivo.
1057   markUnreach(u, t, secs = 6) {
1058     const un = u.unreach || (u.unreach = {});
1059     for (const k of Object.keys(un)) if (un[k] <= this.time) delete un[k];
1060     un[t.id] = this.time + secs;
1061   }
1062 
1063   isUnreach(u, t) {
1064     return !!(u.unreach && u.unreach[t.id] > this.time);
1065   }
1066 
1067   // v1.4: la tropa que va a subir no llega al transporte (la orilla junto a él está tapada por
1068   // edificios, o el transporte está lejos de la costa): si el transporte está quieto, va a buscarla
1069   // a la orilla libre más cercana a la tropa.
1070   callTransport(u, t) {
1071     if (t.owner !== u.owner || t.inside || t.mover === 'air' || !t.alive) return false;
1072     if (t.state !== 'idle' || (t.path && t.pathI < t.path.length)) return false;
1073     if ((t.pickupT || 0) > this.time) return false;
1074     t.pickupT = this.time + 5;
1075     const uc = this.cells[u.cell];
1076     const tc = this.cells[t.cell];
1077     let best = -1;
1078     let bd = Infinity;
1079     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
1080       if (off.d > 6 || off.d * 4 > bd) break;
1081       const n = this.map.get(uc.q + off.q, uc.r + off.r);
1082       if (!n || n.comp !== uc.comp || !this.passable(n, u.mover, u.owner)) continue;
1083       for (const si of n.nb) {
1084         const s = this.cells[si];
1085         if (s.comp !== tc.comp || (si !== t.cell && !this.passable(s, t.mover, t.owner))) continue;
1086         const d = off.d * 4 + this.map.dist(s, tc) * 0.01;
1087         if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = si; }
1088       }
1089     }
1090     if (best < 0 || best === t.cell) return false;
1091     this.orderMove([t], best);
1092     return true;
1093   }
1094 
1095   board(u, t) {
1096     const need = u.cls === 'veh' ? 2 : 1;
1097     if (this.cargoSlots(t) + need > this.capacityOf(t)) {
1098       this.toast(u.owner, `${t.def.name}: no queda lugar`, 'bad');
1099       u.state = 'idle';
1100       return false;
1101     }
1102     t.cargo.push(u);
1103     u.inside = t;
1104     u.state = 'idle';
1105     u.path = [];
1106     u.boardTarget = null;
1107     u.target = null;
1108     u.autoTarget = null;
1109     if (u.owner === 0) this.emit('sound', { name: 'ready' });
1110     return true;
1111   }
1112 
1113   unload(t) {
1114     if (!t.cargo || !t.cargo.length) return `${t.def.name} va ${t.def.garrison ? 'sin soldados' : 'vacío'}`;
1115     const c0 = this.cells[t.cell];
1116     const spots = [];
1117     const mover = t.def.hangar ? 'air' : 'land';
1118     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
1119       if (off.d > 2) break;
1120       const c = this.map.get(c0.q + off.q, c0.r + off.r);
1121       if (c && this.passable(c, mover, t.owner)) spots.push(c.i);
1122     }
1123     if (!spots.length) {
1124       if (t.mover === 'sea' || t.mover === 'amphib') return 'Acércate a la orilla para desembarcar';
1125       return t.def.airlift ? 'Vuela sobre tierra para bajar a las tropas' : 'No hay lugar para bajar';
1126     }
1127     // v1.8: del avión de transporte bajan en paracaídas.
1128     const para = !!(t.def.airlift && t.def.plane);
1129     t.cargo.forEach((u, i) => {
1130       const ci = spots[i % spots.length];
1131       const c = this.cells[ci];
1132       u.inside = null;
1133       u.cell = ci;
1134       u.x = c.x + u.offX;
1135       u.z = c.z + u.offZ;
1136       u.y = c.h;
1137       u.state = 'idle';
1138       u.path = [];
1139       if (para) u.dropT = this.time + 1.6;
1140     });
1141     const out = t.cargo;
1142     t.cargo = [];
1143     if (t.owner === 0) this.emit('sound', { name: 'order' });
1144     // v1.4: desembarco en otra isla (para el logro «Lobo de mar»).
1145     const home = this.players[t.owner].core && this.cells[this.players[t.owner].core.cell];
1146     if (t.mover === 'sea' && home && out.some((u) => u.mover === 'land' && this.cells[u.cell].comp !== home.comp)) {
1147       const st = this.players[t.owner].stats;
1148       st.landings = (st.landings || 0) + 1;
1149     }
1150     return out;
1151   }
1152 
1153   // ---------- órdenes ----------
1154   setPath(u, dest) {
1155     u.dest = dest;
1156     u.path = u.mover === 'air' ? [dest] : this.findPath(u.cell, dest, u.mover, u.owner);
1157     u.pathI = 0;
1158   }
1159 
1160   spreadDest(u, center, used) {
1161     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
1162       if (off.d > 7) break;
1163       const c = this.map.get(center.q + off.q, center.r + off.r);
1164       if (!c || used.has(c.i) || !this.passable(c, u.mover, u.owner)) continue;
1165       return c.i;
1166     }
1167     return center.i;
1168   }
1169 
1170   // Formación en línea (v0.7): una fila de frente al destino, perpendicular a la dirección de marcha.
1171   // Devuelve una casilla por tropa (ordenadas de izquierda a derecha) y hacia dónde miran.
1172   lineSlots(units, center) {
1173     let cx = 0;
1174     let cz = 0;
1175     for (const u of units) { cx += u.x; cz += u.z; }
1176     cx /= units.length;
1177     cz /= units.length;
1178     let dx = center.x - cx;
1179     let dz = center.z - cz;
1180     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
1181     if (len < 0.5) { dx = 0; dz = 1; } else { dx /= len; dz /= len; }
1182     const px = -dz;
1183     const pz = dx;
1184     const perRow = 10;
1185     const order = [...units].sort((a, b) => (a.x * px + a.z * pz) - (b.x * px + b.z * pz));
1186     const slots = new Map();
1187     const used = new Set();
1188     order.forEach((u, k) => {
1189       const row = Math.floor(k / perRow);
1190       const inRow = Math.min(perRow, order.length - row * perRow);
1191       const off = (k % perRow) - (inRow - 1) / 2;
1192       const x = center.x + px * off * SQ3 - dx * row * SQ3;
1193       const z = center.z + pz * off * SQ3 - dz * row * SQ3;
1194       const c = this.map.atWorld(x, z) || center;
1195       const dest = this.spreadDest(u, c, used);
1196       used.add(dest);
1197       slots.set(u, dest);
1198       // Dentro de su casilla, se para justo sobre la línea (sin salirse de la casilla).
1199       const dc = this.cells[dest];
1200       let ox = x - dc.x;
1201       let oz = z - dc.z;
1202       const ol = Math.hypot(ox, oz);
1203       if (ol > 0.7) { ox *= 0.7 / ol; oz *= 0.7 / ol; }
1204       // v1.3: si con ese desplazamiento la tropa quedaría sobre una casilla que no puede pisar
1205       // (agua para las de tierra, tierra para los barcos), se queda más cerca del centro.
1206       if (u.mover !== 'air') {
1207         const over = this.map.atWorld(dc.x + ox, dc.z + oz);
1208         if (over && over.i !== dest && !this.passable(over, u.mover, u.owner)) {
1209           const k = Math.min(1, 0.33 / (Math.hypot(ox, oz) || 1));
1210           ox *= k;
1211           oz *= k;
1212         }
1213         u.offX = ox;
1214         u.offZ = oz;
1215       }
1216     });
1217     return { slots, face: Math.atan2(dx, dz) };
1218   }
1219 
1220   orderMove(units, ci, attackMove = false, formation = 'block') {
1221     const used = new Set();
1222     const center = this.cells[ci];
1223     const alive = units.filter((u) => u.alive);
1224     const line = formation === 'line' && alive.length > 1 ? this.lineSlots(alive, center) : null;
1225     for (const u of alive) {
1226       const dest = line ? line.slots.get(u) : this.spreadDest(u, center, used);
1227       used.add(dest);
1228       u.faceYaw = line ? line.face : null;
1229       u.target = null;
1230       u.autoTarget = null;
1231       u.aggroTarget = null;
1232       u.state = attackMove ? 'amove' : 'move';
1233       u.resume = attackMove ? dest : -1;
1234       u.leashCell = -1;
1235       u.patrol = null;
1236       this.setPath(u, dest);
1237     }
1238   }
1239 
1240   // v1.4: patrullar entre donde están y el punto elegido.
1241   orderPatrol(units, ci) {
1242     const alive = units.filter((u) => u.alive && !u.inside && u.def.weapon);
1243     this.orderMove(alive, ci, true);
1244     for (const u of alive) {
1245       const dest = u.path.length ? u.path[u.path.length - 1] : ci;
1246       u.patrol = { a: u.cell, b: dest, leg: 1, laps: 0 };
1247       u.state = 'patrol';
1248       u.resume = -1;
1249     }
1250     return alive.length;
1251   }
1252 
1253   // v1.4: «Mantener posición»: se quedan quietas y solo disparan a lo que tienen a tiro.
1254   setHold(units, on) {
1255     for (const u of units) {
1256       if (!u.alive || !u.def.weapon) continue;
1257       u.hold = !!on;
1258       if (on) {
1259         u.patrol = null;
1260         if (u.state === 'attack' || u.state === 'amove') {
1261           u.state = 'idle';
1262           u.path = [];
1263           u.target = null;
1264           u.resume = -1;
1265         }
1266       }
1267     }
1268   }
1269 
1270   orderAttack(units, target) {
1271     for (const u of units) {
1272       if (!u.alive) continue;
1273       u.faceYaw = null;
1274       u.patrol = null;
1275       const w = u.def.weapon;
1276       if (!w || !this.canAttack(u, w, target)) continue;
1277       u.state = 'attack';
1278       u.target = target;
1279       u.resume = -1;
1280       u.repathT = 0;
1281       u.leashCell = -1;
1282     }
1283   }
1284 
1285   orderFound(u, ci) {
1286     const why = this.foundInvalid(u.owner, ci, u.def.founds);
1287     if (why) return why;
1288     u.state = 'found';
1289     u.foundCell = ci;
1290     u.target = null;
1291     this.setPath(u, ci);
1292     return null;
1293   }
1294 
1295   orderStop(units) {
1296     for (const u of units) {
1297       u.patrol = null;
1298       u.state = 'idle';
1299       u.path = [];
1300       u.target = null;
1301       u.resume = -1;
1302     }
1303   }
1304 
1305   // ---------- combate ----------
1306   canAttack(a, w, t) {
1307     if (!t.alive || t.inside || !this.isEnemy(a.owner, t.owner)) return false;
1308     if (t.def.stealth && !(t.seenBy & (1 << this.players[a.owner].team))) return false;
1309     // v1.8: armas que solo atacan un tipo de edificio (el Dragaminas, a las minas) y minas que solo dañan los dragaminas.
1310     if (w.onlyType) return t.type === w.onlyType;
1311     if (t.type === 'seamine') return false;
1312     if (t.kind === 'bld') return w.waterOnly ? !!(t.onWater || t.coastal) : (w.mult.bld || 0) > 0;
1313     if (w.waterOnly) return t.cls === 'ship' || t.cls === 'sub';
1314     return (w.mult[t.cls] || 0) > 0;
1315   }
1316 
1317   coverBetween(a, t) {
1318     const dx = t.x - a.x;
1319     const dz = t.z - a.z;
1320     const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
1321     const steps = Math.ceil(d / 0.8);
1322     for (let i = 1; i < steps; i++) {
1323       const c = this.map.atWorld(a.x + (dx * i) / steps, a.z + (dz * i) / steps);
1324       if (c && TERRAIN[c.t].cover && c.i !== t.cell) return true;
1325     }
1326     return false;
1327   }
1328 
1329   // v1.2: ventaja de altura: desde una meseta se dispara 1 casilla más lejos a lo que está abajo.
1330   heightBonus(a, t) {
1331     if (a.mover === 'air' || a.cell === undefined || !this.cells[a.cell]) return 0;
1332     if (!TERRAIN[this.cells[a.cell].t].highGround) return 0;
1333     if (t && t.cell !== undefined && this.cells[t.cell] && TERRAIN[this.cells[t.cell].t].highGround) return 0;
1334     return 1;
1335   }
1336 
1337   inRange(a, w, t, extraTiles = 0) {
1338     let r = w.range + extraTiles + (w.range >= 2 ? this.heightBonus(a, t) : 0);
1339     const d = Math.hypot(t.x - a.x, t.z - a.z);
1340     const reach = (rr) => rr * SQ3 + (t.kind === 'bld' ? 0.75 : 0.35);
1341     if (d > reach(r)) return false;
1342     if (a.def.losBlock && d > reach(2) && this.coverBetween(a, t)) r = Math.min(r, 2);
1343     // Ocultación: una tropa en bosque solo se ataca de cerca, salvo desde el aire.
1344     if (t.kind === 'unit' && t.mover === 'land' && a.mover !== 'air' && this.cells[t.cell].t === 'forest') r = Math.min(r, 2);
1345     return d <= reach(r);
1346   }
1347 
1348   acquire(a, w, extraTiles, exclude = null) {
1349     const maxD = (w.range + extraTiles + (w.range >= 2 ? this.heightBonus(a, null) : 0)) * SQ3 + 0.8;
1350     // Fuego concentrado (bots desde Normal, v0.8): entre lo que tienen a tiro, primero la tropa
1351     // armada con menos vida; así la eliminan antes en vez de repartir el daño.
1352     const focus = extraTiles === 0 && this.players[a.owner].focusFire;
1353     // Difícil (v1.0): entre lo que tiene a tiro, primero los Constructores y la economía.
1354     const snipe = extraTiles === 0 && this.players[a.owner].snipe;
1355     let best = null;
1356     let bs = Infinity;
1357     // v1.3: enemigos a los que esta tropa no encontró camino hace poco: no los vuelve a perseguir
1358     // (si no, en «Avanzar atacando» cambiaba de estado en cada paso y no se movía).
1359     const unreach = extraTiles > 0 && a.unreach ? a.unreach : null;
1360     const check = (t) => {
1361       if (!t.alive || t.owner === a.owner || t === exclude) return;
1362       if (unreach && (unreach[t.id] || 0) > this.time && !this.inRange(a, w, t, 0)) return;
1363       const dx = t.x - a.x;
1364       const dz = t.z - a.z;
1365       if (Math.abs(dx) > maxD || Math.abs(dz) > maxD) return;
1366       if (!this.canAttack(a, w, t)) return;
1367       const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
1368       if (d > maxD || !this.inRange(a, w, t, extraTiles)) return;
1369       const s = a.def && a.def.prefersBld
1370         ? d + (t.kind === 'bld' ? 0 : 8)
1371         : a.def && a.def.prefersAir
1372           ? d + (t.cls === 'air' ? 0 : 20)
1373         : focus
1374           ? (t.kind === 'bld' ? 1e6 : 0) + (t.def.weapon ? 0 : 5000) + t.hp + (t.shield || 0) + d * 4
1375           : d + (t.kind === 'bld' ? 3 : 0) + (t.def.weapon ? 0 : 1.5);
1376       let sc = s;
1377       if (snipe && !(a.def && (a.def.prefersBld || a.def.prefersAir))) {
1378         if (t.kind === 'unit' && t.def.builds) sc -= focus ? 6000 : 6;
1379         else if (t.kind === 'bld' && t.def.income) sc -= focus ? 5e5 : 1;
1380       }
1381       if (sc < bs) { bs = sc; best = t; }
1382     };
1383     for (const t of this.units) check(t);
1384     for (const t of this.buildings) check(t);
1385     return best;
1386   }
1387 
1388   muzzleY(a) {
1389     if (a.kind === 'bld') return a.y + (a.type === 'core' ? 1.3 : 0.65);
1390     if (a.mover === 'air') return a.y + 0.2;
1391     return a.y + (a.cls === 'inf' ? 0.35 : 0.35);
1392   }
1393 
1394   fire(a, w, t, gun = 0) {
1395     if (a.def.stealth) a.lastShot = this.time;
1396     const dmg = w.dmg * this.dmgMult(a, w, t) * (1 + (a.vet || 0) * VETERAN.dmg);
1397     let sx = a.x;
1398     const sy = this.muzzleY(a) + (gun && a.type === 'turret' ? 0.05 : 0);
1399     let sz = a.z;
1400     if (gun && a.kind === 'bld') {
1401       // Cañones laterales (miniguns o segundo láser) salen un poco a cada lado.
1402       const side = gun % 2 === 1 ? 1 : -1;
1403       const yaw = a.aimYaw || 0;
1404       sx += Math.cos(yaw) * 0.32 * side;
1405       sz -= Math.sin(yaw) * 0.32 * side;
1406     }
1407     const ty = t.kind === 'bld' ? t.y + 0.4 : t.y + (t.cls === 'inf' ? 0.25 : 0.2);
1408     const color = PLAYER_COLORS[a.owner];
1409     if (w.proj === 'ram') {
1410       // v1.7: Dron kamikaze: choca, daña al blanco y a lo que está pegado, y se destruye.
1411       this.damage(t, dmg, a.owner, a);
1412       if (w.splash) this.splashDamage(t.x, t.z, w, a.owner, a, t);
1413       this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x: t.x, y: ty, z: t.z, s: 0.8 });
1414       this.emit('sound', { name: 'boom', x: t.x, z: t.z });
1415       this.players[a.owner].stats.kamikaze = (this.players[a.owner].stats.kamikaze || 0) + 1;
1416       this.kill(a, -1);
1417       return;
1418     }
1419     if (w.proj === 'laser') {
1420       this.fx.push({ k: 'laser', x1: sx, y1: sy, z1: sz, x2: t.x, y2: ty, z2: t.z });
1421       this.damage(t, dmg, a.owner, a);
1422       this.fx.push({ k: 'spark', x: t.x, y: ty, z: t.z, s: 0.4 });
1423     } else if (w.proj === 'bullet' || w.proj === 'bolt' || w.proj === 'flak') {
1424       this.fx.push({ k: 'tracer', x1: sx, y1: sy, z1: sz, x2: t.x, y2: ty, z2: t.z, color, heavy: w.proj !== 'bullet' });
1425       this.damage(t, dmg, a.owner, a);
1426       if (w.proj === 'flak' || w.proj === 'bolt') this.fx.push({ k: 'spark', x: t.x, y: ty, z: t.z, s: 0.35 });
1427     } else {
1428       const speed = w.proj === 'rocket' ? 10 : w.proj === 'shell' ? 12 : w.proj === 'missile' ? 7 : w.proj === 'bomb' ? 3 : 5;
1429       const d = Math.hypot(t.x - sx, t.z - sz);
1430       // Bengalas del Apache: esquiva un misil cada 20 s.
1431       let miss = false;
1432       if (w.proj === 'missile' && t.def.flares && this.time >= (t.flareAt || 0)) {
1433         miss = true;
1434         t.flareAt = this.time + t.def.flares;
1435         this.fx.push({ k: 'flare', x: t.x, y: t.y + 0.4, z: t.z });
1436         if (t.owner === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: `${t.def.name}: bengalas, esquivó un misil`, kind: 'good' });
1437       }
1438       this.projectiles.push({
1439         kind: w.proj, t, dmg, owner: a.owner, src: a, sx, sy, sz, tx: t.x, ty, tz: t.z,
1440         time: 0, dur: Math.max(w.proj === 'bomb' ? 0.6 : 0.12, d / speed), color, miss, w: w.splash ? w : null,
1441       });
1442     }
1443     // Sonido: la minigun de la Torreta suena distinto al cañón.
1444     this.emit('sound', { name: gun && a.type === 'turret' ? 'minigun' : w.proj, x: sx, z: sz });
1445   }
1446 
1447   // v1.8: multiplicador de daño de un arma contra un blanco: clase, drones, defensas y muros, mando cercano,
1448   // investigación «Puntería» y soldados dentro del Búnker.
1449   dmgMult(a, w, t) {
1450     let m = t.kind === 'bld' ? w.mult.bld || 0 : w.mult[t.cls] || 0;
1451     if (w.droneMult && t.def.drone) m *= w.droneMult;
1452     if (w.defMult && t.kind === 'bld' && t.def.weapon) m *= w.defMult;
1453     if (w.wallMult && (t.type === 'wall' || t.type === 'gate')) m = w.wallMult;
1454     let buff = 1 + (a.buffDmg || 0);
1455     const res = this.players[a.owner] && this.players[a.owner].research;
1456     if (res && res.aim && a.cls === 'inf') buff += RESEARCH.aim.pct;
1457     if (a.kind === 'bld' && a.def.garrison && a.cargo) buff += a.cargo.length * a.def.garrisonDmg;
1458     return m * buff;
1459   }
1460 
1461   // v1.7: daño en área (Lanzacohetes múltiple, Dron kamikaze). A los enemigos a «r» casillas del impacto les llega
1462   // la parte «pct» del daño del arma, con el multiplicador de cada uno. No toca a los propios ni a los aliados.
1463   splashDamage(x, z, w, owner, src, except) {
1464     const R = w.splash.r * SQ3;
1465     for (const list of [this.units, this.buildings]) {
1466       for (const e of list) {
1467         if (!e.alive || e === except || e.inside || !this.isEnemy(owner, e.owner)) continue;
1468         if (e.type === 'seamine') continue;
1469         const mult = src && src.alive !== undefined ? this.dmgMult(src, w, e) : e.kind === 'bld' ? w.mult.bld || 0 : w.mult[e.cls] || 0;
1470         if (!(mult > 0) || Math.hypot(e.x - x, e.z - z) > R) continue;
1471         this.damage(e, w.dmg * mult * w.splash.pct, owner, src);
1472       }
1473     }
1474   }
1475 
1476   domeCovers(owner, t) {
1477     const p = this.players[owner];
1478     if (!p.dome || p.dome.hp <= 0 || !p.core.alive) return false;
1479     return Math.hypot(t.x - p.core.x, t.z - p.core.z) <= DOME_LEVELS[p.dome.level].range * SQ3 + 0.5;
1480   }
1481 
1482   unitShieldActive(pid) {
1483     const p = this.players[pid];
1484     return !!(p && p.dome && p.dome.level >= 3 && p.dome.hp > 0 && p.core && p.core.alive);
1485   }
1486 
1487   // v0.9: el escudo personal (Cúpula nivel 3) solo funciona dentro de la Cúpula.
1488   unitShielded(u) {
1489     return this.unitShieldActive(u.owner) && this.domeCovers(u.owner, u);
1490   }
1491 
1492   // Lugares con pelea reciente: la interfaz dibuja un icono de combate (documento pág. 13).
1493   noteFight(t) {
1494     const last = this._fightCell.get(t.cell) || -99;
1495     if (this.time - last < 1) return;
1496     this._fightCell.set(t.cell, this.time);
1497     this.fights.push({ x: t.x, z: t.z, y: t.y, t: this.time, cell: t.cell });
1498     if (this.fights.length > 40) this.fights.shift();
1499   }
1500 
1501   damage(t, dmg, src, srcEnt, nuke = false) {
1502     if (!t.alive || dmg <= 0) return;
1503     if (srcEnt) this.noteFight(t);
1504     // v1.1: quién atacó a quién (para las alianzas).
1505     if (src >= 0 && src !== t.owner && this.players[t.owner]) {
1506       const tp = this.players[t.owner];
1507       tp.hurtBy = tp.hurtBy || {};
1508       tp.hurtBy[src] = this.time;
1509       tp.underAttackAt = this.time;
1510     }
1511     if (t.owner === 0 && srcEnt) {
1512       const k = srcEnt.kind === 'bld' ? 'bld' : srcEnt.type;
1513       const hb = this.players[0].stats.hitBy;
1514       hb[k] = (hb[k] || 0) + dmg;
1515     }
1516     // Escudo personal de las tropas (Cúpula nivel 3).
1517     if (t.kind === 'unit' && t.shield > 0) {
1518       const a = Math.min(t.shield, dmg);
1519       t.shield -= a;
1520       dmg -= a;
1521       t.lastHit = this.time;
1522       if (dmg <= 0) return;
1523     }
1524     // Cúpula: absorbe el daño de barcos, aeronaves y lanzamisiles cerca del Núcleo.
1525     // v1.3: también el del misil nuclear; lo que pase de la vida de la Cúpula sí llega.
1526     if (((srcEnt && (srcEnt.cls === 'ship' || srcEnt.cls === 'sub' || srcEnt.cls === 'air' || srcEnt.type === 'arty')) || nuke) &&
1527       this.domeCovers(t.owner, t)) {
1528       const dome = this.players[t.owner].dome;
1529       const took = nuke ? Math.min(dome.hp, dmg) : dmg;
1530       dome.hp -= took;
1531       dome.lastHit = this.time;
1532       if (dome.hp <= 0) {
1533         dome.hp = 0;
1534         dome.brokenAt = this.time;
1535         this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x: this.players[t.owner].core.x, y: 2, z: this.players[t.owner].core.z, s: 1.2 });
1536         if (t.owner === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: `La Cúpula se rompió. Vuelve en ${DOME.recover} s`, kind: 'bad' });
1537         for (const u of this.units) if (u.owner === t.owner) u.shield = 0;
1538       }
1539       dmg -= took;
1540       if (dmg <= 0) return;
1541     }
1542     // Escudo propio del edificio (v0.9).
1543     if (t.kind === 'bld' && t.shield > 0) {
1544       const a = Math.min(t.shield, dmg);
1545       t.shield -= a;
1546       dmg -= a;
1547       t.lastHit = this.time;
1548       if (dmg <= 0) return;
1549     }
1550     if (t.type === 'core') {
1551       if (t.shieldUntil > this.time) return;
1552       const p = this.players[t.owner];
1553       if (!p.emergencyUsed && t.hp - dmg <= t.maxHp * EMERGENCY.at) {
1554         p.emergencyUsed = true;
1555         t.hp = Math.max(1, Math.min(t.hp, t.maxHp * EMERGENCY.at));
1556         t.shieldUntil = this.time + EMERGENCY.time;
1557         this.emit('toast', { text: t.owner === 0 ? `¡Escudo de emergencia! ${EMERGENCY.time} s de protección`
1558           : `${p.name} activó su escudo de emergencia`, kind: t.owner === 0 ? 'good' : 'info' });
1559         this.emit('sound', { name: 'alarm' });
1560         return;
1561       }
1562     }
1563     t.hp -= dmg;
1564     t.lastHit = this.time;
1565     t.lastAttacker = src;
1566     const victim = this.players[t.owner];
1567     if (t.kind === 'bld' && srcEnt && (srcEnt.cls === 'ship' || srcEnt.cls === 'sub' || srcEnt.cls === 'air' || srcEnt.type === 'arty')) {
1568       victim.navalHitAt = this.time;
1569     }
1570     if (t.owner === 0) {
1571       if (t.type === 'core' && this.time - this._coreWarn > 15) {
1572         this._coreWarn = this.time;
1573         this.alert('core', '¡Tu Núcleo está bajo ataque!', 'bad', t.x, t.z, 0);
1574         this.emit('sound', { name: 'alarm' });
1575       } else if (t.kind === 'bld') {
1576         this.alert('bld', `Atacan tu ${t.def.name}`, 'bad', t.x, t.z, 20);
1577       } else if (this.cells[t.cell].owner === 0) {
1578         this.alert('units', 'Tus tropas pelean en tu territorio', 'bad', t.x, t.z, 25);
1579       }
1580     } else if (src === 0 && !victim.human && !victim.provoked && t.kind === 'bld') {
1581       victim.provoked = true;
1582       const lines = PERSONALITIES[victim.persona].lines.provoked;
1583       this.say(t.owner, lines[Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length)], { toMe: true, force: true });
1584     }
1585     if (t.hp <= 0) {
1586       if (srcEnt && srcEnt.kind === 'unit' && srcEnt.alive && this.isEnemy(srcEnt.owner, t.owner)) this.creditKill(srcEnt, t);
1587       this.kill(t, src);
1588     }
1589   }
1590 
1591   // v1.4: eliminaciones de cada tropa y sus estrellas (veteranas).
1592   creditKill(u, t) {
1593     u.kills = (u.kills || 0) + 1;
1594     const st = this.players[u.owner].stats;
1595     if (t.kind === 'unit' && t.mover === 'air') st.airKills = (st.airKills || 0) + 1;
1596     const stars = VETERAN.kills.filter((k) => u.kills >= k).length;
1597     if (stars > (u.vet || 0)) {
1598       const before = 1 + (u.vet || 0) * VETERAN.hp;
1599       const after = 1 + stars * VETERAN.hp;
1600       const add = u.maxHp * (after / before - 1);
1601       u.maxHp += add;
1602       u.hp += add;
1603       u.vet = stars;
1604       st.bestVet = Math.max(st.bestVet || 0, stars);
1605       this.fx.push({ k: 'heal', x: u.x, y: u.y + 0.6, z: u.z });
1606       if (u.owner === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: `${u.def.name}: ${'★'.repeat(stars)} veterano (${u.kills} eliminaciones)`, kind: 'good', x: u.x, z: u.z });
1607     }
1608   }
1609 
1610   // v1.4: un Constructor o Ingeniero libre repara solo los edificios dañados cercanos.
1611   autoRepairScan(u, dt) {
1612     const p = this.players[u.owner];
1613     if (!p.human || p.autoRepair === false) return;
1614     u.repScanT = (u.repScanT || 0) - dt;
1615     if (u.repScanT > 0) return;
1616     u.repScanT = AUTO_REPAIR.every;
1617     const uc = this.cells[u.cell];
1618     let best = null;
1619     let bd = Infinity;
1620     for (const b of this.buildings) {
1621       if (!b.alive || !b.built || b.owner !== u.owner || b.hp >= b.maxHp * 0.98 || b.upgrading) continue;
1622       const d = this.map.dist(uc, this.cells[b.cell]);
1623       if (d > AUTO_REPAIR.range) continue;
1624       if (this.isUnreach(u, b)) continue;
1625       if (this.units.some((x) => x !== u && x.alive && x.state === 'repair' && x.repairTarget === b)) continue;
1626       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = b; }
1627     }
1628     if (best && bd > 1) {
1629       this.orderRepair([u], best);
1630       u.autoRep = true;
1631       p.stats.autoRepairs = (p.stats.autoRepairs || 0) + 1;
1632     }
1633   }
1634 
1635   kill(e, killer) {
1636     if (!e.alive) return;
1637     e.alive = false;
1638     const big = e.kind === 'bld' ? 1.5 : e.cls === 'inf' ? 0.45 : 0.95;
1639     this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x: e.x, y: e.y + 0.3, z: e.z, s: big, death: true, bld: e.kind === 'bld' });
1640     this.emit('sound', { name: e.kind === 'bld' ? 'bigboom' : e.cls !== 'inf' ? 'boom' : 'hit', x: e.x, z: e.z });
1641     if (killer >= 0 && killer !== e.owner) this.players[killer].stats.kills++;
1642     if (e.kind === 'unit') this.players[e.owner].stats.lost++;
1643     if (e.kind === 'bld') this.players[e.owner].stats.lostBld = (this.players[e.owner].stats.lostBld || 0) + 1;
1644     if (e.kind === 'bld' && e.owner === 0 && this.camp && !this.over) this.camp.lostBld++;
1645     // v1.8: del Búnker los soldados salen vivos; de los transportes que caen, no.
1646     if (e.cargo && e.def.garrison && e.cargo.length) this.unload(e);
1647     else if (e.cargo) for (const c of e.cargo) this.kill(c, killer);
1648     if (e.kind === 'bld') {
1649       const c = this.cells[e.cell];
1650       if (c.bld === e) c.bld = null;
1651       if (e.def.claim) this.territoryDirty = true;
1652       if (e.type === 'core') this.eliminate(e.owner, killer);
1653       else if (e.owner === 0) {
1654         this.emit('toast', { text: `Perdiste: ${e.def.name}`, kind: 'bad', x: e.x, z: e.z });
1655         this.emit('ping', { x: e.x, z: e.z, kind: 'bad' });
1656       }
1657     }
1658   }
1659 
1660   eliminate(pid, killer) {
1661     const p = this.players[pid];
1662     if (!p.alive) return;
1663     p.alive = false;
1664     this.elimOrder.push({ pid, time: this.time, killer });
1665     if (killer >= 0 && killer !== pid) this.players[killer].coresKilled++;
1666     if (!p.human && p.persona) {
1667       const lines = PERSONALITIES[p.persona].lines.fall;
1668       this.say(pid, lines[Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length)], { force: true, public: true });
1669     }
1670     for (const pt of this.points) {
1671       if (pt.owner === pid) {
1672         pt.owner = -1;
1673         pt.prog = 0;
1674         pt.capTeam = -1;
1675         this.territoryDirty = true;
1676       }
1677     }
1678     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && u.owner === pid) this.kill(u, -1);
1679     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.alive && b.owner === pid) this.kill(b, -1);
1680     this.emit('toast', { text: pid === 0 ? 'Tu Núcleo ha caído' : `${p.name} ha sido eliminado`, kind: pid === 0 ? 'bad' : 'good' });
1681     if (killer === 0 && pid !== 0) this.completeObjective('kill');
1682     this.checkEnd();
1683   }
1684 
1685   endKing(team) {
1686     if (this.over) return;
1687     this.over = true;
1688     this.result = team === this.players[0].team ? 'victory' : 'defeat';
1689     this.kingWinner = team;
1690     this.emit('over', { result: this.result, king: true });
1691   }
1692 
1693   checkEnd() {
1694     if (this.over) return;
1695     const me = this.players[0];
1696     const alive = this.players.filter((p) => p.alive);
1697     const teams = new Set(alive.map((p) => p.team));
1698     // v1.1: si solo quedan aliados de una alianza hecha en la partida, la alianza se rompe: gana uno solo.
1699     if (alive.length > 1 && teams.size <= 1 && this.alliancesAllowed() && new Set(alive.map((p) => p.team0)).size > 1) {
1700       for (const p of alive) p.team = p.team0;
1701       this.allianceChanged();
1702       const bot = alive.find((p) => !p.human);
1703       if (bot) this.say(bot.id, 'Solo quedamos nosotros: se acabó la alianza. ¡Que gane el mejor!', { force: true, public: true });
1704       this.emit('toast', { text: 'La alianza se rompió: solo puede quedar un imperio', kind: 'bad' });
1705       return;
1706     }
1707     // v1.1: espectador. Ya perdiste; la partida sigue hasta que queda un solo equipo.
1708     if (this.spectating) {
1709       if (teams.size <= 1) {
1710         this.over = true;
1711         this.spectating = false;
1712         this.spectateWinner = alive.length ? alive[0].id : -1;
1713         this.emit('over', { result: this.result, spectated: true });
1714       }
1715       return;
1716     }
1717     if (!me.alive) {
1718       this.over = true;
1719       this.result = 'defeat';
1720     } else if (teams.size <= 1) {
1721       this.over = true;
1722       this.result = 'victory';
1723     }
1724     if (this.over) this.emit('over', { result: this.result });
1725   }
1726 
1727   // Al perder, se puede seguir mirando si todavía pelean dos equipos o más.
1728   canSpectate() {
1729     if (this.result !== 'defeat' || this.camp || this.mode.tutorial) return false;
1730     return new Set(this.players.filter((p) => p.alive).map((p) => p.team)).size > 1;
1731   }

1733   startSpectating() {

1740   completeObjective(id) {
1741     if (this.objDone[id]) return;

1746   // ---------- simulación ----------
1747   update(rawDt) {
1748     const dt = Math.min(rawDt, 0.1) * this.speed;
1749     if (dt <= 0) return;
1750     this.time += dt;
1751 
1752     this._slowT -= dt;
1753     if (this._slowT <= 0) {
1754       this._slowT = 0.5;
1755       this.refreshEconomy();
1756       this.checkObjectives();
1757       for (const p of this.players) {
1758         if (p.pendingSay && p.alive && this.time - (p.lastSay || -99) >= 20) {
1759           const { text, opts } = p.pendingSay;
1760           p.pendingSay = null;
1761           this.say(p.id, text, { ...opts, queue: 0 });
1762         }
1763       }
1764     }
1765     if (this.creator) {
1766       // Modo creador: monedas y energía infinitas para el jugador.
1767       this.players[0].coins = 999999;
1768       this.players[0].energy = 99999;
1769     }
1770     this._assignT -= dt;
1771     if (this._assignT <= 0) {
1772       this._assignT = 1;
1773       this.assignBuilders();
1774     }
1775     for (const p of this.players) {
1776       if (!p.alive) continue;
1777       const inc = (p.income / 60) * dt * this.incomeMult(p);
1778       p.coins += inc;
1779       p.stats.earned += inc;
1780       p.energy += (p.energyRate / 10) * dt;
1781       if (p.dome && p.dome.hp <= 0 && this.time - p.dome.brokenAt >= DOME.recover) {
1782         p.dome.hp = p.dome.maxHp;
1783         if (p.id === 0) this.emit('toast', { text: 'La Cúpula volvió a levantarse', kind: 'good' });
1784       }
1785     }
1786     this.updatePoints(dt);
1787     this.updateAuras(dt);
1788 
1789     for (let i = 0; i < this.buildings.length; i++) {
1790       const b = this.buildings[i];
1791       if (b.alive) this.updateBuilding(b, dt);
1792     }
1793     for (let i = 0; i < this.units.length; i++) {
1794       const u = this.units[i];
1795       if (u.alive) this.updateUnit(u, dt);
1796     }
1797     this.updateProjectiles(dt);
1798     this.updateRadiation(dt);
1799     this.updateAutoUpgrade(dt);
1800     this.recordHistory(dt);
1801     if (!this.over && this.bots.length) {
1802       // Como mucho un bot piensa por paso; el turno rota para que ninguno se quede esperando.
1803       const n = this.bots.length;
1804       this._botTurn = ((this._botTurn || 0) + 1) % n;
1805       let busy = false;
1806       for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) busy = this.bots[(this._botTurn + k) % n].update(dt, busy) || busy;
1807     }
1808     if (this.camp) Campaign.update(this, dt);
1809 
1810     if (this.units.some((u) => !u.alive)) {
1811       for (const u of this.units) if (!u.alive) this.removed.push(u);
1812       this.units = this.units.filter((u) => u.alive);
1813     }
1814     if (this.buildings.some((b) => !b.alive)) {
1815       for (const b of this.buildings) if (!b.alive) this.removed.push(b);
1816       this.buildings = this.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive);
1817     }
1818     if (this.territoryDirty) this.recomputeTerritory();
1819 
1820     this._fogT -= dt;
1821     if (this._fogT <= 0) {
1822       this._fogT = 0.3;
1823       this.updateVisibility();
1824     }
1825   }

1827   checkObjectives() {
1828     if (this.count(0, 'farm') && this.buildings.some((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.type === 'farm' && b.built)) this.completeObjective('farm');
1829     if (this.buildings.some((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.type === 'barracks' && b.built)) this.completeObjective('barracks');
1830     const army = this.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.def.weapon).length;
1831     if (army >= 5) this.completeObjective('army');
1832     // v1.3: ya empiezas con un Constructor; el objetivo es entrenar otro.
1833     if ((this.players[0].stats.builders || 0) > 0) this.completeObjective('builder');
1834     if (this.buildings.some((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.def.cat === 'energy' && b.built)) this.completeObjective('energy');
1835     if (this.points.some((pt) => pt.owner === 0)) this.completeObjective('capture');
1836     // v1.3: pasos del tutorial de tu documento.
1837     if (this.mode.tutorial) {
1838       const done = (t) => this.buildings.filter((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.alive && b.built && t(b)).length;
1839       if (done((b) => b.type === 'farm') >= 2 && done((b) => b.def.cat === 'energy') >= 1) this.completeObjective('tut_build');
1840       const soldiers = this.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive && u.cls === 'inf' && u.def.weapon).length;
1841       if (done((b) => b.type === 'barracks') >= 1 && soldiers >= 3) this.completeObjective('tut_army');
1842     }
1843   }

1845   // Cúpula (puntos 5 y 6): pide Núcleo nivel 3; sube de nivel 1 a 3.
1846   domeCost(pid) {
1847     const p = this.players[pid];
1848     const next = p.dome ? p.dome.level + 1 : 1;
1849     return next <= 3 ? DOME_LEVELS[next].cost : 0;
1850   }
1851 
1852   domeInvalid(pid) {
1853     const p = this.players[pid];
1854     if (!p.core.alive || p.core.level < 3) return 'Mejora el Núcleo a nivel 3 para comprar la Cúpula';
1855     if (p.dome && p.dome.level >= 3) return 'La Cúpula ya está en nivel 3';
1856     if (!(this.creator && pid === 0) && p.coins < this.domeCost(pid)) return 'Monedas insuficientes';
1857     return null;
1858   }
1859 
1860   buyDome(pid) {
1861     const err = this.domeInvalid(pid);
1862     if (err) return err;
1863     const p = this.players[pid];
1864     p.coins -= this.domeCost(pid);
1865     const lv = p.dome ? p.dome.level + 1 : 1;
1866     const L = DOME_LEVELS[lv];
1867     p.dome = { level: lv, hp: L.hp, maxHp: L.hp, brokenAt: -99, lastHit: -99 };
1868     if (L.unitShield) {
1869       for (const u of this.units) {
1870         if (u.alive && u.owner === pid) {
1871           u.shieldMax = u.maxHp * L.unitShield;
1872           u.shield = u.shieldMax;
1873         }
1874       }
1875     }
1876     this.emit('sound', { name: 'done', pid });
1877     return null;
1878   }

1880   // ---------- captura de puntos ----------
1881   updatePoints(dt) {
1882     this._pointT -= dt;
1883     if (this._pointT > 0) return;
1884     const step = 0.25 - this._pointT;
1885     this._pointT = 0.25;
1886     const nearD = CAPTURE.near * SQ3 + 0.5;
1887     const clearD = CAPTURE.clear * SQ3 + 0.5;
1888     for (const pt of this.points) {
1889       const near = new Map();
1890       const close = new Set();
1891       const fastCap = new Map();
1892       for (const u of this.units) {
1893         if (!u.alive || u.inside) continue;
1894         const d = Math.hypot(u.x - pt.x, u.z - pt.z);
1895         if (d > clearD) continue;
1896         const team = this.players[u.owner].team;
1897         close.add(team);
1898         if (d <= nearD && u.cls === 'inf') {
1899           if (!near.has(team)) near.set(team, u.owner);
1900           // v1.8: el Explorador captura más rápido.
1901           if (u.def.captureMult) fastCap.set(team, Math.max(fastCap.get(team) || 1, u.def.captureMult));
1902         }
1903       }
1904       const ownerTeam = pt.owner >= 0 ? this.players[pt.owner].team : -1;
1905       pt.contested = close.size > 1;
1906       if (pt.contested) continue;
1907       if (near.size === 1) {
1908         const [team, pid] = [...near.entries()][0];
1909         const k = (step / CAPTURE.time) * (fastCap.get(team) || 1);
1910         if (team === ownerTeam) {
1911           pt.prog = Math.min(1, pt.prog + k);
1912         } else if (pt.owner >= 0) {
1913           pt.prog -= k;
1914           if (pt.prog <= 0) {
1915             const lost = pt.owner;
1916             pt.owner = -1;
1917             pt.prog = 0;
1918             pt.capTeam = team;
1919             this.territoryDirty = true;
1920             if (this.players[lost].team === this.players[0].team) {
1921               this.alert('pt' + pt.id, `Perdiste ${pt.type === 'faro' ? 'el Faro' : 'una Bandera'}`, 'bad', pt.x, pt.z, 0);
1922             }
1923           }
1924         } else {
1925           if (pt.capTeam !== team) {
1926             pt.capTeam = team;
1927             pt.prog = 0;
1928           }
1929           pt.prog += k;
1930           if (pt.prog >= 1) {
1931             pt.prog = 1;
1932             pt.owner = pid;
1933             this.players[pid].stats.captures++;
1934             if (pt.type === 'faro') this.players[pid].stats.faro = (this.players[pid].stats.faro || 0) + 1;
1935             this.territoryDirty = true;
1936             this.refreshEconomy();
1937             const what = pt.type === 'faro' ? 'el Faro' : 'una Bandera';
1938             const capP = this.players[pid];
1939             if (!capP.human && capP.persona) {
1940               if (capP.team === this.players[0].team) {
1941                 this.say(pid, pt.type === 'faro' ? ALLY_LINES.faro : ALLY_LINES.flag, { x: pt.x, z: pt.z });
1942               } else if (pt.type === 'faro') {
1943                 const lines = PERSONALITIES[capP.persona].lines.faro;
1944                 this.say(pid, lines[Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length)], { x: pt.x, z: pt.z, public: true, force: true });
1945               }
1946             }
1947             if (this.players[pid].team === this.players[0].team) {
1948               this.emit('toast', { text: pid === 0 ? `¡Capturaste ${what}!` : `${this.players[pid].name} capturó ${what}`, kind: 'good' });
1949               if (pid === 0) this.emit('sound', { name: 'capture' });
1950               this.emit('sound', { name: 'done' });
1951             } else if (pt.type === 'faro') {
1952               this.emit('toast', { text: `${this.players[pid].name} capturó el Faro`, kind: 'bad', x: pt.x, z: pt.z });
1953               this.emit('ping', { x: pt.x, z: pt.z, kind: 'bad' });
1954             }
1955           }
1956         }
1957       } else if (pt.owner < 0 && pt.prog > 0 && near.size === 0) {
1958         pt.prog = Math.max(0, pt.prog - step / (CAPTURE.time * 2));
1959       }
1960     }
1961     if (this.mode.king && !this.over) {
1962       const faro = this.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
1963       if (faro && faro.owner >= 0) {
1964         const team = this.players[faro.owner].team;
1965         this.kingTime[team] = (this.kingTime[team] || 0) + step;
1966         if (this.kingTime[team] >= KING_TIME) this.endKing(team);
1967       }
1968     }
1969   }

1971   updateStealth() {
1972     const detR = (3 * SQ3 + 0.5) ** 2;
1973     // v1.8: detectores con alcance propio («detect» en casillas): radares, patrulleras, perro robot, torre…
1974     const dets = [];
1975     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && !u.inside && u.def.detect) dets.push(u);
1976     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.alive && b.built && b.def.detect) dets.push(b);
1977     const stealthy = this.units.filter((s) => s.alive && s.def.stealth);
1978     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.alive && b.def.stealth) stealthy.push(b);
1979     for (const s of stealthy) {
1980       if (this.time - (s.lastShot || -99) < 3) {
1981         s.seenBy = 0xff;
1982         continue;
1983       }
1984       let mask = 1 << this.players[s.owner].team;
1985       const check = (e) => {
1986         if (!e.alive || !this.isEnemy(e.owner, s.owner)) return;
1987         const dx = e.x - s.x;
1988         const dz = e.z - s.z;
1989         if (dx * dx + dz * dz <= detR) mask |= 1 << this.players[e.owner].team;
1990       };
1991       for (const u of this.units) if (u.def.detects) check(u);
1992       for (const b of this.buildings) {
1993         if (!b.built) continue;
1994         // Puertos ven submarinos; AIR DEFENSE y Torretas de nivel 4 ven al bombardero furtivo de cerca.
1995         if (b.type === 'harbor' && (s.mover === 'sea' || s.type === 'seamine')) check(b);
1996         else if (s.mover === 'air' && (b.type === 'aadef' || (b.def.aaLevel && b.level >= b.def.aaLevel))) check(b);
1997       }
1998       for (const e of dets) {
1999         if (!e.alive || !this.isEnemy(e.owner, s.owner)) continue;
2000         const R = (e.def.detect * SQ3 + 0.5) ** 2;
2001         if ((e.x - s.x) ** 2 + (e.z - s.z) ** 2 <= R) mask |= 1 << this.players[e.owner].team;
2002       }
2003       s.seenBy = mask;
2004     }
2005   }
2006 
2007   updateVisibility() {
2008     const fog = this.fog;
2009     const myTeam = this.players[0].team;
2010     this.updateStealth();
2011     const stealthy = (u) => u.def.stealth && !(u.seenBy & (1 << myTeam));
2012     // v1.8: minas: solo se ven si son tuyas, de tu equipo o las descubrió un detector.
2013     for (const b of this.buildings) {
2014       if (b.def.stealth) b.visible = this.players[b.owner].team === myTeam || !!(b.seenBy & (1 << myTeam));
2015     }
2016     if (!fog) {
2017       for (const u of this.units) u.visible = !u.inside && !stealthy(u);
2018       return;
2019     }
2020     const eyes = [];
2021     for (const u of this.units) {
2022       if (this.players[u.owner].team === myTeam) eyes.push([u.x, u.z, (((u.def.vision || (u.def.weapon ? u.def.weapon.range + 1.5 : 3)) + this.heightBonus(u, null)) * SQ3) ** 2]);
2023     }
2024     for (const b of this.buildings) {
2025       if (this.players[b.owner].team === myTeam) eyes.push([b.x, b.z, ((b.def.vision || 3) * SQ3) ** 2]);
2026     }
2027     for (const u of this.units) {
2028       if (u.inside) { u.visible = false; continue; }
2029       if (this.players[u.owner].team === myTeam) { u.visible = true; continue; }
2030       if (stealthy(u)) { u.visible = false; continue; }
2031       const inForest = u.mover === 'land' && this.cells[u.cell].t === 'forest';
2032       const forestR = (2 * SQ3 + 0.4) ** 2;
2033       let vis = false;
2034       for (const e of eyes) {
2035         const dx = u.x - e[0];
2036         const dz = u.z - e[1];
2037         if (dx * dx + dz * dz <= (inForest ? Math.min(e[2], forestR) : e[2])) { vis = true; break; }
2038       }
2039       u.visible = vis;
2040     }
2041   }

2043   updateBuilding(b, dt) {
2044     const def = b.def;
2045     // El trabajo de los constructores llega en workAcc; el Puesto avanzado se levanta solo.
2046     const work = b.type === 'outpost' || b.selfBuild || this.creator && b.owner === 0 && this.opts.instantBuild ? dt * 3 : b.workAcc;
2047     b.workAcc = 0;
2048     b.helped = work > 0;
2049     if (b.upgrading) {
2050       b.upgrading.progress += work / (def.build * 0.5);
2051       if (b.upgrading.progress >= 1) this.finishUpgrade(b);
2052     }
2053     if (!b.built) {
2054       b.progress += work / def.build;
2055       b.hp = Math.min(b.maxHp, b.hp + (b.maxHp * 0.9 * work) / def.build);
2056       if (b.progress >= 1) {
2057         b.progress = 1;
2058         b.built = true;
2059         b.builtAt = this.time;
2060         this.players[b.owner].stats.built++;
2061         this.resetShield(b);
2062         this.emit('built', { b });
2063         if (b.owner === 0) {
2064           this.emit('toast', { text: `${def.name} ${def.fem ? 'terminada' : 'terminado'}`, kind: 'good' });
2065           this.emit('sound', { name: 'done' });
2066         }
2067       }
2068       return;
2069     }
2070     // Escudo propio: se recarga si nadie lo ataca durante 8 s.
2071     if (b.shield < b.shieldMax && this.time - b.lastHit > BLD_SHIELD.delay) {
2072       b.shield = Math.min(b.shieldMax, b.shield + b.shieldMax * BLD_SHIELD.regen * dt);
2073     }
2074     if (b.queue.length) {
2075       const q = b.queue[0];
2076       q.t += dt * this.prodRate(b);
2077       if (q.t >= UNITS[q.type].build) {
2078         b.queue.shift();
2079         this.spawnFrom(b, q.type);
2080       }
2081     }
2082     // v1.4: producción continua: con la cola vacía vuelve a poner la última tropa si alcanza el dinero,
2083     // la energía y la comunidad; si no, espera sin gastar.
2084     if (b.loop && b.lastType && !b.queue.length) {
2085       b.loopT = (b.loopT || 0) - dt;
2086       if (b.loopT <= 0) {
2087         b.loopT = LOOP_TRAIN.every;
2088         const err = this.enqueue(b, b.lastType);
2089         b.loopWait = err || null;
2090         if (!err) this.players[b.owner].stats.looped = (this.players[b.owner].stats.looped || 0) + 1;
2091       }
2092     }
2093     if (def.mine) this.updateMine(b, dt);
2094     if (b.researching) this.updateResearch(b, dt);
2095     const w = this.weaponOf(b);
2096     if (w) {
2097       b.cd -= dt;
2098       b.scanT -= dt;
2099       if (b.scanT <= 0) {
2100         b.scanT = 0.3;
2101         b.autoTarget = this.acquire(b, w, 0);
2102         b.autoTarget2 = w.beams > 1 ? this.acquire(b, w, 0, b.autoTarget) : null;
2103       }
2104       const t = b.autoTarget;
2105       // AIR DEFENSE (v0.9): el radar fija cada blanco nuevo antes de lanzar.
2106       if (w.lock) {
2107         if (t !== b.lockOn) {
2108           b.lockOn = t && t.alive ? t : null;
2109           b.lockT = w.lock;
2110         }
2111         b.lockT -= dt;
2112       }
2113       if (b.salvoLeft > 0) {
2114         b.salvoT -= dt;
2115         const st = b.salvoTarget;
2116         if (b.salvoT <= 0) {
2117           if (st && st.alive && this.inRange(b, w, st)) this.fire(b, w, st, b.salvoLeft);
2118           b.salvoLeft--;
2119           b.salvoT = 0.22;
2120         }
2121       }
2122       if (t && t.alive && this.inRange(b, w, t)) {
2123         b.aimYaw = Math.atan2(t.x - b.x, t.z - b.z);
2124         if (b.cd <= 0 && !(w.lock && b.lockT > 0)) {
2125           if (w.salvo > 1) {
2126             b.salvoLeft = w.salvo - 1;
2127             b.salvoT = 0.22;
2128             b.salvoTarget = t;
2129             b.lastLaunch = this.time;
2130           }
2131           this.fire(b, w, t);
2132           // Núcleo nivel 3: segundo láser (a otro enemigo si lo hay).
2133           if (w.beams > 1) {
2134             const t2 = b.autoTarget2 && b.autoTarget2.alive && this.inRange(b, w, b.autoTarget2) ? b.autoTarget2 : t;
2135             if (t2.alive) this.fire(b, w, t2, 1);
2136           }
2137           // v1.8: la interferencia enemiga (Avión de apoyo electrónico) hace que las defensas disparen más lento.
2138           b.cd = w.cd * (1 + (b.jam || 0));
2139         }
2140       }
2141     }
2142     // Torreta nivel 2: 1 minigun; nivel 3: 2; nivel 4: 3 con más daño y tiro antiaéreo.
2143     const mg = def.minigun;
2144     if (mg && b.level > 1) {
2145       const guns = b.level - 1;
2146       const aa = def.aaLevel && b.level >= def.aaLevel;
2147       const mw = aa ? { ...mg, dmg: mg.dmg * 1.5, mult: { ...mg.mult, ...def.aaMiniMult }, proj: 'bullet' } : { ...mg, proj: 'bullet' };
2148       for (let gi = 0; gi < guns; gi++) {
2149         b.miniCd[gi] = (b.miniCd[gi] || 0) - dt;
2150         if (b.miniCd[gi] > 0) continue;
2151         const mt = b.autoTarget && b.autoTarget.alive && this.canAttack(b, mw, b.autoTarget) && this.inRange(b, mw, b.autoTarget)
2152           ? b.autoTarget : this.acquire(b, mw, 0);
2153         if (!mt) continue;
2154         this.fire(b, mw, mt, gi + 1);
2155         b.miniCd[gi] = mg.cd;
2156       }
2157     }
2158     const heal = this.healOf(b);
2159     if (heal) {
2160       b.healT -= dt;
2161       if (b.healT <= 0) {
2162         b.healT = 0.5;
2163         const rr = (heal.range * SQ3 + 0.4) ** 2;
2164         for (const u of this.units) {
2165           if (!u.alive || u.inside || this.isEnemy(u.owner, b.owner) || !heal.cls.includes(u.cls) || u.hp >= u.maxHp) continue;
2166           if (heal.droneOnly && !u.def.drone) continue;
2167           const dx = u.x - b.x;
2168           const dz = u.z - b.z;
2169           if (dx * dx + dz * dz > rr) continue;
2170           u.hp = Math.min(u.maxHp, u.hp + (heal.rate ? heal.rate * 0.5 : heal.pct * u.maxHp * 0.5));
2171           if (Math.random() < 0.25) this.fx.push({ k: 'heal', x: u.x, y: u.y + 0.5, z: u.z });
2172         }
2173       }
2174     }
2175   }

2177   spawnFrom(b, type) {
2178     const def = UNITS[type];
2179     // v1.8: el Paracaidista cae en paracaídas en el punto de reunión si tienes Aeropuerto militar y ves esa casilla.
2180     const rc = b.rally >= 0 ? this.cells[b.rally] : null;
2181     const drop = def.para && rc && TERRAIN[rc.t].land && this.passable(rc, 'land', b.owner) && this.hasBuilt(b.owner, 'airport') &&
2182       (!this.fog || b.owner !== 0 || this.seesCell(0, rc));

2212     const tz = c.z + (last ? u.offZ : u.offZ * 0.5);

2629   updateProjectiles(dt) {

2649         if (p.w && !p.miss) this.splashDamage(p.tx, p.tz, p.w, p.owner, p.src, p.t);
