2657   pointDefend(p, pds) {
2658     const k = Math.min(1, p.time / p.dur);
2659     const x = p.sx + (p.tx - p.sx) * k;
2660     const z = p.sz + (p.tz - p.sz) * k;
2661     for (const b of pds) {
2662       if (!this.isEnemy(b.owner, p.owner) || this.time < (b.pdReadyAt || 0)) continue;
2663       const pd = b.def.pointDefense;
2664       if (Math.hypot(x - b.x, z - b.z) > pd.range * SQ3 + 0.5) continue;
2665       p.done = true;
2666       b.pdReadyAt = this.time + pd.cd;
2667       b.pdKills = (b.pdKills || 0) + 1;
2668       this.pdKills = (this.pdKills || 0) + 1;
2669       const y = (p.sy || 0.5) + ((p.ty || 0) - (p.sy || 0.5)) * k + 0.4;
2670       this.fx.push({ k: 'tracer', x1: b.x, y1: b.y + (b.kind === 'bld' ? 1.3 : 0.4), z1: b.z, x2: x, y2: y, z2: z, color: 0xffe08a, heavy: true });
2671       this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x, y, z, s: 0.45, small: true });
2672       return true;
2673     }
2674     return false;
2675   }

2677   // ---------- v1.8: sistemas de las tropas y edificios nuevos ----------
2678   // Auras cada 0,5 s. Mando (dmg): más daño a tus tropas cerca. Suministros (supply): recargan más rápido.
2679   // Combustible (fuel): tus vehículos van más rápido. Interferencia (jam): las defensas enemigas disparan más lento.
2680   // Entre varias fuentes del mismo tipo vale la mayor (no se suman).
2681   updateAuras(dt) {
2682     this._auraT = (this._auraT || 0) - dt;
2683     if (this._auraT > 0) return;
2684     this._auraT = 0.5;
2685     const src = [];
2686     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && !u.inside && u.def.aura) src.push(u);
2687     for (const b of this.buildings) if (b.alive && b.built && b.def.aura) src.push(b);
2688     for (const u of this.units) { u.buffDmg = 0; u.buffCd = 0; u.buffSpd = 0; }
2689     for (const b of this.buildings) b.jam = 0;
2690     if (!src.length) return;
2691     const key = { dmg: 'buffDmg', supply: 'buffCd', fuel: 'buffSpd' };
2692     for (const s of src) {
2693       for (const a of s.def.aura) {
2694         const R = (a.range * SQ3 + 0.4) ** 2;
2695         if (a.kind === 'jam') {
2696           for (const b of this.buildings) {
2697             if (!b.alive || !b.def.weapon || !this.isEnemy(b.owner, s.owner)) continue;
2698             if ((b.x - s.x) ** 2 + (b.z - s.z) ** 2 <= R) b.jam = Math.max(b.jam || 0, a.pct);
2699           }
2700           continue;
2701         }
2702         const k = key[a.kind];
2703         for (const u of this.units) {
2704           if (u === s || !u.alive || u.inside || this.isEnemy(u.owner, s.owner)) continue;
2705           if (a.cls && !a.cls.includes(u.cls)) continue;
2706           if (a.kind !== 'fuel' && !u.def.weapon) continue;
2707           if ((u.x - s.x) ** 2 + (u.z - s.z) ** 2 <= R) u[k] = Math.max(u[k] || 0, a.pct);
2708         }
2709       }
2710     }
2711   }
2712 
2713   // Mina naval: explota con el primer barco enemigo a 1 casilla; un desminador enemigo cerca la desactiva.
2714   updateMine(b, dt) {
2715     b.mineT = (b.mineT || 0) - dt;
2716     if (b.mineT > 0) return;
2717     b.mineT = 0.3;
2718     const M = b.def.mine;
2719     const R = M.range * SQ3 + 0.3;
2720     for (const u of this.units) {
2721       if (!u.alive || u.inside || !this.isEnemy(u.owner, b.owner)) continue;
2722       const d = Math.hypot(u.x - b.x, u.z - b.z);
2723       if (u.def.demine && d <= SQ3 + 0.3 && (b.seenBy & (1 << this.players[u.owner].team))) {
2724         this.mineCleared = (this.mineCleared || 0) + 1;
2725         if (u.owner === 0) this.toast(0, `${u.def.name} desactivó una mina`, 'good');
2726         this.kill(b, u.owner);
2727         return;
2728       }
2729       const onWater = TERRAIN[this.cells[u.cell].t].water;
2730       if ((u.cls === 'ship' || u.cls === 'sub') && onWater && !u.def.demine && d <= R) {
2731         this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x: b.x, y: 0.2, z: b.z, s: 1.0 });
2732         this.emit('sound', { name: 'boom', x: b.x, z: b.z });
2733         this.minesExploded = (this.minesExploded || 0) + 1;
2734         if (u.owner === 0) this.alert('mine', `¡Mina! ${u.def.name} chocó con una mina`, 'bad', b.x, b.z, 5);
2735         this.damage(u, M.dmg, b.owner, b);
2736         this.kill(b, -1);
2737         return;
2738       }
2739     }
2740   }

2742   // Centro de investigación: una investigación a la vez; al terminar vale para todo el ejército del jugador.
2743   researchInvalid(b, key) {
2744     const R = RESEARCH[key];
2745     if (!b || !b.alive || b.type !== 'research' || !b.built) return 'Necesita un Centro de investigación terminado';
2746     if (!R) return 'Investigación desconocida';
2747     const p = this.players[b.owner];
2748     if (p.research && p.research[key]) return 'Ya investigada';
2749     if (b.researching) return `Investigando ${RESEARCH[b.researching.key].name}`;
2750     if (!(this.creator && b.owner === 0) && p.coins < R.cost) return `Monedas insuficientes (${fmt(R.cost)})`;
2751     return null;
2752   }

2754   startResearch(b, key) {
2755     const why = this.researchInvalid(b, key);
2756     if (why) return why;
2757     const p = this.players[b.owner];
2758     if (!(this.creator && b.owner === 0)) p.coins -= RESEARCH[key].cost;
2759     b.researching = { key, t: 0 };
2760     if (b.owner === 0) this.emit('sound', { name: 'place' });
2761     return null;

2764   updateResearch(b, dt) {
2765     const r = b.researching;
2766     r.t += dt;
2767     const R = RESEARCH[r.key];
2768     if (r.t < R.time) return;
2769     b.researching = null;
2770     const p = this.players[b.owner];
2771     p.research = p.research || {};
2772     p.research[r.key] = true;
2773     // Blindaje: los vehículos que ya existen también reciben la vida extra.
2774     if (r.key === 'armor') {
2775       for (const u of this.units) {
2776         if (!u.alive || u.owner !== b.owner || u.cls !== 'veh') continue;
2777         const add = u.maxHp * R.pct;
2778         u.maxHp += add;
2779         u.hp += add;
2780       }
2781     }
2782     if (b.owner === 0) {
2783       this.emit('toast', { text: `Investigación terminada: ${R.name}`, kind: 'good' });
2784       this.emit('sound', { name: 'done' });
2785     }

2788   // Vehículo lanzapuentes: pone un Puente modular en una casilla de agua poco profunda de al lado (paga el puente).
2789   bridgeSpot(u) {
2790     const uc = this.cells[u.cell];
2791     let best = -1;
2792     let bd = Infinity;
2793     for (const ni of uc.nb) {
2794       const c = this.cells[ni];
2795       if (c.t !== 'shallow' || c.bld || c.point || !this.map.isCoast(c)) continue;
2796       if (c.owner >= 0 && this.isEnemy(c.owner, u.owner)) continue;
2797       let d = Math.atan2(c.x - u.x, c.z - u.z) - u.yaw;
2798       while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
2799       while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
2800       d = Math.abs(d);
2801       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = ni; }
2802     }
2803     return best;
2804   }

2806   layBridgeInvalid(u) {
2807     if (!u || !u.alive || !u.def.layBridge) return 'Necesita un Vehículo lanzapuentes';
2808     if (u.inside) return 'Bájalo del transporte primero';
2809     const p = this.players[u.owner];
2810     if (this.count(u.owner, 'bridge') >= this.limitFor(u.owner, 'bridge')) return `Límite alcanzado (${this.limitFor(u.owner, 'bridge')})`;
2811     if (!(this.creator && u.owner === 0) && p.coins < BUILDINGS.bridge.cost) return `Monedas insuficientes (${fmt(BUILDINGS.bridge.cost)})`;
2812     if (this.bridgeSpot(u) < 0) return 'Acércate a agua poco profunda junto a la orilla';
2813     return null;
2814   }

2929     if (ci !== undefined) {

3010   // El misil sale de un AIR DEFENSE de nivel 4 o de un Lanzador nuclear móvil. Con Arsenal estratégico gasta el uso.
3011   fireNuke(owner, src, ci) {
3012     const c = this.cells[ci];
3013     if (this.strategic) {
3014       const pl = this.players[owner];
3015       pl.stratUsed = (pl.stratUsed || 0) + 1;
3016       pl.stratAt = this.time;
3017     }
3018     this.projectiles.push({
3019       kind: 'nuke', t: null, dmg: NUKE.dmg, owner, src, sx: src.x, sy: src.y + 1, sz: src.z, tx: c.x, ty: c.h, tz: c.z,
3020       time: 0, dur: NUKE.flight, color: PLAYER_COLORS[owner], cell: ci, checked: false,
3021     });
3022     this.nukesLaunched = (this.nukesLaunched || 0) + 1;
3023     this.emit('sound', { name: 'alarm' });
3024     // Aviso a quien tenga algo cerca del blanco (y siempre a quien lo lanza).
3025     const R = NUKE.radius + 2;
3026     for (const q of this.players) {
3027       if (!q.alive) continue;
3028       const mine = q.id === owner;
3029       const near = this.buildings.some((x) => x.alive && x.owner === q.id && this.map.dist(this.cells[x.cell], c) <= R) ||
3030         this.units.some((u) => u.alive && u.owner === q.id && this.map.dist(this.cells[u.cell], c) <= R);
3031       if (q.id === 0 && (mine || near)) {
3032         this.emit('toast', { text: mine ? `Misil nuclear lanzado: llega en ${NUKE.flight} s` : `¡Misil nuclear en camino! Llega en ${NUKE.flight} s`, kind: mine ? 'info' : 'bad', x: c.x, z: c.z });
3033         this.emit('ping', { x: c.x, z: c.z, kind: 'bad' });
3034       }
3035       // Una sola frase aunque lleguen varios a la vez (salva de 3, v1.0).
3036       if (!q.human && near && !mine && q.persona && this.time - (q.nukeSaidAt ?? -99) > 2) {
3037         q.nukeSaidAt = this.time;
3038         this.say(q.id, '¡Un misil nuclear! ¡Todos a cubierto!', { force: true, public: true });
3039       }
3040     }
3041     return null;
3042   }

3044   updateNuke(p) {
3045     const k = p.time / p.dur;
3046     // Escudo antimisiles enemigo cerca del blanco: lo derriba a mitad de camino.
3047     if (!p.checked && k >= 0.6) {
3048       p.checked = true;
3049       const tc = this.cells[p.cell];
3050       const shield = this.buildings.find((b) => b.alive && b.built && b.def.intercept && this.isEnemy(b.owner, p.owner) &&
3051         this.time >= (b.chargeAt || 0) && this.map.dist(this.cells[b.cell], tc) <= b.def.intercept.range);
3052       if (shield) {
3053         shield.chargeAt = this.time + shield.def.intercept.recharge;
3054         p.done = true;
3055         const x = p.sx + (p.tx - p.sx) * k;
3056         const z = p.sz + (p.tz - p.sz) * k;
3057         this.fx.push({ k: 'boom', x, y: 4, z, s: 1.4 });
3058         this.nukesIntercepted = (this.nukesIntercepted || 0) + 1;
3059         if (shield.owner === 0 || p.owner === 0) {
3060           this.emit('toast', { text: shield.owner === 0 ? '¡Tu Escudo antimisiles derribó el misil nuclear!' : 'El Escudo antimisiles enemigo derribó tu misil', kind: shield.owner === 0 ? 'good' : 'bad' });
3061         }
3062         return;
3063       }
3064     }
3065     if (p.time < p.dur) return;
3066     p.done = true;
3067     const R = NUKE.radius * SQ3 + 0.6;
3068     this.fx.push({ k: 'nuke', x: p.tx, y: p.ty, z: p.tz });
3069     this.emit('sound', { name: 'bigboom', x: p.tx, z: p.tz });
3070     const hits = [...this.units.filter((u) => u.alive && !u.inside), ...this.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive)];
3071     for (const t of hits) {
3072       // v1.3: solo daña a los enemigos de quien lo lanzó (igual que la radiación).
3073       if (!this.isEnemy(p.owner, t.owner)) continue;
3074       const d = Math.hypot(t.x - p.tx, t.z - p.tz);
3075       if (d > R) continue;
3076       this.damage(t, p.dmg * (1 - (d / R) * 0.6), p.owner, null, true);
3077     }
3078     // v1.0: queda 1 minuto de radiación que sigue quemando a los enemigos de quien lo lanzó.
3079     if (!this.radZones) this.radZones = [];
3080     this.radZones.push({ x: p.tx, y: p.ty, z: p.tz, cell: p.cell, owner: p.owner, start: this.time, until: this.time + NUKE.rad.time, tick: 0 });
3081     const zc = this.cells[p.cell];
3082     const near0 = this.buildings.some((b) => b.alive && b.owner === 0 && this.map.dist(this.cells[b.cell], zc) <= NUKE.radius + 2);
3083     if (p.owner === 0 || near0) {
3084       this.emit('toast', { text: `Radiación por ${NUKE.rad.time} s donde cayó el misil`, kind: p.owner === 0 ? 'info' : 'bad', x: p.tx, z: p.tz });
3085     }
3086   }
3087 
3088   // Gráficas del final (v1.1): una muestra cada 10 s (a lo sumo 240; si sobran, se juntan de a dos).
3089   recordHistory(dt) {
3090     if (!this.history) this.history = [];
3091     this._histT = (this._histT || 0) - dt;
3092     if (this._histT > 0) return;
3093     this._histT = 10;
3094     const army = this.players.map(() => 0);
3095     for (const u of this.units) if (u.alive && u.def.weapon) army[u.owner]++;
3096     this.history.push({ t: Math.round(this.time), inc: this.players.map((p) => (p.alive ? p.income : 0)), army });
3097     if (this.history.length > 240) this.history = this.history.filter((_, i) => i % 2 === 0);
3098   }
3099 
3100   // Radiación (v1.0): cada medio segundo quema a tropas y edificios enemigos dentro de la zona.
3101   updateRadiation(dt) {
3102     if (!this.radZones || !this.radZones.length) return;
3103     const R = NUKE.radius * SQ3 + 0.6;
3104     for (const z of this.radZones) {
3105       z.tick += dt;
3106       if (z.tick < 0.5) continue;
3107       const step = z.tick;
3108       z.tick = 0;
3109       const burn = (t, pct) => {
3110         if (!t.alive || t.inside || !this.isEnemy(z.owner, t.owner)) return;
3111         if (Math.hypot(t.x - z.x, t.z - z.z) > R) return;
3112         this.damage(t, t.maxHp * pct * step, z.owner, null);
3113       };
3114       for (const u of this.units) burn(u, NUKE.rad.unit);
3115       for (const b of this.buildings) burn(b, b.type === 'core' ? NUKE.rad.core : NUKE.rad.bld);
3116       this.fx.push({ k: 'rad', x: z.x, y: z.y, z: z.z, r: R });
3117     }
3118     this.radZones = this.radZones.filter((z) => this.time < z.until);
3119   }
3120 }

faro/src/js/045-save.js · 250 líneas

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Guardar y cargar una partida (punto 16: si sales sin querer, puedes volver).
  3 // Convierte todo el estado del juego en JSON: las referencias entre objetos (un edificio que
  4 // apunta a su objetivo, el Núcleo de cada jugador...) se guardan como números, y los datos de
  5 // configuración (BUILDINGS, UNITS...) como su nombre, para no copiarlos.
  6 
  7 const SAVE_KEY = 'faro-save-v1';
  8 const SAVE_VERSION = 1;
  9 
 10 const Save = {
 11   _paths: null,
 12   _byPath: null,
 13 
 14   // Recorre la configuración una vez y anota la ruta de cada objeto (por ejemplo «BUILDINGS.core»).
 15   _consts() {
 16     if (this._paths) return this._paths;
 17     const paths = new Map();
 18     const byPath = new Map();
 19     const roots = {
 20       BUILDINGS, UNITS, MODES, MAPS, DIFFICULTY, POINTS, PERSONALITIES, TERRAIN, DOME_LEVELS, UNIT_SHIELD,
 21       HOUSE_LEVELS, DOME, EMERGENCY, REPAIR, CAPTURE, PALETTES, BUILD_TABS, OBJECTIVES, PLAYER_COLORS,
 22       PLAYER_NAMES, LEVEL_UP_COST, PERSONALITY_ORDER, ALLY_LINES, CAT_NAMES, CAMPAIGN,
 23     };
 24     const walk = (o, path, depth) => {
 25       if (!o || typeof o !== 'object' || paths.has(o) || depth > 6) return;
 26       paths.set(o, path);
 27       byPath.set(path, o);
 28       for (const k of Object.keys(o)) walk(o[k], path + '.' + k, depth + 1);
 29     };
 30     for (const [name, obj] of Object.entries(roots)) walk(obj, name, 0);
 31     this._paths = paths;
 32     this._byPath = byPath;
 33     return paths;
 34   },
 35 
 36   // v1.3: guardado más chico y rápido (cada 60 s). El mapa no se guarda: se vuelve a crear con su
 37   // semilla al cargar (una suma de control comprueba que sea el mismo). Las casillas solo guardan lo
 38   // que no se puede recalcular; los efectos visuales y avisos ya mostrados tampoco se guardan.
 39   MAP_STATIC: ['i', 'q', 'r', 'x', 'z', 't', 'h', 'land', 'nb', 'comp', 'bridge'],
 40   // Datos de las casillas que se vuelven a poner al cargar: territorio (se recalcula), edificio y punto.
 41   CELL_REBUILT: ['owner', 'ownerD', 'ownerId', 'bld', 'point'],
 42   GAME_TRANSIENT: ['fx', 'events', 'removed'],
 43 
 44   mapCheck(cells) {
 45     let h = 2166136261;
 46     for (const c of cells) {
 47       const str = `${c.q},${c.r},${c.t},${Math.round(c.h * 100)},${c.land ? 1 : 0},${c.comp},${c.bridge ? 1 : 0};`;
 48       for (let k = 0; k < str.length; k++) {
 49         h ^= str.charCodeAt(k);
 50         h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
 51       }
 52     }
 53     return h >>> 0;
 54   },
 55 
 56   serialize(game) {
 57     const consts = this._consts();
 58     const ids = new Map();
 59     const objs = [];
 60     const map = game.map;
 61     const compact = map instanceof GameMap && map.cells === game.cells;
 62     const cellIdx = compact ? new Map(map.cells.map((c, i) => [c, i])) : null;
 63     const skipGame = new Set(this.GAME_TRANSIENT);
 64     if (compact) skipGame.add('cells');
 65     const skipMap = new Set(['cells', 'lookup']);
 66     const classes = new Map([[Game.prototype, 'Game'], [Bot.prototype, 'Bot'], [GameMap.prototype, 'GameMap'], [MinHeap.prototype, 'MinHeap']]);
 67     const enc = (v) => {
 68       if (typeof v === 'function' || v === undefined) return undefined;
 69       if (typeof v === 'number' && !Number.isFinite(v)) return { $n: String(v) };
 70       if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
 71       const cp = consts.get(v);
 72       if (cp) return { $c: cp };
 73       const known = ids.get(v);
 74       if (known !== undefined) return { $r: known };
 75       if (cellIdx && cellIdx.has(v)) {
 76         // Referencia a una casilla: al cargar apunta a la casilla recreada.
 77         const cid = objs.length;
 78         ids.set(v, cid);
 79         objs.push({ cell: cellIdx.get(v) });
 80         return { $r: cid };
 81       }
 82       const id = objs.length;
 83       ids.set(v, id);
 84       objs.push(null);
 85       let rec;
 86       if (Array.isArray(v)) rec = { a: v.map((x) => { const e = enc(x); return e === undefined ? null : e; }) };
 87       else if (v instanceof Map) rec = { m: [...v].map(([k, x]) => [enc(k), enc(x)]) };
 88       else if (v instanceof Set) rec = { s: [...v].map(enc) };
 89       else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(v)) rec = { t: v.constructor.name, n: v.length };
 90       else {
 91         const o = {};
 92         const skip = v === game ? skipGame : compact && v === map ? skipMap : null;
 93         for (const k of Object.keys(v)) {
 94           if (skip && skip.has(k)) continue;
 95           const e = enc(v[k]);
 96           if (e !== undefined) o[k] = e;
 97         }
 98         rec = { o };
 99         const cls = classes.get(Object.getPrototypeOf(v));
100         if (cls) rec.k = cls;
101         if (compact && v === map) {
102           // Datos de casillas que no se recalculan solos (si los hay): se guardan aparte.
103           const fixed = new Set([...this.MAP_STATIC, ...this.CELL_REBUILT]);
104           const extra = [];
105           map.cells.forEach((c, i) => {
106             const ks = Object.keys(c).filter((k) => !fixed.has(k));
107             if (!ks.length) return;
108             const eo = {};
109             for (const k of ks) {
110               const e = enc(c[k]);
111               if (e !== undefined) eo[k] = e;
112             }
113             extra.push([i, eo]);
114           });
115           // La suma de control se calcula una vez por mapa (sus casillas fijas no cambian en la partida).
116           if (!this._checks) this._checks = new WeakMap();
117           let check = this._checks.get(map);
118           if (check === undefined) {
119             check = this.mapCheck(map.cells);
120             this._checks.set(map, check);
121           }
122           rec.gen = { seed: map.seed, kind: map.kind, n: map.n, pairs: !!map.pairs, check, extra };
123         }
124       }
125       objs[id] = rec;
126       return { $r: id };
127     };
128     enc(game);
129     let maxId = 0;
130     for (const e of game.units) maxId = Math.max(maxId, e.id || 0);
131     for (const e of game.buildings) maxId = Math.max(maxId, e.id || 0);
132     return { v: SAVE_VERSION, nextId: Math.max(maxId + 1, _nextId), objs };
133   },
134 
135   deserialize(data) {
136     if (!data || data.v !== SAVE_VERSION || !Array.isArray(data.objs)) throw new Error('Guardado no válido');
137     this._consts();
138     const byPath = this._byPath;
139     const classes = { Game, Bot, GameMap, MinHeap };
140     const typed = { Float32Array, Int32Array, Uint32Array, Uint8Array, Int16Array, Uint16Array, Float64Array };
141     let fresh = null;
142     const genRec = data.objs.find((r) => r && r.gen);
143     if (genRec) {
144       const g0 = genRec.gen;
145       fresh = new GameMap(g0.seed, g0.kind, g0.n, g0.pairs);
146       if (this.mapCheck(fresh.cells) !== g0.check) throw new Error('El mapa no coincide con esta versión del juego');
147     }
148     const made = data.objs.map((r) => {
149       if (r.cell !== undefined) return fresh.cells[r.cell];
150       if (r.a) return [];
151       if (r.m) return new Map();
152       if (r.s) return new Set();
153       // Los arreglos numéricos son memoria de trabajo del buscador de caminos: se crean vacíos.
154       if (r.t) return new (typed[r.t] || Float32Array)(r.n);
155       return r.k && classes[r.k] ? Object.create(classes[r.k].prototype) : {};
156     });
157     const dec = (v) => {
158       if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
159       if (v.$r !== undefined) return made[v.$r];
160       if (v.$c !== undefined) {
161         if (!byPath.has(v.$c)) throw new Error('Dato de configuración desconocido: ' + v.$c);
162         return byPath.get(v.$c);
163       }
164       if (v.$n !== undefined) return Number(v.$n);
165       return v;
166     };
167     data.objs.forEach((r, i) => {
168       if (r.cell !== undefined) return;
169       const t = made[i];
170       if (r.a) r.a.forEach((x) => t.push(dec(x)));
171       else if (r.m) r.m.forEach(([k, x]) => t.set(dec(k), dec(x)));
172       else if (r.s) r.s.forEach((x) => t.add(dec(x)));
173       else if (r.o) for (const k of Object.keys(r.o)) t[k] = dec(r.o[k]);
174     });
175     const game = made[0];
176     if (!(game instanceof Game)) throw new Error('Guardado no válido');
177     _nextId = Math.max(_nextId, data.nextId || 1);
178     game.events = [];
179     if (!game.fx) game.fx = [];
180     if (!game.removed) game.removed = [];
181     if (genRec) {
182       // Mapa recreado: casillas nuevas, con sus edificios, puntos y datos extra.
183       game.map.cells = fresh.cells;
184       game.map.lookup = fresh.lookup;
185       game.cells = fresh.cells;
186       for (const [ci, eo] of genRec.gen.extra || []) for (const k of Object.keys(eo)) fresh.cells[ci][k] = dec(eo[k]);
187       for (const c of fresh.cells) { c.bld = null; delete c.point; }
188       for (const b of game.buildings) if (b.alive) fresh.cells[b.cell].bld = b;
189       for (const pt of game.points || []) fresh.cells[pt.cell].point = pt;
190     }
191     // Los datos de cada edificio y tropa vuelven a apuntar a la configuración actual.
192     for (const b of game.buildings) if (BUILDINGS[b.type]) b.def = BUILDINGS[b.type];
193     for (const u of game.units) if (UNITS[u.type]) u.def = UNITS[u.type];
194     // Partidas guardadas antes de la v1.1: equipo de origen para las alianzas.
195     for (const p of game.players) if (p.team0 === undefined) p.team0 = p.team;
196     if (!game.radZones) game.radZones = [];
197     game.territoryDirty = true;
198     return game;
199   },
200 
201   // Datos para mostrar en el vestíbulo sin cargar toda la partida.
202   summary(game) {
203     const me = game.players[0];
204     return {
205       mode: game.mode.name, map: (MAPS[game.opts.mapKind] || {}).name || '', time: Math.round(game.time),
206       alive: game.players.filter((p) => p.alive).length, players: game.players.length,
207       units: game.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive).length, coins: Math.round(me.coins),
208       savedAt: Date.now(), creator: !!game.creator,
209       ranked: !!(game.mode.ranked && !game.opts.custom),
210     };
211   },
212 
213   write(game) {
214     if (!game || game.over || game.preview) return false;
215     try {
216       const data = this.serialize(game);
217       data.summary = this.summary(game);
218       localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
219       return true;
220     } catch (err) {
221       console.warn('[Guardado] No se pudo guardar la partida:', err && err.message);
222       return false;
223     }
224   },
225 
226   peek() {
227     try {
228       const raw = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
229       if (!raw) return null;
230       const data = JSON.parse(raw);
231       return data && data.v === SAVE_VERSION ? data.summary || {} : null;
232     } catch (err) {
233       return null;
234     }
235   },
236 
237   read() {
238     try {
239       const raw = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
240       return raw ? this.deserialize(JSON.parse(raw)) : null;
241     } catch (err) {
242       console.warn('[Guardado] No se pudo cargar la partida:', err && err.message);
243       return null;
244     }
245   },
246 
247   clear() {
248     try { localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY); } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
249   },
250 };

faro/src/js/046-campaign.js · 291 líneas

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Campaña «La ruta del Faro» (v0.7): prepara cada misión, sigue su meta y calcula las estrellas.
  3 // El estado de la misión vive en game.camp (solo datos simples, para que se guarde con la partida).
  4 
  5 const Campaign = {
  6   def(id) {
  7     return CAMPAIGN.find((m) => m.id === id) || null;
  8   },
  9 
 10   // Modo de juego de una misión: todos contra todos. Las monedas extra son solo para ti.
 11   mode(id) {
 12     const m = this.def(id);
 13     const teams = [];
 14     for (let i = 0; i < m.players; i++) teams.push(i);
 15     return { name: `Misión ${m.id} · ${m.name}`, players: m.players, teams, campaign: m.id };
 16   },
 17 
 18   // Opciones para empezar una misión: mapa y semilla fijos, así siempre es la misma isla.
 19   opts(id) {
 20     const m = this.def(id);
 21     return { mode: 'campaign', mission: id, mapKind: m.mapKind, difficulty: m.difficulty, seed: m.seed, personas: m.personas.slice() };
 22   },
 23 
 24   // Una misión está abierta si es la primera, si terminaste la anterior o en modo creador.
 25   unlocked(id, P, creator) {
 26     if (creator || id === 1) return true;
 27     return !!(P && P.campaign && P.campaign.done[id - 1]);
 28   },
 29 
 30   goalText(m) {
 31     const g = m.goal;
 32     if (g.kind === 'eco') return `Llega a ${fmt(g.income)} monedas por minuto y ten ${g.army} tropas de combate.`;
 33     if (g.kind === 'survive') return `Aguanta ${Math.round(g.time / 60)} minutos con tu Núcleo en pie.`;
 34     if (g.kind === 'hold') return `Toma el Faro y mantenlo ${g.time} s en total.`;
 35     if (g.kind === 'flags') return `Captura ${g.count} Banderas de otras islas.`;
 36     return m.players > 2 ? 'Sé el último Núcleo en pie.' : 'Destruye el Núcleo enemigo.';
 37   },
 38 
 39   starText(s) {
 40     if (s.kind === 'time') return `En menos de ${Math.round(s.max / 60)} min`;
 41     if (s.kind === 'lostBld') return s.max === 0 ? 'Sin perder edificios' : `Pierdes ${s.max} edificios o menos`;
 42     if (s.kind === 'lostUnits') return `Pierdes ${s.max} tropas o menos`;
 43     if (s.kind === 'coreEnd') return `Núcleo sobre el ${Math.round(s.min * 100)} % al terminar`;
 44     return `Tu Núcleo nunca baja del ${Math.round(s.min * 100)} %`;
 45   },
 46 
 47   // ---------- preparación ----------
 48   setup(g) {
 49     const m = this.def(g.opts.mission);
 50     const me = g.players[0];
 51     g.camp = {
 52       id: m.id, lostBld: 0, minCore: 1, faroHold: 0, flags: [], won: false, checkT: 0,
 53       homeComp: g.cells[me.core.cell].comp,
 54     };
 55     if (m.coins) me.coins = m.coins;
 56     for (const bot of g.bots) {
 57       if (m.passive) bot.passive = true;
 58       if (m.firstWave) bot.nextWaveAt = m.firstWave + Math.random() * 15;
 59       if (m.waveEvery) bot.waveMult = m.waveEvery;
 60       if (m.enemyStart) this.giveStart(g, bot.pid, m.enemyStart);
 61       if (m.fortress) this.fortify(g, bot.pid);
 62       if (m.guardFlags) this.guardFlags(g, bot.pid, m.guardFlags);
 63       if (m.guardFaro) this.guardPoints(g, bot.pid, g.points.filter((pt) => pt.type === 'faro'), m.guardFaro.units);
 64     }
 65     if (m.myStart) this.giveStart(g, 0, m.myStart);
 66     g.recomputeTerritory();
 67     g.refreshEconomy();
 68   },
 69 
 70   // Casilla libre más cercana al Núcleo donde cabe ese edificio (en su territorio o en agua libre).
 71   spotFor(g, pid, type) {
 72     const core = g.cells[g.players[pid].core.cell];
 73     let best = -1;
 74     let bd = Infinity;
 75     for (const c of g.cells) {
 76       if (c.bld || c.point || (c.owner >= 0 && c.owner !== pid)) continue;
 77       const d = g.map.dist(c, core);
 78       if (d > 8 || d < 2) continue;
 79       const why = g.placeInvalid(pid, type, c.i, true);
 80       if (why && !(why === 'Fuera de tu territorio' && c.owner < 0 && type === 'harbor')) continue;
 81       if (type === 'harbor' && (c.t !== 'shallow' || !g.map.isCoast(c))) continue;
 82       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = c.i; }
 83     }
 84     return best;
 85   },
 86 
 87   giveStart(g, pid, spec) {
 88     const p = g.players[pid];
 89     let harbor = null;
 90     for (const type of spec.buildings || []) {
 91       const ci = this.spotFor(g, pid, type);
 92       if (ci < 0) continue;
 93       const b = g.addBuilding(pid, type, ci, true);
 94       if (type === 'harbor') harbor = b;
 95       g.recomputeTerritory();
 96     }
 97     const sea = (spec.units || []).filter((t) => UNITS[t].mover === 'sea');
 98     const land = (spec.units || []).filter((t) => UNITS[t].mover !== 'sea');
 99     if (sea.length && harbor) {
100       const cells = g.freeCellsNear(harbor.cell, 'sea', pid, sea.length);
101       sea.forEach((t, k) => { if (cells[k] !== undefined) g.addUnit(pid, t, cells[k]); });
102     }
103     const cells = g.freeCellsNear(p.core.cell, 'land', pid, land.length + 2);
104     land.forEach((t, k) => { if (cells[k + 2] !== undefined) g.addUnit(pid, t, cells[k + 2]); });
105   },
106 
107   // Cruzar el mar: el rival ya tiene las Banderas de otras islas más cercanas a ti, con guardias.
108   guardFlags(g, pid, spec) {
109     const mine = g.cells[g.players[0].core.cell];
110     const flags = g.points.filter((pt) => pt.type === 'flag' && g.cells[pt.cell].comp !== g.camp.homeComp)
111       .sort((a, b) => g.map.dist(g.cells[a.cell], mine) - g.map.dist(g.cells[b.cell], mine)).slice(0, spec.count);
112     this.guardPoints(g, pid, flags, spec.units);
113   },
114 
115   // El rival empieza dueño de esos puntos, con guardias a su lado.
116   guardPoints(g, pid, points, units) {
117     for (const pt of points) {
118       pt.owner = pid;
119       pt.prog = 1;
120       pt.capTeam = g.players[pid].team;
121       const cells = g.freeCellsNear(pt.cell, 'land', pid, units.length);
122       units.forEach((t, k) => {
123         const u = g.addUnit(pid, t, cells[k]);
124         u.role = 'guard';
125       });
126     }
127     g.territoryDirty = true;
128   },
129 
130   // Asedio: Núcleo en nivel 2, arco de murallas, Torretas de nivel 3 y 2 y AIR DEFENSE detrás.
131   fortify(g, pid) {
132     const core = g.players[pid].core;
133     const cc = g.cells[core.cell];
134     const mine = g.cells[g.players[0].core.cell];
135     const dir = Math.atan2(mine.z - cc.z, mine.x - cc.x);
136     const off = (c) => {
137       let a = Math.atan2(c.z - cc.z, c.x - cc.x) - dir;
138       while (a > Math.PI) a -= Math.PI * 2;
139       while (a < -Math.PI) a += Math.PI * 2;
140       return Math.abs(a);
141     };
142     const free = (c) => !c.bld && !c.point && TERRAIN[c.t].land && !['gold', 'fertile', 'oilland'].includes(c.t);
143     const ring = (d) => g.cells.filter((c) => g.map.dist(c, cc) === d && free(c)).sort((a, b) => off(a) - off(b));
144     const level = (b, lv) => {
145       if (lv <= 1) return;
146       b.upgrading = { level: lv, progress: 1 };
147       g.finishUpgrade(b);
148     };
149     level(core, 2);
150     // Muralla en arco (v0.9: también sobre tierra fértil, que ahora ocupa más casillas).
151     const wallRing = g.cells.filter((c) => g.map.dist(c, cc) === 3 && !c.bld && !c.point && TERRAIN[c.t].land && !['gold', 'oilland'].includes(c.t));
152     // Los 5 tramos más de frente, como en la v0.7.
153     wallRing.filter((c) => off(c) < 1.3).sort((a, b) => off(a) - off(b)).slice(0, 5).forEach((c) => g.addBuilding(pid, 'wall', c.i, true));
154     const r2 = ring(2);
155     const picks = [];
156     const take = (ok) => {
157       const c = r2.find((x) => !picks.includes(x) && ok(x) && picks.every((p) => g.map.dist(p, x) >= 2));
158       if (c) picks.push(c);
159       return c;
160     };
161     const front = take(() => true);
162     if (front) level(g.addBuilding(pid, 'turret', front.i, true), 3);
163     for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
164       const c = take((x) => off(x) > 0.45 && off(x) < 2);
165       if (c) level(g.addBuilding(pid, 'turret', c.i, true), 2);
166     }
167     const back = [...r2].reverse().find((x) => !picks.includes(x) && off(x) > 1.8);
168     if (back) g.addBuilding(pid, 'aadef', back.i, true);
169   },

171   // ---------- durante la partida ----------
172   update(g, dt) {
173     const c = g.camp;
174     if (!c || g.over || g.preview) return;
175     const core = g.players[0].core;
176     if (core.alive) c.minCore = Math.min(c.minCore, core.hp / core.maxHp);
177     c.checkT -= dt;
178     if (c.checkT > 0) return;
179     const step = 0.25 - c.checkT;
180     c.checkT = 0.25;
181     const m = this.def(c.id);
182     if (m.goal.kind === 'hold') {
183       const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
184       if (faro && faro.owner === 0) c.faroHold += step;
185     } else if (m.goal.kind === 'flags') {
186       for (const pt of g.points) {
187         if (pt.type === 'flag' && pt.owner === 0 && g.cells[pt.cell].comp !== c.homeComp && !c.flags.includes(pt.id)) {
188           c.flags.push(pt.id);
189           g.emit('toast', { text: `Bandera de otra isla: ${c.flags.length} de ${m.goal.count}`, kind: 'good' });
190         }
191       }
192     }
193     if (this.goalMet(g)) this.win(g);
194   },

196   army(g) {
197     return g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === 0 && u.def.weapon).length;
198   },

200   goalMet(g) {
201     const c = g.camp;
202     const goal = this.def(c.id).goal;
203     const me = g.players[0];
204     if (!me.alive) return false;
205     if (goal.kind === 'eco') return me.income >= goal.income && this.army(g) >= goal.army;
206     if (goal.kind === 'survive') return g.time >= goal.time;
207     if (goal.kind === 'hold') return c.faroHold >= goal.time;
208     if (goal.kind === 'flags') return c.flags.length >= goal.count;
209     return false; // destroy: lo decide checkEnd cuando cae el último Núcleo rival
210   },
211 
212   win(g) {
213     if (g.over) return;
214     g.over = true;
215     g.result = 'victory';
216     g.camp.won = true;
217     g.emit('over', { result: 'victory', mission: true });
218   },
219 
220   // Líneas de la meta con su progreso (para el panel de objetivos).
221   goalLines(g) {
222     const c = g.camp;
223     const m = this.def(c.id);
224     const goal = m.goal;
225     const me = g.players[0];
226     if (goal.kind === 'eco') {
227       const army = this.army(g);
228       return [
229         { text: `Ingresos: ${fmt(me.income)} / ${fmt(goal.income)} por min`, done: me.income >= goal.income },
230         { text: `Tropas de combate: ${Math.min(army, goal.army)} / ${goal.army}`, done: army >= goal.army },
231       ];
232     }
233     if (goal.kind === 'survive') {
234       return [{ text: `Aguanta: ${fmtTime(Math.min(g.time, goal.time))} / ${fmtTime(goal.time)}`, done: g.time >= goal.time }];
235     }
236     if (goal.kind === 'hold') {
237       const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
238       const now = faro && faro.owner === 0 ? ' · ¡es tuyo!' : '';
239       return [{ text: `Faro en tu poder: ${Math.floor(Math.min(c.faroHold, goal.time))} / ${goal.time} s${now}`, done: c.faroHold >= goal.time }];
240     }
241     if (goal.kind === 'flags') {
242       return [{ text: `Banderas de otras islas: ${Math.min(c.flags.length, goal.count)} / ${goal.count}`, done: c.flags.length >= goal.count }];
243     }
244     const rivals = g.players.filter((p) => !p.human);
245     const down = rivals.filter((p) => !p.alive).length;
246     if (rivals.length === 1) return [{ text: down ? 'Núcleo enemigo destruido' : 'Destruye el Núcleo enemigo', done: down > 0 }];
247     return [{ text: `Núcleos rivales caídos: ${down} / ${rivals.length}`, done: down >= rivals.length }];
248   },
249 
250   // Estrellas: la primera por terminar y dos por condiciones. final = al acabar la partida.
251   stars(g) {
252     const c = g.camp;
253     const m = this.def(c.id);
254     const me = g.players[0];
255     const won = c.won || (g.over && g.result === 'victory');
256     const core = me.core;
257     const coreK = core && core.alive ? core.hp / core.maxHp : 0;
258     const out = [{ text: 'Termina la misión', ok: won, live: true, why: won ? '' : 'No se cumplió la meta' }];
259     for (const s of m.stars) {
260       let ok;
261       let live;
262       let why;
263       let now;
264       if (s.kind === 'time') {
265         live = g.time < s.max;
266         ok = won && live;
267         now = live ? `quedan ${fmtTime(s.max - g.time)}` : 'se acabó el tiempo';
268         why = `Tardaste ${fmtTime(g.time)}`;
269       } else if (s.kind === 'lostBld' || s.kind === 'lostUnits') {
270         const n = s.kind === 'lostBld' ? c.lostBld : me.stats.lost;
271         live = n <= s.max;
272         ok = won && live;
273         now = `llevas ${n}`;
274         why = `Perdiste ${n} ${s.kind === 'lostBld' ? (n === 1 ? 'edificio' : 'edificios') : (n === 1 ? 'tropa' : 'tropas')}`;
275       } else if (s.kind === 'coreEnd') {
276         live = coreK >= s.min;
277         ok = won && live;
278         now = `ahora ${Math.round(coreK * 100)} %`;
279         why = `Tu Núcleo terminó al ${Math.round(coreK * 100)} %`;
280       } else {
281         live = c.minCore >= s.min;
282         ok = won && live;
283         now = `mínimo ${Math.round(c.minCore * 100)} %`;
284         why = `Tu Núcleo bajó al ${Math.round(c.minCore * 100)} %`;
285       }
286       if (!won && live) why = 'Hay que terminar la misión';
287       out.push({ text: this.starText(s), ok, live, now, why: ok ? '' : why });
288     }
289     return out;
290   },
291 };

   1 'use strict';
   2 // Bots (NPC): cada uno tiene una personalidad. Construyen economía, se expanden, planifican un
   3 // ejército mixto que contrarresta al enemigo, agrupan sus oleadas, se retiran heridos, reparan,
   4 // capturan puntos (también cruzando el mar) y hablan con el jugador.

   6 const unitCat = (u) => (u.cls === 'ship' || u.cls === 'sub' ? 'sea' : u.cls);
   7 // Tropas rápidas para hostigar la economía enemiga (v0.8).
   8 // Orden de preferencia: Jeep, Lancha, Ranger (sin Fábrica ni Puerto) y Helicóptero.
   9 const FAST_UNITS = { jeep: 'veh', speedboat: 'sea', ranger: 'inf', heli: 'air' };
  10 const ECO_TYPES = ['farm', 'mine', 'pump', 'rig'];
  11 
  12 // v1.8: tropas nuevas que los bots usan en lugar de otras con el mismo papel (salen del mismo edificio).
  13 const AI_SWAP_CHANCE = 0.3;
  14 const AI_SWAPS = {
  15   rifle: ['soldier', 'gunner'], rocket: ['atguided'], sniper: ['mortar'], shotgun: ['soldier'],
  16   jeep: ['armoredcar'], lighttank: ['armoredcar'], tank: ['tankdestroyer'], apc: ['ifv'], arty: ['howitzer', 'towedgun'], mlrs: ['thermo'],
  17   speedboat: ['gunboat', 'patrolboat'], destroyer: ['corvette'],
  18   fighter: ['attackjet'], bomber: ['heavybomber', 'gunship'],

  20 
  21 class Bot {
  22   constructor(game, pid) {
  23     this.g = game;
  24     this.pid = pid;
  25     const p = game.players[pid];
  26     this.pkey = p.persona || 'aggro';
  27     this.persona = PERSONALITIES[this.pkey];
  28     this.tac = game.diff.tactics;
  29     this.t = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
  30     this.wave = Math.max(4, Math.round(game.diff.wave * this.persona.waveSize));
  31     this.nextWaveAt = game.diff.firstWave * this.persona.firstWave + Math.random() * 30;

  40     this.threatAt = -99;
  41     this.siegeAt = -99;

  43     // v0.8: fuego concentrado, hostigamiento, Torreta de defensa y ayuda a aliados.
  44     p.focusFire = !!this.tac.focus;
  45     p.snipe = !!this.tac.snipe;
  46     this.nextHarassAt = 200 + Math.random() * 60;
  47     this.wantFast = -99;
  48     this.turretAt = -99;
  49     this.helpAt = {};
  50     this.lastTarget = null;
  51     this.harassSent = 0;
  52     this.firstHarassAt = -1;
  53     this.defTurrets = 0;
  54     this.helpSent = 0;
  55     this.lastDefense = null;
  56     // Métricas para las pruebas.
  57     this.wavesSent = 0;

  64   get p() {
  65     return this.g.players[this.pid];

  68   // v1.3: si otro bot ya pensó en este paso (busy), espera al siguiente: así nunca piensan dos
  69   // a la vez y el paso más lento de la simulación baja.
  70   update(dt, busy = false) {
  71     if (!this.p.alive) return false;
  72     this.t -= dt;
  73     this.defendT -= dt;
  74     if (this.t > 0 || busy) return false;
  75     this.t = this.g.diff.think * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);
  76     this.think();
  77     return true;

  80   targetArmy() {
  81     return 3 + Math.floor(this.g.time / 22);
  82   }

  84   think() {
  85     const g = this.g;
  86     const p = this.p;
  87     g.refreshEconomy();
  88     const mine = g.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.owner === this.pid);
  89     const units = g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === this.pid);
  90     const army = units.filter((u) => u.def.weapon).length;
  91 
  92     // Reparte lo ganado desde la última decisión entre las dos bolsas.
  93     const gained = (p.income * g.incomeMult(p) * (g.time - this.lastT)) / 60;
  94     this.lastT = g.time;
  95     const T = g.time;
  96     const base = T < 50 ? 0.2 : army < this.targetArmy() ? (T < 240 ? 0.45 : 0.55) : 0.38;
  97     const overdue = T > this.nextWaveAt + 60 ? 0.15 : 0;
  98     const milShare = clamp(base + overdue + (T < 50 ? 0 : this.persona.milShare), 0.1, 0.8);
  99     this.milBank += gained * milShare;
 100     this.ecoBank += gained * (1 - milShare);
 101     const total = this.milBank + this.ecoBank;
 102     if (total > p.coins) {
 103       // Gastos no anotados (puestos, barcos ingenieros): salen primero de la economía.
 104       let excess = total - p.coins;
 105       const fromEco = Math.min(this.ecoBank, excess);
 106       this.ecoBank -= fromEco;
 107       excess -= fromEco;
 108       this.milBank = Math.max(0, this.milBank - excess);
 109     } else if (total < p.coins) {
 110       this.ecoBank += p.coins - total;
 111     }
 112 
 113     this.defend(units);
 114     if (g.mode.tutorial) return;
 115     this.staffBuilders(mine, units);
 116     this.build(mine);
 117     this.expand(mine, units);
 118     this.produce(mine, units);
 119     if (this.tac.retreat) this.retreat(units, mine);
 120     this.repairBase(units, mine);
 121     // Campaña: un vecino tranquilo no ataca ni sale a capturar.
 122     if (this.passive) return;
 123     this.attack(units);
 124     this.ferry(mine, units);
 125     if (this.tac.harass) this.harass(units);
 126     if (this.tac.teamwork) this.helpAllies(units);
 127     if (this.tac.focus) this.useNuke(mine);
 128   }

 130   // Misil nuclear (v0.9, desde Normal): solo pasados 20 min, contra el Núcleo enemigo más cercano.
 131   useNuke(mine) {
 132     const g = this.g;
 133     if (g.time < (this.tac.earlyNuke ? 900 : 1200)) return;
 134     const target = this.chooseEnemyCore();
 135     if (!target) return;
 136     // Difícil (v1.0): con los 3 listos y dinero, la salva de 3 (un Escudo antimisiles solo derriba uno).
 137     if (this.tac.earlyNuke && this.p.coins >= NUKE.cost * 3 + 3000 && !g.salvoInvalid(this.pid, target.cell)) {
 138       const n = g.launchSalvo(this.pid, target.cell);
 139       if (typeof n === 'number') {
 140         this.nukes = (this.nukes || 0) + n;
 141         this.ecoBank = Math.max(0, this.ecoBank - NUKE.cost * n);
 142         return;
 143       }
 144     }
 145     for (const b of mine) {
 146       if (b.type !== 'aadef' || b.level < 4) continue;
 147       if (this.p.coins < NUKE.cost + 3000) return;
 148       if (g.nukeInvalid(b, target.cell)) continue;
 149       if (!g.launchNuke(b, target.cell)) {
 150         this.nukes = (this.nukes || 0) + 1;
 151         this.ecoBank = Math.max(0, this.ecoBank - NUKE.cost);
 152         return;
 153       }
 154     }
 155   }

 162   build(mine) {
 163     const g = this.g;

 165     const T = g.time;
 166     const n = (t) => mine.filter((b) => b.type === t).length;
 167     const ownFree = (terrain) => g.cells.some((c) => c.owner === this.pid && c.t === terrain && !c.bld);
 168     const coast = g.cells.some((c) => c.owner === this.pid && c.t === 'shallow' && !c.bld && g.map.isCoast(c));

 258 
 259     // Una mejora barata cada ~minuto (Granja, Mina, Bomba o Casa) aunque haya otras compras esperando.
 260     if (T > 300 && T - (this.cheapUpAt || 0) > (fast ? 35 : 60) && !tooBusy) {
 261       const cand = mine.filter((x) => ['farm', 'mine', 'pump', 'house'].includes(x.type) && x.built && !x.upgrading && x.level < x.def.maxLevel)
 262         .sort((x, y) => g.upgradeCost(x) - g.upgradeCost(y))[0];
 263       if (cand && this.ecoBank >= g.upgradeCost(cand)) {
 264         const uc = g.upgradeCost(cand);
 265         if (typeof g.upgrade(cand) !== 'string') {
 266           this.ecoBank -= uc;
 267           this.cheapUpAt = T;
 268         }
 269       }
 270     }
 271     if (!want.length) {
 272       this.milBank += this.ecoBank * 0.5;
 273       this.ecoBank *= 0.5;
 274       return;
 275     }
 276     let actions = 0;
 277     for (const type of want) {
 278       if (actions >= 2) break;
 279       if (type.startsWith('up:')) {
 280         const t = type.slice(3);
 281         const b = mine.find((x) => x.type === t && x.built && !x.upgrading && x.level < x.def.maxLevel);
 282         if (!b || tooBusy) continue;
 283         const uc = g.upgradeCost(b);
 284         if (this.ecoBank < uc) {
 285           if (t === 'core') break;
 286           continue;
 287         }
 288         if (typeof g.upgrade(b) !== 'string') {
 289           this.ecoBank -= uc;
 290           actions++;
 291         }
 292         continue;
 293       }
 294       if (type === 'dome') {
 295         const dc = g.domeCost(this.pid);
 296         if (this.ecoBank + this.milBank < dc) break;
 297         if (!g.buyDome(this.pid)) {
 298           const fromEco = Math.min(this.ecoBank, dc);
 299           this.ecoBank -= fromEco;
 300           this.milBank = Math.max(0, this.milBank - (dc - fromEco));
 301           actions++;
 302         }
 303         continue;
 304       }
 305       const def = BUILDINGS[type];
 306       if (!def.sea && tooBusy) continue;
 307       const cost = def.cost;
 308       if (this.ecoBank < cost || p.coins < cost) break;
 309       if (def.energyCost && p.energy < def.energyCost) continue;
 310       const ci = def.sea ? this.seaSpot(type) : this.pickCell(type);
 311       if (ci < 0) continue;
 312       if (!g.place(this.pid, type, ci)) {
 313         this.ecoBank -= cost;
 314         actions++;
 315       }
 316     }
 317   }
 318 
 319   // Estructuras de mar: el lugar libre más cercano a la base (puede estar fuera del territorio).
 320   seaSpot(type) {
 321     const g = this.g;
 322     const core = this.coreCell();
 323     let best = -1;
 324     let bd = Infinity;
 325     for (const c of g.cells) {
 326       if (c.bld || (c.owner >= 0 && c.owner !== this.pid)) continue;
 327       const d = g.map.dist(c, core);
 328       if (d > 9) continue;
 329       if (g.placeInvalid(this.pid, type, c.i, true)) continue;
 330       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = c.i; }
 331     }
 332     return best;
 333   }
 334 
 335   // Constructores: 2 al empezar y más a medida que crece la base (máximo 5).
 336   // Barco constructor si hay estructuras de mar esperando.
 337   staffBuilders(mine, units) {
 338     const g = this.g;
 339     const want = Math.min(5, 2 + Math.floor(mine.length / 6));
 340     const have = units.filter((u) => u.def.builds === 'land').length +
 341       mine.reduce((s, b) => s + b.queue.filter((q) => UNITS[q.type].builds === 'land').length, 0);
 342     const sieged = g.time - this.siegeAt < 15;
 343     if (have < want && (!sieged || have === 0)) {
 344       const prod = mine.filter((b) => b.built && b.def.produces && b.def.produces.includes('builder') && b.queue.length < 2)
 345         .sort((a, b) => a.queue.length - b.queue.length)[0];
 346       if (prod && this.p.coins >= UNITS.builder.cost && !g.enqueue(prod, 'builder')) {
 347         this.ecoBank = Math.max(0, this.ecoBank - UNITS.builder.cost);
 348       }
 349     }
 350     const seaWork = mine.some((b) => g.needsWork(b) && b.def.builtBy === 'sea');
 351     if (seaWork) this.queueOnce(mine, 'harbor', 'boatEng');
 352   }
 353 
 354   pickCell(type) {
 355     const g = this.g;
 356     const core = this.coreCell();
 357     let best = -1;
 358     let bestS = Infinity;
 359     const toCenter = Math.hypot(core.x, core.z) || 1;
 360     for (const c of g.cells) {
 361       if (c.owner !== this.pid || c.bld || c.bridge) continue;
 362       if (g.placeInvalid(this.pid, type, c.i)) continue;
 363       const d = g.map.dist(c, core);
 364       if (d < 2 && type !== 'turret') continue;
 365       let s = Math.random() * 1.5;
 366       if (type === 'turret') {
 367         const dot = -(c.x * core.x + c.z * core.z) / toCenter;
 368         s += Math.abs(d - 2.5) * 2 - dot * 0.3;
 369       } else if (type === 'farm' || type === 'house') {
 370         s += Math.abs(d - 3);
 371       } else if (type === 'mine' || type === 'rig' || type === 'harbor') {
 372         s += d * 0.3;
 373       } else {
 374         s += d * 1.2;
 375       }
 376       // Evita tapar el paso: penaliza casillas con pocas vecinas libres.
 377       let free = 0;
 378       for (const ni of c.nb) {
 379         const nc = g.cells[ni];
 380         if (TERRAIN[nc.t].land && !nc.bld) free++;
 381       }
 382       if (TERRAIN[c.t].land && free < 3) s += 4;
 383       if (s < bestS) { bestS = s; best = c.i; }
 384     }
 385     return best;
 386   }
 387 
 388   // ---------- expansión ----------
 389   expand(mine, units) {
 390     const g = this.g;
 391     const T = g.time;
 392     if (T < 25) return;
 393     const outposts = mine.filter((b) => b.type === 'outpost').length;
 394     const maxOut = Math.min(6, 2 + Math.floor(T / 200));
 395     const busy = units.filter((u) => u.def.founds && u.state === 'found');
 396     if (outposts + busy.length >= maxOut) return;
 397     this.claimed = new Set(busy.map((u) => u.foundCell));
 398 
 399     const landEng = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'engineer' && u.state !== 'found' && u.state !== 'repair' && u.state !== 'build');
 400     const target = this.findExpansion('land');
 401     if (target >= 0) {
 402       if (landEng.length) {
 403         if (this.p.coins >= BUILDINGS.outpost.cost) g.orderFound(landEng[0], target);
 404       } else {
 405         this.queueOnce(mine, 'barracks', 'engineer');
 406       }
 407     }
 408     const harbors = mine.filter((b) => b.type === 'harbor' && b.built);
 409     if (harbors.length && T > 140) {
 410       const boats = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'boatEng' && u.state !== 'found');
 411       const st = this.findExpansion('sea');
 412       if (st >= 0) {
 413         if (boats.length) {
 414           if (this.p.coins >= BUILDINGS.outpost.cost) g.orderFound(boats[0], st);
 415         } else if ((this.boatEngs || 0) < 3 && this.ecoBank >= UNITS.boatEng.cost + BUILDINGS.outpost.cost) {
 416           if (this.queueOnce(mine, 'harbor', 'boatEng')) this.boatEngs = (this.boatEngs || 0) + 1;
 417         }
 418       }
 419     }
 420   }
 421 
 422   queueOnce(mine, btype, utype) {
 423     const g = this.g;
 424     const builders = mine.filter((b) => b.type === btype && b.built);
 425     if (!builders.length) return false;
 426     if (builders.some((b) => b.queue.some((q) => q.type === utype))) return false;
 427     if (g.units.some((u) => u.owner === this.pid && u.type === utype)) return false;
 428     if (g.enqueue(builders[0], utype)) return false;
 429     // Barcaza: gasto militar. Ingenieros: gasto de expansión.
 430     if (utype === 'barge' || utype === 'lander') this.milBank = Math.max(0, this.milBank - UNITS[utype].cost);
 431     else this.ecoBank = Math.max(0, this.ecoBank - UNITS[utype].cost);
 432     return true;
 433   }
 434 
 435   findExpansion(how) {
 436     const g = this.g;
 437     const core = this.coreCell();
 438     let best = -1;
 439     let bestS = Infinity;
 440     for (const r of g.cells) {
 441       if ((r.t !== 'gold' && r.t !== 'oil') || r.owner !== -1 || r.bld) continue;
 442       if (how === 'land' && r.t === 'oil') continue;
 443       for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 444         if (off.d > 2) break;
 445         const c = g.map.get(r.q + off.q, r.r + off.r);
 446         if (!c || this.claimed.has(c.i) || c.owner !== -1) continue;
 447         if (g.foundInvalid(this.pid, c.i, how)) continue;
 448         if (how === 'land' && c.comp !== core.comp) continue;
 449         const s = g.map.dist(c, core) + off.d * 0.5;
 450         if (s < bestS) { bestS = s; best = c.i; }
 451       }
 452     }
 453     return best;
 454   }
 455 
 456   // ---------- producción: plan de ejército y contrarrestos ----------
 457   enemyMix() {
 458     const g = this.g;
 459     const mix = { inf: 0, veh: 0, sea: 0, air: 0, total: 0 };
 460     for (const u of g.units) {
 461       if (!u.alive || !u.def.weapon || !g.isEnemy(u.owner, this.pid)) continue;
 462       mix[unitCat(u)]++;
 463       mix.total++;
 464     }
 465     for (const k of ['inf', 'veh', 'sea', 'air']) mix[k] = mix.total ? mix[k] / mix.total : 0;
 466     return mix;
 467   }
 468 
 469   pickUnit(producers, units) {
 470     const g = this.g;
 471     const T = g.time;
 472     const open = g.opts.mapKind === 'open';
 473     const cats = {};
 474     for (const b of producers) {
 475       if (b.type === 'barracks') cats.inf = 'barracks';
 476       else if (b.type === 'factory') cats.veh = 'factory';
 477       else if (b.type === 'harbor') cats.sea = 'harbor';
 478       else if (b.type === 'helipad') cats.air = 'helipad';
 479       else if (b.type === 'airport') cats.plane = 'airport';
 480     }
 481     const have = { inf: 0, veh: 0, sea: 0, air: 0, plane: 0 };
 482     const catOf = (d) => (d.plane ? 'plane' : unitCat(d));
 483     for (const u of units) if (u.def.weapon) have[catOf(u.def.cls ? { ...u.def, cls: u.cls } : u.def)]++;
 484     for (const b of producers) {
 485       for (const q of b.queue) if (UNITS[q.type].weapon) have[catOf(UNITS[q.type])]++;
 486     }
 487     const plan = { ...this.persona.plan, plane: Math.max(1, this.persona.plan.air) };
 488     if (open) {
 489       plan.sea += 2;
 490       plan.inf = Math.max(1, plan.inf - 1);
 491     }
 492     // v0.9: con mucho dinero guardado, más aviones (Cazas y Bombarderos).
 493     if (T > 900 && this.p.coins > 15000) plan.plane += 2;
 494     // Energía acumulada: prioriza tropas que la usan.
 495     if (this.p.energy > 120) {
 496       plan.veh += 2;
 497       plan.sea += 1;
 498       plan.air += 1;
 499     }
 500     const mix = this.enemyMix();
 501     if (this.tac.counter && mix.total >= 3) {
 502       if (mix.air >= 0.12) plan.veh += 2;
 503       if (mix.sea >= 0.25) plan.sea += 2;
 504       if (mix.veh >= 0.3) plan.inf += 1;
 505     }
 506     // Hostigamiento: si faltan tropas rápidas, entrena una (Jeep, Lancha o Helicóptero).
 507     if (this.tac.harass && T - this.wantFast < 40) {
 508       const fastHave = units.filter((u) => FAST_UNITS[u.type]).length +
 509         producers.reduce((s, b) => s + b.queue.filter((q) => FAST_UNITS[q.type]).length, 0);
 510       const opt = Object.entries(FAST_UNITS).find(([t, c]) => cats[c] && (t !== 'heli' || this.p.energy >= UNITS.heli.energy));
 511       if (opt && fastHave < 3) return { type: opt[0], btype: cats[opt[1]], since: T };
 512     }
 513     // Recién empezada la partida, o bajo ataque: infantería rápida.
 514     const urgent = T < 120 || g.time - this.threatAt < 12;
 515     let avail = Object.keys(cats);
 516     if (urgent && cats.inf) avail = ['inf'];
 517     let best = null;
 518     let bestGap = -Infinity;
 519     const planSum = avail.reduce((s, c) => s + plan[c], 0) || 1;
 520     const haveSum = avail.reduce((s, c) => s + have[c], 0) || 1;
 521     for (const c of avail) {
 522       const gap = plan[c] / planSum - have[c] / haveSum + Math.random() * 0.05;
 523       if (gap > bestGap) { bestGap = gap; best = c; }
 524     }
 525     if (!best) return null;
 526     return { type: this.unitFor(best, mix, have, units), btype: cats[best], since: T };
 527   }
 528 
 529   // v1.8: en Normal y Difícil, a veces cambia la tropa elegida por una nueva del catálogo con el mismo papel
 530   // (y del mismo edificio). Así los bots también usan las tropas nuevas sin gastar distinto.
 531   unitFor(cat, mix, have, units) {
 532     const pick = this.unitFor17(cat, mix, have, units);
 533     const swaps = AI_SWAPS[pick];
 534     if (!swaps || this.g.opts.difficulty === 'easy' || Math.random() >= AI_SWAP_CHANCE) return pick;
 535     return swaps[Math.floor(Math.random() * swaps.length)];
 536   }
 537 
 538   unitFor17(cat, mix, have, units) {
 539     const T = this.g.time;
 540     const r = Math.random();
 541     const counter = this.tac.counter && mix.total >= 3;
 542     if (cat === 'plane') {
 543       // Aeropuerto: Cazas si el rival tiene aire; si no, sobre todo Bombarderos.
 544       return (mix.air >= 0.1 && r < 0.75) || r < 0.35 ? 'fighter' : 'bomber';
 545     }
 546     if (cat === 'inf') {
 547       if (T < 90) return r < 0.7 ? 'rifle' : 'shotgun';
 548       const infN = units.filter((u) => u.cls === 'inf' && u.def.weapon).length;
 549       if (infN >= 6 && !units.some((u) => u.type === 'medic') && r < 0.25) return 'medic';
 550       if (counter && mix.veh >= 0.3) return r < 0.65 ? 'rocket' : 'rifle';
 551       if (counter && mix.inf >= 0.6) return r < 0.3 ? 'sniper' : r < 0.55 ? 'breaker' : r < 0.75 ? 'hunter' : 'rifle';
 552       return r < 0.3 ? 'rifle' : r < 0.45 ? 'ranger' : r < 0.58 ? 'shotgun' : r < 0.78 ? 'rocket' : r < 0.88 ? 'sniper' : r < 0.95 ? 'breaker' : 'hunter';
 553     }
 554     if (cat === 'veh') {
 555       const aaHave = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'aa').length;
 556       if (counter && mix.air >= 0.12 && aaHave < 3) return 'aa';
 557       if (counter && mix.veh >= 0.3) return r < 0.7 ? 'tank' : 'jeep';
 558       if (counter && mix.inf >= 0.6) return r < 0.55 ? 'jeep' : 'tank';
 559       if (mix.air > 0 && aaHave < 1) return 'aa';
 560       if (T < 300) return r < 0.5 ? 'jeep' : 'lighttank';
 561       // v1.7: también el Lanzacohetes múltiple.
 562       return r < 0.16 ? 'lighttank' : r < 0.34 ? 'tank' : r < 0.5 ? 'heavytank' : r < 0.6 ? 'jeep' : r < 0.65 ? 'arty'
 563         : r < 0.7 ? 'mlrs' : r < 0.8 ? 'missiletruck' : r < 0.9 ? 'launcher' : 'apc';
 564     }
 565     if (cat === 'sea') {
 566       if (counter && mix.air >= 0.15 && r < 0.4) return 'frigate';
 567       if (counter && mix.sea >= 0.25) return r < 0.5 ? 'destroyer' : 'sub';
 568       if (T > 900 && this.p.coins > UNITS.carrier.cost * 1.2 && !units.some((u) => u.type === 'carrier') && r < 0.5) return 'carrier';
 569       // v1.7: también la Lancha misilera.
 570       return r < 0.45 ? 'destroyer' : r < 0.6 ? 'speedboat' : r < 0.7 ? 'missileboat' : r < 0.85 ? 'frigate' : 'sub';
 571     }
 572     // v1.7: drones del Helipuerto (baratos) en parte de las veces; el kamikaze sobre todo contra vehículos.
 573     if (r < 0.2) return 'drone';
 574     if (r < 0.28 && (!counter || mix.veh >= 0.2)) return 'fpv';
 575     // El Apache no tiene límite (v0.9): con dinero de sobra, el bot lleva tantos Apaches como Helicópteros.
 576     const nApache = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'apache').length;
 577     const nHeli = units.filter((u) => u.type === 'heli').length;
 578     return nApache <= nHeli && this.p.coins > UNITS.apache.cost * 1.2 ? 'apache' : 'heli';
 579   }
 580 
 581   produce(mine, units) {
 582     const g = this.g;
 583     const p = this.p;
 584     const producers = mine.filter((b) => b.built && b.def.produces);
 585     if (!producers.length) {
 586       this.ecoBank += this.milBank;
 587       this.milBank = 0;
 588       return;
 589     }
 590     let budget = Math.min(p.coins, this.milBank);
 591     for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
 592       if (!this.saveFor || !producers.some((b) => b.type === this.saveFor.btype)) this.saveFor = this.pickUnit(producers, units);
 593       const s = this.saveFor;
 594       if (!s) return;
 595       const def = UNITS[s.type];
 596       const b = producers.filter((x) => x.type === s.btype && x.queue.length < 2)
 597         .sort((a, c) => a.queue.length - c.queue.length)[0];
 598       if (!b) return;
 599       if (def.cost > budget || p.energy < (def.energy || 0)) {
 600         // Ahorra para esta tropa; si tarda demasiado, vuelve a planificar.
 601         if (g.time - s.since > 70) this.saveFor = null;
 602         return;
 603       }
 604       const err = g.enqueue(b, s.type);
 605       this.saveFor = null;
 606       if (err) return;
 607       budget -= def.cost;
 608       this.milBank -= def.cost;
 609     }
 610   }
 611 
 612   // ---------- combate ----------
 613   defend(units) {
 614     const g = this.g;
 615     if (this.defendT > 0) return;
 616     this.defendT = 2;
 617     const core = this.coreCell();
 618     let threat = null;
 619     let td = Infinity;
 620     for (const e of g.units) {
 621       if (!e.alive || e.inside || !g.isEnemy(e.owner, this.pid)) continue;
 622       const c = g.cells[e.cell];
 623       const d = g.map.dist(c, core);
 624       if (c.owner === this.pid || d <= 5) {
 625         if (d < td) { td = d; threat = e; }
 626       }
 627     }
 628     if (!threat) return;
 629     // Urgencia (comprar infantería rápida) solo si el peligro está junto al Núcleo y el ejército es pequeño.
 630     const armySize = units.filter((u) => u.def.weapon).length;
 631     if (td <= 4 && armySize < 8) this.threatAt = g.time;
 632     if (td <= 3) this.siegeAt = g.time;
 633     // Una oleada que se estaba reuniendo vuelve a defender si el peligro está cerca del Núcleo.
 634     if (this.raid && td <= 4) {
 635       for (const u of this.raid.units) if (u.alive && u.role === 'raid') u.role = 'home';
 636       this.raid = null;
 637     }
 638     // Defensa en equipo (v0.8): van todas las tropas de casa, también las que salen de la producción,
 639     // y los hostigadores que estén cerca. Los guardias se quedan cuidando sus Banderas.
 640     const tc = g.cells[threat.cell];
 641     const near = (u) => g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], tc) <= 10;
 642     const guards = units.filter((u) => u.def.weapon && !u.inside && g.canAttack(u, u.def.weapon, threat) &&
 643       (u.role === 'home' || (u.role === 'harass' && near(u))) &&
 644       (u.state === 'idle' || u.state === 'move' || (u.state === 'amove' && u.role !== 'raid')));
 645     for (const u of guards) if (u.role !== 'home') u.role = 'home';
 646     const nearby = units.filter((u) => u.def.weapon && !u.inside && u.role !== 'retreat' && near(u));
 647     this.lastDefense = { t: g.time, cell: tc.i, near: nearby.length, sent: guards.filter(near).length,
 648       fighting: nearby.filter((u) => u.state === 'attack' || guards.includes(u)).length };
 649     if (this.tac.turret && td <= 7) this.defenseTurret(tc);
 650     const byMover = { land: [], sea: [], air: [] };
 651     for (const u of guards) byMover[u.mover].push(u);
 652     if (byMover.land.length && TERRAIN[tc.t].land) g.orderMove(byMover.land, tc.i, true);
 653     if (byMover.air.length) g.orderMove(byMover.air, tc.i, true);
 654     if (byMover.sea.length) {
 655       const wc = this.waterNear(tc, byMover.sea[0]);
 656       if (wc >= 0) g.orderMove(byMover.sea, wc, true);
 657     }
 658   }
 659 
 660   // Tropas con menos del 30 % de vida vuelven a curarse y luego regresan.
 661   retreat(units, mine) {
 662     const g = this.g;
 663     const core = this.p.core;
 664     for (const u of units) {
 665       if (!u.def.weapon || u.inside) continue;
 666       if (u.role === 'retreat') {
 667         if (u.hp >= u.maxHp * 0.85) {
 668           u.role = 'home';
 669           u.state = 'idle';
 670         } else if (u.state === 'idle' && u.retreatTo >= 0 && g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], g.cells[u.retreatTo]) > 2) {
 671           g.orderMove([u], u.retreatTo, false);
 672         }
 673         continue;
 674       }
 675       // Difícil (v1.0): retira a los heridos antes (45 % de vida) para curarlos.
 676       if (u.hp >= u.maxHp * (this.tac.medevac ? 0.45 : 0.3)) continue;
 677       const comp = g.cells[u.cell].comp;
 678       let spot = null;
 679       let sd = Infinity;
 680       const consider = (b) => {
 681         if (!b.alive || !b.built) return;
 682         const bc = g.cells[b.cell];
 683         if (u.mover === 'land' && bc.comp !== comp) return;
 684         if (u.mover === 'sea' && !bc.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === comp) && bc.comp !== comp) return;
 685         const d = g.map.dist(bc, g.cells[u.cell]);
 686         if (d < sd) { sd = d; spot = b; }
 687       };
 688       if (u.mover === 'sea') {
 689         for (const b of mine) if (b.type === 'harbor') consider(b);
 690       } else if (u.mover === 'air' && g.repairPadFor(u)) {
 691         consider(g.repairPadFor(u));
 692       } else {
 693         if (u.mover === 'land') for (const b of mine) if (b.type === 'hospital') consider(b);
 694         if (!spot || sd > 8) consider(core);
 695       }
 696       if (!spot) continue;
 697       const dest = g.freeCellsNear(spot.cell, u.mover, this.pid, 1)[0];
 698       u.role = 'retreat';
 699       u.retreatTo = dest;
 700       u.target = null;
 701       if (this.raid) this.raid.units = this.raid.units.filter((x) => x !== u);
 702       g.orderMove([u], dest, false);
 703       this.retreats++;
 704     }
 705   }
 706 
 707   // Ingenieros libres reparan los edificios dañados de la base.
 708   repairBase(units, mine) {
 709     const g = this.g;
 710     const engs = units.filter((u) => u.def.repairs && u.state === 'idle' && !u.inside);
 711     if (!engs.length) return;
 712     const damaged = mine.filter((b) => b.built && b.hp < b.maxHp * 0.9 && g.time - b.lastHit > REPAIR.pause)
 713       .sort((a, b) => a.hp / a.maxHp - b.hp / b.maxHp);
 714     for (const b of damaged) {
 715       const bc = g.cells[b.cell];
 716       const e = engs.find((x) => !g.isUnreach(x, b) && (g.cells[x.cell].comp === bc.comp || bc.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === g.cells[x.cell].comp)));
 717       if (!e) continue;
 718       g.orderRepair([e], b);
 719       engs.splice(engs.indexOf(e), 1);
 720       this.repairs++;
 721       if (!engs.length) return;
 722     }
 723   }
 724 
 725   waterNear(target, ship) {
 726     const g = this.g;
 727     const comp = g.cells[ship.cell].comp;
 728     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 729       if (off.d > 5) break;
 730       const c = g.map.get(target.q + off.q, target.r + off.r);
 731       if (c && TERRAIN[c.t].water && !c.bld && c.comp === comp) return c.i;
 732     }
 733     return -1;
 734   }
 735 
 736   coastNear(target, ship) {
 737     const g = this.g;
 738     const comp = g.cells[ship.cell].comp;
 739     for (const off of SPIRAL) {
 740       if (off.d > 6) break;
 741       const c = g.map.get(target.q + off.q, target.r + off.r);
 742       if (c && TERRAIN[c.t].water && !c.bld && c.comp === comp && g.map.isCoast(c)) return c.i;
 743     }
 744     return -1;
 745   }
 746 
 747   // Banderas sin dueño de tu equipo a las que no se llega por tierra.
 748   farFlags() {
 749     const g = this.g;
 750     const core = this.coreCell();
 751     const team = this.p.team;
 752     return g.points.filter((pt) => pt.type === 'flag' && (pt.owner < 0 || g.players[pt.owner].team !== team) &&
 753       g.cells[pt.cell].comp !== core.comp)
 754       .sort((a, b) => g.map.dist(g.cells[a.cell], core) - g.map.dist(g.cells[b.cell], core));
 755   }

 757   // Barcaza: lleva tropas a islas sin camino por tierra (Núcleos enemigos, el Faro o Banderas).
 758   ferry(mine, units) {
 759     const g = this.g;
 760     if (g.time < 200 || !mine.some((b) => b.type === 'harbor' && b.built)) return;
 761     const core = this.coreCell();
 762     const landReach = g.players.some((p) => p.alive && g.isEnemy(p.id, this.pid) && p.core.alive &&
 763       g.cells[p.core.cell].comp === core.comp);
 764     const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
 765     const faroByLand = !g.mode.king || !faro || g.cells[faro.cell].comp === core.comp;
 766     const flagsWanted = this.farFlags().length > 0 &&
 767       (!landReach || this.pkey === 'admiral' || this.pkey === 'keeper' || g.time > 420);
 768     if (landReach && faroByLand && !flagsWanted) return;
 769     // v0.9: pasados 10 minutos y con dinero, usa la Lancha de desembarco (más rápida, 10 lugares).
 770     const t = units.find((u) => u.type === 'barge' || u.type === 'lander');
 771     if (!t) {
 772       this.queueOnce(mine, 'harbor', g.time > 600 && this.p.coins > 4000 ? 'lander' : 'barge');
 773       return;
 774     }
 775     t.botMode = t.botMode || 'load';
 776     if (t.botMode === 'load') {
 777       if (t.state !== 'idle') return;
 778       if (g.map.dist(g.cells[t.cell], core) > 7) {
 779         const wc = this.coastNear(core, t);
 780         if (wc >= 0) g.orderMove([t], wc);
 781         return;
 782       }
 783       const boarding = units.filter((u) => u.state === 'board' && u.boardTarget === t);
 784       let slots = t.def.capacity - g.cargoSlots(t) - boarding.reduce((s, u) => s + (u.cls === 'veh' ? 2 : 1), 0);
 785       const pick = [];
 786       for (const u of units) {
 787         if (u.mover !== 'land' || !u.def.weapon || u.inside || u.role !== 'home' || u.state !== 'idle') continue;
 788         // v1.8: no vuelve a mandar a subir a quien ya esperó a esta Barcaza y no pudo llegar.
 789         if (g.isUnreach(u, t)) continue;
 790         const need = u.cls === 'veh' ? 2 : 1;
 791         if (need <= slots) {
 792           pick.push(u);
 793           slots -= need;
 794         }
 795       }
 796       if (pick.length) g.orderBoard(pick, t);
 797       t.loadT = (t.loadT || 0) + g.diff.think;
 798       const full = g.cargoSlots(t) >= t.def.capacity - 1;
 799       if (full || (t.cargo.length >= 3 && t.loadT > 60)) {
 800         const target = this.ferryTarget(landReach);
 801         if (!target) return;
 802         const wc = this.coastNear(g.cells[target.cell], t);
 803         if (wc < 0) return;
 804         for (const u of boarding) u.state = 'idle';
 805         t.botMode = 'sail';
 806         t.botTarget = target;
 807         t.loadT = 0;
 808         this.ferryTrips++;
 809         if (target.kind === 'bld') {
 810           this.coreRaids = (this.coreRaids || 0) + 1;
 811           if (this.firstRaidAt === undefined) this.firstRaidAt = g.time;
 812         }
 813         g.orderMove([t], wc);
 814       }
 815     } else if (t.botMode === 'sail') {
 816       if (t.state !== 'idle') return;
 817       const res = g.unload(t);
 818       if (typeof res !== 'string') {
 819         let target = t.botTarget && t.botTarget.alive ? t.botTarget : this.ferryTarget(landReach);
 820         if (target && target.kind === 'point') {
 821           const team = this.p.team;
 822           if (target.owner >= 0 && g.players[target.owner].team === team) target = null;
 823         }
 824         if (target && target.kind === 'point') {
 825           for (const u of res) {
 826             u.role = 'cap';
 827             u.capPoint = target;
 828             u.capSince = g.time;
 829           }
 830         } else {
 831           for (const u of res) u.role = 'wave';
 832         }
 833         if (target) g.orderMove(res, target.cell, true);
 834       }
 835       t.botMode = 'return';
 836       const wc = this.coastNear(core, t);
 837       if (wc >= 0) g.orderMove([t], wc);
 838     } else if (t.botMode === 'return' && t.state === 'idle') {
 839       t.botMode = 'load';
 840     }
 841   }
 842 
 843   ferryTarget(landReach = true) {
 844     const g = this.g;
 845     if (g.mode.king) {
 846       const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
 847       if (faro && (faro.owner < 0 || g.players[faro.owner].team !== this.p.team)) return faro;
 848     }
 849     const flags = this.farFlags();
 850     const flagFirst = this.pkey === 'keeper' || this.pkey === 'admiral' || this.ferryTrips % 2 === 1 || landReach;
 851     if (flags.length && flagFirst) return flags[0];
 852     if (landReach) return flags[0] || null;
 853     return this.chooseEnemyCore() || flags[0] || null;
 854   }
