 856   // ---------- órdenes de un aliado humano (v1.1) ----------
 857   // «¡Ayuda!»: manda hasta la mitad de su ejército (máx. 8) a defender la base del aliado.
 858   answerHelp(pid) {
 859     const g = this.g;
 860     const ally = g.players[pid];
 861     if (!this.p.alive || !ally || !ally.core || !ally.core.alive || g.isEnemy(pid, this.pid)) return 0;
 862     const home = g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === this.pid && u.def.weapon && !u.inside && u.role !== 'guard');
 863     if (!home.length) {
 864       g.say(this.pid, 'No tengo tropas libres ahora, ¡aguanta!', { force: true, toMe: true });
 865       return 0;
 866     }
 867     const go = home.slice(0, Math.min(8, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(home.length / 2))));
 868     const sent = this.sendTo(go, { cell: ally.core.cell });
 869     for (const u of sent) u.role = 'help';
 870     this.helpAt[pid] = g.time;
 871     if (sent.length) this.helpSent++;
 872     g.say(this.pid, sent.length ? `¡Voy a ayudarte con ${sent.length} tropas!` : 'No llego a tu base desde aquí.', { force: true, toMe: true });
 873     return sent.length;
 874   }
 875 
 876   // «¡Ataquemos!»: ataca ya al rival que elegiste y lo prefiere en sus oleadas por 3 minutos.
 877   answerAttack(targetPid) {
 878     const g = this.g;
 879     const foe = g.players[targetPid];
 880     if (!this.p.alive || !foe || !foe.alive || !g.isEnemy(targetPid, this.pid)) return 0;
 881     this.focusPid = targetPid;
 882     this.focusUntil = g.time + 180;
 883     const target = foe.core && foe.core.alive ? foe.core : g.buildings.find((b) => b.alive && b.owner === targetPid);
 884     if (!target) return 0;
 885     const army = g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === this.pid && u.def.weapon && !u.inside && u.role !== 'guard');
 886     const go = army.slice(0, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(army.length * 0.7)));
 887     const sent = go.length ? this.sendTo(go, target) : [];
 888     for (const u of sent) u.role = 'help';
 889     this.lastTarget = target;
 890     g.say(this.pid, sent.length ? `¡Vamos por ${foe.name}! Mando ${sent.length} tropas.` : `Atacaré a ${foe.name} con la próxima oleada.`, { force: true, toMe: true });
 891     return sent.length;
 892   }
 893 
 894   chooseEnemyCore() {
 895     const g = this.g;
 896     const core = this.coreCell();
 897     // v1.1: el rival que pidió el aliado humano con «¡Ataquemos!».
 898     if (this.focusPid !== undefined && g.time < this.focusUntil) {
 899       const f = g.players[this.focusPid];
 900       if (f && f.alive && f.core && f.core.alive && g.isEnemy(f.id, this.pid)) return f.core;
 901     }
 902     let cores = g.players
 903       .filter((p) => p.alive && g.isEnemy(p.id, this.pid) && p.core.alive)
 904       .map((p) => ({ p, d: g.map.dist(g.cells[p.core.cell], core) }))
 905       .sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
 906     if (!cores.length) return null;
 907     // Primero los Núcleos a los que el ejército llega a pie.
 908     const byLand = cores.filter((c) => g.cells[c.p.core.cell].comp === core.comp);
 909     if (byLand.length) cores = byLand;
 910     // Aliados coordinados (v0.8): atacan al mismo rival que un aliado bot.
 911     if (this.tac.teamwork) {
 912       for (const b of g.bots) {
 913         if (b === this || b.p.team !== this.p.team || !b.p.alive) continue;
 914         const t = b.lastTarget;
 915         if (t && t.alive && cores.some((c) => c.p.core === t) && Math.random() < 0.8) {
 916           this.lastTarget = t;
 917           return t;
 918         }
 919       }
 920     }
 921     const pickI = cores.length > 1 && Math.random() < 0.3 ? 1 : 0;
 922     this.lastTarget = cores[pickI].p.core;
 923     return this.lastTarget;
 924   }
 925 
 926   sendTo(units, targetB) {
 927     const g = this.g;
 928     const tc = g.cells[targetB.cell];
 929     const land = [];
 930     const air = [];
 931     const sea = [];
 932     for (const u of units) {
 933       if (u.mover === 'air') air.push(u);
 934       else if (u.mover === 'sea') sea.push(u);
 935       else if (g.cells[u.cell].comp === tc.comp || tc.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === g.cells[u.cell].comp)) land.push(u);
 936     }
 937     // Avanzan atacando, juntas (en bloque) para llegar a la vez; la línea se usa al reunirse.
 938     if (land.length) g.orderMove(land, tc.i, true);
 939     if (air.length) g.orderMove(air, tc.i, true);
 940     if (sea.length) {
 941       const wc = this.waterNear(tc, sea[0]);
 942       if (wc >= 0) g.orderMove(sea, wc, true);
 943     }
 944     return [...land, ...air, ...(sea.length && this.waterNear(tc, sea[0]) >= 0 ? sea : [])];
 945   }
 946 
 947   // ---------- v0.8: Torreta de defensa, hostigamiento y aliados ----------
 948   // Levanta una Torreta entre el Núcleo y el lado por donde vino el ataque (cada 45 s como mucho).
 949   defenseTurret(threatCell) {
 950     const g = this.g;
 951     if (g.time - this.turretAt < 45) return false;
 952     const core = this.coreCell();
 953     const p = this.p;
 954     if (p.coins < BUILDINGS.turret.cost + 200) return false;
 955     const dir = Math.atan2(threatCell.z - core.z, threatCell.x - core.x);
 956     const off = (c) => {
 957       let a = Math.atan2(c.z - core.z, c.x - core.x) - dir;
 958       while (a > Math.PI) a -= Math.PI * 2;
 959       while (a < -Math.PI) a += Math.PI * 2;
 960       return Math.abs(a);
 961     };
 962     const own = g.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.owner === this.pid && b.type === 'turret');
 963     const cand = g.cells.filter((c) => {
 964       const d = g.map.dist(c, core);
 965       return d >= 2 && d <= 3 && off(c) < 0.9 && !own.some((t) => g.map.dist(g.cells[t.cell], c) < 2) && !g.placeInvalid(this.pid, 'turret', c.i);
 966     }).sort((a, b) => off(a) - off(b));
 967     if (!cand.length) return false;
 968     if (g.place(this.pid, 'turret', cand[0].i)) return false;
 969     this.turretAt = g.time;
 970     this.defTurrets++;
 971     return true;
 972   }
 973 
 974   // Granja, Mina, Bomba o Plataforma enemiga lejos de sus defensas y alcanzable por esa tropa.
 975   ecoTarget(u, maxDist = Infinity) {
 976     const g = this.g;
 977     const uc = g.cells[u.cell];
 978     const defs = g.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && g.isEnemy(b.owner, this.pid) && b.def.weapon && g.canAttack(b, b.def.weapon, u));
 979     let best = null;
 980     let bs = Infinity;
 981     for (const b of g.buildings) {
 982       if (!b.alive || !g.isEnemy(b.owner, this.pid) || !ECO_TYPES.includes(b.type)) continue;
 983       const c = g.cells[b.cell];
 984       const d = g.map.dist(c, uc);
 985       if (d > maxDist) continue;
 986       if (u.mover === 'land' && c.comp !== uc.comp && !c.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === uc.comp)) continue;
 987       if (u.mover === 'sea' && this.waterNear(c, u) < 0) continue;
 988       let safe = 99;
 989       for (const t of defs) safe = Math.min(safe, g.map.dist(g.cells[t.cell], c) - (t.def.weapon.range || 4));
 990       if (safe < -1) continue;
 991       const s = d / 3 - Math.min(safe, 6) * 3;
 992       if (s < bs) { bs = s; best = b; }
 993     }
 994     return best;
 995   }
 996 
 997   // Hostigamiento: 2-3 tropas rápidas atacan la economía enemiga lejos de sus defensas.
 998   harass(units) {
 999     const g = this.g;
1000     const team = units.filter((u) => u.role === 'harass' && !u.inside);
1001     for (const u of team) {
1002       if (u.state !== 'idle') continue;
1003       const t = this.ecoTarget(u, 7);
1004       if (t) this.sendTo([u], t);
1005       else {
1006         u.role = 'home';
1007         g.orderMove([u], this.p.core.cell, false);
1008       }
1009     }
1010     if (team.length || g.time < this.nextHarassAt) return;
1011     const fast = units.filter((u) => FAST_UNITS[u.type] && u.role === 'home' && !u.inside && u.state === 'idle');
1012     if (fast.length < 2) {
1013       this.wantFast = g.time;
1014       return;
1015     }
1016     const group = fast.slice(0, 3);
1017     const target = this.ecoTarget(group[0]);
1018     if (!target) {
1019       this.nextHarassAt = g.time + 30;
1020       return;
1021     }
1022     const sent = this.sendTo(group, target);
1023     for (const u of sent) u.role = 'harass';
1024     if (sent.length) {
1025       this.harassSent++;
1026       if (this.firstHarassAt < 0) this.firstHarassAt = g.time;
1027       this.lastHarass = { t: g.time, target: target.type, owner: target.owner, units: sent.map((u) => u.type) };
1028       this.nextHarassAt = g.time + 80 + Math.random() * 40;
1029     } else this.nextHarassAt = g.time + 30;
1030   }
1031 
1032   // Aliados (Liga y Equipos): si atacan la base de un aliado, va la mitad del ejército de casa.
1033   helpAllies(units) {
1034     const g = this.g;
1035     if (g.time - (this._helpScan || -99) < 3) return;
1036     this._helpScan = g.time;
1037     // Las tropas que ya ayudaron vuelven a casa.
1038     for (const u of units) {
1039       if (u.role === 'help' && u.state === 'idle') {
1040         u.role = 'home';
1041         g.orderMove([u], this.p.core.cell, false);
1042       }
1043     }
1044     const me = this.p;
1045     for (const ally of g.players) {
1046       if (ally.id === this.pid || !ally.alive || ally.team !== me.team || !ally.core || !ally.core.alive) continue;
1047       if (g.time - (this.helpAt[ally.id] || -99) < 40) continue;
1048       const ac = g.cells[ally.core.cell];
1049       let threat = null;
1050       let n = 0;
1051       for (const e of g.units) {
1052         if (!e.alive || e.inside || !g.isEnemy(e.owner, this.pid) || !e.def.weapon) continue;
1053         if (g.map.dist(g.cells[e.cell], ac) <= 6) { n++; if (!threat) threat = e; }
1054       }
1055       if (!threat || n < 2) continue;
1056       const tc = g.cells[threat.cell];
1057       const home = units.filter((u) => u.def.weapon && u.role === 'home' && !u.inside && (u.state === 'idle' || u.state === 'move') && g.canAttack(u, u.def.weapon, threat) &&
1058         (u.mover !== 'land' || g.cells[u.cell].comp === tc.comp));
1059       if (home.length < 3) continue;
1060       const go = home.slice(0, Math.min(8, Math.ceil(home.length / 2)));
1061       const sent = this.sendTo(go, threat.kind === 'bld' ? threat : { cell: tc.i });
1062       for (const u of sent) u.role = 'help';
1063       if (sent.length) {
1064         this.helpAt[ally.id] = g.time;
1065         this.helpSent++;
1066         this.lastHelp = { t: g.time, ally: ally.id, units: sent.length };
1067         if (ally.human) g.say(this.pid, '¡Voy a ayudarte!', { x: tc.x, z: tc.z, queue: 2 });
1068       }
1069     }
1070   }
1071 
1072   // Siguiente objetivo de una tropa en oleada. En Difícil, primero las defensas cercanas.
1073   nextTarget(from, comp) {
1074     const g = this.g;
1075     let best = null;
1076     let bd = Infinity;
1077     for (const b of g.buildings) {
1078       if (!b.alive || !g.isEnemy(b.owner, this.pid)) continue;
1079       const c = g.cells[b.cell];
1080       if (comp !== undefined && c.comp !== comp && !c.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === comp)) continue;
1081       let d = g.map.dist(c, from);
1082       if (this.tac.focusDefense && b.def.weapon && b.type !== 'core' && d <= 6) d -= 10;
1083       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = b; }
1084     }
1085     return best;
1086   }
1087 
1088   // Envía escuadras de infantería a capturar Banderas y el Faro; deja un guardia en cada punto.
1089   capture(units) {
1090     const g = this.g;
1091     const T = g.time;
1092     if (T < 45) return;
1093     const myTeam = this.p.team;
1094     const core = this.coreCell();
1095     const king = !!g.mode.king;
1096     const squads = new Map();
1097     const guards = new Map();
1098     for (const u of units) {
1099       if (u.role === 'guard') {
1100         const pt = u.capPoint;
1101         if (!pt || pt.owner < 0 || g.players[pt.owner].team !== myTeam) {
1102           u.role = 'cap';
1103           u.capSince = T;
1104         } else {
1105           guards.set(pt, u);
1106           if (u.state === 'idle' && g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], g.cells[pt.cell]) > 1) g.orderMove([u], pt.cell, true);
1107           continue;
1108         }
1109       }
1110       if (u.role !== 'cap') continue;
1111       const pt = u.capPoint;
1112       const held = pt && pt.owner >= 0 && g.players[pt.owner].team === myTeam;
1113       if (!pt || (held && T - (u.capSince || 0) > (king && pt.type === 'faro' ? 9999 : 90))) {
1114         if (pt && held && !guards.has(pt) && guards.size < 3) {
1115           u.role = 'guard';
1116           guards.set(pt, u);
1117         } else {
1118           u.role = 'home';
1119           u.capPoint = null;
1120         }
1121         continue;
1122       }
1123       squads.set(pt, (squads.get(pt) || 0) + 1);
1124       if (u.state === 'idle' && g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], g.cells[pt.cell]) > 1) g.orderMove([u], pt.cell, true);
1125     }
1126     const maxSquads = (king ? 3 : 2) + this.persona.capture;
1127     if (squads.size >= maxSquads) return;
1128     const faroBias = (king ? 30 : 6) + this.persona.capture * 6;
1129     const targets = g.points
1130       .filter((pt) => !squads.has(pt) && (pt.owner < 0 || g.players[pt.owner].team !== myTeam))

1149   // Casilla propia más cercana al objetivo: allí se reúne la oleada antes de salir.

1213   attack(units) {

1231       const r = this.raid;
1232       r.units = r.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.role === 'raid');
1233       if (!r.units.length) {
1234         this.raid = null;
1235         return;
1236       }
1237       const st = g.cells[r.stage];
1238       const ready = r.units.filter((u) => u.mover === 'sea' || g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], st) <= 3).length;
1239       // No sale mientras su aviso de ataque espera turno (el límite de mensajes es de 20 s).
1240       const warning = this.p.pendingSay && this.p.pendingSay.opts.queue === 3;
1241       if ((ready >= r.units.length * 0.8 && !warning) || g.time - r.start > 25) {
1242         // Las rezagadas (a más de 5 casillas) se quedan en casa: nadie llega solo al combate.
1243         const go = r.units.filter((u) => u.mover !== 'land' || g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], st) <= 5);
1244         for (const u of r.units) if (!go.includes(u)) u.role = 'home';
1245         this.raid = null;
1246         if (go.length < 3) {
1247           for (const u of go) u.role = 'home';

1249           return;
1250         }
1251         const land = go.filter((u) => u.mover === 'land');
1252         const near = land.filter((u) => g.map.dist(g.cells[u.cell], st) <= 4).length;
1253         this.lastLaunch = { together: land.length ? near / land.length : 1, size: go.length, gathered: g.time - r.start };
1254         this.launch(go, r.target, true);

1256       return;
1257     }

1259     // que hay en casa (los guardias siguen en sus Banderas), dejando 3 defensores.
1260     if (this.tac.focus && g.time > 900 && g.time >= this.nextWaveAt) {
1261       const home = army.filter((u) => u.role === 'home');
1262       if (home.length >= 12) {
1263         const target = this.chooseEnemyCore();
1264         if (target) {
1265           const keep = home.filter((u) => u.mover === 'land').slice(0, 3);
1266           if (this.launch(home.filter((u) => !keep.includes(u)), target).length) {
1267             this.allIn = (this.allIn || 0) + 1;
1268             return;
1269           }
1270         }
1271       }
1272     }
1273     if (g.time < this.nextWaveAt) return;

1276     const late = g.time > this.nextWaveAt + 60;
1277     let need = Math.min(this.wave, Math.max(5, Math.floor(this.p.popCap * 0.5)), 3 + Math.floor(g.time / 150));
1278     if (late) need = Math.max(3, need - 2);

1280     const target = this.chooseEnemyCore();

1283     const tc = g.cells[target.cell];
1284     const reach = (u) => u.mover !== 'land' || g.cells[u.cell].comp === tc.comp || tc.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === g.cells[u.cell].comp);
1285     const home = army.filter((u) => (u.role === 'home' || (late && u.role === 'guard')) && reach(u));

1287     if (this.tac.group) {

1289       const coreComp = this.coreCell().comp;
1290       const raiders = home.filter((u) => u.mover !== 'land' || g.cells[u.cell].comp === coreComp);

1296         if (landers.length) g.orderMove(landers, stage, true, this.tac.line !== false ? 'line' : 'block');
1297         this.raid = { units: raiders, target, stage, start: g.time };
1298         this.announce(raiders, target);
1299         return;
1300       }

  78   // «Alta calidad» o «Más fluido» (la «Automática» elige entre las dos según los cuadros por segundo).
  79   applyQuality(q) {
  80     this.quality = q;
  81     const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  82     // v0.9: Alta llega a 2× en pantallas Retina (un poco más nítida).
  83     this.renderer.setPixelRatio(q === 'high' ? Math.min(dpr, 2) : 1);

  92     if (this.scene) {

  94         if (!o.material) return;
  95         if (o.isMesh) o.material = fastMat(o.material, FAST_MATS);
  96         o.material.needsUpdate = true;
  97       });
  98       this.applyLight(this.lightMode || lightPref());

 120   resize() {
 121     const w = this.canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
 122     const h = this.canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
 123     this.width = w;
 124     this.height = h;
 125     this.renderer.setSize(w, h, false);

 127       this.camera.aspect = w / h;

 130     }

 132     this.overlay.width = Math.round(w * dpr);

 135     if (this.fxs && this.camera) {

 137       const hpx = h * this.renderer.getPixelRatio();

 179   // ---------- v1.6.1: mar vivo (reflejos que se mueven y espuma en las costas) ----------

 196           Math.sin(u - 2 * v + 1.2 * Math.sin(u + v));
 197         const b = Math.round(255 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(w) / 1.1), 3));
 198         const o = (y * N + x) * 4;
 199         img.data[o] = b;
 200         img.data[o + 1] = b;
 201         img.data[o + 2] = b;
 202         img.data[o + 3] = 255;

 243     // Espuma: una franja en el agua por cada borde entre una casilla de agua y una de tierra.

 261         // Esquina «más» (compartida con la dirección anterior) y esquina «menos» (con la siguiente).

 270           const z = c.z + Math.sin(ka);
 271           pos.push(x, -0.012, z, x, -0.012, z);
 272           out.push(0, 0, Math.cos(oa) * W, Math.sin(oa) * W);
 273           edge.push(1, 0);
 274           phase.push(ph, ph);
 275         }
 276         idx.push(base, base + 1, base + 2, base + 2, base + 1, base + 3);
 277       }
 278     }
 279     const fg = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 280     fg.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
 281     fg.setAttribute('aOut', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(out, 2));
 282     fg.setAttribute('aEdge', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(edge, 1));
 283     fg.setAttribute('aPhase', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(phase, 1));
 284     fg.setIndex(idx);
 285     this.foamMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
 286       uniforms: { time: { value: 0 }, strength: { value: 0.85 } },
 287       // La franja se ensancha y se encoge despacio, cada tramo a su ritmo (las olas llegan y se van).
 288       vertexShader: `attribute vec2 aOut;
 289         attribute float aEdge;
 290         attribute float aPhase;
 291         uniform float time;
 292         varying float vEdge;
 293         varying float vWave;
 294         void main() {
 295           float wave = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(time * 1.15 + aPhase);
 296           vec3 p = position;
 297           p.xz += aOut * (0.5 + 0.5 * wave);
 298           vEdge = aEdge;
 299           vWave = wave;
 300           gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0);
 301         }`,
 302       fragmentShader: `uniform float strength;
 303         varying float vEdge;
 304         varying float vWave;
 305         void main() {
 306           // Blanca y firme junto a la orilla; se deshace hacia el mar. Más marcada cuando la ola se retira.
 307           float a = smoothstep(0.0, 0.55, vEdge) * (0.5 + 0.5 * (1.0 - vWave)) * strength;
 308           gl_FragColor = vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, a);
 309         }`,
 310       transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
 311     });
 312     this.foamMesh = new THREE.Mesh(fg, this.foamMat);
 313     this.foamMesh.frustumCulled = false;
 314     this.foamMesh.renderOrder = 1;
 315     this.foamCount = idx.length / 6;
 316     this.scene.add(this.foamMesh);
 317   }

 330   buildDecor() {
 331     const g = this.game;
 332     const rng = mulberry32(g.opts.seed + 9);
 333     const trees = [];
 334     const peaks = [];
 335     const golds = [];
 336     const oils = [];
 337     const rocks = [];
 338     for (const c of g.cells) {
 339       if (c.t === 'forest') {
 340         const k = 2 + Math.floor(rng() * 2);
 341         c.trees = [];
 342         for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) {
 343           const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
 344           const r = 0.2 + rng() * 0.45;
 345           c.trees.push(trees.length);
 346           trees.push({ x: c.x + Math.cos(a) * r, y: c.h, z: c.z + Math.sin(a) * r, s: 0.75 + rng() * 0.5, c: c.i });
 347         }
 348       } else if (c.t === 'mount') {
 349         peaks.push({ x: c.x + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.2, y: c.h, z: c.z + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.2, s: 0.85 + rng() * 0.35, c: c.i });
 350       } else if (c.t === 'gold') {
 351         c.golds = [];
 352         for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
 353           const a = (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + rng();
 354           c.golds.push(golds.length);
 355           golds.push({ x: c.x + Math.cos(a) * 0.4, y: c.h + 0.1, z: c.z + Math.sin(a) * 0.4, s: 0.12 + rng() * 0.06, c: c.i });
 356         }
 357       } else if (c.t === 'oil') {
 358         c.oil = oils.length;
 359         oils.push({ x: c.x, y: c.h + 0.015, z: c.z, s: 0.62, c: c.i });
 360       } else if ((c.t === 'grass' || c.t === 'sand') && rng() < 0.07) {
 361         rocks.push({ x: c.x + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.1, y: c.h, z: c.z + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.1, s: 0.09 + rng() * 0.08, c: c.i });
 362       }
 363     }
 364     const inst = (geo, mat, list, place, shadow = true) => {
 365       const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, Math.max(1, list.length));
 366       mesh.count = list.length;
 367       const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
 368       list.forEach((it, i) => mesh.setMatrixAt(i, place(it, m)));
 369       mesh.castShadow = shadow;
 370       mesh.receiveShadow = true;
 371       this.scene.add(mesh);
 372       return mesh;
 373     };
 374     const flat = (color, extra = {}) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, flatShading: true, roughness: 0.9, ...extra });
 375     const trunkGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.06, 0.25, 5);
 376     trunkGeo.translate(0, 0.125, 0);
 377     const crownGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.26, 0.62, 6);
 378     crownGeo.translate(0, 0.52, 0);
 379     const placeTree = (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, it.s, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y, it.z);
 380     this.trees = trees;
 381     this.treeTrunks = inst(trunkGeo, flat(0x7a5232), trees, placeTree);
 382     this.treeCrowns = inst(crownGeo, flat(0x3f8a3a), trees, placeTree);
 383     const tc = new THREE.Color();
 384     trees.forEach((t, i) => {
 385       tc.set(0x3f8a3a).offsetHSL((rng() - 0.5) * 0.04, 0, (rng() - 0.5) * 0.12);
 386       this.treeCrowns.setColorAt(i, tc);
 387     });
 388 
 389     const peakGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.88, 1.5, 6);
 390     peakGeo.translate(0, 0.75, 0);
 391     const capGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.36, 0.6, 6);
 392     capGeo.translate(0, 1.21, 0);
 393     const placePeak = (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, it.s, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y, it.z);
 394     inst(peakGeo, flat(0x8f8a80), peaks, placePeak);
 395     inst(capGeo, flat(0xf4f6f8), peaks, placePeak);
 396 
 397     this.golds = golds;
 398     this.goldMesh = inst(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0),
 399       flat(0xffcf3a, { emissive: 0x8a6400, emissiveIntensity: 0.5, roughness: 0.4 }), golds,
 400       (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, it.s * 1.5, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y + it.s, it.z));
 401     this.oils = oils;
 402     const oilGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 0.02, 10);
 403     this.oilMesh = inst(oilGeo, flat(0x161a20, { roughness: 0.25, metalness: 0.4 }), oils,
 404       (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, 1, it.s * 0.8).setPosition(it.x, it.y, it.z), false);
 405     inst(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1, 0), flat(0x9a978f), rocks,
 406       (it, m) => m.makeScale(it.s, it.s * 0.7, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y + it.s * 0.4, it.z));
 407   }

 409   // Oculta árboles, oro y petróleo bajo los edificios.
 410   refreshDecor() {
 411     const g = this.game;
 412     const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
 413     const zero = new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(0, 0, 0);
 414     this.trees.forEach((t, i) => {
 415       const hidden = !!g.cells[t.c].bld;
 416       const mat = hidden ? zero : m.makeScale(t.s, t.s, t.s).setPosition(t.x, t.y, t.z);
 417       this.treeTrunks.setMatrixAt(i, mat);
 418       this.treeCrowns.setMatrixAt(i, mat);
 419     });

 423       const hidden = !!g.cells[it.c].bld;
 424       this.goldMesh.setMatrixAt(i, hidden ? zero : m.makeScale(it.s, it.s * 1.5, it.s).setPosition(it.x, it.y + it.s, it.z));
 425     });

 427     this.oils.forEach((it, i) => {
 428       const hidden = !!g.cells[it.c].bld;
 429       this.oilMesh.setMatrixAt(i, hidden ? zero : m.makeScale(it.s, 1, it.s * 0.8).setPosition(it.x, it.y, it.z));
 430     });
 431     this.oilMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;

 442   rebuildBorders() {
 443     const g = this.game;
 444     const pos = [];
 445     const col = [];
 446     const tmp = new THREE.Color();
 447     for (const c of g.cells) {
 448       if (c.owner < 0) continue;
 449       tmp.set(PLAYER_COLORS[c.owner]);
 450       const y = Math.max(c.h, 0) + 0.035;
 451       for (const [dq, dr] of HEX_DIRS) {
 452         const n = g.map.get(c.q + dq, c.r + dr);
 453         if (n && n.owner === c.owner) continue;
 454         const w = hexToWorld(dq, dr);
 455         const a = Math.atan2(w.z, w.x);
 456         const a1 = a - Math.PI / 6;
 457         const a2 = a + Math.PI / 6;
 458         const o = 0.97;
 459         const i = 0.8;
 460         const p1 = [c.x + Math.cos(a1) * o, y, c.z + Math.sin(a1) * o];
 461         const p2 = [c.x + Math.cos(a2) * o, y, c.z + Math.sin(a2) * o];
 462         const p3 = [c.x + Math.cos(a2) * i, y, c.z + Math.sin(a2) * i];
 463         const p4 = [c.x + Math.cos(a1) * i, y, c.z + Math.sin(a1) * i];
 464         pos.push(...p1, ...p3, ...p2, ...p1, ...p4, ...p3);
 465         for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) col.push(tmp.r, tmp.g, tmp.b);
 466       }
 467     }
 468     const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 469     geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
 470     geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col, 3));
 471     this.borderMesh.geometry.dispose();
 472     this.borderMesh.geometry = geo;
 473   }

 542   // ¿Cae en el agua? Entonces salpica.
 543   overWater(x, z) {
 544     const h = worldToHex(x, z);
 545     const c = this.game.map.get(h.q, h.r);
 546     return !!(c && TERRAIN[c.t].water && !c.bld);

 549   spawnBoom(x, y, z, s, small, bld) {
 550     if (small) {
 551       if (this.overWater(x, z)) this.fxs.splash(x, z, s);
 552       else this.fxs.impact(x, y, z, s);
 553     } else {
 554       this.fxs.explosion(x, y, z, s, bld);
 555       if (this.overWater(x, z)) this.fxs.splash(x, z, s * 1.2);
 556     }
 557   }

 559   // Láser del Núcleo (punto 17): un rayo ámbar brillante que dura un instante.
 560   spawnLaser(f) {
 561     if (!this.lasers) {
 562       this.lasers = [];
 563       this.laserGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 8, 1, true).rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
 564     }
 565     let L = this.lasers.find((l) => l.t >= l.dur);
 566     if (!L) {
 567       if (this.lasers.length >= 12) return;
 568       const outer = new THREE.Mesh(this.laserGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffb63a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.6, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }));
 569       const inner = new THREE.Mesh(this.laserGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfff4d6, transparent: true, opacity: 0.95, depthWrite: false }));
 570       const grp = new THREE.Group();
 571       grp.add(outer);
 572       grp.add(inner);
 573       this.scene.add(grp);
 574       L = { grp, outer, inner, t: 1, dur: 0.18 };
 575       this.lasers.push(L);
 576     }
 577     const a = new THREE.Vector3(f.x1, f.y1, f.z1);
 578     const b = new THREE.Vector3(f.x2, f.y2, f.z2);
 579     const len = a.distanceTo(b);
 580     L.grp.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5);
 581     L.grp.lookAt(b);
 582     L.outer.scale.set(0.09, 0.09, len);
 583     L.inner.scale.set(0.035, 0.035, len);
 584     L.grp.visible = true;
 585     L.t = 0;
 586   }
 587 
 588   updateLasers(dt) {
 589     if (!this.lasers) return;
 590     for (const L of this.lasers) {
 591       if (L.t >= L.dur) { L.grp.visible = false; continue; }
 592       L.t += dt;
 593       const k = 1 - L.t / L.dur;
 594       L.outer.material.opacity = 0.6 * k;
 595       L.inner.material.opacity = 0.95 * k;
 596     }
 597     this.laserCount = this.lasers.filter((L) => L.t < L.dur).length;
 598   }

 604   // Explosión del misil nuclear: destello enorme, bola de fuego y columna de humo (sin nada violento).
 605   spawnNuke(x, y, z) {
 606     this.fxs.flash(x, y + 1, z, 9);
 607     this.fxs.explosion(x, y + 0.3, z, 4, true);
 608     for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
 609       const a = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2;
 610       this.fxs.explosion(x + Math.cos(a) * 3.5, y + 0.2, z + Math.sin(a) * 3.5, 1.6, true);
 611     }
 612     for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) this.fxs.smoke(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, y + i * 0.35, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, 2.6);
 613     this.nukeFlashT = 1.2;
 614   }

 616   // Radiación (v1.0): fuego y humo sueltos dentro de la zona mientras dura.
 617   spawnRadBurn(f) {
 618     const n = this.quality === 'high' ? 3 : 1;
 619     for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 620       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
 621       const d = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * f.r * 0.85;
 622       const x = f.x + Math.cos(a) * d;
 623       const z = f.z + Math.sin(a) * d;
 624       if (Math.random() < 0.45) this.fxs.explosion(x, f.y + 0.15, z, 0.45, false);
 625       this.fxs.smoke(x, f.y + 0.4, z, 1.2);
 626     }
 627   }

 629   // Disco verde de la zona de radiación, que late y se apaga al final.
 630   updateRadZones(time) {
 631     const g = this.game;
 632     const zones = g.radZones || [];
 633     if (!this.radMeshes) this.radMeshes = new Map();
 634     for (const [z, m] of this.radMeshes) {
 635       if (!zones.includes(z)) {
 636         this.scene.remove(m);
 637         m.material.dispose();
 638         this.radMeshes.delete(z);
 639       }
 640     }
 641     const R = NUKE.radius * SQ3 + 0.6;
 642     for (const z of zones) {
 643       let m = this.radMeshes.get(z);
 644       if (!m) {
 645         if (!this.radGeo) {
 646           this.radGeo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 40);
 647           this.radGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
 648         }
 649         m = new THREE.Mesh(this.radGeo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x7cff4a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }));
 650         m.scale.setScalar(R);
 651         m.position.set(z.x, z.y + 0.08, z.z);
 652         m.renderOrder = 3;
 653         this.scene.add(m);
 654         this.radMeshes.set(z, m);
 655       }
 656       const left = Math.max(0, z.until - g.time);
 657       const fade = Math.min(1, left / 8);
 658       m.material.opacity = (0.16 + 0.1 * Math.sin(time * 3)) * fade;
 659     }
 660   }
 661 
 662   consumeFx() {
 663     const g = this.game;
 664     for (const f of g.fx) {
 665       if (f.k === 'laser') this.spawnLaser(f);
 666       else if (f.k === 'tracer') {
 667         if (this.tracers.length < this.MAXT) this.tracers.push({ ...f, t: 0, dur: f.heavy ? 0.12 : 0.07 });
 668         // Fogonazo en el cañón y chispa donde pega.
 669         if (f.heavy || Math.random() < 0.6) this.fxs.flash(f.x1, f.y1, f.z1, f.heavy ? 0.36 : 0.24);
 670         if (Math.random() < 0.35) this.fxs.sparks(f.x2, f.y2, f.z2, 0.4, 1);
 671       } else if (f.k === 'boom') this.spawnBoom(f.x, f.y, f.z, f.s, f.small, f.bld);
 672       else if (f.k === 'spark') this.fxs.sparks(f.x, f.y, f.z, f.s, 2);
 673       else if (f.k === 'heal') this.spawnHeal(f.x, f.y, f.z);
 674       else if (f.k === 'flare') {
 675         // Bengalas del Apache: chispas brillantes hacia los lados.
 676         for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.fxs.sparks(f.x, f.y, f.z, 1.2, 4);
 677         this.fxs.flash(f.x, f.y, f.z, 0.6);
 678       } else if (f.k === 'nuke') this.spawnNuke(f.x, f.y, f.z);
 679       else if (f.k === 'rad') this.spawnRadBurn(f);
 680     }
 681     g.fx.length = 0;
 682   }
 683 
 684   updateFx(dt) {
 685     // Trazadoras
 686     let n = 0;
 687     const tmp = new THREE.Color();
 688     this.tracers = this.tracers.filter((t) => (t.t += dt) < t.dur);
 689     for (const t of this.tracers) {
 690       tmp.set(t.color).lerp(new THREE.Color(0xffffff), 0.55);
 691       const o = n * 6;
 692       this.tracerPos[o] = t.x1; this.tracerPos[o + 1] = t.y1; this.tracerPos[o + 2] = t.z1;
 693       this.tracerPos[o + 3] = t.x2; this.tracerPos[o + 4] = t.y2; this.tracerPos[o + 5] = t.z2;
 694       for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
 695         this.tracerCol[o + k * 3] = tmp.r;
 696         this.tracerCol[o + k * 3 + 1] = tmp.g;
 697         this.tracerCol[o + k * 3 + 2] = tmp.b;
 698       }
 699       n++;
 700     }
 701     this.tracerLines.geometry.setDrawRange(0, n * 2);
 702     this.tracerLines.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
 703     this.tracerLines.geometry.attributes.color.needsUpdate = true;
 704 
 705     this.fxs.update(dt);
 706 
 707     // Proyectiles
 708     const used = { rocket: 0, shell: 0, torpedo: 0, missile: 0, bomb: 0, nuke: 0 };
 709     for (const p of this.game.projectiles) {
 710       const list = this.projMeshes[p.kind];
 711       if (!list) continue;
 712       let mesh = list[used[p.kind]];
 713       if (!mesh) {
 714         mesh = new THREE.Mesh(this.projGeo[p.kind], this.projMat[p.kind]);
 715         this.scene.add(mesh);
 716         list.push(mesh);
 717       }
 718       used[p.kind]++;
 719       const k = Math.min(1, p.time / p.dur);
 720       const arc = p.kind === 'shell' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 1.1 : p.kind === 'rocket' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.35
 721         : p.kind === 'missile' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 2.6 : p.kind === 'nuke' ? Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 14 : 0;
 722       const y = p.kind === 'torpedo' ? -0.02 : p.sy + (p.ty - p.sy) * k + arc;
 723       mesh.position.set(p.sx + (p.tx - p.sx) * k, y, p.sz + (p.tz - p.sz) * k);
 724       mesh.lookAt(p.tx, p.kind === 'torpedo' ? -0.02 : p.ty, p.tz);
 725       mesh.visible = true;
 726       // Estela de humo detrás de cohetes y misiles (más gruesa en el misil nuclear).
 727       if ((p.kind === 'rocket' || p.kind === 'missile') && Math.random() < dt * 45 * this.fxs.scale) {
 728         this.fxs.trail(mesh.position.x, mesh.position.y, mesh.position.z);
 729       }
 730       if (p.kind === 'nuke') {
 731         for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.fxs.trail(mesh.position.x, mesh.position.y, mesh.position.z);
 732         this.fxs.flash(mesh.position.x, mesh.position.y, mesh.position.z, 0.5);
 733       }
 734     }
 735     for (const kind of Object.keys(this.projMeshes)) {
 736       const list = this.projMeshes[kind];
 737       for (let i = used[kind]; i < list.length; i++) list[i].visible = false;
 738     }
 739 
 740     this.markers = this.markers.filter((mk) => {
 741       mk.t += dt;
 742       const k = mk.t / 0.6;
 743       if (k >= 1) {
 744         this.scene.remove(mk.mesh);
 745         return false;
 746       }
 747       mk.mesh.scale.setScalar(1.6 - k);
 748       mk.mesh.material.opacity = 1 - k;
 749       return true;
 750     });
 751   }

 754     this.pings.push({ x, z, kind, t: performance.now() });
 755     if (this.pings.length > 12) this.pings.shift();

 789   buildShields() {

 791       const r = DOME.range * SQ3 + 0.5;
 792       const dome = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, 32, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),
 793         new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4aa8ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.08, depthWrite: false }));
 794       const rim = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(r, 0.05, 6, 48).rotateX(Math.PI / 2),
 795         new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4aa8ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7, depthWrite: false }));
 796       dome.add(rim);
 797       dome.renderOrder = 6;
 798       dome.visible = false;
 799       const bubble = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.7, 24, 14),
 800         new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffb63a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3, depthWrite: false }));
 801       bubble.renderOrder = 6;
 802       bubble.visible = false;
 803       this.scene.add(dome);
 804       this.scene.add(bubble);

 809   updateShields(time) {
 810     const g = this.game;
 811     g.players.forEach((p, i) => {
 812       const v = this.shieldVis[i];
 813       const core = p.core;
 814       const domeOn = p.alive && core.alive && p.dome && p.dome.hp > 0;
 815       v.dome.visible = !!domeOn;
 816       if (domeOn) {
 817         const k = p.dome.hp / p.dome.maxHp;
 818         const col = k > 0.6 ? 0x4aa8ff : k > 0.3 ? 0xf2c94c : 0xef5350;
 819         v.dome.material.color.set(col);
 820         v.rim.material.color.set(col);
 821         const hit = g.time - p.dome.lastHit < 0.25;
 822         v.dome.material.opacity = hit ? 0.22 : 0.08;
 823         v.dome.position.set(core.x, core.y, core.z);
 824       }
 825       const shield = p.alive && core.alive && core.shieldUntil > g.time;
 826       v.bubble.visible = !!shield;
 827       if (shield) {
 828         v.bubble.position.set(core.x, core.y + 0.6, core.z);
 829         v.bubble.material.opacity = 0.22 + Math.sin(time * 6) * 0.08;
 830       }
 831     });

 834   // ---------- vista previa de construcción ----------
 835   setGhost(type, ci, rot, valid) {
 836     if (this.ghost && (this.ghost.type !== type)) {
 837       this.scene.remove(this.ghost.group);
 838       this.ghost = null;
 839     }
 840     if (!type || ci < 0) {
 841       if (this.ghost) this.ghost.group.visible = false;
 842       if (this.ghostRange) this.ghostRange.visible = false;
 843       return;
 844     }
 845     if (!this.ghost) {
 846       const m = getModel(type === 'wall' && GLB.wall_post ? 'wall_post' : type, PLAYER_COLORS[0]);
 847       // Holograma ámbar (documento pág. 7); rojo cuando no se puede.
 848       const okMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffb63a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false });
 849       const badMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff5a5a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false });
 850       const group = new THREE.Group();
 851       const parts = [];
 852       const pp = m.partPos || {};
 853       for (const key of ['main', 'turret', 'rotor', 'rocker', 'blades', 'crystal']) {
 854         if (!m[key]) continue;
 855         const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(m[key], okMat);
 856         if (pp[key]) mesh.position.copy(pp[key]);
 857         else if (key === 'turret') mesh.position.set(0, m.turretY || 0, m.turretZ || 0);
 858         else if (key === 'rocker') mesh.position.set(0, m.rockerY, m.rockerZ || 0);
 859         else if (key === 'blades') mesh.position.set(0, m.bladesY, m.bladesZ);
 860         else if (key === 'crystal') mesh.position.y = m.crystalY;
 861         mesh.renderOrder = 7;
 862         group.add(mesh);
 863         parts.push(mesh);
 864       }
 865       this.scene.add(group);
 866       this.ghost = { type, group, parts, okMat, badMat };
 867     }
 868     const c = this.game.cells[ci];
 869     const gh = this.ghost;
 870     gh.group.visible = true;
 871     gh.group.position.set(c.x, c.h, c.z);
 872     gh.group.rotation.y = rot;
 873     for (const mesh of gh.parts) mesh.material = valid ? gh.okMat : gh.badMat;
 874     // v1.6: alcance de la defensa antes de ponerla (con la ventaja de altura de las mesetas).
 875     const w = BUILDINGS[type] && BUILDINGS[type].weapon;
 876     if (w) {
 877       if (!this.ghostRange) {
 878         this.ghostRange = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.96, 1, 72).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2),
 879           new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffd36a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, depthWrite: false }));
 880         this.ghostRange.renderOrder = 6;
 881         this.scene.add(this.ghostRange);
 882       }
 883       const hb = w.range >= 2 && TERRAIN[c.t].highGround ? 1 : 0;
 884       const R = (w.range + hb) * SQ3 + 0.75;
 885       this.ghostRange.visible = true;
 886       this.ghostRange.scale.setScalar(R);
 887       this.ghostRange.userData = { radius: R, range: w.range + hb, type };
 888       this.ghostRange.position.set(c.x, c.h + 0.07, c.z);
 889       this.ghostRange.material.color.set(valid ? 0xffd36a : 0xff6b6b);
 890     } else if (this.ghostRange) this.ghostRange.visible = false;
 891     this.hoverMesh.material.color.set(valid ? 0x8dffb0 : 0xff6b6b);
 892     this.setHover(ci);
 893   }

 895   // Aspecto equipado en el Inventario: solo para tus tropas y tu Núcleo.

 898     if (!looks || e.owner !== 0) return null;
 899     return looks[skinSlotOf(e.kind === 'bld' ? 'bld' : 'unit', e.type)] || null;

 902   // ---------- entidades ----------
 903   syncEntities(dt, time) {
 904     const g = this.game;
 905     let smoking = 0;
 906     for (const e of g.removed) {
 907       const v = this.vis.get(e.id);
 908       if (v) {
 909         this.scene.remove(v.group);
 910         this.vis.delete(e.id);
 911       }
 912     }
 913     g.removed.length = 0;
 914 
 915     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
 916     for (const b of g.buildings) {
 917       // Núcleo, Torreta y Enfermería tienen un modelo distinto por nivel.
 918       const mkey = GLB[b.type + '_' + b.level] ? b.type + '_' + b.level : b.type;
 919       let v = this.vis.get(b.id);
 920       if (v && v.mkey !== mkey) {
 921         this.scene.remove(v.group);
 922         this.vis.delete(b.id);
 923         v = null;
 924       }
 925       if (!v) {
 926         v = b.type === 'wall' ? this.createWall(b) : createVisual(mkey, PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner], this.lookFor(b));
 927         v.mkey = mkey;
 928         v.group.rotation.y = b.type === 'wall' ? 0 : b.rot;
 929         v.group.position.set(b.x, b.y, b.z);
 930         this.scene.add(v.group);
 931         this.vis.set(b.id, v);
 932       }
 933       if (b.type === 'wall') this.updateWall(b, v);
 934       // v1.8: las minas enemigas no se ven si ningún detector las descubrió.
 935       if (b.def.stealth) v.group.visible = b.visible !== false;
 936       // Humo de daño: un edificio con menos del 40 % de vida echa humo hasta que lo reparan.
 937       if (b.built && b.hp < b.maxHp * 0.4) {
 938         smoking++;
 939         v.smokeT = (v.smokeT || 0) - dt;
 940         if (v.smokeT <= 0) {
 941           v.smokeT = this.quality === 'high' ? 0.32 : 0.65;
 942           this.fxs.smoke(b.x, b.y + (b.type === 'core' ? 1.1 : 0.6), b.z, b.type === 'core' ? 0.8 : 0.55);
 943         }
 944       }
 945       const k = b.built ? 1 : 0.2 + 0.8 * b.progress;
 946       v.main.scale.y = k;
 947       // Andamio mientras se construye o se mejora.
 948       const working = !b.built || !!b.upgrading;
 949       if (working && !v.scaffold && GLB.scaffold) {
 950         v.scaffold = new THREE.Mesh(getModel('scaffold', PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner]).main, fastMat(GLB_MAT, FAST_MATS));
 951         v.scaffold.rotation.y = -v.group.rotation.y;
 952         if (b.type === 'core') v.scaffold.scale.set(1.35, 1.6, 1.35);
 953         v.group.add(v.scaffold);
 954       }
 955       if (v.scaffold) v.scaffold.visible = working;
 956       if (v.turret) {
 957         v.turret.position.y = v.turretBaseY * k;
 958         v.turret.rotation.y = b.aimYaw - b.rot;
 959       }
 960       if (v.blades && b.built) {
 961         if (b.type === 'hydro') v.blades.rotation.x += dt * 1.6;
 962         else v.blades.rotation.z += dt * 2.2;
 963       }
 964       if (v.rocker) {
 965         v.rocker.visible = b.built;
 966         v.rocker.rotation.x = b.built ? Math.sin(time * 2.2 + b.id) * (b.type === 'wave' ? 0.12 : 0.28) : 0;
 967       }
 968       if (v.rotor && b.built) v.rotor.rotation.y += dt * 1.6;
 969       if (v.crystal) {
 970         v.crystal.rotation.y = time * 0.8;
 971         v.crystal.position.y = (v.crystalBaseY || 1.35) + Math.sin(time * 1.6) * 0.08;
 972         // v1.5: aro de luz del color del jugador que gira alrededor del cristal del Núcleo.
 973         if (b.type === 'core') {
 974           if (!v.halo) {
 975             const hm = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner], transparent: true, opacity: 0.75, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
 976             v.halo = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.36 + 0.05 * b.level, 0.022, 6, 32), hm);
 977             v.halo2 = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.3 + 0.05 * b.level, 0.016, 6, 32), hm);
 978             v.group.add(v.halo, v.halo2);
 979           }
 980           v.halo.position.y = v.crystal.position.y;
 981           v.halo2.position.y = v.crystal.position.y;
 982           v.halo.rotation.set(1.15, time * 1.4, 0);
 983           v.halo2.rotation.set(-1.0, -time * 1.1, 0.4);
 984         }
 985       }
 986     }
 987     this.smokingCount = smoking;
 988     // Movimiento de CMU solo en Alta calidad y con hasta 120 soldados a la vista (si no, balanceo simple).
 989     const gaitFull = !!CMU_GAIT && this.quality === 'high' && (this.soldiersSeen || 0) <= 120;
 990     let soldiers = 0;
 991     for (const u of g.units) {
 992       let v = this.vis.get(u.id);
 993       if (!v) {
 994         v = createVisual(u.type, PLAYER_COLORS[u.owner], this.lookFor(u));
 995         this.scene.add(v.group);
 996         this.vis.set(u.id, v);
 997       }
 998       const seen = !u.inside && (u.visible || g.players[u.owner].team === myTeam);
 999       v.group.visible = seen;
1000       if (!seen) continue;
1001       let y = u.y;
1002       if (u.mover === 'sea' || (u.mover === 'amphib' && u.cls === 'ship')) y += Math.sin(time * 2.2 + u.id) * 0.025;
1003       // v1.8: paracaídas mientras baja (Paracaidista y tropas lanzadas desde el avión).
1004       const dropping = u.dropT > g.time;
1005       if (dropping && !v.chute) {
1006         v.chute = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.32, 10, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),
1007           new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: PLAYER_COLORS[u.owner], side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
1008         v.chute.position.y = 0.95;
1009         v.chute.scale.y = 0.55;
1010         v.group.add(v.chute);
1011       }
1012       if (v.chute) v.chute.visible = dropping;
1013       if (u.mover === 'air') y += Math.sin(time * 1.7 + u.id) * 0.06;
1014       if (u.def.plane) {
1015         this.updatePlane(u, v, dt, time, y);
1016       } else {
1017         v.group.position.set(u.x, y, u.z);
1018         v.group.rotation.y = u.yaw;
1019         if (u.mover === 'air') v.group.rotation.x = u.moving ? 0.12 : 0;
1020       }
1021       if (v.turret) {
1022         const aiming = u.autoTarget && u.autoTarget.alive;
1023         const want = aiming ? u.aimYaw - u.yaw : 0;
1024         v.turret.rotation.y = lerpAngle(v.turret.rotation.y, want, Math.min(1, dt * 6));
1025       }
1026       if (v.rotor) v.rotor.rotation.y += dt * 22;
1027       if (v.legl) {
1028         soldiers++;
1029         this.animateLegs(u, v, dt, time, gaitFull);
1030         // v1.0: el constructor martilla mientras trabaja en la obra.
1031         if (u.workingAt !== undefined && g.time - u.workingAt < 0.25) v.main.rotation.x = 0.08 + Math.sin(time * 11 + u.id) * 0.12;
1032       }
1033     }
1034     this.soldiersSeen = soldiers;
1035     this.updateUnitShields(time);
1036     this.updateSkyBeams(time);
1037   }
1038 
1039   // Aviones (v1.0): quietos no flotan en el aire, dan vueltas sobre su punto; se inclinan al girar
1040   // y dejan estela. Es solo la vista: la posición del juego sigue siendo el centro de la vuelta.
1041   updatePlane(u, v, dt, time, y) {
1042     const k = Math.min(1, dt * 1.5);
1043     v.orbitA = (v.orbitA || 0) + ((u.moving ? 0 : 1) - (v.orbitA || 0)) * k;
1044     const R = 0.75 * v.orbitA;
1045     const a = time * 0.8 + u.id * 1.7;
1046     const x = u.x + Math.cos(a) * R;
1047     const z = u.z + Math.sin(a) * R;
1048     // Rumbo: el de la vuelta cuando está quieto, el de su marcha cuando vuela a un destino.
1049     const orbitYaw = Math.atan2(-Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a));
1050     const yaw = v.orbitA > 0.5 ? orbitYaw : u.yaw;
1051     const prev = v.lastYaw === undefined ? yaw : v.lastYaw;
1052     let turn = yaw - prev;
1053     while (turn > Math.PI) turn -= Math.PI * 2;
1054     while (turn < -Math.PI) turn += Math.PI * 2;
1055     v.lastYaw = yaw;
1056     const wantBank = clamp(-(turn / Math.max(dt, 1e-3)) * 0.35, -0.6, 0.6);
1057     v.bank = (v.bank || 0) + (wantBank - (v.bank || 0)) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
1058     v.group.position.set(x, y + 0.15, z);
1059     v.group.rotation.set(u.moving ? 0.06 : 0, yaw, v.bank);
1060     // Estela detrás de las toberas.
1061     v.trailT = (v.trailT || 0) - dt;
1062     if (v.trailT <= 0) {
1063       v.trailT = this.quality === 'high' ? 0.05 : 0.15;
1064       const s = v.group.scale.x || 1;
1065       this.fxs.trail(x - Math.sin(yaw) * 0.55 * s, y + 0.3 * s, z - Math.cos(yaw) * 0.55 * s);
1066     }
1067   }
1068 
1069   // Piernas de los soldados. Alta calidad: ciclo de caminar o correr de CMU (cadera, rodilla,
1070   // inclinación y rebote), al ritmo de la velocidad real para que los pies no patinen.
1071   // Más fluido o muchísimas tropas: el balanceo simple de antes.
1072   animateLegs(u, v, dt, time, full) {
1073     const moving = u.moving && !u.inside;
1074     const k = Math.min(1, dt * 8);
1075     v.gaitA = (v.gaitA || 0) + ((moving ? 1 : 0) - (v.gaitA || 0)) * k;
1076     const a = v.gaitA;
1077     if (!full || !v.shinl) {
1078       const sw = moving ? Math.sin(time * 10 + u.id) * 0.55 : 0;
1079       v.legl.rotation.x += (sw - v.legl.rotation.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 12);
1080       v.legr.rotation.x = -v.legl.rotation.x;
1081       if (v.shinl) { v.shinl.rotation.x = 0; v.shinr.rotation.x = 0; }
1082       v.main.rotation.x = 0;
1083       v.main.position.y = 0;
1084       v.gaitClip = null;
1085       return;
1086     }
1087     const cell = this.game.cells[u.cell];
1088     const slow = TERRAIN[cell.t].slow || 1;
1089     // Constructores, Ingenieros y el bosque: caminan. Las tropas de combate corren.
1090     const clip = u.def.builds || slow > 1 ? CMU_GAIT.walk : CMU_GAIT.run;
1091     v.gaitClip = clip === CMU_GAIT.walk ? 'walk' : 'run';
1092     const leg = 0.19 * (v.group.scale.x || 1);
1093     if (moving) {
1094       const speed = (u.def.speed * SQ3) / slow;
1095       v.gaitPhase = ((v.gaitPhase === undefined ? (u.id * 0.37) % 1 : v.gaitPhase) + dt * (speed / (clip.stride * leg))) % 1;
1096     }
1097     const n = clip.hipL.length;
1098     const t = (v.gaitPhase || 0) * n;
1099     const i0 = Math.floor(t) % n;
1100     const i1 = (i0 + 1) % n;
1101     const f = t - Math.floor(t);
1102     const at = (arr) => arr[i0] + (arr[i1] - arr[i0]) * f;
1103     v.legl.rotation.x = -at(clip.hipL) * a;
1104     v.legr.rotation.x = -at(clip.hipR) * a;
1105     v.shinl.rotation.x = at(clip.kneeL) * a;
1106     v.shinr.rotation.x = at(clip.kneeR) * a;
1107     v.main.rotation.x = at(clip.pitch) * a;
1108     // Rebote al paso; quieto, respira despacio.
1109     v.group.position.y += at(clip.bob) * leg * a;
1110     v.main.position.y = Math.sin(time * 2.4 + u.id) * 0.004 * (1 - a);
1111   }

1123   updateWall(b, v) {
1124     const g = this.game;
1125     const c = g.cells[b.cell];
1126     let mask = 0;
1127     HEX_DIRS.forEach(([dq, dr], i) => {
1128       const n = g.map.get(c.q + dq, c.r + dr);
1129       if (n && n.bld && n.bld.alive && n.bld.type === 'wall' && n.bld.owner === b.owner) mask |= 1 << i;
1130     });
1131     if (mask === v.mask) return;
1132     v.mask = mask;
1133     while (v.segs.children.length) v.segs.remove(v.segs.children[0]);
1134     if (!GLB.wall_seg) return;
1135     const geo = getModel('wall_seg', PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner]).main;
1136     HEX_DIRS.forEach(([dq, dr], i) => {
1137       if (!(mask & (1 << i))) return;
1138       const w = hexToWorld(dq, dr);
1139       const seg = new THREE.Mesh(geo, fastMat(GLB_MAT, FAST_MATS));
1140       seg.castShadow = true;
1141       seg.receiveShadow = true;
1142       seg.rotation.y = Math.atan2(w.x, w.z);
1143       v.segs.add(seg);
1144     });

1168       m.makeScale(s, s, s).setPosition(u.x, u.y + s * 0.6, u.z);

1178   // ---------- rayo ámbar al cielo sobre cada Núcleo (documento pág. 13) ----------
1179   // ---------- v1.5: de quién es cada cosa y qué nivel tiene ----------
1180   // Banderín del color del jugador y marcas de nivel (doradas) en cada edificio; anillo del color del
1181   // jugador bajo cada tropa. Todo con mallas instanciadas: pocas llamadas de dibujo aunque haya cientos.
1182   buildMarks() {
1183     const N = 700;
1184     const pole = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.018, 0.022, 0.66, 5);
1185     pole.translate(0, 0.33, 0);
1186     this.flagPoles = new THREE.InstancedMesh(pole, new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x59616b }), N);
1187     const flag = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.3, 0.18, 3, 1);
1188     flag.translate(0.15, 0.55, 0);
1189     this.flags = new THREE.InstancedMesh(flag, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, side: THREE.DoubleSide }), N);
1190     const pip = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.075, 0);
1191     pip.scale(1, 0.6, 1);
1192     this.levelPips = new THREE.InstancedMesh(pip, new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffcf3a, emissive: 0x4a3200 }), N * 2);
1193     const ring = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.74, 1, 22);
1194     ring.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
1195     this.unitRings = new THREE.InstancedMesh(ring, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false }), 1200);
1196     this.unitRings.renderOrder = 2;
1197     // El color por instancia se crea con el tamaño que tiene la malla en ese momento: antes de vaciarla.
1198     this.flags.setColorAt(0, new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1));
1199     this.unitRings.setColorAt(0, new THREE.Color(1, 1, 1));
1200     for (const m of [this.flagPoles, this.flags, this.levelPips, this.unitRings]) {
1201       m.frustumCulled = false;
1202       m.count = 0;
1203       this.scene.add(m);
1204     }
1205     this.flags.castShadow = true;
1206     this.markColor = new THREE.Color();
1207     this.markMat = new THREE.Matrix4();
1208     this.markQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
1209     this.markPos = new THREE.Vector3();
1210     this.markScale = new THREE.Vector3();
1211     this.markEuler = new THREE.Euler();
1212   }
1213 
1214   updateMarks(time) {
1215     if (!this.flags) this.buildMarks();
1216     const g = this.game;
1217     const M = this.markMat;
1218     const Q = this.markQuat;
1219     const P = this.markPos;
1220     const S = this.markScale;
1221     const E = this.markEuler;
1222     const col = this.markColor;
1223     let nf = 0;
1224     let np = 0;
1225     for (const b of g.buildings) {
1226       if (!b.alive || b.type === 'wall' || b.type === 'core') continue;
1227       const v = this.vis.get(b.id);
1228       if (!v || !v.group.visible) continue;
1229       if (nf >= 700) break;
1230       // Esquina de la casilla (detrás y a la derecha, mirando desde la cámara de siempre).
1231       const a = Math.PI / 6 + Math.PI / 3 * 4;
1232       const cx = b.x + Math.sin(a) * 0.74;
1233       const cz = b.z + Math.cos(a) * 0.74;
1234       const k = b.built ? 1 : 0.6;
1235       P.set(cx, b.y, cz);
1236       S.set(1, k, 1);
1237       Q.identity();
1238       M.compose(P, Q, S);
1239       this.flagPoles.setMatrixAt(nf, M);
1240       E.set(0, 0.6 + Math.sin(time * 2.6 + b.id) * 0.18, 0);
1241       Q.setFromEuler(E);
1242       S.set(1, k, 1);
1243       M.compose(P, Q, S);
1244       this.flags.setMatrixAt(nf, M);
1245       col.setHex(PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner]);
1246       this.flags.setColorAt(nf, col);
1247       nf++;
1248       // Marcas de nivel: una por nivel, al pie del banderín (solo en lo que se puede mejorar).
1249       if (b.def.maxLevel > 1 && b.built) {
1250         for (let i = 0; i < b.level && np < 1400; i++) {
1251           const aa = a - 0.42 - i * 0.2;
1252           P.set(b.x + Math.sin(aa) * 0.8, b.y + 0.07, b.z + Math.cos(aa) * 0.8);
1253           E.set(0, time * 0.8 + i, 0);
1254           Q.setFromEuler(E);
1255           S.set(1, 1, 1);
1256           M.compose(P, Q, S);
1257           this.levelPips.setMatrixAt(np++, M);
1258         }
1259       }
1260     }
1261     this.flagPoles.count = nf;
1262     this.flags.count = nf;
1263     this.levelPips.count = np;
1264     this.flagPoles.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
1265     this.flags.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
1266     if (this.flags.instanceColor) this.flags.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
1267     this.levelPips.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
1268     // Anillo del color del jugador bajo cada tropa (los aviones, en el suelo debajo de ellos).
1269     let nr = 0;
1270     Q.identity();
1271     for (const u of g.units) {
1272       if (!u.alive || u.inside || nr >= 1200) continue;
1273       const v = this.vis.get(u.id);
1274       if (!v || !v.group.visible) continue;
1275       const r = u.cls === 'inf' ? 0.27 : u.mover === 'sea' ? 0.56 : u.mover === 'air' ? 0.36 : 0.44;
1276       const c = g.cells[u.cell];
1277       const gy = u.mover === 'sea' ? 0.04 : u.mover === 'air' ? (c ? Math.max(0.04, c.h + 0.03) : 0.04) : (c ? c.h + 0.03 : u.y + 0.03);
1278       const x = u.def.plane ? v.group.position.x : u.x;
1279       const z = u.def.plane ? v.group.position.z : u.z;
1280       P.set(x, gy, z);
1281       S.set(r, 1, r);
1282       M.compose(P, Q, S);
1283       this.unitRings.setMatrixAt(nr, M);
1284       col.setHex(PLAYER_COLORS[u.owner]);
1285       this.unitRings.setColorAt(nr, col);
1286       nr++;
1287     }
1288     this.unitRings.count = nr;
1289     this.unitRings.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
1290     if (this.unitRings.instanceColor) this.unitRings.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
1291     this.marksShown = { flags: nf, pips: np, rings: nr };
1292   }

1294   // v1.5: icono del tipo de tropa cuando la cámara está lejos (las tropas se ven chicas).
1295   drawUnitIcons(ctx) {
1296     const g = this.game;
1297     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
1298     let n = 0;
1299     for (const u of g.units) {
1300       if (!u.alive || u.inside || n >= 260) continue;
1301       if (!u.visible && g.players[u.owner].team !== myTeam) continue;
1302       const s = this.project(u.x, u.y + (u.mover === 'air' ? 0.9 : 0.75), u.z);
1303       if (!s.ok || s.x < -12 || s.y < -12 || s.x > this.width + 12 || s.y > this.height + 12) continue;
1304       n++;
1305       const x = s.x;
1306       const y = s.y;
1307       ctx.fillStyle = hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[u.owner]);
1308       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(12,16,22,0.85)';
1309       ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
1310       ctx.beginPath();
1311       ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1312       ctx.fill();
1313       ctx.stroke();
1314       ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
1315       ctx.beginPath();
1316       if (u.cls === 'inf') {
1317         ctx.arc(x, y - 2.6, 1.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1318         ctx.rect(x - 1.6, y - 0.6, 3.2, 4.2);
1319       } else if (u.mover === 'air') {
1320         ctx.moveTo(x, y - 4.5); ctx.lineTo(x + 4.5, y + 2); ctx.lineTo(x, y + 0.5); ctx.lineTo(x - 4.5, y + 2); ctx.closePath();
1321       } else if (u.mover === 'sea') {
1322         ctx.moveTo(x - 4.5, y - 0.5); ctx.lineTo(x + 4.5, y - 0.5); ctx.lineTo(x + 2.8, y + 3); ctx.lineTo(x - 2.8, y + 3); ctx.closePath();
1323         ctx.rect(x - 1, y - 3.5, 2.5, 3);
1324       } else {
1325         ctx.rect(x - 3.8, y - 1.2, 7.6, 3.8);
1326         ctx.rect(x - 1.6, y - 3.6, 3.2, 2.4);
1327         ctx.rect(x + 1.6, y - 2.9, 3.4, 1.1);
1328       }
1329       ctx.fill();
1330     }
1331     this.unitIcons = n;
1332   }

1363   updateSelectionRings(selection) {

1365     while (this.rings.length < items.length) {
1366       const r = new THREE.Mesh(this.ringGeo, this.ringMatOwn);
1367       r.renderOrder = 5;

1369       this.rings.push(r);
1370     }
1371     this.rings.forEach((r, i) => {
1372       const e = items[i];
1373       if (!e) {
1374         r.visible = false;
1375         return;
1376       }
1377       r.visible = true;
1378       r.material = e.owner === 0 || (e.kind === 'point' && e.owner < 0) ? this.ringMatOwn : this.ringMatEnemy;
1379       const s = e.kind === 'bld' || e.kind === 'point' ? 1.85 : e.cls === 'inf' ? 0.75 : e.cls === 'ship' || e.cls === 'sub' ? 1.4 : 1.1;
1380       r.scale.setScalar(s);
1381       const y = e.kind === 'bld' || e.kind === 'point' ? e.y + 0.05 : e.mover === 'air' ? Math.max(this.game.cells[e.cell].h, 0) + 0.05 : Math.max(e.y, 0) + 0.04;
1382       r.position.set(e.x, y, e.z);
1383     });
1384     // Círculo de alcance de la tropa o defensa seleccionada.
1385     const one = items.length === 1 ? items[0] : null;
1386     const w = one && one.def && one.def.weapon;
1387     if (w && !one.inside) {
1388       const R = w.range * SQ3 + (one.kind === 'bld' ? 0.75 : 0.35);
1389       this.rangeRing.visible = true;
1390       this.rangeRing.scale.setScalar(R);
1391       this.rangeRing.userData.radius = R;
1392       const gy = one.kind === 'bld' ? one.y : Math.max(this.game.cells[one.cell].h, 0);
1393       this.rangeRing.position.set(one.x, gy + 0.06, one.z);
1394       this.rangeRing.material.color.set(one.owner === 0 ? 0xffffff : 0xff7070);
1395     } else {
1396       this.rangeRing.visible = false;
1397     }
1398     const b = items.length === 1 && items[0].kind === 'bld' && items[0].owner === 0 ? items[0] : null;
1399     if (b && b.rally >= 0) {
1400       const c = this.game.cells[b.rally];
1401       this.rallyFlag.visible = true;
1402       this.rallyFlag.position.set(c.x, Math.max(c.h, 0), c.z);
1403     } else this.rallyFlag.visible = false;

1430   // ---------- cámara ----------
1431   updateCamera() {
1432     const c = this.cam;
1433     const R = this.game.map.R * 1.5;
1434     const len = Math.hypot(c.tx, c.tz);
1435     if (len > R) {
1436       c.tx *= R / len;
1437       c.tz *= R / len;
1438     }
1439     c.dist = clamp(c.dist, 9, 70);
1440     const zt = (c.dist - 9) / 61;
1441     c.pitch = 0.78 + zt * 0.42;
1442     const cp = Math.cos(c.pitch);
1443     this.camera.position.set(
1444       c.tx + Math.sin(c.yaw) * cp * c.dist,
1445       Math.sin(c.pitch) * c.dist,
1446       c.tz + Math.cos(c.yaw) * cp * c.dist,
1447     );
1448     this.camera.lookAt(c.tx, 0, c.tz);
1449     this.camera.updateMatrixWorld();
1450     this.sun.position.set(c.tx - 16, 34, c.tz + 10);
1451     this.sun.target.position.set(c.tx, 0, c.tz);
1452     const span = clamp(c.dist * 1.1, 22, 60);
1453     const sc = this.sun.shadow.camera;
1454     if (Math.abs(sc.right - span) > 2) {
1455       sc.left = -span; sc.right = span; sc.top = span; sc.bottom = -span;
1456       sc.updateProjectionMatrix();
1457     }
1458   }
1459 
1460   screenToWorld(sx, sy, planeY = 0) {
1461     this._ndc.set((sx / this.width) * 2 - 1, -(sy / this.height) * 2 + 1);
1462     this.raycaster.setFromCamera(this._ndc, this.camera);
1463     this._plane.constant = -planeY;
1464     const hit = this.raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(this._plane, this._p);
1465     return hit ? { x: hit.x, z: hit.z } : null;
1466   }
1467 
1468   pickCell(sx, sy) {
1469     const map = this.game.map;
1470     let p = this.screenToWorld(sx, sy, 0.3);
1471     if (!p) return null;
1472     let c = map.atWorld(p.x, p.z);
1473     if (!c) return null;
1474     p = this.screenToWorld(sx, sy, Math.max(c.h, 0));
1475     const c2 = p && map.atWorld(p.x, p.z);
1476     return c2 || c;
1477   }
1478 
1479   project(x, y, z) {
1480     this._p.set(x, y, z).project(this.camera);
1481     return { x: (this._p.x + 1) * 0.5 * this.width, y: (1 - this._p.y) * 0.5 * this.height, ok: this._p.z < 1 && this._p.z > -1 };
1482   }
1483 
1484   pickUnit(sx, sy, filter) {
1485     let best = null;
1486     let bd = Math.max(16, 520 / this.cam.dist);
1487     for (const u of this.game.units) {
1488       if (!u.alive || u.inside || (filter && !filter(u))) continue;
1489       if (!u.visible && this.game.players[u.owner].team !== this.game.players[0].team) continue;
1490       const s = this.project(u.x, u.y + 0.25, u.z);
1491       if (!s.ok) continue;
1492       const d = Math.hypot(s.x - sx, s.y - sy);
1493       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = u; }
1494     }
1495     return best;
1496   }
1497 
1498   // v1.2: tocar el cuerpo o el techo de un edificio también lo elige (antes solo valía su casilla del suelo).
1499   // Solo cuenta la zona entre la base y el techo, para no robar los toques al suelo de delante.
1500   pickBuilding(sx, sy) {
1501     let best = null;
1502     let bd = Infinity;
1503     const half = Math.max(16, 380 / this.cam.dist);
1504     for (const b of this.game.buildings) {
1505       if (!b.alive) continue;
1506       const base = this.project(b.x, b.y, b.z);
1507       const top = this.project(b.x, b.y + (b.type === 'wall' ? 0.6 : 1.15), b.z);
1508       if (!base.ok || !top.ok) continue;
1509       if (sy > base.y + 4 || sy < top.y - 8 || Math.abs(sx - base.x) > half) continue;
1510       const d = Math.abs(sx - base.x) + Math.abs(sy - (base.y + top.y) / 2) * 0.5;
1511       if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = b; }
1512     }
1513     return best;
1514   }
1515 
1516   unitsInRect(x1, y1, x2, y2, filter) {
1517     const lx = Math.min(x1, x2);
1518     const hx = Math.max(x1, x2);
1519     const ly = Math.min(y1, y2);
1520     const hy = Math.max(y1, y2);
1521     return this.game.units.filter((u) => {
1522       if (!u.alive || u.inside || (filter && !filter(u))) return false;
1523       const s = this.project(u.x, u.y + 0.2, u.z);
1524       return s.ok && s.x >= lx && s.x <= hx && s.y >= ly && s.y <= hy;
1525     });
1526   }

1528   // ---------- capa 2D: barras de vida ----------
1529   drawOverlay(selection) {
1530     const ctx = this.octx;
1531     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.width, this.height);
1532     const g = this.game;
1533     const sel = new Set(selection);
1534     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
1535     this.upBars = 0;
1536     const bar = (e, w, hTop) => {
1537       const s = this.project(e.x, e.y + hTop, e.z);
1538       if (!s.ok || s.x < -40 || s.y < -40 || s.x > this.width + 40 || s.y > this.height + 40) return;
1539       const x = Math.round(s.x - w / 2);

1835   // ---------- minimapa ----------
1836   minimapTransform(size) {
1837     const R = this.game.map.R;
1838     const ext = SQ3 * R + 1.2;
1839     const s = size / (ext * 2);
1840     return { s, ox: size / 2, oz: size / 2 };
1841   }
1842 
1843   drawMinimap(canvas) {
1844     const g = this.game;
1845     const size = canvas.width;
1846     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
1847     const T = this.minimapTransform(size);
1848     if (!this.miniBase || this.miniBase.width !== size || this.miniDirty) {
1849       this.miniDirty = false;
1850       const base = this.miniBase && this.miniBase.width === size ? this.miniBase : document.createElement('canvas');
1851       base.width = size;
1852       base.height = size;
1853       const b = base.getContext('2d');
1854       b.fillStyle = '#16405a';
1855       b.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
1856       const r = T.s * 1.02;
1857       const tmp = new THREE.Color();
1858       for (const c of g.cells) {
1859         tmp.set(terrainColor(this.game.map.kind, c.t));
1860         if (c.t === 'deep') continue;
1861         if (c.owner >= 0) tmp.lerp(new THREE.Color(PLAYER_COLORS[c.owner]), TERRAIN[c.t].water ? 0.35 : 0.45);
1862         b.fillStyle = '#' + tmp.getHexString();
1863         const cx = T.ox + c.x * T.s;
1864         const cy = T.oz + c.z * T.s;
1865         b.beginPath();
1866         for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
1867           const a = (k * Math.PI) / 3;
1868           const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * r;
1869           const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * r;
1870           if (k === 0) b.moveTo(px, py);
1871           else b.lineTo(px, py);
1872         }
1873         b.fill();
1874       }
1875       this.miniBase = base;
1876     }
1877     ctx.drawImage(this.miniBase, 0, 0);
1878     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
1879     for (const pt of g.points) {
1880       const x = T.ox + pt.x * T.s;
1881       const y = T.oz + pt.z * T.s;
1882       ctx.fillStyle = pt.owner >= 0 ? hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[pt.owner]) : '#e6e8ea';
1883       ctx.strokeStyle = pt.type === 'faro' ? '#ffb63a' : '#1b2630';
1884       ctx.lineWidth = pt.type === 'faro' ? 2 : 1;
1885       ctx.beginPath();
1886       ctx.moveTo(x, y - 5);
1887       ctx.lineTo(x + 4, y);
1888       ctx.lineTo(x, y + 5);
1889       ctx.lineTo(x - 4, y);
1890       ctx.closePath();
1891       ctx.fill();
1892       ctx.stroke();
1893     }
1894     // v1.4: con «Colores para daltonismo», cada jugador tiene además su forma (Núcleo y tropas).
1895     const cvd = !!(window.FARO && window.FARO.cvd);
1896     for (const bl of g.buildings) {
1897       ctx.fillStyle = hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[bl.owner]);
1898       const x = T.ox + bl.x * T.s;
1899       const y = T.oz + bl.z * T.s;
1900       if (cvd && bl.type === 'core') {
1901         ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
1902         ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
1903         minimapShape(ctx, PLAYER_SHAPES[bl.owner], x, y, 6.5);
1904         continue;
1905       }
1906       const s = bl.type === 'core' ? 7 : 4;
1907       ctx.fillRect(x - s / 2, y - s / 2, s, s);
1908       if (bl.type === 'core') {
1909         ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
1910         ctx.lineWidth = 1;
1911         ctx.strokeRect(x - s / 2, y - s / 2, s, s);
1912       }
1913     }
1914     for (const u of g.units) {
1915       if (u.inside || (!u.visible && g.players[u.owner].team !== myTeam)) continue;
1916       ctx.fillStyle = hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[u.owner]);
1917       if (cvd) {
1918         ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,0.8)';
1919         ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
1920         minimapShape(ctx, PLAYER_SHAPES[u.owner], T.ox + u.x * T.s, T.oz + u.z * T.s, 2.6);
1921         continue;
1922       }
1923       ctx.beginPath();
1924       ctx.arc(T.ox + u.x * T.s, T.oz + u.z * T.s, 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1925       ctx.fill();
1926     }
1927     // Pulsos de alerta
1928     const now = performance.now();
1929     this.pings = this.pings.filter((pg) => now - pg.t < 5000);
1930     for (const pg of this.pings) {
1931       const k = ((now - pg.t) % 1000) / 1000;
1932       ctx.strokeStyle = pg.kind === 'bad' ? `rgba(255,90,90,${1 - k})` : `rgba(242,171,56,${1 - k})`;
1933       ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
1934       ctx.beginPath();
1935       ctx.arc(T.ox + pg.x * T.s, T.oz + pg.z * T.s, 4 + k * 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
1936       ctx.stroke();
1937     }
1938     // Vista de la cámara
1939     const corners = [[0, 0], [this.width, 0], [this.width, this.height], [0, this.height]];
1940     const pts = corners.map(([x, y]) => this.screenToWorld(x, y, 0));
1941     if (pts.every(Boolean)) {
1942       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
1943       ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
1944       ctx.beginPath();
1945       pts.forEach((p, i) => {
1946         const x = T.ox + p.x * T.s;
1947         const y = T.oz + p.z * T.s;
1948         if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
1949         else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
1950       });
1951       ctx.closePath();
1952       ctx.stroke();
1953     }
1954   }
1955 
1956   worldToMinimap(canvas, x, z) {
1957     const T = this.minimapTransform(canvas.width);
1958     const k = canvas.width / canvas.clientWidth;
1959     return { x: (x * T.s + T.ox) / k, y: (z * T.s + T.oz) / k };
1960   }
1961 
1962   minimapToWorld(canvas, mx, my) {
1963     const T = this.minimapTransform(canvas.width);
1964     const k = canvas.width / canvas.clientWidth;
1965     return { x: (mx * k - T.ox) / T.s, z: (my * k - T.oz) / T.s };
1966   }
1967 
1968   dispose() {
1969     if (this.fxs) this.fxs.dispose();
1970     for (const m of [this.waterMesh, this.foamMesh]) {
1971       if (!m) continue;
1972       m.geometry.dispose();
1973       if (m.material.uniforms.map) m.material.uniforms.map.value.dispose();
1974       m.material.dispose();
1975     }
1976     this.scene.traverse((o) => {
1977       if (o.isInstancedMesh || o === this.borderMesh || o === this.tracerLines) {
1978         if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose();
1979         if (o.material && o.material !== MODEL_MAT) o.material.dispose();
1980       }
1981     });
1982   }
1983 
1984   // ---------- cuadro ----------
1985   frame(dt, time, selection) {
1986     const g = this.game;
1987     if (this.nukeFlashT > 0) this.nukeFlashT -= dt;
1988     if (g.territoryVersion !== this.lastTerritory) {
1989       this.lastTerritory = g.territoryVersion;
1990       this.tintTerritory();
1991       this.rebuildBorders();
1992       this.miniDirty = true;
1993     }
1994     const bkey = g.buildings.length * 1e6 + (g.buildings.length ? g.buildings[g.buildings.length - 1].id : 0);
1995     if (bkey !== this.lastBuildCount) {
1996       this.lastBuildCount = bkey;
1997       this.refreshDecor();
1998     }
1999     if (this.placeMesh.count) this.placeMesh.material.opacity = 0.32 + Math.sin(time * 4) * 0.14;
2000     this.consumeFx();
2001     this.syncEntities(dt, time);
2002     this.updateMarks(time);
2003     this.updateFx(dt);
2004     this.updateLasers(dt);
2005     this.updatePoints(time);
2006     this.updateShields(time);
2007     this.updateRadZones(time);
2008     this.updateSelectionRings(selection);
2009     this.updateCamera();
2010     if (this.waterMat) {
2011       // Con ahorro de batería el mar queda quieto (sin reflejos) para gastar menos.
2012       this.waterMesh.visible = !this.calm;
2013       this.waterMat.uniforms.time.value = time;
2014       this.foamMat.uniforms.time.value = this.calm ? 0 : time;
2015     }
2016     this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
2017     // Con muchas tropas, las barras de vida y los iconos se dibujan un cuadro sí y otro no.
2018     this.ovFrame = (this.ovFrame || 0) + 1;
2019     // v0.9: en Más fluido las barras y avisos se dibujan cada dos cuadros con más de 40 tropas.
2020     this.overlayHalf = g.units.length > (this.quality === 'high' ? 120 : 40);
2021     if (!this.overlayHalf || this.ovFrame % 2 === 0) this.drawOverlay(selection);
2022   }
2023 }

2025 // v1.4: forma de cada jugador en el minimapa (modo para daltonismo).
2026 function minimapShape(ctx, shape, x, y, r) {
2027   ctx.beginPath();
2028   if (shape === 'square') ctx.rect(x - r * 0.85, y - r * 0.85, r * 1.7, r * 1.7);
2029   else if (shape === 'triangle') { ctx.moveTo(x, y - r); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + r * 0.8); ctx.lineTo(x - r, y + r * 0.8); ctx.closePath(); }
2030   else if (shape === 'diamond') { ctx.moveTo(x, y - r); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x - r, y); ctx.closePath(); }
2031   else if (shape === 'star') {
2032     for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
2033       const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i * Math.PI) / 5;
2034       const rr = i % 2 ? r * 0.45 : r;
2035       if (i) ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y + Math.sin(a) * rr); else ctx.moveTo(x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y + Math.sin(a) * rr);
2036     }
2037     ctx.closePath();
2038   } else if (shape === 'cross') {
2039     const t = r * 0.38;
2040     ctx.moveTo(x - t, y - r); ctx.lineTo(x + t, y - r); ctx.lineTo(x + t, y - t); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y - t); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + t);
2041     ctx.lineTo(x + t, y + t); ctx.lineTo(x + t, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x - t, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x - t, y + t); ctx.lineTo(x - r, y + t);
2042     ctx.lineTo(x - r, y - t); ctx.lineTo(x - t, y - t); ctx.closePath();
2043   } else ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
2044   ctx.fill();
2045   ctx.stroke();
2046 }
