  1 'use strict';
  2 // Efectos con partículas (v0.6): fuego, humo, restos, chispas, fogonazos, estelas y salpicaduras.
  3 // Todas las partículas de un tipo de mezcla se dibujan en una sola pasada (THREE.Points), con un
  4 // tope fijo: cuando se llena, la partícula más vieja se reutiliza. Así los efectos no ponen lento
  5 // al iPad aunque haya muchas peleas.
  6 
  7 const FX_VERT = `
  8 attribute float psize;
  9 attribute float palpha;
 10 attribute vec3 pcolor;
 11 uniform float scale;
 12 varying vec3 vColor;
 13 varying float vAlpha;
 14 void main() {
 15   vColor = pcolor;
 16   vAlpha = palpha;
 17   vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
 18   gl_PointSize = psize * scale / max(0.1, -mv.z);
 19   gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
 20 }`;
 21 
 22 const FX_FRAG = `
 23 varying vec3 vColor;
 24 varying float vAlpha;
 25 void main() {
 26   vec2 c = gl_PointCoord - 0.5;
 27   float d = length(c);
 28   if (d > 0.5) discard;
 29   gl_FragColor = vec4(vColor, vAlpha * smoothstep(0.5, 0.12, d));
 30 }`;
 31 
 32 class Particles {
 33   constructor(scene, max, additive) {
 34     this.max = max;
 35     this.head = 0;
 36     this.count = 0;
 37     this.pos = new Float32Array(max * 3);
 38     this.col = new Float32Array(max * 3);
 39     this.alpha = new Float32Array(max);
 40     this.size = new Float32Array(max);
 41     const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 42     g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.pos, 3));
 43     g.setAttribute('pcolor', new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.col, 3));
 44     g.setAttribute('palpha', new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.alpha, 1));
 45     g.setAttribute('psize', new THREE.BufferAttribute(this.size, 1));
 46     g.setDrawRange(0, 0);
 47     this.mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
 48       uniforms: { scale: { value: 400 } },
 49       vertexShader: FX_VERT,
 50       fragmentShader: FX_FRAG,
 51       transparent: true,
 52       depthWrite: false,
 53       blending: additive ? THREE.AdditiveBlending : THREE.NormalBlending,
 54     });
 55     this.points = new THREE.Points(g, this.mat);
 56     this.points.frustumCulled = false;
 57     this.points.renderOrder = additive ? 9 : 8;
 58     scene.add(this.points);
 59     this.p = [];
 60     for (let i = 0; i < max; i++) {
 61       this.p.push({ t: 1, life: 0, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0, s0: 0, s1: 0, r: 1, g: 1, b: 1, a: 1, grav: 0, drag: 0, fade: 1 });
 62     }
 63   }
 64 
 65   spawn(o) {
 66     const p = this.p[this.head];
 67     this.head = (this.head + 1) % this.max;
 68     p.t = 0;
 69     p.life = o.life;
 70     p.x = o.x; p.y = o.y; p.z = o.z;
 71     p.vx = o.vx || 0; p.vy = o.vy || 0; p.vz = o.vz || 0;
 72     p.s0 = o.s0; p.s1 = o.s1 === undefined ? o.s0 : o.s1;
 73     p.r = o.r; p.g = o.g; p.b = o.b;
 74     p.a = o.a === undefined ? 1 : o.a;
 75     p.grav = o.grav || 0;
 76     p.drag = o.drag || 0;
 77     p.fade = o.fade || 1;
 78   }
 79 
 80   update(dt) {
 81     let n = 0;
 82     for (const p of this.p) {
 83       if (p.t >= p.life) continue;
 84       p.t += dt;
 85       if (p.t >= p.life) continue;
 86       p.vy -= p.grav * dt;
 87       if (p.drag) {
 88         const k = Math.max(0, 1 - p.drag * dt);
 89         p.vx *= k; p.vy *= k; p.vz *= k;
 90       }
 91       p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.z += p.vz * dt;
 92       if (p.grav && p.y < 0) { p.y = 0; p.vy *= -0.3; p.vx *= 0.5; p.vz *= 0.5; }
 93       const k = p.t / p.life;
 94       const o = n * 3;
 95       this.pos[o] = p.x; this.pos[o + 1] = p.y; this.pos[o + 2] = p.z;
 96       this.col[o] = p.r; this.col[o + 1] = p.g; this.col[o + 2] = p.b;
 97       this.size[n] = p.s0 + (p.s1 - p.s0) * k;
 98       this.alpha[n] = p.a * Math.pow(1 - k, p.fade);
 99       n++;
100     }
101     this.count = n;
102     const g = this.points.geometry;
103     g.setDrawRange(0, n);
104     if (n) {
105       g.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
106       g.attributes.pcolor.needsUpdate = true;
107       g.attributes.palpha.needsUpdate = true;
108       g.attributes.psize.needsUpdate = true;
109     }
110   }
111 
112   setScale(px) {
113     this.mat.uniforms.scale.value = px;
114   }
115 
116   dispose() {
117     this.points.geometry.dispose();
118     this.mat.dispose();
119   }
120 }
121 
122 const rnd = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
123 
124 // Efectos compuestos. glow = mezcla aditiva (fuego, fogonazo, chispas); soft = normal (humo, restos, agua).
125 class FxSystem {
126   constructor(scene) {
127     this.glow = new Particles(scene, 520, true);
128     this.soft = new Particles(scene, 720, false);
129     this.scale = 1; // 0,5 en «Más fluido»: la mitad de partículas.
130     this.spawned = 0;
131   }
132 
133   n(k) {
134     // Cantidad según la calidad: en «Más fluido» se reparte la mitad (redondeando al azar).
135     const v = k * this.scale;
136     return Math.floor(v) + (Math.random() < v - Math.floor(v) ? 1 : 0);
137   }
138 
139   add(sys, o) {
140     sys.spawn(o);
141     this.spawned++;
142   }
143 
144   explosion(x, y, z, s, bld) {
145     const big = bld ? 1.3 : 1;
146     this.add(this.glow, { x, y: y + 0.1, z, life: 0.16, s0: s * 1.4 * big, s1: s * 1.9 * big, r: 1, g: 0.95, b: 0.75, a: 1 });
147     for (let i = this.n(bld ? 10 : 6); i > 0; i--) {
148       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
149       const sp = rnd(0.4, 1.4) * s;
150       this.add(this.glow, { x, y: y + rnd(0, 0.3) * s, z, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: rnd(0.4, 1.2) * s, vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, drag: 3,
151         life: rnd(0.35, 0.6), s0: s * rnd(0.5, 0.8) * big, s1: s * rnd(0.9, 1.3) * big, r: 1, g: rnd(0.45, 0.7), b: 0.15, a: 0.95, fade: 1.4 });
152     }
153     for (let i = this.n(bld ? 9 : 4); i > 0; i--) {
154       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
155       this.add(this.soft, { x: x + Math.cos(a) * 0.2 * s, y: y + 0.2, z: z + Math.sin(a) * 0.2 * s, vx: Math.cos(a) * 0.25, vy: rnd(0.5, 1.1), vz: Math.sin(a) * 0.25,
156         drag: 0.8, life: rnd(1.4, 2.4), s0: s * 0.55 * big, s1: s * 1.35 * big, r: 0.3, g: 0.31, b: 0.33, a: 0.5, fade: 1.2 });
157     }
158     for (let i = this.n(bld ? 12 : 6); i > 0; i--) {
159       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
160       const sp = rnd(1.2, 2.8) * s;
161       this.add(this.soft, { x, y: y + 0.2, z, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: rnd(1.5, 3.2) * s, vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, grav: 6,
162         life: rnd(0.7, 1.2), s0: rnd(0.07, 0.13) * big, r: 0.16, g: 0.15, b: 0.14, a: 1, fade: 0.4 });
163     }
164     this.sparks(x, y + 0.2, z, s, bld ? 8 : 5);
165   }
166 
167   sparks(x, y, z, s, k = 4) {
168     for (let i = this.n(k); i > 0; i--) {
169       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
170       const sp = rnd(1.5, 3.5) * Math.max(0.5, s);
171       this.add(this.glow, { x, y, z, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: rnd(0.8, 2.6), vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, grav: 7,
172         life: rnd(0.2, 0.42), s0: 0.08, s1: 0.03, r: 1, g: 0.85, b: 0.4, a: 1 });
173     }
174   }
175 
176   flash(x, y, z, s = 0.28) {
177     // v1.7: con «Reducir destellos» no hay fogonazos.
178     if (this.lowFlash) return;
179     this.add(this.glow, { x, y, z, life: 0.07, s0: s, s1: s * 1.4, r: 1, g: 0.9, b: 0.55, a: 1 });
180   }
181 
182   impact(x, y, z, s) {
183     this.add(this.glow, { x, y, z, life: 0.22, s0: s * 1.2, s1: s * 1.8, r: 1, g: 0.75, b: 0.3, a: 0.9 });
184     this.sparks(x, y, z, s, 3);
185     if (this.n(1)) this.add(this.soft, { x, y, z, vy: 0.5, life: 0.9, s0: s * 0.7, s1: s * 1.6, r: 0.35, g: 0.35, b: 0.37, a: 0.5 });
186   }
187 
188   splash(x, z, s) {
189     for (let i = this.n(9); i > 0; i--) {
190       const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
191       const sp = rnd(0.3, 1.1) * s;
192       this.add(this.soft, { x, y: 0.02, z, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: rnd(2, 3.6) * s, vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, grav: 8,
193         life: rnd(0.5, 0.8), s0: rnd(0.1, 0.18), s1: 0.05, r: 0.86, g: 0.95, b: 1, a: 0.9, fade: 0.6 });
194     }
195     this.add(this.soft, { x, y: 0.03, z, life: 0.6, s0: s * 0.6, s1: s * 1.8, r: 0.9, g: 0.97, b: 1, a: 0.55 });
196   }
197 
198   trail(x, y, z) {
199     this.add(this.soft, { x, y, z, vy: 0.15, life: 0.55, s0: 0.1, s1: 0.32, r: 0.78, g: 0.78, b: 0.8, a: 0.55, drag: 1 });
200   }
201 
202   smoke(x, y, z, s) {
203     this.add(this.soft, { x: x + rnd(-0.12, 0.12), y, z: z + rnd(-0.12, 0.12), vx: rnd(-0.1, 0.1), vy: rnd(0.45, 0.8), vz: rnd(-0.1, 0.1),
204       drag: 0.4, life: rnd(1.8, 2.8), s0: s * 0.5, s1: s * 1.9, r: 0.24, g: 0.25, b: 0.27, a: 0.5, fade: 1.3 });
205     if (this.n(0.5)) this.add(this.glow, { x, y: y - 0.05, z, vy: 0.3, life: 0.4, s0: s * 0.45, s1: s * 0.2, r: 1, g: 0.5, b: 0.12, a: 0.7 });
206   }

208   heal(x, y, z) {

210   }

212   update(dt) {

  1 'use strict';
  2 // Controles: toque (iPad/celular), ratón y teclado.
  3 // Un dedo arrastra el mapa, dos dedos hacen zoom y giran, un toque selecciona u ordena.
  4 
  5 class Input {
  6   constructor(app) {
  7     this.app = app;
  8     this.canvas = app.canvas;
  9     this.pointers = new Map();
 10     this.drag = null;
 11     this.keys = new Set();
 12     this.boxMode = false;
 13     this.amoveArm = false; // «Avanzar atacando»: el siguiente toque en el mapa da la orden
 14     this.placement = null;
 15     this.lastTap = { t: 0, x: 0, y: 0, id: -1 };
 16     this.lastRot = {};
 17     this.bind();
 18   }
 19 
 20   get game() {
 21     return this.app.game;
 22   }
 23 
 24   get r() {
 25     return this.app.renderer;
 26   }
 27 
 28   bind() {
 29     const c = this.canvas;
 30     c.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => this.onDown(e));
 31     c.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => this.onMove(e));
 32     c.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => this.onUp(e));
 33     c.addEventListener('pointercancel', (e) => this.onUp(e, true));
 34     c.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { if (!this.pointers.size && this.r) this.r.setHover(-1); });
 35     c.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => this.onWheel(e), { passive: false });
 36     c.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());
 37     window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => this.onKey(e, true));
 38     window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => this.onKey(e, false));
 39     window.addEventListener('blur', () => this.keys.clear());
 40   }
 41 
 42   active() {
 43     return this.app.state === 'play' && this.game && this.r;
 44   }
 45 
 46   pos(e) {
 47     const rect = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 48     return { x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top };
 49   }
 50 
 51   onDown(e) {
 52     if (!this.active()) return;
 53     e.preventDefault();
 54     try { this.canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* sin captura */ }
 55     const p = this.pos(e);
 56     this.pointers.set(e.pointerId, p);
 57     const cam = this.r.cam;
 58     if (this.pointers.size === 1) {
 59       this.drag = {
 60         mode: null, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, x: p.x, y: p.y, moved: false,
 61         right: e.button === 2, shift: e.shiftKey, grab: this.r.screenToWorld(p.x, p.y, 0),
 62       };
 63       // v1.2: mantener pulsado el mapa (sin moverse) abre la rueda de selección del ejército.
 64       clearTimeout(this.holdTimer);
 65       if (e.button !== 2 && !this.placement && !this.amoveArm && !this.boxMode && !e.shiftKey) {
 66         const d0 = this.drag;
 67         this.holdTimer = setTimeout(() => {
 68           if (this.drag === d0 && !d0.moved && this.pointers.size === 1) {
 69             d0.mode = 'wheel';
 70             d0.wheelAt = performance.now();
 71             this.app.ui.showWheel(d0.sx, d0.sy);
 72           }
 73         }, WHEEL_HOLD_MS);
 74       }
 75     } else if (this.pointers.size === 2) {
 76       clearTimeout(this.holdTimer);
 77       const [a, b] = [...this.pointers.values()];
 78       const mid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
 79       this.drag = {
 80         mode: 'pinch', moved: true, d0: Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) || 1,
 81         ang0: Math.atan2(b.y - a.y, b.x - a.x), dist0: cam.dist, yaw0: cam.yaw,
 82         grab: this.r.screenToWorld(mid.x, mid.y, 0),
 83       };
 84       this.app.ui.hideBox();
 85     }
 86   }
 87 
 88   onMove(e) {
 89     if (!this.active()) return;
 90     const p = this.pos(e);
 91     if (!this.pointers.has(e.pointerId)) {
 92       if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && this.placement) this.hover(p.x, p.y);
 93       return;
 94     }
 95     this.pointers.set(e.pointerId, p);
 96     const d = this.drag;
 97     if (!d) return;
 98     const cam = this.r.cam;
 99     if (d.mode === 'pinch' && this.pointers.size >= 2) {
100       const [a, b] = [...this.pointers.values()];
101       const dist = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) || 1;
102       const ang = Math.atan2(b.y - a.y, b.x - a.x);
103       cam.dist = clamp(d.dist0 * (d.d0 / dist), 9, 70);
104       cam.yaw = d.yaw0 + (ang - d.ang0);
105       this.r.updateCamera();
106       const mid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
107       const w = this.r.screenToWorld(mid.x, mid.y, 0);
108       if (w && d.grab) {
109         cam.tx += d.grab.x - w.x;
110         cam.tz += d.grab.z - w.z;
111         this.r.updateCamera();
112       }
113       return;
114     }
115     if (this.pointers.size !== 1) return;
116     if (d.mode === 'wheel') {
117       // Si el dedo ya se movía antes de que se abriera la rueda (el aviso llegó tarde en un cuadro lento),
118       // era un arrastre del mapa: se cierra la rueda y se sigue moviendo la cámara.
119       const early = d.wheelAt && e.timeStamp && e.timeStamp < d.wheelAt;
120       if (early && Math.hypot(p.x - d.sx, p.y - d.sy) > 9) {
121         this.app.ui.hideWheel();
122         d.mode = null;
123       } else {
124         this.app.ui.hoverWheel(p.x, p.y);
125         return;
126       }
127     }
128     if (!d.moved && Math.hypot(p.x - d.sx, p.y - d.sy) > 9) {
129       d.moved = true;
130       clearTimeout(this.holdTimer);
131       d.mode = this.boxMode || d.shift ? 'box' : 'pan';
132     }
133     if (d.mode === 'pan') {
134       const w = this.r.screenToWorld(p.x, p.y, 0);
135       if (w && d.grab) {
136         cam.tx += d.grab.x - w.x;
137         cam.tz += d.grab.z - w.z;
138         this.r.updateCamera();
139       }
140     } else if (d.mode === 'box') {
141       this.app.ui.showBox(d.sx, d.sy, p.x, p.y);
142     }
143     d.x = p.x;
144     d.y = p.y;
145     if (this.placement && e.pointerType === 'mouse') this.hover(p.x, p.y);
146   }
147 
148   onUp(e, cancelled = false) {
149     if (!this.pointers.has(e.pointerId)) return;
150     const p = this.pos(e);
151     this.pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
152     const d = this.drag;
153     if (!d) return;
154     if (d.mode === 'pinch') {
155       if (this.pointers.size === 0) this.drag = null;
156       else {
157         const [rest] = [...this.pointers.values()];
158         this.drag = { mode: 'pan', sx: rest.x, sy: rest.y, moved: true, grab: this.r.screenToWorld(rest.x, rest.y, 0) };
159       }
160       return;
161     }
162     if (this.pointers.size) return;
163     this.drag = null;
164     clearTimeout(this.holdTimer);
165     if (d.mode === 'wheel') {
166       // Si suelta el dedo sobre una opción, la elige; si no, la rueda queda abierta para tocar.
167       if (!cancelled) this.app.ui.releaseWheel(p.x, p.y);
168       return;
169     }
170     if (cancelled || !this.active()) return;
171     if (d.mode === 'box') {
172       this.app.ui.hideBox();
173       const list = this.r.unitsInRect(d.sx, d.sy, p.x, p.y, (u) => u.owner === 0);
174       this.app.setSelection(list);
175       if (!list.length) this.app.ui.toast('No hay tropas tuyas en el recuadro');
176       return;
177     }
178     if (!d.moved) this.tap(p.x, p.y, d.right);
179   }
180 
181   onWheel(e) {
182     if (!this.active()) return;
183     e.preventDefault();
184     const cam = this.r.cam;
185     const p = this.pos(e);
186     const before = this.r.screenToWorld(p.x, p.y, 0);
187     cam.dist = clamp(cam.dist * (1 + clamp(e.deltaY, -120, 120) * 0.0012), 9, 70);
188     this.r.updateCamera();
189     const after = this.r.screenToWorld(p.x, p.y, 0);
190     if (before && after) {
191       cam.tx += before.x - after.x;
192       cam.tz += before.z - after.z;
193     }
194   }
195 
196   onKey(e, down) {
197     if (e.target && (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA')) return;
198     const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
199     if (down) this.keys.add(k);
200     else this.keys.delete(k);
201     if (!down || !this.active()) return;
202     // Grupos (v0.7): número elige; Ctrl, Cmd o Mayús + número guarda. Se usa e.code para que
203     // Mayús + 1 funcione aunque el teclado escriba «!».
204     const digit = /^Digit([1-3])$/.exec(e.code || '');
205     if (digit) {
206       const n = Number(digit[1]);
207       if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey) {
208         e.preventDefault();
209         this.app.saveGroup(n);
210       } else {
211         this.app.selectGroup(n);
212       }
213       return;
214     }
215     if (k === 'tab') {
216       e.preventDefault();
217       if (this.app.ui.wheelOpen()) this.app.ui.hideWheel();
218       else this.app.ui.showWheel(this.r.width / 2, this.r.height / 2);
219       return;
220     }
221     if (k === 'escape' && this.app.ui.wheelOpen()) {
222       this.app.ui.hideWheel();
223       return;
224     }
225     if (k === 'escape') {
226       if (this.amoveArm) this.disarmAttackMove();
227       else if (this.placement) this.cancelPlacement();
228       else if (this.app.selection.length) this.app.setSelection([]);
229       else this.app.togglePause(true);
230     } else if (k === 'r' && this.placement && this.placement.kind === 'build') this.rotatePlacement();
231     else if (k === 'enter' && this.placement && this.placement.kind === 'build') this.confirmPlacement();
232     else if (k === 'b') this.app.ui.toggleBuild();
233     else if (k === ' ') {
234       e.preventDefault();
235       this.app.focusCore();
236     } else if (k === 'delete' || k === 'backspace') {
237       const s = this.app.selection;
238       if (s.length === 1 && s[0].kind === 'bld' && s[0].owner === 0) this.app.ui.demolishSelected();
239     } else if (k === 't') this.app.quickSelect('army');
240     else if (k === 'p') this.app.togglePause(true);
241     else if (k === 'f') this.armAttackMove();
242     else if (k === 'c') this.app.selectBuilders();
243   }
244 
245   update(dt) {
246     if (!this.active()) return;
247     const cam = this.r.cam;
248     const sp = cam.dist * 1.1 * dt;
249     let fx = 0;
250     let fz = 0;
251     if (this.keys.has('w') || this.keys.has('arrowup')) fz -= 1;
252     if (this.keys.has('s') || this.keys.has('arrowdown')) fz += 1;
253     if (this.keys.has('a') || this.keys.has('arrowleft')) fx -= 1;
254     if (this.keys.has('d') || this.keys.has('arrowright')) fx += 1;
255     if (fx || fz) {
256       const s = Math.sin(cam.yaw);
257       const c = Math.cos(cam.yaw);
258       cam.tx += (fx * c + fz * s) * sp;
259       cam.tz += (-fx * s + fz * c) * sp;
260     }
261     if (this.keys.has('q')) cam.yaw += dt * 1.6;
262     if (this.keys.has('e')) cam.yaw -= dt * 1.6;
263   }
264 
265   hover(x, y) {
266     const c = this.r.pickCell(x, y);
267     this.r.setHover(c ? c.i : -1);
268   }
269 
270   // ---------- avanzar atacando ----------
271   // mode: true = «Avanzar atacando»; 'patrol' = «Patrullar» (v1.4).
272   armAttackMove(mode = true) {
273     const armed = this.app.selection.filter((e) => e.kind === 'unit' && e.owner === 0 && e.alive && e.def.weapon);
274     if (!armed.length) {
275       this.app.ui.toast('Elige primero tropas que puedan pelear', 'bad');
276       return false;
277     }
278     this.amoveArm = mode;
279     this.app.ui.selSig = '';
280     this.app.ui.toast(mode === 'patrol' ? 'Toca el otro punto: irán y volverán entre aquí y allí, peleando en el camino'
281       : 'Toca el destino: avanzarán peleando con todo lo que encuentren');
282     return true;
283   }
284 
285   disarmAttackMove() {
286     if (!this.amoveArm) return;
287     this.amoveArm = false;
288     if (this.app.ui) this.app.ui.selSig = '';
289   }
290 
291   // ---------- toques ----------
292   tap(x, y, right) {
293     const g = this.game;
294     const app = this.app;
295     if (this.placement && !right) {
296       this.placementTap(x, y);
297       return;
298     }
299     const amove = this.amoveArm;
300     this.disarmAttackMove();
301     const mine = app.selection.filter((e) => e.kind === 'unit' && e.owner === 0 && e.alive);
302     const unit = this.r.pickUnit(x, y);
303     const cell = this.r.pickCell(x, y);
304     const bld = cell && cell.bld && cell.bld.alive ? cell.bld : (!unit ? this.r.pickBuilding(x, y) : null);
305     const point = !unit && !bld && cell && cell.point ? cell.point : null;
306     const target = unit || bld;
307     const now = performance.now();
308     const dbl = now - this.lastTap.t < 330 && Math.hypot(x - this.lastTap.x, y - this.lastTap.y) < 30;
309     this.lastTap = { t: now, x, y, id: target ? target.id : -1 };
310 
311     // Avanzar atacando: a ese lugar, peleando en el camino (sobre un enemigo, se ataca directo).
312     if (amove === 'patrol' && mine.length && cell) {
313       const n = g.orderPatrol(mine, cell.i);
314       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xffd166);
315       app.ui.toast(n ? `${n === 1 ? 'Patrulla' : `${n} tropas patrullan`} entre aquí y allí` : 'Esas tropas no pueden patrullar', n ? 'info' : 'bad');
316       app.sound.play('order');
317       return;
318     }
319     if (amove && mine.length && cell && !(target && g.isEnemy(target.owner, 0))) {
320       g.orderMove(mine, cell.i, true, app.formation);
321       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff6060);
322       app.ui.toast(`${mine.length === 1 ? 'Avanza' : `${mine.length} tropas avanzan`} atacando`);
323       app.sound.play('order');
324       return;
325     }
326 
327     if (target && g.isEnemy(target.owner, 0)) {
328       if (mine.length) {
329         const armed = mine.filter((u) => u.def.weapon && g.canAttack(u, u.def.weapon, target));
330         if (armed.length) {
331           g.orderAttack(armed, target);
332           this.r.addMoveMarker(target.kind === 'bld' ? target.cell : target.cell, 0xff6060);
333           app.sound.play('order');
334           const rest = mine.filter((u) => !armed.includes(u));
335           if (rest.length) g.orderMove(rest, target.cell);
336         } else {
337           app.ui.toast('Tus tropas seleccionadas no pueden atacar eso', 'bad');
338         }
339         return;
340       }
341       app.setSelection([target]);
342       return;
343     }
344     if (right) {
345       if (mine.length && cell) this.moveTo(mine, cell.i);
346       return;
347     }
348     // Constructores seleccionados + toque en una obra tuya = construir o mejorar.
349     if (bld && bld.owner === 0 && g.needsWork(bld)) {
350       const workers = mine.filter((u) => g.canBuildSite(u, bld));
351       if (workers.length) {
352         g.orderBuild(workers, bld);
353         this.r.addMoveMarker(bld.cell, 0xf2ab38);
354         app.ui.toast(`${workers.length === 1 ? 'Construyendo' : `${workers.length} constructores en`} ${bld.def.name}`);
355         app.sound.play('order');
356         return;
357       }
358     }
359     // Ingeniero seleccionado + toque en un edificio tuyo dañado = reparar.
360     if (bld && bld.owner === 0 && bld.hp < bld.maxHp && bld.built) {
361       const fixers = mine.filter((u) => u.def.repairs);
362       if (fixers.length) {
363         g.orderRepair(fixers, bld);
364         const rest = mine.filter((u) => !u.def.repairs);
365         if (rest.length) g.orderMove(rest, bld.cell);
366         this.r.addMoveMarker(bld.cell, 0x6dff8a);
367         app.ui.toast(`Reparando ${bld.def.name}`);
368         app.sound.play('order');
369         return;
370       }
371     }
372     // Toque en el Faro o una Bandera: con tropas seleccionadas, ir a capturarlo.
373     if (point) {
374       if (mine.length) {
375         g.orderMove(mine, cell.i, true);
376         this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xffb63a);
377         const inf = mine.some((u) => u.cls === 'inf');
378         app.ui.toast(inf ? 'Quédate junto al punto sin enemigos cerca para capturarlo'
379           : 'Solo la infantería captura puntos', inf ? 'info' : 'bad');
380         app.sound.play('order');
381       } else {
382         app.setSelection([point]);
383         app.sound.play('click');
384       }
385       return;
386     }
387     // Tropas seleccionadas + toque en tu transporte (Barcaza, Lancha, Jeep, Transporte, Portaaviones) = subir.
388     if (target && target.owner === 0 && (target.def.capacity || target.def.hangar || target.def.garrison)) {
389       const landers = mine.filter((u) => g.canBoard(u, target));
390       if (landers.length) {
391         g.orderBoard(landers, target);
392         this.r.addMoveMarker(target.cell, 0x7dd3ff);
393         app.ui.toast(`Subiendo ${landers.length} ${landers.length === 1 ? 'tropa' : 'tropas'} a ${target.def.name}`);
394         app.sound.play('order');
395         return;
396       }
397     }
398     if (target && target.owner === 0) {
399       if (target.kind === 'unit' && dbl) {
400         const same = this.r.unitsInRect(0, 0, this.r.width, this.r.height, (u) => u.owner === 0 && u.type === target.type);
401         app.setSelection(same.length ? same : [target]);
402       } else {
403         app.setSelection([target]);
404       }
405       app.sound.play('click');
406       return;
407     }
408     if (target) {
409       app.setSelection([target]);
410       return;
411     }
412     if (mine.length && cell) {
413       this.moveTo(mine, cell.i);
414       return;
415     }
416     app.setSelection([]);
417   }
418 
419   moveTo(units, ci) {
420     const g = this.game;
421     const founders = units.filter((u) => u.state === 'found');
422     g.orderMove(units, ci, false, this.app.formation);
423     for (const u of founders) u.foundCell = -1;
424     this.r.addMoveMarker(ci);
425     this.app.sound.play('order');
426   }
427 
428   // ---------- colocación ----------
429   startPlacement(p) {
430     if (p.kind === 'build') {
431       p.rot = this.lastRot[p.btype] || 0;
432       p.cell = -1;
433       p.err = null;
434       p.placed = 0;
435     }
436     this.placement = p;
437     this.refreshPlacement();
438     this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
439   }
440 
441   previewAt(ci) {
442     const p = this.placement;
443     p.cell = ci;
444     p.err = this.game.placeInvalid(0, p.btype, ci);
445     this.r.setGhost(p.btype, ci, p.rot, !p.err);
446     this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
447   }
448 
449   rotatePlacement() {
450     const p = this.placement;
451     if (!p || p.kind !== 'build') return;
452     p.rot = (p.rot + Math.PI / 3) % (Math.PI * 2);
453     this.lastRot[p.btype] = p.rot;
454     if (p.cell >= 0) this.r.setGhost(p.btype, p.cell, p.rot, !p.err);
455     this.app.sound.play('click');
456   }
457 
458   // «Construir» (v1.0): tocar una casilla solo muestra la obra fantasma; este botón la pone.
459   // Después se puede elegir otra casilla y volver a construir; «Terminar» sale.
460   confirmPlacement() {
461     const p = this.placement;
462     if (!p || p.kind !== 'build') return;
463     if (p.cell < 0) {
464       this.app.ui.toast('Toca primero una casilla dorada', 'bad');
465       this.app.sound.play('error');
466       return;
467     }
468     this.buildAt(p.cell);
469   }
470 
471   // Pone la obra en la casilla elegida y sigue en modo construir para poner más.
472   buildAt(ci) {
473     const g = this.game;
474     const p = this.placement;
475     p.cell = ci;
476     const err = g.place(0, p.btype, p.cell, p.rot);
477     if (err) {
478       p.err = err;
479       this.r.setGhost(p.btype, p.cell, p.rot, false);
480       this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
481       this.app.ui.toast(err, 'bad');
482       this.app.sound.play('error');
483       return;
484     }
485     this.lastRot[p.btype] = p.rot;
486     this.r.addMoveMarker(p.cell, 0xf5c542);
487     this.app.ui.refreshBuild(true);
488     p.placed++;
489     p.cell = -1;
490     p.err = null;
491     this.r.setGhost(null, -1);
492     this.r.setHover(-1);
493     this.refreshPlacement();
494     this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
495   }
496 
497   refreshPlacement() {
498     const p = this.placement;
499     if (!p || !this.game) return;
500     const g = this.game;
501     let cells = [];
502     if (p.kind === 'build') {
503       cells = g.cells.filter((c) => !g.placeInvalid(0, p.btype, c.i, true)).map((c) => c.i);
504     } else if (p.kind === 'found') {
505       const u = p.unit;
506       const comp = g.cells[u.cell].comp;
507       cells = g.cells.filter((c) => !g.foundInvalid(0, c.i, u.def.founds) &&
508         (u.mover !== 'land' || c.comp === comp)).map((c) => c.i);
509     } else if (p.kind === 'rally' || p.kind === 'bombzone' || p.kind === 'allyattack') {
510       cells = [];
511     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke') {
512       cells = g.cells.filter((c) => !g.nukeInvalid(p.building, c.i) && g.map.dist(c, g.cells[p.building.cell]) <= NUKE.range).map((c) => c.i);
513     } else if (p.kind === 'mnuke') {
514       cells = p.unit.alive ? g.cells.filter((c) => !g.mobileNukeInvalid(p.unit, c.i)).map((c) => c.i) : [];
515     } else if (p.kind === 'silo') {
516       cells = p.building.alive ? g.cells.filter((c) => !g.siloInvalid(p.building, c.i)).map((c) => c.i) : [];
517     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke3') {
518       const silos = g.readySilos(0).slice(0, 3);
519       cells = silos.length < 3 || g.salvoInvalid(0) ? [] : g.cells.filter((c) => silos.every((b) => !g.nukeInvalid(b, c.i))).map((c) => c.i);
520     }
521     p.valid = new Set(cells);
522     this.r.setPlacement(cells);
523     if (p.kind === 'build' && p.cell >= 0) {
524       const err = g.placeInvalid(0, p.btype, p.cell);
525       if (err !== p.err) {
526         p.err = err;
527         this.r.setGhost(p.btype, p.cell, p.rot, !err);
528         this.app.ui.showPlaceBar(p);
529       }
530     }
531   }
532 
533   cancelPlacement() {
534     this.placement = null;
535     if (this.r) {
536       this.r.setPlacement(null);
537       this.r.setGhost(null, -1);
538       this.r.hoverMesh.material.color.set(0xffffff);
539       this.r.setHover(-1);
540     }
541     this.app.ui.hidePlaceBar();
542   }
543 
544   placementTap(x, y) {
545     const g = this.game;
546     const p = this.placement;
547     const cell = this.r.pickCell(x, y);
548     if (!cell) return;
549     if (p.kind === 'build') {
550       this.previewAt(cell.i);
551       this.app.sound.play('click');
552     } else if (p.kind === 'found') {
553       if (!p.unit.alive) {
554         this.cancelPlacement();
555         return;
556       }
557       const err = g.orderFound(p.unit, cell.i);
558       if (err) {
559         this.app.ui.toast(err, 'bad');
560         this.app.sound.play('error');
561         return;
562       }
563       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xf5c542);
564       this.app.ui.toast('El ingeniero va en camino (cuesta 800 al llegar)');
565       this.cancelPlacement();
566     } else if (p.kind === 'mnuke' || p.kind === 'silo' || (p.kind === 'nuke' && g.strategic)) {
567       // v1.7: con Arsenal estratégico el uso es único: primero se revisa la zona y se confirma.
568       const err = p.kind === 'mnuke' ? g.mobileNukeInvalid(p.unit, cell.i) : p.kind === 'silo' ? g.siloInvalid(p.building, cell.i) : g.nukeInvalid(p.building, cell.i);
569       if (err) {
570         this.app.ui.toast(err, 'bad');
571         this.app.sound.play('error');
572         return;
573       }
574       this.r.setHover(cell.i);
575       this.app.sound.play('click');
576       this.app.ui.askStrategic(p, cell.i);
577     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke') {
578       const err = g.launchNuke(p.building, cell.i);
579       if (err) {
580         this.app.ui.toast(err, 'bad');
581         this.app.sound.play('error');
582         return;
583       }
584       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff4040);
585       this.cancelPlacement();
586     } else if (p.kind === 'allyattack') {
587       // El rival es el dueño de lo que tocaste: edificio, tropa cercana o territorio.
588       let pid = cell.bld && cell.bld.alive ? cell.bld.owner : -1;
589       if (pid < 0) {
590         const u = g.units.find((x) => x.alive && Math.hypot(x.x - cell.x, x.z - cell.z) < 1.2 && g.isEnemy(0, x.owner));
591         if (u) pid = u.owner;
592       }
593       if (pid < 0 && cell.owner >= 0) pid = cell.owner;
594       if (pid < 0 || !g.isEnemy(0, pid)) {
595         this.app.ui.toast('Toca algo de un rival', 'bad');
596         this.app.sound.play('error');
597         return;
598       }
599       const bots = g.bots.filter((b) => b.p.alive && b.p.team === g.players[0].team && b.pid !== 0);
600       const n = bots.reduce((a, b) => a + b.answerAttack(pid), 0);
601       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff4040);
602       this.app.ui.toast(`Tus aliados atacan a ${g.players[pid].name}${n ? ` con ${n} tropas` : ''}`, 'good');
603       this.app.sound.play('order');
604       this.cancelPlacement();
605     } else if (p.kind === 'bombzone') {
606       const bombers = p.units.filter((u) => u.alive);
607       if (bombers.length) {
608         g.orderMove(bombers, cell.i, true);
609         this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff4040);
610         this.app.ui.toast(`${bombers.length === 1 ? 'El Bombardero va' : 'Los Bombarderos van'} a bombardear la zona`, 'info');
611         this.app.sound.play('order');
612       }
613       this.cancelPlacement();
614     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke3') {
615       const res = g.launchSalvo(0, cell.i);
616       if (typeof res === 'string') {
617         this.app.ui.toast(res, 'bad');
618         this.app.sound.play('error');
619         return;
620       }
621       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xff4040);
622       this.app.ui.toast(`¡${res} misiles nucleares lanzados a la vez!`, 'info');
623       this.cancelPlacement();
624     } else if (p.kind === 'rally') {
625       p.building.rally = cell.i;
626       this.r.addMoveMarker(cell.i, 0xffffff);
627       this.cancelPlacement();
628       this.app.ui.toast('Punto de reunión fijado');
629     }
630   }
631 }

 316   // ---------- v1.8: Ajustes «A tu manera» ----------
 317   // Los controles son los mismos de la pausa: al abrir se acomodan por secciones y al cerrar vuelven a su lugar.
 318   openSettings(sec = 'interfaz') {
 319     if (!this.setMoved) {
 320       this.setMoved = [];
 321       for (const [pane, ids] of Object.entries(SETTINGS_LAYOUT)) {
 322         const box = document.querySelector(`[data-setpane="${pane}"]`);
 323         const after = box.querySelector('h3');
 324         let ref = after.nextSibling;
 325         for (const id of ids) {
 326           const el = $(id);
 327           if (!el) continue;
 328           this.setMoved.push([el, el.parentNode, el.nextSibling]);
 329           box.insertBefore(el, ref);
 330         }
 331       }
 332     }
 333     $('settings').hidden = false;
 334     this.showSettingsSection(sec);
 335     this.app.sound.play('click');
 336   }

 338   showSettingsSection(sec) {
 339     document.querySelectorAll('#settings [data-setsec]').forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(b.dataset.setsec === sec)));
 340     document.querySelectorAll('#settings [data-setpane]').forEach((p) => { p.hidden = p.dataset.setpane !== sec; });
 341   }
 342 
 343   closeSettings() {
 344     if (this.setMoved) {
 345       for (let i = this.setMoved.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 346         const [el, parent, next] = this.setMoved[i];
 347         parent.insertBefore(el, next);
 348       }
 349       this.setMoved = null;
 350     }
 351     $('settings').hidden = true;
 352   }

 356   resetSettings() {
 357     const app = this.app;
 358     app.setQuality('auto');

 360     if (app.battery) app.setBattery(false);

 399       sl.value = String(app.uiScale || 100);

 402       $('ui-scale-note').textContent = eff < (app.uiScale || 100) ? `En esta pantalla se usa ${eff} % para que todo quepa.` : 'Agranda los paneles, las listas y los avisos. Los botones nunca bajan de 44 px.';

 406   updateMusicBtns() {

 481   toast(text, kind = 'info', at = null) {
 482     const now = performance.now();
 483     if (this.lastToast[text] && now - this.lastToast[text] < 1200) return;
 484     this.lastToast[text] = now;
 485     const box = $('toasts');
 486     const el = document.createElement('div');
 487     el.className = 'toast ' + kind;
 488     const span = document.createElement('span');
 489     span.textContent = text;
 490     el.appendChild(span);
 491     if (at && at.x !== undefined) {
 492       el.classList.add('has-btn');
 493       const b = document.createElement('button');
 494       b.type = 'button';
 495       b.className = 'mini-btn';
 496       b.textContent = 'Ver';
 497       b.addEventListener('click', () => {
 498         this.app.focusAt(at.x, at.z);
 499         el.remove();
 500       });
 501       el.appendChild(b);
 502     }
 503     box.appendChild(el);
 504     while (box.children.length > 3) box.removeChild(box.firstChild);
 505     setTimeout(() => el.remove(), at ? 5000 : 2800);
 506   }

 508   // Mensaje de un bot: al panel de mensajes (pantallas anchas) o como aviso (estrechas).
 509   chat(msg) {
 510     const g = this.app.game;
 511     if (!msg.toMe && !msg.ally && !msg.public) return;
 512     const p = g.players[msg.pid];
 513     const who = msg.ally ? `${p.name} (aliado)` : p.name;
 514     const at = msg.x !== undefined ? { x: msg.x, z: msg.z } : null;
 515     const feed = $('feed');
 516     const wide = feed.offsetParent !== null;
 517     if (wide) {
 518       const el = document.createElement('div');
 519       el.className = 'msg' + (msg.toMe ? ' bad' : '');
 520       el.innerHTML = `<i style="background:${hexColor(p.color)}"></i><div><b>${esc(who)}:</b> ${esc(msg.text)}</div>`;
 521       if (at) {
 522         const b = document.createElement('button');
 523         b.type = 'button';
 524         b.className = 'mini-btn';
 525         b.textContent = 'Ver';
 526         b.addEventListener('click', () => this.app.focusAt(at.x, at.z));
 527         el.appendChild(b);
 528       }
 529       feed.appendChild(el);
 530       while (feed.children.length > 4) feed.removeChild(feed.firstChild);
 531       setTimeout(() => el.classList.add('old'), 15000);
 532       setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 40000);
 533     }
 534     if (msg.toMe || !wide) this.toast(`${who}: ${msg.text}`, msg.toMe ? 'bad' : 'info', msg.toMe ? at : null);
 535     if (msg.toMe) this.app.sound.play('alarm');
 536   }

 538   // ---------- tutorial que señala qué tocar (v1.2) ----------
 539   // Si sigues en modo construir (la obra ya está puesta y el modo sigue para poner más), primero se sale de él:
 540   // si no, tocar un edificio o una tropa no la elige.
 541   coachStep(g) {
 542     const step = this.coachStepRaw(g);
 543     const p = this.app.input.placement;
 544     if (step && p && !step.place) {
 545       return { sel: '#btn-place-cancel', text: p.placed ? 'Toca «Terminar» para salir del modo construir' : 'Toca «Cancelar» para salir de este modo' };
 546     }
 547     return step;
 548   }
 549 
 550   coachStepRaw(g) {
 551     const app = this.app;
 552     const me = g.players[0];
 553     const mine = g.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive);
 554     const blds = g.buildings.filter((b) => b.owner === 0 && b.alive);
 555     const sel = app.selection;
 556     const core = me.core;
 557     const p = app.input.placement;
 558     const bp = $('buildpanel');
 559     // (offsetParent no sirve con paneles «position: fixed»; se mira si ocupa lugar en la pantalla.)
 560     const shown = (el) => !!el && el.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden';
 561     const panelOpen = shown(bp) && !bp.classList.contains('min') && (window.innerWidth > 860 || bp.classList.contains('open'));
 562     const buildFlow = (tab, type, name, tabName) => {
 563       if (p && p.kind === 'build' && p.btype === type) {
 564         if (p.cell < 0) {
 565           const c = [...(p.valid || [])].map((i) => g.cells[i]).sort((a, b) => g.map.dist(a, g.cells[core.cell]) - g.map.dist(b, g.cells[core.cell]))[0];
 566           return c ? { world: { x: c.x, y: c.h, z: c.z }, text: 'Toca una casilla dorada (por ejemplo, esta)', place: true } : { text: 'No quedan casillas libres', place: true };
 567         }
 568         return { sel: '#btn-place-ok', text: 'Toca «Construir» para poner la obra', place: true };
 569       }
 570       if (!panelOpen) return { sel: '#btn-build', text: 'Abre «Construir»' };
 571       if (this.tab !== tab) return { sel: `#btabs [data-tab="${tab}"]`, text: `Abre la pestaña «${tabName}»` };
 572       return { sel: `.bitem[data-b="${type}"]`, text: `Elige «${name}»` };
 573     };
 574     const hasBuilder = mine.some((u) => u.def.builds) || core.queue.some((q) => q.type === 'builder');
 575     if (!hasBuilder) {
 576       if (!(sel.length === 1 && sel[0] === core)) return { world: { x: core.x, y: core.y + 1, z: core.z }, text: 'Toca tu Núcleo' };
 577       return { sel: '[data-act="train"][data-type="builder"]', text: 'Entrena un Constructor' };
 578     }
 579     // v1.3: los 3 pasos de tu documento. 1 Construí: otra Granja y una energía.
 580     const at = (e, dy = 0.5) => ({ x: e.x, y: (e.y || 0) + dy, z: e.z });
 581     const isSel = (e) => sel.length === 1 && sel[0] === e;
 582     if (blds.filter((b) => b.type === 'farm').length < 2) return buildFlow('eco', 'farm', 'Granja', 'Economía');
 583     if (!blds.some((b) => ['solar', 'wind', 'hydro', 'tidal', 'wave'].includes(b.type))) return buildFlow('energy', 'solar', 'Solar', 'Energía');
 584     // 2 Producí: un Cuartel y 3 soldados.
 585     const bar = blds.find((b) => b.type === 'barracks');
 586     if (!bar) return buildFlow('prod', 'barracks', 'Cuartel', 'Producción');
 587     const soldiers = mine.filter((u) => u.cls === 'inf' && u.def.weapon);
 588     const inQueue = bar.queue.filter((q) => UNITS[q.type].cls === 'inf' && UNITS[q.type].weapon).length;
 589     if (soldiers.length + inQueue < 3) {
 590       if (!bar.built) return { world: at(bar), text: 'El Constructor va a la obra: espera a que termine el Cuartel' };
 591       if (!isSel(bar)) return { world: at(bar), text: 'Toca tu Cuartel' };
 592       return { sel: '[data-act="train"][data-type="rifle"]', text: `Entrena Artilleros (tienes ${soldiers.length + inQueue} de 3)` };
 593     }
 594     // 3 Atacá: Puerto, Barcaza, subir a los soldados, cruzar y tomar la isla del bot.
 595     const foe = g.players.find((q) => q.id !== 0 && q.alive && q.core && q.core.alive);
 596     if (!foe) return null;
 597     const foeComp = g.cells[foe.core.cell].comp;
 598     const landed = soldiers.filter((u) => !u.inside && g.cells[u.cell].comp === foeComp);
 599     if (landed.length) {
 600       if (!sel.some((u) => u.kind === 'unit' && u.def.weapon)) return { sel: '[data-quick="army"]', text: 'Toca «Ejército» para elegir a tus soldados' };
 601       return { world: at(foe.core, 1), text: 'Toca el Núcleo del bot para tomar su isla' };
 602     }
 603     const harbor = blds.find((b) => b.type === 'harbor');
 604     if (!harbor) return buildFlow('prod', 'harbor', 'Puerto', 'Producción');
 605     const barge = mine.find((u) => u.type === 'barge');
 606     if (!barge) {
 607       if (!harbor.built) return { world: at(harbor), text: 'El Constructor va a la obra: espera a que termine el Puerto' };
 608       if (harbor.queue.some((q) => q.type === 'barge')) return { world: at(harbor), text: 'El Puerto fabrica la Barcaza: espera' };
 609       if (!isSel(harbor)) return { world: at(harbor), text: 'Toca tu Puerto' };
 610       return { sel: '[data-act="train"][data-type="barge"]', text: 'Entrena una Barcaza: lleva tropas por el mar' };
 611     }
 612     const ashore = soldiers.filter((u) => !u.inside);
 613     if (soldiers.length < 3) return { world: at(bar), text: `Espera a tus soldados (${soldiers.length} de 3)` };
 614     if (ashore.length) {
 615       if (ashore.every((u) => u.state === 'board')) return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'Los soldados suben a la Barcaza: espera' };
 616       if (!sel.some((u) => u.kind === 'unit' && u.cls === 'inf' && u.def.weapon)) return { sel: '[data-quick="army"]', text: 'Toca «Ejército» para elegir a tus soldados' };
 617       return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'Toca la Barcaza para subirlos' };
 618     }
 619     // Todos a bordo: llevar la Barcaza junto a la isla del bot y desembarcar.
 620     const c0 = g.cells[barge.cell];
 621     const nearFoe = g.cells.some((c) => c.comp === foeComp && TERRAIN[c.t].land && g.map.dist(c, c0) <= 2);
 622     if (!nearFoe) {
 623       if (barge.path && barge.pathI < barge.path.length) return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'La Barcaza navega hacia la isla del bot: espera' };
 624       if (!isSel(barge)) return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'Toca tu Barcaza' };
 625       const dest = this.landingCell(g, foe, foeComp);
 626       return dest ? { world: { x: dest.x, y: 0.1, z: dest.z }, text: 'Toca el mar junto a la isla del bot para llevarla' } : { text: 'No hay costa libre junto a la isla del bot' };
 627     }
 628     if (!isSel(barge)) return { world: at(barge, 0.3), text: 'Toca tu Barcaza' };
 629     return { sel: '[data-act="unload"]', text: 'Toca «Desembarcar»' };
 630   }
 631 
 632   // Casilla de mar junto a la isla del bot, lo más cerca posible de su Núcleo.
 633   landingCell(g, foe, foeComp) {
 634     if (this._landing && this._landing.g === g && this._landing.pid === foe.id) return this._landing.c;
 635     const core = g.cells[foe.core.cell];
 636     const c = g.cells.filter((x) => TERRAIN[x.t].water && !x.bld && x.nb.some((ni) => g.cells[ni].comp === foeComp && TERRAIN[g.cells[ni].t].land))
 637       .sort((a, b) => g.map.dist(a, core) - g.map.dist(b, core))[0] || null;
 638     this._landing = { g, pid: foe.id, c };
 639     return c;
 640   }
 641 
 642   updateCoach() {
 643     const app = this.app;
 644     const g = app.game;
 645     let el = $('coach');
 646     const step = g && g.mode.tutorial && !g.over && app.state === 'play' && !app.paused ? this.coachStep(g) : null;
 647     if (!step) {
 648       if (el) el.hidden = true;
 649       return;
 650     }
 651     if (!el) {
 652       el = document.createElement('div');
 653       el.id = 'coach';
 654       el.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
 655       el.innerHTML = '<div class="coach-ring"></div><div class="coach-tip"></div>';
 656       document.body.appendChild(el);
 657       this._tipKey = null;
 658     }
 659     let rect = null;
 660     let text = step.text;
 661     if (step.sel) {
 662       const t = document.querySelector(step.sel);
 663       if (t && t.getClientRects().length > 0) {
 664         const r = t.getBoundingClientRect();
 665         rect = { x: r.left - 6, y: r.top - 6, w: r.width + 12, h: r.height + 12 };
 666       }
 667     } else if (step.world && app.renderer) {
 668       const sp = app.renderer.project(step.world.x, step.world.y, step.world.z);
 669       const onScreen = sp.ok && sp.x > 24 && sp.x < window.innerWidth - 24 && sp.y > 24 && sp.y < window.innerHeight - 24;
 670       // ¿Lo tapa un panel? (por ejemplo, el de «Construir»): tocar ahí tocaría el panel, no el mapa.
 671       const top = onScreen ? document.elementFromPoint(sp.x, sp.y) : null;
 672       const covered = onScreen && !!top && top.id !== 'gl' && top.id !== 'overlay';
 673       if (onScreen && !covered) rect = { x: sp.x - 30, y: sp.y - 30, w: 60, h: 60, round: true };
 674       else {
 675         // Fuera de la pantalla: el aro señala ese lugar en el minimapa (tocarlo lleva la cámara allí).
 676         const mm = $('minimap');
 677         if (mm && mm.getClientRects().length > 0) {
 678           const r = mm.getBoundingClientRect();
 679           const m = app.renderer.worldToMinimap(mm, step.world.x, step.world.z);
 680           rect = { x: r.left + clamp(m.x, 0, r.width) - 16, y: r.top + clamp(m.y, 0, r.height) - 16, w: 32, h: 32, round: true };
 681           text = covered ? 'Lo tapa un panel: toca este punto del minimapa para centrarlo'
 682             : 'Está fuera de la pantalla: toca este punto del minimapa para ir allí';
 683         }
 684       }
 685     }
 686     el.hidden = false;
 687     const ring = el.querySelector('.coach-ring');
 688     const tip = el.querySelector('.coach-tip');
 689     ring.hidden = !rect;
 690     if (rect) Object.assign(ring.style, { left: `${rect.x}px`, top: `${rect.y}px`, width: `${rect.w}px`, height: `${rect.h}px`, borderRadius: rect.round ? '50%' : '12px' });
 691     // v1.4: se mide el texto de verdad (con «Letra grande» es más ancho y más alto).
 692     const tipKey = text + document.body.classList.contains('bigtext');
 693     if (this._tipKey !== tipKey || tip.textContent !== text) {
 694       tip.textContent = text;
 695       this._tipKey = tipKey;
 696       this._tipSize = { w: tip.offsetWidth || 220, h: tip.offsetHeight || 44 };
 697     }
 698     const { w: tw, h: th } = this._tipSize;
 699     const W = window.innerWidth;
 700     const Hh = window.innerHeight;
 701     const tx = rect ? clamp(rect.x + rect.w / 2 - tw / 2, 8, W - tw - 8) : W / 2 - tw / 2;
 702     const below = rect ? rect.y + rect.h + 8 : 120;
 703     const ty = clamp(rect && below + th + 8 > Hh ? rect.y - th - 8 : below, 8, Math.max(8, Hh - th - 8));
 704     Object.assign(tip.style, { left: `${tx}px`, top: `${ty}px` });
 705     this.coachText = text;
 706   }

 708   // ---------- rueda de selección del ejército (v1.2) ----------
 709   wheelOpen() {

 713   showWheel(x, y) {
 714     this.hideWheel();
 715     const app = this.app;
 716     const g = app.game;
 717     if (!g || app.state !== 'play') return;
 718     const count = (f) => g.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive && !u.inside && f(u)).length;
 719     const opts = [
 720       { k: 'army', label: 'Tierra', n: count((u) => u.def.weapon && u.mover === 'land') },
 721       { k: 'sea', label: 'Mar', n: count((u) => u.def.weapon && u.mover === 'sea') },
 722       { k: 'air', label: 'Aire', n: count((u) => u.def.weapon && u.mover === 'air') },
 723       { k: 'all', label: 'Todo', n: count((u) => u.def.weapon) },
 724       { k: 'builders', label: 'Constructores', n: count((u) => u.def.builds === 'land') },
 725       { k: 'g1', label: 'Grupo 1', n: (app.groups[1] || []).filter((u) => u.alive).length },
 726       { k: 'g2', label: 'Grupo 2', n: (app.groups[2] || []).filter((u) => u.alive).length },
 727       { k: 'g3', label: 'Grupo 3', n: (app.groups[3] || []).filter((u) => u.alive).length },
 728     ];
 729     // Radio para que las 8 opciones (84 px de ancho) no se pisen entre sí.
 730     const R = 122;
 731     const cx = clamp(x, R + 50, window.innerWidth - R - 50);
 732     const cy = clamp(y, R + 40, window.innerHeight - R - 40);
 733     const el = document.createElement('div');
 734     el.id = 'wheel';
 735     el.setAttribute('role', 'menu');
 736     el.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Rueda de selección');
 737     el.innerHTML = `<div class="wheel-hub" style="left:${cx}px;top:${cy}px">Elegir</div>` + opts.map((o, i) => {
 738       const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i / opts.length) * Math.PI * 2;
 739       return `<button type="button" role="menuitem" class="wheel-opt" data-wk="${o.k}" style="left:${cx + Math.cos(a) * R}px;top:${cy + Math.sin(a) * R}px" ${o.n ? '' : 'disabled'}>
 740         <b>${o.label}</b><small>${o.n}</small></button>`;
 741     }).join('');
 742     el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 743       const b = e.target.closest('[data-wk]');
 744       if (b && !b.disabled) this.pickWheel(b.dataset.wk);
 745       else if (!e.target.closest('.wheel-opt')) this.hideWheel();
 746     });
 747     document.body.appendChild(el);
 748     this.wheel = el;
 749     app.sound.play('click');
 750   }
 751 
 752   hoverWheel(x, y) {
 753     if (!this.wheel) return;
 754     const hit = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
 755     this.wheel.querySelectorAll('.wheel-opt').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('hot', b === (hit && hit.closest('.wheel-opt'))));
 756   }
 757 
 758   releaseWheel(x, y) {
 759     if (!this.wheel) return;
 760     const hit = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
 761     const b = hit && hit.closest('.wheel-opt');
 762     if (b && !b.disabled) this.pickWheel(b.dataset.wk);
 763   }

 770     else app.quickSelect(k);

 778   // ---------- alianzas y órdenes a los aliados (v1.1) ----------
 779   allyAction(kind, pid) {
 780     const app = this.app;
 781     const g = app.game;
 782     if (!g) return;
 783     if (kind === 'ask') {
 784       const res = g.proposeAlliance(0, pid);
 785       this.toast(res.text, res.ok ? 'good' : 'bad');
 786       app.sound.play(res.ok ? 'ready' : 'error');
 787     } else if (kind === 'break') {
 788       if (this.breakArm !== pid) {
 789         this.breakArm = pid;
 790         this.toast(`¿Romper la alianza con ${g.players[pid].name}? Toca «Romper» otra vez`, 'bad');
 791         setTimeout(() => { if (this.breakArm === pid) this.breakArm = null; }, 4000);
 792         return;
 793       }
 794       this.breakArm = null;
 795       const err = g.breakAlliance(0);
 796       if (err) this.toast(err, 'bad');
 797       else {
 798         g.say(pid, 'Rompiste la alianza. Ahora somos rivales otra vez.', { force: true, toMe: true });
 799         this.toast(`Ya no eres aliado de ${g.players[pid].name}`, 'info');
 800       }
 801     } else if (kind === 'help' || kind === 'attack') {
 802       this.allyOrder(kind);
 803       return;
 804     }
 805     this.renderPop();
 806   }

 818     const hasAllies = g.players.some((q) => q.id !== 0 && q.alive && !q.human && q.team === me.team) && me.alive;

 820       <button class="btn mini gold" type="button" data-ally="help" data-pid="0">¡Ayuda!</button>
 821       <button class="btn mini gold" type="button" data-ally="attack" data-pid="0">¡Ataquemos!</button></div>`

 867   renderPop() {

 878   econHtml(g) {
 879     const p = g.players[0];
 880     const rows = [];
 881     const groups = new Map();
 882     for (const b of g.buildings) {
 883       if (!b.alive || b.owner !== 0 || !b.built || !b.def.income) continue;
 884       const k = groups.get(b.type) || { n: 0, sum: 0 };
 885       k.n++;
 886       k.sum += b.def.income;
 887       groups.set(b.type, k);
 888     }
 889     for (const [type, k] of groups) rows.push([`${BUILDINGS[type].name}${k.n > 1 ? ` ×${k.n}` : ''}`, k.sum]);
 890     const flags = g.points.filter((pt) => pt.owner === 0 && pt.def.income);
 891     if (flags.length) rows.push([`Banderas ×${flags.length}`, flags.reduce((s, pt) => s + pt.def.income, 0)]);
 892     rows.sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
 893     const bonus = p.income - p.baseIncome;
 894     let html = '<header><h4>Monedas por minuto</h4><button class="btn icon" type="button" data-close aria-label="Cerrar">' + ICON.close + '</button></header><table><tbody>';
 895     html += rows.map(([n, v]) => `<tr><td>${esc(n)}</td><td class="n">+${fmt(v)}</td></tr>`).join('');
 896     if (bonus > 0) {
 897       html += `<tr><td>Subtotal</td><td class="n">${fmt(p.baseIncome)}</td></tr><tr><td>Faro (+${Math.round(p.bonus * 100)} %)</td><td class="n">+${fmt(bonus)}</td></tr>`;
 898     }
 899     html += `<tr class="total"><td>Total</td><td class="n" id="econ-total">+${fmt(p.income)}</td></tr></tbody></table>`;
 900     if (!groups.has('farm') && !groups.has('mine')) html += '<p class="hint-press" style="margin:0">Construye Granjas y Minas para ganar más.</p>';
 901     return html;
 902   }

 904   energyHtml(g) {

 907     for (const b of g.buildings) {
 908       if (!b.alive || b.owner !== 0 || !b.built || !b.def.energy) continue;
 909       const k = groups.get(b.type) || { n: 0, sum: 0 };
 910       k.n++;
 911       k.sum += g.bEnergy(b);
 912       groups.set(b.type, k);

 916     for (const [type, k] of groups) html += `<tr><td>${esc(BUILDINGS[type].name)} ×${k.n}</td><td class="n">+${k.sum} / 10 s</td></tr>`;
 917     html += `<tr class="total"><td>Disponible</td><td class="n">${fmt(p.energy)}</td></tr></tbody></table>`;
 918     html += '<p class="hint-press" style="margin:0">La producen Solar, Eólica, Hidráulica, Mareomotriz y Undimotriz. La gastan vehículos, buques de guerra, helicópteros, la Fábrica y el Helipuerto.</p>';

 922   scoreHtml(g) {
 923     const land = g.cells.filter((c) => TERRAIN[c.t].land).length || 1;
 924     const terr = new Map();
 925     for (const c of g.cells) if (c.owner >= 0 && TERRAIN[c.t].land) terr.set(c.owner, (terr.get(c.owner) || 0) + 1);
 926     const myTeam = g.players[0].team;
 927     const rows = g.players.map((p) => {
 928       const army = g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === p.id && u.def.weapon).length;
 929       const blds = g.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.owner === p.id).length;
 930       const pts = g.points.filter((pt) => pt.owner === p.id).length;
 931       const role = p.human ? '—' : PERSONALITIES[p.persona].name;
 932       const rel = p.id === 0 ? '' : p.team === myTeam ? ' · aliado' : '';
 933       // v1.1: alianzas en los modos de todos contra todos.
 934       const canAlly = g.alliancesAllowed() && p.id !== 0 && p.alive && g.players[0].alive;
 935       const allyBtn = !canAlly ? '' : p.team === myTeam
 936         ? `<button class="btn mini danger" type="button" data-ally="break" data-pid="${p.id}">Romper</button>`
 937         : `<button class="btn mini" type="button" data-ally="ask" data-pid="${p.id}">Aliarse</button>`;
 938       return `<tr class="${p.alive ? '' : 'dead'}" data-pid="${p.id}"><td><i class="dot" style="background:${hexColor(p.color)}"></i>${esc(p.name)}</td>
 939         <td>${esc(role)}${rel}${allyBtn}</td><td class="n">${Math.round(((terr.get(p.id) || 0) / land) * 100)} %</td>
 940         <td class="n">${army}</td><td class="n">${blds}</td><td class="n">${p.alive ? '+' + fmt(p.income) : '—'}</td><td class="n">${pts}</td></tr>`;
 941     }).join('');
 942     const hasAllies = g.players.some((q) => q.id !== 0 && q.alive && !q.human && q.team === myTeam) && g.players[0].alive;
 943     const orders = hasAllies ? `<div class="allyorders"><span>A tus aliados:</span>
 944       <button class="btn mini gold" type="button" data-ally="help" data-pid="0" id="btn-ally-help">¡Ayuda!</button>
 945       <button class="btn mini gold" type="button" data-ally="attack" data-pid="0" id="btn-ally-attack">¡Ataquemos!</button></div>` : '';
 946     const hint = g.alliancesAllowed() ? '<p class="allyhint">Toca «Aliarse» para proponer una alianza: los aliados no se atacan y comparten lo que ven. Al final solo puede ganar uno.</p>' : '';
 947     return `<header><h4>Marcador · ${fmtTime(g.time)}</h4><span class="row" style="gap:6px"><button class="btn mini" type="button" data-openchat id="btn-open-chat">Mensajes</button><button class="btn icon" type="button" data-close aria-label="Cerrar">${ICON.close}</button></span></header>${orders}${hint}
 948       <div class="wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Imperio</th><th>Estilo</th><th>Territorio</th><th>Ejército</th><th>Edificios</th><th>Monedas/min</th><th>Puntos</th></tr></thead>
 949       <tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div>`;
 950   }

 977           `<span>Furtivo</span><b class="${seen ? 'radar-lock' : ''}">${seen ? 'Visible (acaba de soltar bombas)' : 'Oculto: solo se ve a 3 casillas'}</b>`);

1019       status = `<b class="${locking ? 'radar-track' : 'radar-lock'}">${locking ? 'Siguiendo' : 'Fijado'}: ${esc(name)}</b>`;

1040   // v1.5: «la próxima en 3 s · todo en 12 s» (o por qué no avanza).
1041   queueTimeText(b) {
1042     const g = this.app.game;
1043     if (!b.queue.length) return '';
1044     const rate = g.prodRate(b);
1045     if (!(rate > 0)) return 'parada: falta energía';
1046     const q = b.queue[0];
1047     const first = Math.max(0, (UNITS[q.type].build - q.t) / rate);
1048     let total = first;
1049     for (let i = 1; i < b.queue.length; i++) total += UNITS[b.queue[i].type].build / rate;
1050     const f = (x) => (x < 60 ? `${Math.ceil(x)} s` : fmtTime(x));
1051     return b.queue.length > 1 ? `la próxima en ${f(first)} · todas en ${f(total)}` : `lista en ${f(first)}`;
1052   }

1054   // v1.5: ficha de una tropa: vida, daño, alcance, velocidad y contra qué es buena o mala.
1055   unitTilesHtml(u) {
1056     const d = u.def;
1057     const w = d.weapon;
1058     const tiles = [['Vida máxima', fmt(u.maxHp), u.vet ? 'gold' : '']];
1059     if (w) {
1060       const mult = 1 + (u.vet || 0) * VETERAN.dmg;
1061       tiles.push(['Daño/s', fmt((w.dmg * mult) / w.cd), u.vet ? 'gold' : '']);
1062       tiles.push(['Alcance', `${w.range} casillas`, '']);
1063     }
1064     tiles.push(['Velocidad', d.speed.toLocaleString('es-ES'), '']);
1065     let html = `<div class="coretiles unittiles">${tiles.map(([k, v, c]) => `<div class="ctile ${c}"><small>${k}</small><b>${v}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
1066     if (w) {
1067       const cls = ['inf', 'veh', 'ship', 'sub', 'air', 'bld'];
1068       const strong = cls.filter((c) => (w.mult[c] || 0) >= 1.2).map((c) => CAT_NAMES[c]);
1069       const weak = cls.filter((c) => w.mult[c] > 0 && w.mult[c] <= 0.5).map((c) => CAT_NAMES[c]);
1070       const none = cls.filter((c) => !(w.mult[c] > 0)).map((c) => CAT_NAMES[c]);
1071       const line = [];
1072       if (strong.length) line.push(`<span class="vs good">Fuerte contra: <b>${strong.join(', ')}</b></span>`);
1073       if (weak.length) line.push(`<span class="vs bad">Débil contra: <b>${weak.join(', ')}</b></span>`);
1074       if (none.length) line.push(`<span class="vs muted">No ataca a: <b>${none.join(', ')}</b></span>`);
1075       if (line.length) html += `<div class="vsline">${line.join('')}</div>`;
1076     }
1077     return html;

1131     if (isBuild) {
1132       // v1.0: tocar una casilla muestra la obra; «Construir» la pone; «Terminar» sale.
1133       const d = BUILDINGS[p.btype];
1134       const price = `<span class="cost">${fmt(d.cost)}</span>${d.energyCost ? ` <span class="ecost">${ICON.bolt}${d.energyCost}</span>` : ''}`;
1135       const placed = p.placed ? ` · <b>${p.placed}</b> ${p.placed === 1 ? 'puesta' : 'puestas'}` : '';
1136       if (p.err && p.cell >= 0) text = `<b>${esc(d.name)}</b> · <span class="err">${esc(p.err)}</span>${placed}`;
1137       else if (p.cell >= 0) text = `<b>${esc(d.name)}</b> · ${price} · Toca «Construir» para poner la obra aquí${placed}`;
1138       else if (p.valid && p.valid.size) text = `<b>${esc(d.name)}</b> · ${price} · Toca una casilla dorada y luego «Construir»${placed}`;
1139       else text = `No quedan casillas para ${esc(d.name)} en tu territorio${placed}. ${esc(d.desc)}`;
1140       $('btn-place-ok').disabled = p.cell < 0 || !!p.err;
1141       $('btn-place-rot').disabled = false;
1142     } else if (p.kind === 'found') {
1143       text = p.valid && p.valid.size
1144         ? 'Toca dónde fundar el <b>Puesto avanzado</b> · <span class="cost">800</span> al llegar'
1145         : 'No hay sitio alcanzable para fundar un puesto';
1146     } else if (p.kind === 'rally') {
1147       text = 'Toca el <b>punto de reunión</b> para las tropas nuevas';
1148     } else if (p.kind === 'mnuke') {
1149       text = p.valid && p.valid.size
1150         ? `Toca la zona del <b>misil del Lanzador nuclear móvil</b> (alcance ${STRATEGIC.range} casillas). Después te pide confirmar.`
1151         : 'No hay ninguna zona al alcance del lanzador: acércalo más.';
1152     } else if (p.kind === 'silo') {
1153       text = `Toca la zona del <b>DF-5C</b> (alcance ${NUKE.range} casillas). Después te pide confirmar.`;
1154     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke') {
1155       text = `Toca el blanco del <b>misil nuclear</b> · <span class="cost">${fmt(NUKE.cost)}</span> · llega en ${NUKE.flight} s${this.app.game.strategic ? ' · uso único: después te pide confirmar' : ''}`;
1156     } else if (p.kind === 'allyattack') {
1157       text = 'Toca un edificio, una tropa o el territorio del <b>rival</b> que quieres atacar con tus aliados';
1158     } else if (p.kind === 'bombzone') {
1159       text = `Toca la <b>zona a bombardear</b>: ${p.units.length} ${p.units.length === 1 ? 'Bombardero va' : 'Bombarderos van'} atacando los edificios que encuentren`;
1160     } else if (p.kind === 'nuke3') {
1161       text = `Toca el blanco de los <b>3 misiles nucleares</b> · <span class="cost">${fmt(NUKE.cost * 3)}</span> · llegan en ${NUKE.flight} s`;
1162     }

1191   refreshBuild(force) {
1192     const g = this.app.game;
1193     if (!g) return;
1194     const p = g.players[0];
1195     const placing = this.app.input.placement;
1196     const items = $('blist').querySelectorAll('[data-b]');
1197     let sig = '';
1198     const states = [];
1199     items.forEach((el) => {
1200       const k = el.dataset.b;
1201       const d = BUILDINGS[k];
1202       const n = g.count(0, k);
1203       const poor = p.coins < d.cost;
1204       const poorE = !!d.energyCost && p.energy < d.energyCost;
1205       const limit = g.limitFor(0, k);
1206       const maxed = limit && n >= limit;
1207       const act = placing && placing.kind === 'build' && placing.btype === k;
1208       // v1.6: el motivo, con el número exacto (cambia con las monedas y la energía).
1209       const why = maxed ? `Límite: ${n} de ${limit}` : poor ? `Faltan ${fmt(Math.ceil(d.cost - p.coins))} monedas` : poorE ? `Faltan ${fmt(Math.ceil(d.energyCost - p.energy))} de energía` : '';
1210       states.push([el, k, d, n, poor, maxed, act, poorE, limit, why]);
1211       sig += `${k}${n}${poor}${maxed}${act}${poorE}${limit}${why}|`;
1212     });
1213     if (!force && sig === this.buildSig) return;
1214     this.buildSig = sig;
1215     for (const [el, k, d, n, poor, maxed, act, poorE, limit, why] of states) {
1216       const w = el.querySelector('.why');
1217       if (w && w.textContent !== why) w.textContent = why;
1218       el.classList.toggle('poor', poor);
1219       el.classList.toggle('poorE', poorE);
1220       el.classList.toggle('maxed', !!maxed);
1221       el.classList.toggle('active', !!act);
1222       const cnt = el.querySelector(`[data-count="${k}"]`);
1223       if (cnt) cnt.textContent = limit ? ` (${n}/${limit})` : n ? ` (${n})` : '';
1224     }
1225   }

1227   // ---------- panel de selección ----------
1228   renderSel(force) {
1229     const app = this.app;
1230     const g = app.game;
1231     const panel = $('selpanel');
1232     const sel = app.selection.filter((e) => e.alive);
1233     if (!sel.length || app.input.placement) {
1234       panel.hidden = true;
1235       this.selSig = '';
1236       return;
1237     }
1238     const p = g.players[0];
1239     let sig = sel.map((e) => e.id).join(',');
1240     const first = sel[0];
1241     if (first.kind === 'point') {
1242       sig += `|${first.owner}|${first.contested}|${Math.round(first.prog * 20)}`;
1243     } else if (first.kind === 'bld') {
1244       sig += `|${first.built}|${first.queue.map((q) => q.type).join('.')}|${first.rally >= 0}|${this.demolishArm}|${first.level}` +
1245         `|${first.upgrading ? first.upgrading.level + ':' + Math.floor(first.upgrading.progress * 20) : ''}|${first.built ? '' : Math.floor(first.progress * 20)}` +
1246         `|${g.time - first.lastWork > 1.5}|${first.lastType || ''}|${first.loop ? 1 : 0}${first.loopWait || ''}` +
1247         // v1.8: investigación, puerta, guarnición y silo.
1248         `|${first.researching ? first.researching.key + Math.floor(first.researching.t) : ''}${first.type === 'research' ? JSON.stringify(p.research || {}) + (p.coins >= RESEARCH.armor.cost) : ''}` +
1249         `|${first.closed ? 'c' : ''}${first.cargo ? 'g' + first.cargo.length : ''}${first.type === 'silo' ? g.siloState(first) + Math.ceil(Math.max(0, (first.builtAt || 0) + STRATEGIC.prep - g.time)) : ''}`;
1250       if (first.def.produces) {
1251         sig += '|' + g.producesOf(first).map((t) => p.coins >= UNITS[t].cost && p.energy >= (UNITS[t].energy || 0)).join('') + (g.strategic ? 'q' + g.strategicLeft(0) : '');
1252       }
1253       const uc = g.upgradeCost(first);
1254       if (uc) sig += '|u' + (p.coins >= uc);
1255       if (first.type === 'airport') sig += '|p' + g.units.filter((u) => u.alive && u.owner === 0 && u.cls === 'air' && Math.hypot(u.x - first.x, u.z - first.z) < 4.5).map((u) => u.id + ':' + Math.floor((u.hp / u.maxHp) * 10)).join(',') + g.units.filter((u) => u.def.plane && u.owner === 0).length;
1256       if (first.type === 'aadef' || first.type === 'turret') sig += `|r${first.lockOn && first.lockOn.alive ? first.lockOn.id + (first.lockT > 0 ? 't' : 'l') : first.autoTarget && first.autoTarget.alive ? 'a' + first.autoTarget.id : '-'}`;
1257       if (first.type === 'aadef' || first.type === 'antinuke') sig += `|n${Math.ceil(Math.max(0, (first.nukeReadyAt || first.chargeAt || 0) - g.time))}${p.coins >= NUKE.cost}${first.type === 'aadef' && first.level >= 4 ? g.salvoInvalid(0) : ''}${g.strategic ? 'q' + g.strategicLeft(0) : ''}`;
1258       if (first.type === 'core' && first.owner === 0) {
1259         const d = p.dome;
1260         sig += `|d${d ? d.level + ':' + (d.hp > 0 ? Math.ceil((d.hp / d.maxHp) * 10) : 'x') : ''}${p.coins >= g.domeCost(0)}|e${p.emergencyUsed}${first.shieldUntil > g.time}`;
1261         if (first.level >= AUTO_UP.coreLevel) {
1262           const cand = g.upgradeCandidates(0);
1263           sig += `|a${p.autoUpgrade ? 1 : 0}:${cand.length}:${cand.filter((x) => g.upgradeCost(x) <= p.coins).length}`;
1264         }
1265       }
1266     } else {
1267       sig += '|' + sel.map((u) => u.state === 'found').join('') + (p.coins >= 800) +
1268         sel.map((u) => (u.cargo ? u.cargo.length : '')).join('') + `|${this.app.formation}|${this.app.input.amoveArm}` +
1269         `|${sel.map((u) => `${u.patrol ? 'p' : ''}${u.hold ? 'h' : ''}${u.vet || 0}:${u.kills || 0}`).join(',')}|${g.players[0].autoRepair !== false}` +
1270         // v1.7: estado del Lanzador nuclear móvil y pasajeros en camino.
1271         `|${sel.map((u) => (u.def.strategic ? g.mobileState(u) + Math.ceil(Math.max(0, (u.armAt || 0) - g.time)) : '') + (u.cargo ? 'b' + g.units.filter((x) => x.alive && !x.inside && x.boardTarget === u).length : '')).join('')}` +
1272         // v1.8: lanzapuentes y minador (cambia el motivo del botón).
1273         `|${sel.map((u) => (u.def.layBridge ? g.layBridgeInvalid(u) : u.def.layMine ? g.layMineInvalid(u) : '')).join('')}`;
1274       // Aviones (v1.0): estado, bombas y si el bombardero está oculto.
1275       for (const u of sel) if (u.def.plane) sig += `|${this.planeState(u)}${u.type === 'bomber' ? Math.ceil(Math.max(0, u.cd || 0)) + (g.time - (u.lastShot || -99) < 3 ? 'v' : 'o') : ''}`;
1276     }
1277     if (force || sig !== this.selSig) {
1278       this.selSig = sig;
1279       panel.hidden = false;
1280       panel.classList.toggle('more', !!this.selMore);
1281       if (first.kind === 'point') panel.innerHTML = this.pointHtml(first);
1282       else if (first.kind === 'bld') panel.innerHTML = this.buildingHtml(first);
1283       else if (first.owner === 0) panel.innerHTML = this.unitsHtml(sel);
1284       else panel.innerHTML = this.inspectHtml(first);
1285     }
1286     this.updateSelLive(sel);
1287   }

1308   orderOf(u) {
1309     const s = u.state;
1310     if (u.def.strategic && this.app.game.strategic && this.app.game.mobileState(u) === 'prep' && !u.moving) return 'preparando';
1311     if (s === 'move') return 'moviéndose';
1312     if (s === 'amove') return 'avanzando y atacando';
1313     if (s === 'attack') return 'atacando';
1314     if (s === 'patrol') return 'patrullando';
1315     if (s === 'build') return 'construyendo';
1316     if (s === 'repair') return 'reparando';
1317     if (s === 'board') return 'subiendo al transporte';
1318     if (s === 'found') return 'yendo a fundar un puesto';
1319     if (u.hold) return 'manteniendo posición';
1320     if (u.def.weapon && u.autoTarget && u.autoTarget.alive) return 'disparando a lo que tiene a tiro';
1321     return 'en espera';
1322   }

1324   orderText(sel) {
1325     const counts = new Map();
1326     for (const u of sel) {
1327       const o = this.orderOf(u);
1328       counts.set(o, (counts.get(o) || 0) + 1);
1329     }
1330     if (counts.size === 1) return [...counts.keys()][0];
1331     return [...counts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([o, n]) => `${n} ${o}`).join(' · ');
1332   }

1388   confirmStrategic() {

1395     this.closeStrategic();

1403     app.input.cancelPlacement();
1404     this.selSig = '';
