1407   buildingHtml(b) {
1408     const g = this.app.game;
1409     const own = b.owner === 0;
1410     const d = b.def;
1411     const extra = [];
1412     const inc = g.bIncome(b);
1413     if (inc) extra.push(`+${fmt(inc * g.incomeMult(g.players[b.owner]))} monedas/min`);
1414     if (g.bPop(b)) extra.push(`+${g.bPop(b)} de población`);
1415     if (d.energy) extra.push(`+${g.bEnergy(b)} energía cada 10 s`);
1416     if (d.healLevels) extra.push(`${d.healLevels[b.level].name}: cura ${Math.round(d.healLevels[b.level].pct * 100)} %/s`);
1417     if (d.minigun) extra.push(b.level > 1 ? `${b.level - 1} minigun${b.level > 2 ? 's' : ''}` : 'sin minigun');
1418     const sub = (own ? '' : `<b style="color:${hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner])}">${esc(g.players[b.owner].name)}</b> · `) +
1419       esc(d.desc) + (extra.length ? ' · ' + extra.join(' · ') : '');
1420     const maxLv = d.maxLevel;
1421     const lv = maxLv > 1
1422       ? ` <span class="lvtag">Nivel ${b.level}</span><span class="levels" title="Nivel ${b.level} de ${maxLv}">${Array.from({ length: maxLv }, (_, i) => `<i class="${i < b.level ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</span>` : '';
1423     const mkey = GLB[b.type + '_' + b.level] ? b.type + '_' + b.level : b.type;
1424     let html = this.head(mkey, PLAYER_COLORS[b.owner], esc(d.levelNames ? d.levelNames[b.level] : d.name) + lv, sub);
1425     if (!own) return html + (g.isEnemy(b.owner, 0) ? this.counterHtml(b) : '');
1426     // Obra o mejora en curso.
1427     if (!b.built || b.upgrading) {
1428       const k = b.upgrading ? b.upgrading.progress : b.progress;
1429       const idle = g.time - b.lastWork > 1.5 && b.type !== 'outpost';
1430       const by = d.builtBy === 'sea' ? 'un Barco constructor' : d.builtBy === 'engineer' ? 'un Ingeniero' : 'un Constructor o Ingeniero';
1431       html += `<div class="queue"><b>${b.upgrading ? `Mejorando a nivel ${b.upgrading.level}` : 'En construcción'}</b> · ${Math.floor(k * 100)} % · ` +
1432         (idle ? `<span style="color:#ffb4b5">Sin constructor: selecciona ${by} y toca la obra.</span>` : 'Un constructor está trabajando.') + '</div>';
1433     }
1434     if (b.type === 'core') {
1435       const p = g.players[0];
1436       const dome = p.dome;
1437       // v0.9: el estado del Núcleo en casillas claras.
1438       const L = d.levels[b.level];
1439       const emer = p.emergencyUsed
1440         ? (b.shieldUntil > g.time ? ['Activo', 'gold'] : ['Usado', 'muted']) : ['Listo', 'good'];
1441       const tiles = [
1442         ['Monedas', `+${fmt(g.bIncome(b) * g.incomeMult(p))}/min`, ''],
1443         ['Comunidad', `+${g.bPop(b)}`, ''],
1444         ['Láser', `${L.laser.beams > 1 ? '2 × ' : ''}${L.laser.dmg} · ${L.laser.range} cas.`, ''],
1445         ['Emergencia', emer[0], emer[1]],
1446         ['Cúpula', dome ? (dome.hp > 0 ? `Nivel ${dome.level} · ${Math.round((dome.hp / dome.maxHp) * 100)} %`
1447           : `Rota · ${Math.max(0, Math.ceil(DOME.recover - (g.time - dome.brokenAt)))} s`) : (b.level < 3 ? 'Núcleo nivel 3' : 'Disponible'),
1448         dome ? (dome.hp > 0 ? 'good' : 'bad') : 'muted'],
1449       ];
1450       html += `<div class="coretiles sec">${tiles.map(([k, v, c]) => `<div class="ctile ${c}"><small>${k}</small><b>${v}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
1451       if (dome && dome.level >= 3 && dome.hp > 0) html += '<div class="queue sec">La Cúpula nivel 3 da escudo a tus tropas mientras están dentro de ella.</div>';
1452       const derr = g.domeInvalid(0);
1453       // v1.0: con el Núcleo en nivel 3, mejorar todo de un clic o dejar las mejoras automáticas.
1454       if (b.level >= AUTO_UP.coreLevel) {
1455         const cand = g.upgradeCandidates(0);
1456         let total = 0;
1457         let can = 0;
1458         let left = p.coins;
1459         for (const x of cand) {
1460           const c = g.upgradeCost(x);
1461           total += c;
1462           if (c <= left) { left -= c; can++; }
1463         }
1464         const auto = !!p.autoUpgrade;
1465         html += `<div class="upall"><div class="actions">
1466           <button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="upall" id="btn-upall" ${can ? '' : 'disabled'}>${bi('upgrade')}Mejorar todo · ${can} de ${cand.length}</button>
1467           <button class="btn ${auto ? 'good' : ''}" type="button" data-act="autoup" id="btn-autoup" aria-pressed="${auto}">${bi('repeat')}Mejoras automáticas: ${auto ? 'sí' : 'no'}</button></div>
1468           <span class="queue sec">${cand.length ? `Quedan ${cand.length} mejoras (${fmt(total)} en total). «Mejorar todo» pone a mejorar las que alcanza tu dinero; las automáticas siguen hasta el máximo y guardan ${fmt(AUTO_UP.reserve)} para tropas.` : 'Todo está al máximo.'}</span></div>`;
1469       }
1470       if (!dome || dome.level < 3) {
1471         const next = dome ? dome.level + 1 : 1;
1472         const label = dome ? `Mejorar Cúpula a nivel ${next}` : 'Comprar Cúpula';
1473         const why = b.level < 3 ? 'Necesita el Núcleo en nivel 3.' : next === 3 ? 'Nivel 3: escudo personal para todas tus tropas.'
1474           : `Absorbe el daño de barcos, aeronaves y Lanzamisiles a ${DOME_LEVELS[next].range} casillas del Núcleo.`;
1475         html += `<div class="actions"><button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="dome" ${derr && b.level < 3 ? 'disabled' : ''}>${bi('dome')}${label} · ${fmt(g.domeCost(0))}</button>
1476           <span class="queue sec" style="flex:1 1 200px">${why}</span></div>`;
1477       }
1478     }
1479     if (d.produces && b.built) {
1480       const pl = g.players[0];
1481       html += '<div class="cards">' + g.producesOf(b).map((t) => {
1482         const u = UNITS[t];
1483         const poor = pl.coins < u.cost || pl.energy < (u.energy || 0);
1484         return `<button class="card ${poor ? 'poor' : ''}" type="button" data-act="train" data-type="${t}" title="${esc(u.desc)}">
1485           <img src="${Thumbs.get(t, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt="">
1486           <b>${esc(u.name)}</b>
1487           <div class="meta"><span class="cost">${fmt(u.cost)}</span>${u.energy ? `<span class="ecost">${ICON.bolt}${u.energy}</span>` : ''}<span>${ICON.pop}${u.pop}</span></div>
1488           <small class="why" data-why="${t}">${esc(this.trainWhy(pl, u))}</small>
1489         </button>`;
1490       }).join('') + '</div>';
1491       if (b.lastType && d.produces.includes(b.lastType)) {
1492         // Repetir (v0.7): vuelve a poner la última tropa entrenada, una o cinco veces.
1493         const lu = UNITS[b.lastType];
1494         html += `<div class="actions repeat"><span class="queue">Última: <b>${esc(lu.name)}</b></span>
1495           <button class="btn" type="button" data-act="repeat" data-n="1" id="btn-repeat">${bi('repeat')}Repetir · ${fmt(lu.cost)}</button>
1496           <button class="btn" type="button" data-act="repeat" data-n="5" id="btn-repeat5">${bi('repeat')}×5 · ${fmt(lu.cost * 5)}</button>
1497           <button class="btn ${b.loop ? 'good' : ''}" type="button" data-act="loop" id="btn-loop" aria-pressed="${!!b.loop}" title="Sigue entrenando la última tropa mientras alcance el dinero y la comunidad">${bi('repeat')}Siempre: ${b.loop ? 'sí' : 'no'}</button></div>`;
1498         if (b.loop && b.loopWait && !b.queue.length) html += `<div class="queue" id="loop-wait">Esperando: ${esc(b.loopWait)}</div>`;
1499       }
1500       const info = this.cardInfoType && d.produces.includes(this.cardInfoType) ? this.statsHtml(this.cardInfoType) : '';
1501       html += `<div class="cardinfo" id="cardinfo" ${info ? '' : 'hidden'}>${info}</div>`;
1502       // v1.5: la cola dice cuánto falta y cada tropa tiene su «×» para quitarla (devuelve el dinero).
1503       html += `<div class="queue ${b.queue.length ? '' : 'sec'}" id="sel-queue">` + (b.queue.length
1504         ? `<span class="qhead">En cola · <b id="sel-qtime">${this.queueTimeText(b)}</b></span><span class="qres" id="sel-qres">${esc(this.queueResText(b))}</span>` + b.queue.map((q, i) => `<button class="qitem" type="button" data-act="cancel" data-idx="${i}" title="Quitar ${esc(UNITS[q.type].name)} (te devuelve ${fmt(UNITS[q.type].cost)})" aria-label="Quitar ${esc(UNITS[q.type].name)}">
1505             <img src="${Thumbs.get(q.type, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt=""><i style="width:0"></i><span class="qx" aria-hidden="true">×</span></button>`).join('') +
1506           '<span class="qnote">Toca una para quitarla: te devuelve el dinero.</span>'
1507         : 'Toca una tropa para entrenarla; mantenla pulsada para ver su ficha.') + '</div>';
1508     }
1509     if (b.built && d.weapon && (b.type === 'aadef' || b.type === 'turret')) html += this.radarHtml(b);
1510     if (b.type === 'aadef' && b.built && b.level >= 4) {
1511       // Misil nuclear (v0.9): muy caro, recarga de 3 min.
1512       const why = g.nukeInvalid(b);
1513       const wait = g.time < (b.nukeReadyAt || 0);
1514       if (g.strategic) html += this.stratQuotaHtml();
1515       html += `<div class="actions nukebox"><button class="btn danger" type="button" data-act="nuke" id="btn-nuke" ${why ? 'disabled' : ''}>☢ Misil nuclear · ${fmt(NUKE.cost)}</button>
1516         <span class="queue" style="flex:1 1 200px">${wait ? `Recargando: ${Math.ceil(b.nukeReadyAt - g.time)} s` : why || `Listo. Daña todo en ${NUKE.radius} casillas y deja ${NUKE.rad.time} s de radiación; un Escudo antimisiles lo puede derribar.`}</span></div>`;
1517       // v1.0: los 3 a la vez (un Escudo antimisiles solo derriba uno por carga).
1518       const why3 = g.salvoInvalid(0);
1519       html += `<div class="actions nukebox"><button class="btn danger" type="button" data-act="nuke3" id="btn-nuke3" ${why3 ? 'disabled' : ''}>☢☢☢ Lanzar los 3 · ${fmt(NUKE.cost * 3)}</button>
1520         <span class="queue" style="flex:1 1 200px">${why3 || 'Tus 3 AIR DEFENSE de nivel 4 disparan juntos al mismo blanco: un Escudo antimisiles solo puede derribar uno.'}</span></div>`;
1521     } else if (b.type === 'aadef' && b.built) {
1522       html += `<div class="queue">Nivel 4 (solo 3 de tus AIR DEFENSE): lanza el misil nuclear.</div>`;
1523     }
1524     if (b.type === 'airport' && b.built) html += this.airportHtml(b);
1525     if (b.type === 'antinuke' && b.built) {
1526       const ready = g.time >= (b.chargeAt || 0);
1527       html += `<div class="queue">${ready ? '<b style="color:var(--good)">Carga lista</b>: derriba un misil nuclear que caiga a 7 casillas.' : `Recargando: ${Math.ceil(b.chargeAt - g.time)} s`}</div>`;
1528       html += `<div class="queue">Defensa de punto: derriba misiles y cohetes enemigos a ${b.def.pointDefense.range} casillas · derribados: <b>${b.pdKills || 0}</b></div>`;
1529     }
1530     if (b.built) html += this.extraBuildingHtml(b);
1531     const acts = [];
1532     if (own && b.built && !b.upgrading && b.level < maxLv) {
1533       // v0.9: antes de pagar, qué vas a ganar con la mejora.
1534       const prev = g.upgradePreview(b).map((t) => t.replace(/^Ahora es /, 'Pasa a ser '));
1535       if (prev.length) html += `<div class="nextup"><small>Nivel ${b.level} → ${d.levelNames ? esc(d.levelNames[b.level + 1]) : `nivel ${b.level + 1}`}</small>${prev.map((t) => `<span>${esc(t)}</span>`).join('')}</div>`;
1536     }
1537     if (b.built && !b.upgrading && b.level < maxLv) {
1538       const nextName = d.levelNames ? d.levelNames[b.level + 1] : `nivel ${b.level + 1}`;
1539       acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="upgrade">${bi('upgrade')}Mejorar a ${nextName} · ${fmt(g.upgradeCost(b))}</button>`);
1540     }
1541     if (d.produces && b.built) acts.push(`<button class="btn" type="button" data-act="rally">${bi('rally')}${b.rally >= 0 ? 'Mover punto de reunión' : 'Punto de reunión'}</button>`);
1542     if (b.type !== 'core') {
1543       acts.push(`<button class="btn danger" type="button" data-act="demolish">${bi('demolish')}${this.demolishArm === b.id ? '¿Seguro? Toca otra vez' : 'Demoler'}</button>`);
1544     }
1545     if (acts.length) html += `<div class="actions mainacts">${acts.join('')}</div>`;
1546     return html;
1547   }

1549   // v1.8: Centro de investigación, Puerta reforzada, Búnker de guarnición, Complejo estratégico y defensas nuevas.
1550   extraBuildingHtml(b) {
1551     const g = this.app.game;
1552     const p = g.players[0];
1553     const d = b.def;
1554     let html = '';
1555     if (b.type === 'research') {
1556       const r = b.researching;
1557       html += '<div class="research" id="research">' + Object.entries(RESEARCH).map(([k, R]) => {
1558         const done = p.research && p.research[k];
1559         const now = r && r.key === k;
1560         const why = done ? 'Lista' : now ? `${Math.floor((r.t / R.time) * 100)} %` : g.researchInvalid(b, k) || `${fmt(R.cost)} · ${R.time} s`;
1561         return `<button class="btn ${done ? 'good' : now ? 'gold' : ''}" type="button" data-act="research" data-v="${k}" ${done || now || g.researchInvalid(b, k) ? 'disabled' : ''}>
1562           <b>${esc(R.name)}</b><small>${esc(R.desc)}</small><em>${esc(why)}</em></button>`;
1563       }).join('') + '</div>';
1564     }
1565     if (b.type === 'gate') {
1566       html += `<div class="actions"><button class="btn ${b.closed ? 'danger' : 'good'}" type="button" data-act="gate" id="btn-gate">${b.closed ? 'Abrir puerta' : 'Cerrar puerta'}</button>
1567         <span class="queue" style="flex:1 1 200px">${b.closed ? 'Cerrada: no pasa nadie.' : 'Abierta: pasan tus tropas y las de tus aliados.'}</span></div>`;
1568     }
1569     if (d.garrison) {
1570       const n = b.cargo ? b.cargo.length : 0;
1571       html += `<div class="paxbox" id="paxbox"><div class="paxhead"><b>Guarnición</b><span id="pax-count">${n} / ${d.garrison} soldados · +${Math.round(n * d.garrisonDmg * 100)} % de daño</span></div>` +
1572         (n ? `<ul class="paxlist">${b.cargo.map((u) => `<li class="on"><img src="${Thumbs.get(u.type, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt=""><span>${esc(u.def.name)}</span><em>adentro</em></li>`).join('')}</ul>`
1573           : '<div class="queue">Selecciona soldados y toca el Búnker para que entren.</div>') + '</div>';
1574       if (n) html += `<div class="actions"><button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="unload">${bi('unload')}Sacar soldados</button></div>`;
1575     }
1576     if (b.type === 'silo' && g.strategic) {
1577       const st = g.siloState(b);
1578       const left = st === 'spent' || st === 'quota' ? 0 : 1;
1579       const secs = Math.ceil(Math.max(0, (b.builtAt || 0) + STRATEGIC.prep - g.time));
1580       const text = st === 'prep' ? `Preparando el DF-5C: faltan ${secs} s.` : st === 'ready' ? `DF-5C listo. Alcance: ${NUKE.range} casillas. Un Escudo antimisiles lo puede derribar.`
1581         : st === 'spent' ? 'Agotado: el silo ya lanzó su misil.' : 'Agotado: ya usaste tu único uso estratégico.';
1582       html += `<div class="stratbox ${left ? '' : 'spent'}" id="stratbox"><span class="lbl">Arsenal estratégico · DF-5C · uso único</span>
1583         <b class="stratnum" id="strat-num">${left} / ${STRATEGIC.uses}</b><span class="strattext" id="strat-text">${text}</span>
1584         <button class="btn danger" type="button" data-act="silo" id="btn-silo" ${st === 'ready' ? '' : 'disabled'}>${bi('strat')}Elegir zona</button></div>`;
1585     }
1586     const facts = [];
1587     if (d.detect) facts.push(`Descubre lo oculto a ${d.detect} casillas`);
1588     if (d.vision && d.vision >= 7) facts.push(`Ve ${d.vision} casillas`);
1589     if (d.pointDefense && b.type !== 'antinuke') facts.push(`Derribados: ${b.pdKills || 0}`);
1590     if (b.jam) facts.push(`<span style="color:#ffb4b5">Interferencia enemiga: dispara ${Math.round(b.jam * 100)} % más lento</span>`);
1591     if (facts.length) html += `<div class="queue">${facts.join(' · ')}</div>`;
1592     return html;
1593   }

1595   unitsHtml(sel) {
1596     const counts = new Map();
1597     for (const u of sel) counts.set(u.type, (counts.get(u.type) || 0) + 1);
1598     const first = sel[0];
1599     const stars = (u) => (u.vet ? ` <span class="vetstars" title="Veterana: ${u.kills} eliminaciones">${'★'.repeat(u.vet)}</span>` : '');
1600     const vets = sel.filter((u) => u.vet).length;
1601     const title = sel.length === 1 ? esc(first.def.name) + stars(first) : `${esc(this.groupName(sel))}${vets ? ` <span class="vetstars">★ ${vets}</span>` : ''}`;
1602     const sub = sel.length === 1 ? esc(first.def.desc) + (first.def.weapon ? ` · ${first.kills || 0} eliminaciones${first.vet < 3 ? ` (próxima estrella con ${VETERAN.kills[first.vet || 0]})` : ''}` : '') : `${sel.length} tropas elegidas. Toca un destino para moverlas o un enemigo para atacarlo.`;
1603     // v1.7: «Centrar» junto a «Quitar selección», y la orden actual siempre a la vista.
1604     let html = this.head(first.type, PLAYER_COLORS[0], title, sub).replace('<div class="headbtns">',
1605       `<div class="headbtns"><button class="btn icon" type="button" data-act="center" id="btn-center" aria-label="Centrar la cámara en la selección" title="Centrar">${bi('center')}</button>`);
1606     html += `<div class="queue selorder" id="sel-order">Orden actual: <b>${esc(this.orderText(sel))}</b></div>`;
1607     if (sel.length === 1) html += this.unitTilesHtml(first);
1608     if (sel.length === 1 && first.def.strategic) html += this.mobileHtml(first);
1609     if (counts.size > 1) {
1610       // v1.5: tocar un tipo deja elegidas solo esas tropas.
1611       html += '<div class="chips">' + [...counts.entries()].map(([t, n]) =>
1612         `<button class="chip" type="button" data-act="seltype" data-type="${t}" title="Elegir solo ${esc(UNITS[t].name)}"><img src="${Thumbs.get(t, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt="">${n}× ${esc(UNITS[t].name)}</button>`).join('') + '</div>';
1613     }
1614     const acts = [];
1615     // Transportes (Barcaza, Lancha, Jeep, Transporte blindado) y hangar del Portaaviones.
1616     const ship = sel.length === 1 && (first.def.capacity || first.def.hangar) ? first : null;
1617     if (ship) {
1618       const g = this.app.game;
1619       const hangar = !!ship.def.hangar;
1620       const cap = ship.def.capacity || ship.def.hangar;
1621       const how = hangar ? 'Selecciona Cazas y toca el Portaaviones para guardarlos.'
1622         : ship.def.carries === 'inf' ? `Selecciona soldados y toca el ${ship.def.name} para subirlos.`
1623           : `Selecciona tropas de tierra y toca la ${ship.def.name} para subirlas.`;
1624       // v1.7: lista de pasajeros con nombre, y los que vienen en camino.
1625       const coming = g.units.filter((x) => x.alive && !x.inside && x.boardTarget === ship);
1626       const pax = [...ship.cargo.map((u) => [u, 'a bordo']), ...coming.map((u) => [u, 'en camino'])];
1627       html += `<div class="paxbox" id="paxbox"><div class="paxhead"><b>${hangar ? 'Hangar' : 'Pasajeros'}</b><span id="pax-count">${g.cargoSlots(ship)} / ${cap} plazas${coming.length ? ` · ${coming.length} en camino` : ''}</span></div>` +
1628         (pax.length ? `<ul class="paxlist">${pax.map(([u, st]) => `<li class="${st === 'a bordo' ? 'on' : 'way'}"><img src="${Thumbs.get(u.type, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt=""><span>${esc(u.def.name)}</span><em>${st}</em></li>`).join('')}</ul>`
1629           : `<div class="queue">${how}</div>`) + '</div>';
1630       const label = hangar ? 'Lanzar Cazas' : ship.mover === 'sea' || ship.mover === 'amphib' ? 'Desembarcar' : ship.def.airlift && ship.def.plane ? 'Lanzar en paracaídas' : 'Bajar soldados';
1631       if (ship.cargo.length) acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="unload">${bi('unload')}${label}</button>`);
1632     }
1633     const planes = sel.filter((u) => u.def.plane);
1634     if (planes.length) {
1635       html += this.planeHtml(planes);
1636       if (planes.some((u) => u.type === 'bomber')) {
1637         acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="bombzone" id="btn-bombzone">${bi('amove')}Bombardear zona</button>`);
1638       }
1639     }
1640     if (sel.some((u) => u.def.builds)) {
1641       html += `<div class="queue">Construye solo las obras pendientes. Tócalo y luego una obra para mandarlo; toca un edificio dañado para repararlo.</div>`;
1642     }
1643     // v1.8: Vehículo lanzapuentes y Buque minador.
1644     const layer = sel.find((u) => u.def.layBridge);
1645     if (layer) {
1646       const why = this.app.game.layBridgeInvalid(layer);
1647       acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="laybridge" id="btn-laybridge" ${why ? 'disabled' : ''} title="${esc(why || 'Pone un Puente modular en el agua poco profunda de al lado')}">${bi('found')}Tender puente · ${fmt(BUILDINGS.bridge.cost)}</button>`);
1648       if (why) html += `<div class="queue">${esc(why)}</div>`;
1649     }
1650     const mlayer = sel.find((u) => u.def.layMine);
1651     if (mlayer) {
1652       const why = this.app.game.layMineInvalid(mlayer);
1653       acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="laymine" id="btn-laymine" ${why ? 'disabled' : ''}>${bi('found')}Sembrar mina · ${this.app.game.count(0, 'seamine')} / ${MINES.limit}</button>`);
1654       if (why) html += `<div class="queue">${esc(why)}</div>`;
1655     }
1656     const founder = sel.find((u) => u.def.founds);
1657     if (founder) {
1658       acts.push(`<button class="btn gold" type="button" data-act="found">${bi('found')}Fundar puesto · 800</button>`);
1659     }
1660     const app = this.app;
1661     if (sel.some((u) => u.def.weapon)) {
1662       const arm = app.input.amoveArm;
1663       acts.push(`<button class="btn ${arm === true ? 'gold' : ''}" type="button" data-act="amove" id="btn-amove" title="Avanzar atacando (F)">${bi('amove')}${arm === true ? 'Toca el destino…' : 'Avanzar atacando'}</button>`);
1664       // v1.4: patrullar y mantener posición.
1665       const patrolling = sel.some((u) => u.patrol);
1666       acts.push(`<button class="btn ${arm === 'patrol' || patrolling ? 'gold' : ''}" type="button" data-act="patrol" id="btn-patrol" title="Van y vuelven entre aquí y el punto que toques, peleando en el camino">${bi('patrol')}${arm === 'patrol' ? 'Toca el otro punto…' : patrolling ? 'Patrullando' : 'Patrullar'}</button>`);
1667       const holding = sel.filter((u) => u.def.weapon).every((u) => u.hold);
1668       acts.push(`<button class="btn ${holding ? 'gold' : ''}" type="button" data-act="hold" id="btn-hold" aria-pressed="${holding}" title="Se quedan quietas y solo disparan a lo que tienen a tiro">${bi('hold')}Mantener posición: ${holding ? 'sí' : 'no'}</button>`);
1669     }
1670     if (sel.some((u) => u.def.repairs)) {
1671       // v1.4: los Constructores e Ingenieros libres reparan solos lo dañado cerca.
1672       const on = this.app.game.players[0].autoRepair !== false;
1673       acts.push(`<button class="btn ${on ? 'good' : ''}" type="button" data-act="autorep" id="btn-autorep" aria-pressed="${on}" title="Los Constructores e Ingenieros sin trabajo reparan solos los edificios dañados a ${AUTO_REPAIR.range} casillas">${bi('wrench')}Reparación sola: ${on ? 'sí' : 'no'}</button>`);
1674     }
1675     if (sel.length > 1) {
1676       acts.push(`<button class="btn" type="button" data-act="formation" id="btn-formation" title="Bloque: juntas · Línea: una al lado de otra, de frente al destino">${bi('formation')}Formación: ${app.formation === 'line' ? 'línea' : 'bloque'}</button>`);
1677     }
1678     acts.push(`<button class="btn" type="button" data-act="stop">${bi('stop')}Detener</button>`);
1679     html += `<div class="actions mainacts">${acts.join('')}</div>`;
1680     html += `<div class="actions groupsave"><span class="queue">${bi('group')}Guardar en</span>${[1, 2, 3].map((n) =>
1681       `<button class="btn" type="button" data-act="savegrp" data-v="${n}" title="Guardar en el grupo ${n} (Ctrl o Mayús + ${n})">${n}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
1682     return html;
1683   }

1685   pointHtml(pt) {
1686     const g = this.app.game;
1687     const ownerTxt = pt.owner >= 0
1688       ? `<b style="color:${hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[pt.owner])}">${esc(g.players[pt.owner].name)}</b>` : 'Sin dueño';
1689     const state = pt.contested ? 'En disputa: hay tropas de varios equipos cerca'
1690       : pt.owner < 0 && pt.prog > 0 ? `Capturando… ${Math.floor(pt.prog * 100)} %`
1691         : `Para capturarlo: infantería a 1 casilla y sin enemigos a ${CAPTURE.clear} casillas durante ${CAPTURE.time} s.`;
1692     let html = this.head(pt.type, pt.owner >= 0 ? PLAYER_COLORS[pt.owner] : NEUTRAL, esc(pt.def.name),
1693       `${ownerTxt} · ${esc(pt.def.desc)}`, false);
1694     html += `<div class="queue">${state}</div>`;
1695     if (g.mode.king && pt.type === 'faro') {
1696       const parts = Object.entries(g.kingTime).map(([team, t]) => {
1697         const pid = g.players.findIndex((p) => String(p.team) === team);
1698         return `<b style="color:${hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[pid])}">${esc(g.players[pid].name)}</b> ${fmtTime(t)}`;
1699       });
1700       html += `<div class="queue">Rey del Faro (meta ${fmtTime(KING_TIME)}): ${parts.join(' · ') || 'nadie lo ha controlado aún'}</div>`;
1701     }
1702     return html;
1703   }

1705   inspectHtml(e) {

1713   // Ficha del enemigo (v0.8): vida, nivel, contra qué es fuerte y qué conviene usar contra él.
1714   counterHtml(e) {
1715     const g = this.app.game;
1716     const cls = e.kind === 'bld' ? 'bld' : e.cls;
1717     const w = e.kind === 'bld' ? g.weaponOf(e) : e.def.weapon;
1718     const rows = [`<span>Vida</span><b id="enemy-hp">${fmt(Math.max(0, e.hp))} / ${fmt(e.maxHp)} (${Math.round((Math.max(0, e.hp) / e.maxHp) * 100)} %)</b>`];
1719     if (e.kind === 'bld' && e.def.maxLevel > 1) rows.push(`<span>Nivel</span><b>${e.level} de ${e.def.maxLevel}</b>`);
1720     if (w && w.mult) {
1721       const strong = Object.entries(w.mult).filter(([k, v]) => v >= 1.2 && CAT_NAMES[k]).map(([k]) => CAT_NAMES[k]);
1722       const cant = Object.entries(w.mult).filter(([k, v]) => v === 0 && CAT_NAMES[k]).map(([k]) => CAT_NAMES[k]);
1723       rows.push(`<span>Fuerte contra</span><b>${strong.length ? strong.join(', ') : 'nada en especial'}</b>`);
1724       if (cant.length) rows.push(`<span>No ataca a</span><b>${cant.join(', ')}</b>`);
1725     } else {
1726       rows.push('<span>Ataque</span><b>no dispara</b>');
1727     }
1728     rows.push(`<span>Usa</span><b>${this.countersFor(cls).join(', ')}</b>`);
1729     return `<div class="cardinfo enemycard" id="enemycard">${rows.join('')}</div>`;
1730   }

1732   // Las 3 tropas que más daño hacen a esa clase por cada moneda (daño por segundo × multiplicador).
1733   countersFor(cls) {
1734     return Object.entries(UNITS)
1735       .filter(([, d]) => d.weapon && (d.weapon.mult[cls] || 0) > 0 && !d.limit)
1736       .map(([t, d]) => [t, ((d.weapon.dmg / d.weapon.cd) * d.weapon.mult[cls]) / Math.sqrt(d.cost)])
1737       .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 3).map(([t]) => UNITS[t].name);
1738   }

1740   updateSelLive(sel) {
1741     const ehp = $('enemy-hp');
1742     if (ehp && sel[0]) ehp.textContent = `${fmt(Math.max(0, sel[0].hp))} / ${fmt(sel[0].maxHp)} (${Math.round((Math.max(0, sel[0].hp) / sel[0].maxHp) * 100)} %)`;
1743     const hp = $('sel-hp');
1744     if (!hp || sel[0].kind === 'point') return;
1745     const first = sel[0];
1746     const bar = $('sel-hpbar');
1747     if (first.kind === 'bld' && !first.built) {
1748       bar.classList.add('build');
1749       hp.style.width = (first.progress * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
1750       $('sel-hptext').textContent = `Construyendo… ${Math.floor(first.progress * 100)}%`;
1751     } else {
1752       bar.classList.remove('build');
1753       let cur = 0;
1754       let max = 0;
1755       for (const e of sel) {
1756         cur += Math.max(0, e.hp);
1757         max += e.maxHp;
1758       }
1759       const k = max ? cur / max : 0;
1760       hp.style.width = (k * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
1761       hp.style.background = k > 0.55 ? 'var(--good)' : k > 0.28 ? '#f2c94c' : 'var(--bad)';
1762       $('sel-hptext').textContent = sel.length > 1 && first.kind === 'unit'
1763         ? `Vida del grupo · ${Math.round(k * 100)} % (${fmt(cur)} / ${fmt(max)})` : `${fmt(cur)} / ${fmt(max)}`;
1764     }
1765     // v1.7: orden actual y plazas reservadas, en vivo.
1766     const ord = $('sel-order');
1767     if (ord && first.kind === 'unit') {
1768       const t = this.orderText(sel);
1769       if (ord.dataset.t !== t) {
1770         ord.dataset.t = t;
1771         ord.innerHTML = `Orden actual: <b>${esc(t)}</b>`;
1772       }
1773     }
1774     const qres = $('sel-qres');
1775     if (qres && first.kind === 'bld') {
1776       const t = this.queueResText(first);
1777       if (qres.textContent !== t) qres.textContent = t;
1778     }
1779     // v1.6: el motivo de cada tarjeta de tropa se actualiza con las monedas, la energía y la comunidad.
1780     if (first.kind === 'bld' && first.owner === 0) {
1781       const pl = this.app.game.players[0];
1782       document.querySelectorAll('#selpanel .card[data-type]').forEach((c) => {
1783         const w = c.querySelector('.why');
1784         const t = this.trainWhy(pl, UNITS[c.dataset.type]);
1785         if (w && w.textContent !== t) w.textContent = t;
1786       });
1787     }
1788     if (first.kind === 'bld' && first.queue.length) {
1789       const q = first.queue[0];
1790       const bar0 = document.querySelector('#sel-queue .qitem i');
1791       if (bar0) bar0.style.width = Math.min(100, (q.t / UNITS[q.type].build) * 100) + '%';
1792       const qt = $('sel-qtime');
1793       if (qt) qt.textContent = this.queueTimeText(first);
1794     }
1795   }

1797   onSelClick(e) {
1798     const btn = e.target.closest('[data-act]');
1799     if (!btn) return;
1800     const app = this.app;
1801     const g = app.game;
1802     const sel = app.selection.filter((x) => x.alive);
1803     const act = btn.dataset.act;
1804     if (act === 'train' && this.suppressClick) {
1805       this.suppressClick = false;
1806       return;
1807     }
1808     app.sound.play('click');
1809     if (act === 'seldetails') {
1810       // v1.3: las partes largas del panel se pliegan; este botón las muestra u oculta.
1811       this.selMore = !this.selMore;
1812       this.renderSel(true);
1813       return;
1814     }
1815     if (act === 'close') {
1816       app.setSelection([]);
1817       return;
1818     }
1819     if (!sel.length) return;
1820     const b = sel[0];
1821     if (act === 'train') {
1822       const err = g.enqueue(b, btn.dataset.type);
1823       if (err) {
1824         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1825         app.sound.play('error');
1826       }
1827       this.renderSel(true);
1828     } else if (act === 'seltype') {
1829       const keep = this.app.selection.filter((e) => e.kind === 'unit' && e.type === btn.dataset.type);
1830       if (keep.length) this.app.setSelection(keep);
1831     } else if (act === 'cancel') {
1832       g.cancelQueue(b, Number(btn.dataset.idx));
1833       this.renderSel(true);
1834     } else if (act === 'rally') {
1835       app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'rally', building: b });
1836     } else if (act === 'demolish') {
1837       this.demolishSelected();
1838     } else if (act === 'found') {
1839       const u = sel.find((x) => x.def.founds);
1840       if (u) {
1841         app.setSelection([u]);
1842         app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'found', unit: u });
1843       }
1844     } else if (act === 'upgrade') {
1845       const res = g.upgrade(b);
1846       if (typeof res === 'string') {
1847         this.toast(res, 'bad');
1848         app.sound.play('error');
1849       } else {
1850         app.setSelection([res]);
1851         this.toast(`Mejora de ${res.def.name} pagada: un constructor la hará`, 'good');
1852       }
1853     } else if (act === 'upall') {
1854       const res = g.upgradeAll(0);
1855       if (typeof res === 'string') {
1856         this.toast(res, 'bad');
1857         app.sound.play('error');
1858       } else if (!res.n) {
1859         this.toast('No alcanza el dinero para ninguna mejora', 'bad');
1860         app.sound.play('error');
1861       } else {
1862         this.toast(`Mejorando ${res.n} ${res.n === 1 ? 'edificio' : 'edificios'} (−${fmt(res.spent)}): tus constructores van a cada obra`, 'good');
1863       }
1864       this.renderSel(true);
1865     } else if (act === 'autoup') {
1866       const pl = g.players[0];
1867       pl.autoUpgrade = !pl.autoUpgrade;
1868       this.toast(pl.autoUpgrade ? 'Mejoras automáticas encendidas: se mejora solo hasta el máximo' : 'Mejoras automáticas apagadas', pl.autoUpgrade ? 'good' : 'info');
1869       this.renderSel(true);
1870     } else if (act === 'dome') {
1871       const err = g.buyDome(0);
1872       if (err) {
1873         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1874         app.sound.play('error');
1875       } else {
1876         this.toast(`Cúpula nivel ${g.players[0].dome.level}`, 'good');
1877       }
1878       this.renderSel(true);
1879     } else if (act === 'unload') {
1880       const res = g.unload(b);
1881       if (typeof res === 'string') {
1882         this.toast(res, 'bad');
1883         app.sound.play('error');
1884       } else {
1885         app.setSelection(res);
1886       }
1887     } else if (act === 'research') {
1888       const err = g.startResearch(b, btn.dataset.v);
1889       if (err) {
1890         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1891         app.sound.play('error');
1892       } else this.toast(`Investigando: ${RESEARCH[btn.dataset.v].name}`, 'good');
1893       this.renderSel(true);
1894     } else if (act === 'gate') {
1895       g.toggleGate(b);
1896       app.sound.play('click');
1897       this.renderSel(true);
1898     } else if (act === 'silo') {
1899       const err = g.siloInvalid(b);
1900       if (err) {
1901         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1902         app.sound.play('error');
1903       } else app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'silo', building: b });
1904     } else if (act === 'laybridge' || act === 'laymine') {
1905       const u = sel.find((x) => x.kind === 'unit' && (act === 'laybridge' ? x.def.layBridge : x.def.layMine));
1906       const res = act === 'laybridge' ? g.layBridge(u) : g.layMine(u);
1907       if (typeof res === 'string') {
1908         this.toast(res, 'bad');
1909         app.sound.play('error');
1910       } else this.toast(act === 'laybridge' ? 'Tendiendo el puente…' : 'Mina sembrada (solo tú la ves)', 'good');
1911       this.renderSel(true);
1912     } else if (act === 'stop') {
1913       g.orderStop(sel.filter((x) => x.kind === 'unit'));
1914     } else if (act === 'center') {
1915       const us = sel.filter((x) => x.kind === 'unit');
1916       if (us.length) app.focusAt(us.reduce((s, x) => s + x.x, 0) / us.length, us.reduce((s, x) => s + x.z, 0) / us.length);
1917     } else if (act === 'mnuke') {
1918       const err = g.mobileNukeInvalid(b);
1919       if (err) {
1920         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1921         app.sound.play('error');
1922       } else {
1923         app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'mnuke', unit: b });
1924       }
1925     } else if (act === 'nuke') {
1926       const err = g.nukeInvalid(b);
1927       if (err) {
1928         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1929         app.sound.play('error');
1930       } else {
1931         app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'nuke', building: b });
1932       }
1933     } else if (act === 'bombzone') {
1934       const bombers = sel.filter((x) => x.kind === 'unit' && x.type === 'bomber');
1935       if (bombers.length) app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'bombzone', units: bombers });
1936     } else if (act === 'nuke3') {
1937       const err = g.salvoInvalid(0);
1938       if (err) {
1939         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1940         app.sound.play('error');
1941       } else {
1942         app.input.startPlacement({ kind: 'nuke3', building: b });
1943       }
1944     } else if (act === 'repeat') {
1945       const n = Number(btn.dataset.n) || 1;
1946       let added = 0;
1947       let err = null;
1948       for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
1949         err = g.enqueue(b, b.lastType);
1950         if (err) break;
1951         added++;
1952       }
1953       if (!added) {
1954         this.toast(err, 'bad');
1955         app.sound.play('error');
1956       } else if (added < n) {
1957         this.toast(`${added} en cola · ${err}`, 'bad');
1958       }
1959       this.renderSel(true);
1960     } else if (act === 'amove') {
1961       if (app.input.amoveArm === true) app.input.disarmAttackMove();
1962       else app.input.armAttackMove();
1963       this.renderSel(true);
1964     } else if (act === 'patrol') {
1965       const us = sel.filter((x) => x.kind === 'unit' && x.def.weapon);
1966       if (app.input.amoveArm === 'patrol') app.input.disarmAttackMove();
1967       else if (us.some((u) => u.patrol)) { g.orderStop(us); this.toast('Dejaron de patrullar'); }
1968       else app.input.armAttackMove('patrol');
1969       this.renderSel(true);
1970     } else if (act === 'hold') {
1971       const us = sel.filter((x) => x.kind === 'unit' && x.def.weapon);
1972       const on = !us.every((u) => u.hold);
1973       g.setHold(us, on);
1974       this.toast(on ? 'Mantienen la posición: solo disparan a lo que tienen a tiro' : 'Vuelven a perseguir a los enemigos cercanos');
1975       this.renderSel(true);
1976     } else if (act === 'autorep') {
1977       const p = g.players[0];
1978       p.autoRepair = p.autoRepair === false;
1979       this.toast(p.autoRepair ? 'Los constructores libres repararán solos' : 'Reparación sola apagada');
1980       this.renderSel(true);
1981     } else if (act === 'loop') {
1982       b.loop = !b.loop;
1983       b.loopT = 0;
1984       if (b.loop) this.toast(`${b.def.name}: sigue entrenando ${UNITS[b.lastType].name} mientras alcance el dinero`, 'good');
1985       this.renderSel(true);
1986     } else if (act === 'formation') {
1987       app.toggleFormation();
1988       this.renderSel(true);
1989     } else if (act === 'savegrp') {
1990       app.saveGroup(Number(btn.dataset.v));
1991     }
1992   }

1995   // Tus edificios que entrenan, con su cola y su progreso. Los parados (sin cola) en amarillo.
1996   renderProd() {
1997     const app = this.app;
1998     const g = app.game;
1999     const el = $('prodbar');
2000     if (!g) return;
2001     const order = { core: 0, barracks: 1, factory: 2, harbor: 3, helipad: 4 };
2002     const list = g.buildings.filter((b) => b.alive && b.owner === 0 && b.built && b.def.produces)
2003       .sort((a, b) => order[a.type] - order[b.type] || a.id - b.id);
2004     const sig = list.map((b) => `${b.id}:${b.queue.length}:${b.queue[0] ? b.queue[0].type : ''}`).join(',');
2005     el.hidden = list.length < 2;
2006     document.body.classList.toggle('has-prod', !el.hidden);
2007     if (el.hidden) return;
2008     if (sig !== this.prodSig) {
2009       this.prodSig = sig;
2010       el.innerHTML = '<span class="lbl">Producción</span>' + list.map((b) => {
2011         const idle = !b.queue.length && b.type !== 'core';
2012         const q = b.queue[0];
2013         const tip = `${b.def.name}: ${q ? `entrenando ${UNITS[q.type].name}${b.queue.length > 1 ? ` (+${b.queue.length - 1})` : ''}` : 'parado'}`;
2014         return `<button class="pitem ${idle ? 'idle' : ''}" type="button" data-prod="${b.id}" title="${esc(tip)}" aria-label="${esc(tip)}">
2015           <img src="${Thumbs.get(q ? q.type : b.type, PLAYER_COLORS[0])}" alt="">${b.queue.length ? `<em>${b.queue.length}</em>` : ''}<i><s data-pbar="${b.id}"></s></i></button>`;
2016       }).join('');
2017     }
2018     for (const b of list) {
2019       const bar = el.querySelector(`[data-pbar="${b.id}"]`);
2020       const q = b.queue[0];
2021       if (bar) bar.style.width = q ? Math.min(100, (q.t / UNITS[q.type].build) * 100) + '%' : '0';
2022     }
2023   }

2025   // ---------- v0.8: avisos en el borde ----------
2026   // Si atacan algo tuyo fuera de la pantalla, una flecha en el borde apunta hacia allá.
2027   addEdgeAlert(text, x, z) {
2028     const now = performance.now();
2029     let label = text.replace(/^Atacan tu /, '').replace(/^Perdiste: /, 'Perdiste ').replace(/^Perdiste /, 'Perdiste ');
2030     if (/Núcleo/.test(text)) label = 'Núcleo';
2031     else if (/tropas/i.test(text)) label = 'Tropas';
2032     if (label.length > 18) label = label.slice(0, 17) + '…';
2033     const near = this.edgeAlerts.find((a) => Math.hypot(a.x - x, a.z - z) < 5);
2034     if (near) {
2035       near.until = now + 8000;
2036       near.label = label;
2037       near.x = x;
2038       near.z = z;
2039       if (near.el) near.el.querySelector('span').textContent = label;
2040       return;
2041     }
2042     this.edgeAlerts.push({ x, z, label, until: now + 8000, el: null });
2043     if (this.edgeAlerts.length > 4) {
2044       const old = this.edgeAlerts.shift();
2045       if (old.el) old.el.remove();
2046     }
2047   }
2048 
2049   updateEdges() {
2050     const r = this.app.renderer;
2051     if (!r) return;
2052     const now = performance.now();
2053     const box = $('edges');
2054     for (const a of this.edgeAlerts) {
2055       if (a.until > now) continue;
2056       if (a.el) a.el.remove();
2057       a.el = null;
2058     }
2059     this.edgeAlerts = this.edgeAlerts.filter((a) => a.until > now);
2060     const W = r.width;
2061     const H = r.height;
2062     const m = 34;
2063     for (const a of this.edgeAlerts) {
2064       if (!a.el) {
2065         a.el = document.createElement('button');
2066         a.el.type = 'button';
2067         a.el.className = 'edge';
2068         a.el.innerHTML = `<i>${ICON.arrow}</i><span></span>`;
2069         a.el.querySelector('span').textContent = a.label;
2070         a.el.addEventListener('click', () => {
2071           this.app.focusAt(a.x, a.z);
2072           a.until = 0;
2073         });
2074         box.appendChild(a.el);
2075       }
2076       const s = r.project(a.x, 0.3, a.z);
2077       const inside = s.ok && s.x > m && s.x < W - m && s.y > 70 && s.y < H - m;
2078       a.el.hidden = inside;
2079       if (inside) continue;
2080       let dx = s.x - W / 2;
2081       let dy = s.y - H / 2;
2082       if (!s.ok) { dx = -dx; dy = -dy; }
2083       const ang = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
2084       const hw = W / 2 - m - 40;
2085       const hh = H / 2 - m - 40;
2086       const c = Math.cos(ang);
2087       const sn = Math.sin(ang);
2088       const t = Math.min(Math.abs(c) > 1e-6 ? hw / Math.abs(c) : 1e9, Math.abs(sn) > 1e-6 ? hh / Math.abs(sn) : 1e9);
2089       a.el.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(W / 2 + c * t)}px, ${Math.round(H / 2 + sn * t)}px) translate(-50%, -50%)`;
2090       a.el.querySelector('i').style.transform = `rotate(${ang}rad)`;
2091     }
2092   }

2094   // Botones de grupo y de Constructores junto al minimapa: cuántas tropas tiene cada uno.
2095   renderGroups(force) {
2096     const app = this.app;
2097     const g = app.game;
2098     if (!g) return;
2099     const counts = [1, 2, 3].map((n) => app.groupUnits(n).length);
2100     const builders = g.units.filter((u) => u.owner === 0 && u.alive && u.def.builds === 'land');
2101     const idle = builders.filter((u) => u.state === 'idle' && !u.inside).length;
2102     const sig = counts.join(',') + '|' + idle + '/' + builders.length;
2103     if (!force && sig === this.groupsSig) return;
2104     this.groupsSig = sig;
2105     counts.forEach((k, i) => {
2106       const el = $('grp' + (i + 1));
2107       el.textContent = k ? String(k) : '—';
2108       el.parentElement.classList.toggle('has', k > 0);
2109     });
2110     $('bld-idle').textContent = builders.length ? `${idle}/${builders.length}` : '0';
2111     $('btn-builders').classList.toggle('alert', idle > 0);
2112   }

2114   demolishSelected() {
2115     const app = this.app;
2116     const b = app.selection[0];
2117     if (!b || b.kind !== 'bld' || b.owner !== 0 || b.type === 'core') return;
2118     if (this.demolishArm === b.id) {
2119       app.game.demolish(b);
2120       this.demolishArm = -1;
2121       app.setSelection([]);

2135   // ---------- barra superior ----------
2136   updateTop() {

2139     $('coins').textContent = fmt(p.coins);
2140     $('income').textContent = `+${fmt(p.income)}/min`;
2141     $('income2').textContent = `+${fmt(p.income)}/min`;
2142     $('pop').textContent = `${p.popUsed}/${p.popCap}`;

2144     $('energyRate').textContent = `+${p.energyRate}/10 s`;
2145     if (g.mode.king) {
2146       const faro = g.points.find((pt) => pt.type === 'faro');
2147       const ownerTeam = faro && faro.owner >= 0 ? g.players[faro.owner].team : -1;
2148       const myT = g.kingTime[p.team] || 0;
2149       let best = -1;
2150       let bestT = 0;
2151       for (const [team, t] of Object.entries(g.kingTime)) {
2152         if (Number(team) !== p.team && t > bestT) { bestT = t; best = Number(team); }
2153       }
2154       const rival = best >= 0 ? g.players.findIndex((pl) => pl.team === best) : -1;
2155       const bar = (t, color) => `<span class="bar"><i style="width:${Math.min(100, (t / KING_TIME) * 100)}%;background:${color}"></i></span>`;
2156       $('king').innerHTML = `Faro: ${ownerTeam < 0 ? 'libre' : esc(g.players[faro.owner].name)} · Tú ${bar(myT, hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[0]))}` +
2157         (rival >= 0 ? ` ${esc(g.players[rival].name)} ${bar(bestT, hexColor(PLAYER_COLORS[rival]))}` : '');
2158     }
2159     $('stat-pop').classList.toggle('full', p.popUsed >= p.popCap);
2160     $('clock').textContent = fmtTime(g.time);
2161     // v1.3: también cambia con las alianzas (equipos), no solo cuando alguien cae.
2162     const sig = g.players.map((pl) => `${pl.alive}:${pl.team}`).join(',');
2163     if (sig !== this.playersSig) {
2164       this.playersSig = sig;
2165       const myTeam = p.team;
2166       $('players').innerHTML = g.players.map((pl) => {
2167         const tag = pl.id === 0 ? '' : pl.team === myTeam ? '<em>aliado</em>' : '';
2168         const style = pl.human ? '' : ` · ${PERSONALITIES[pl.persona].name}`;
2169         return `<div class="pchip ${pl.alive ? '' : 'dead'}" title="${esc(pl.name + style)}"><i style="background:${hexColor(pl.color)}"></i><span>${esc(pl.name)}</span>${tag}</div>`;
2170       }).join('');

2209   // Gráficas del final: línea vertical y valores del momento al pasar el dedo o el ratón.
2210   bindHistory(g) {
2211     const H = g.history || [];
2212     document.querySelectorAll('#enddialog .histchart').forEach((fig) => {
2213       const key = fig.dataset.key;
2214       const svg = fig.querySelector('svg');
2215       const tip = fig.querySelector('.histtip');
2216       const cross = fig.querySelector('.hcross');
2217       const vb = svg.viewBox.baseVal;
2218       const L = 40;
2219       const R = 64;
2220       const tMax = Math.max(H[H.length - 1].t, 1);
2221       const show = (ev) => {
2222         const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
2223         const sx = ((ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * vb.width;
2224         const t = clamp((sx - L) / (vb.width - L - R), 0, 1) * tMax;
2225         let best = H[0];
2226         for (const h of H) if (Math.abs(h.t - t) < Math.abs(best.t - t)) best = h;
2227         const cx = L + (best.t / tMax) * (vb.width - L - R);
2228         cross.setAttribute('x1', cx);
2229         cross.setAttribute('x2', cx);
2230         cross.setAttribute('visibility', 'visible');
2231         const rows = g.players.map((p) => ({ p, v: best[key][p.id] })).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v);
2232         tip.innerHTML = `<b>${fmtTime(best.t)}</b>` + rows.map((x) => `<span><i style="background:${cssColor(x.p.color)}"></i>${esc(x.p.name)}<em>${fmt(x.v)}</em></span>`).join('');
2233         tip.hidden = false;
2234         const px = (cx / vb.width) * r.width;
2235         tip.style.left = `${Math.min(r.width - 150, Math.max(0, px + 10))}px`;
2236       };
2237       const hide = () => { tip.hidden = true; cross.setAttribute('visibility', 'hidden'); };
2238       svg.addEventListener('pointermove', show);
2239       svg.addEventListener('pointerdown', show);
2240       svg.addEventListener('pointerleave', hide);
2241     });
2242   }
2243 }

2245 // Sonido sintetizado con Web Audio (sin archivos externos).
2246 class Sound {
2247   constructor() {
2248     this.ctx = null;
2249     this.on = true;
2250     this.last = {};
2251     try {
2252       this.on = localStorage.getItem('faro-sound') !== 'off';
2253     } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
2254   }
2255 
2256   unlock() {
2257     if (!this.ctx) {
2258       try {
2259         const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
2260         if (AC) {
2261           this.ctx = new AC();
2262           const len = this.ctx.sampleRate;
2263           this.noise = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, len, this.ctx.sampleRate);
2264           const d = this.noise.getChannelData(0);
2265           for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
2266           this.master = this.ctx.createGain();
2267           this.master.gain.value = 0.6;
2268           this.master.connect(this.ctx.destination);
2269         }
2270       } catch (err) {
2271         this.ctx = null;
2272       }
2273     }
2274     if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
2275     if (this.ctx && !this.unlocked) {
2276       this.unlocked = true;
2277       if (this.onUnlock && this.on) this.onUnlock();
2278     }
2279   }
2280 
2281   toggle() {
2282     this.on = !this.on;
2283     try {
2284       localStorage.setItem('faro-sound', this.on ? 'on' : 'off');
2285     } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
2286     if (this.on) this.unlock();
2287     if (this.onToggle) this.onToggle();
2288   }
2289 
2290   // Límite de voces: si ya suenan muchas, los sonidos nuevos menos importantes se saltan.
2291   voice(dur) {
2292     const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
2293     this.ends = (this.ends || []).filter((t) => t > now);
2294     if (this.ends.length >= 24) return false;
2295     this.ends.push(now + dur);
2296     this.voices = (this.voices || 0) + 1;
2297     return true;
2298   }
2299 
2300   tone(freq, dur, type = 'sine', vol = 0.08, slide = 0, delay = 0) {
2301     const c = this.ctx;
2302     const t0 = c.currentTime + delay;
2303     const o = c.createOscillator();
2304     const g = c.createGain();
2305     o.type = type;
2306     o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
2307     if (slide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, freq + slide), t0 + dur);
2308     g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
2309     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
2310     o.connect(g);
2311     g.connect(this.master);
2312     o.start(t0);
2313     o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
2314   }
2315 
2316   // Ruido filtrado; sweep cambia la frecuencia del filtro durante el sonido (zumbido de misil).
2317   burst(dur, filterType, freq, vol, delay = 0, sweep = 0, q = 0.8) {
2318     const c = this.ctx;
2319     const t0 = c.currentTime + delay;
2320     const src = c.createBufferSource();
2321     src.buffer = this.noise;
2322     const f = c.createBiquadFilter();
2323     f.type = filterType;
2324     f.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
2325     if (sweep) f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(40, freq + sweep), t0 + dur);
2326     f.Q.value = q;
2327     const g = c.createGain();
2328     g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
2329     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0 + Math.min(0.012, dur * 0.2));
2330     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
2331     src.connect(f);
2332     f.connect(g);
2333     g.connect(this.master);
2334     src.start(t0, Math.random() * 0.5);
2335     src.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
2336   }
2337 
2338   play(name, vol = 1) {
2339     if (!this.on || !this.ctx || this.ctx.state !== 'running') return;
2340     const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
2341     const gap = { bullet: 0.07, minigun: 0.05, flak: 0.08, bolt: 0.12, laser: 0.14, hit: 0.08, boom: 0.09, bigboom: 0.25,
2342       rocket: 0.1, missile: 0.2, shell: 0.12, torpedo: 0.2, build: 0.22, heal: 0.4 }[name] || 0.04;
2343     if (this.last[name] && now - this.last[name] < gap) return;
2344     const ui = ['click', 'order', 'place', 'done', 'ready', 'error', 'alarm', 'capture'].includes(name);
2345     if (!ui && !this.voice(0.4)) return;
2346     this.last[name] = now;
2347     const v = vol;
2348     switch (name) {
2349       case 'bullet': this.burst(0.06, 'highpass', 2400, 0.06 * v); this.tone(180, 0.04, 'square', 0.02 * v, -80); break;
2350       case 'minigun':
2351         for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.burst(0.03, 'bandpass', 2600 + i * 120, 0.045 * v, i * 0.028, 0, 2);
2352         break;
2353       case 'flak': this.burst(0.09, 'bandpass', 1400, 0.07 * v); this.tone(240, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.03 * v, -120); break;
2354       case 'bolt': this.tone(520, 0.12, 'sawtooth', 0.04 * v, -300); break;
2355       case 'laser':
2356         this.tone(1500, 0.16, 'sawtooth', 0.025 * v, -1100);
2357         this.tone(760, 0.18, 'square', 0.018 * v, -500);
2358         this.burst(0.1, 'highpass', 5000, 0.02 * v);
2359         break;
2360       case 'rocket': this.burst(0.22, 'bandpass', 700, 0.07 * v, 0, 900, 1.2); this.tone(130, 0.12, 'sine', 0.05 * v, -50); break;
2361       case 'missile': this.burst(0.5, 'bandpass', 500, 0.07 * v, 0, 1400, 1.5); this.tone(90, 0.25, 'sine', 0.06 * v, -40); break;
2362       case 'shell':
2363         this.tone(110, 0.22, 'sine', 0.15 * v, -70);
2364         this.burst(0.1, 'lowpass', 1100, 0.07 * v);
2365         this.burst(0.35, 'lowpass', 300, 0.04 * v, 0.05);
2366         break;
2367       case 'torpedo': this.burst(0.35, 'lowpass', 420, 0.06 * v, 0, -200); break;
2368       case 'hit': this.burst(0.08, 'bandpass', 600, 0.05 * v); break;
2369       case 'boom':
2370         this.burst(0.55, 'lowpass', 520, 0.24 * v);
2371         this.tone(70, 0.4, 'sine', 0.12 * v, -40);
2372         this.burst(0.25, 'bandpass', 1800, 0.03 * v, 0.08, 0, 1.5);
2373         break;
2374       case 'bigboom':
2375         this.burst(1.1, 'lowpass', 380, 0.3 * v);
2376         this.tone(52, 0.9, 'sine', 0.18 * v, -22);
2377         this.burst(0.6, 'bandpass', 1500, 0.04 * v, 0.12, -900, 1.2);
2378         this.burst(0.4, 'lowpass', 900, 0.08 * v, 0.3);
2379         break;
2380       case 'build': this.tone(900 + Math.random() * 140, 0.05, 'triangle', 0.035 * v, -300); this.burst(0.04, 'highpass', 3000, 0.02 * v); break;
2381       case 'heal': this.tone(660, 0.2, 'sine', 0.025 * v); this.tone(990, 0.25, 'sine', 0.02 * v, 0, 0.08); break;
2382       case 'capture':
2383         [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => this.tone(f, 0.18, 'triangle', 0.05, 0, i * 0.09));
2384         break;
2385       case 'click': this.tone(880, 0.04, 'triangle', 0.04); break;
2386       case 'order': this.tone(520, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.05, 180); break;
2387       case 'place': this.tone(300, 0.12, 'triangle', 0.07, 140); this.burst(0.06, 'lowpass', 900, 0.04); break;
2388       case 'done': this.tone(660, 0.12, 'triangle', 0.06); this.tone(990, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.06, 0, 0.1); break;
2389       case 'ready': this.tone(740, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.045); break;
2390       case 'error': this.tone(200, 0.14, 'square', 0.04, -40); break;
2391       case 'alarm': this.tone(560, 0.15, 'square', 0.04); this.tone(420, 0.15, 'square', 0.04, 0, 0.18); break;
2392       default: break;
2393     }
2394   }
2395 }

 117   const out = [];
 118   for (const [k, d] of Object.entries(UNITS)) {
 119     // v1.8: aire separado en drones, helicópteros y aviación (los drones de mar también están en «Drones»).

 123     out.push({ key: k, kind: 'unit', def: d, fam, also });

 126     if (k === 'seamine') continue;
 127     out.push({ key: k, kind: 'bld', def: d, fam: 'bld', also: k === 'antinuke' || k === 'aadef' || k === 'silo' ? ['strat'] : [] });
 128   }
 129   return out;

 163 function mapThumb(kind, players = 6) {
 164   const key = kind + ':' + players;
 165   if (MAP_THUMBS[key]) return MAP_THUMBS[key];
 166   let url = '';
 167   try {
 168     const m = new GameMap(4321, kind, players, false);
 169     const S = 132;
 170     const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
 171     cv.width = S;
 172     cv.height = S;
 173     const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
 174     ctx.fillStyle = '#' + terrainColor(kind, 'deep').toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
 175     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
 176     const ext = Math.max(...m.cells.map((c) => Math.max(Math.abs(c.x), Math.abs(c.z)))) + 1;
 177     const k = (S / 2 - 3) / ext;
 178     for (const c of m.cells) {
 179       if (c.t === 'deep') continue;
 180       ctx.fillStyle = '#' + terrainColor(kind, c.t).toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
 181       ctx.beginPath();
 182       ctx.arc(S / 2 + c.x * k, S / 2 + c.z * k, k * 1.02, 0, Math.PI * 2);
 183       ctx.fill();
 184     }
 185     for (const hi of m.homes) {
 186       const c = m.cells[hi];
 187       ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
 188       ctx.beginPath();
 189       ctx.arc(S / 2 + c.x * k, S / 2 + c.z * k, 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
 190       ctx.fill();
 191     }
 192     const f = m.cells[m.points[0].cell];
 193     ctx.fillStyle = '#f2ab38';
 194     ctx.beginPath();
 195     ctx.arc(S / 2 + f.x * k, S / 2 + f.z * k, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
 196     ctx.fill();
 197     url = cv.toDataURL('image/png');
 198   } catch (err) {
 199     console.warn('[Vestíbulo] Sin miniatura de mapa:', err);
 200   }
 201   MAP_THUMBS[key] = url;
 202   return url;
 203 }

 216 function dayKey(d = new Date()) {
 217   return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
 218 }
 219 
 220 function dayNum(key) {
 221   const [y, m, d] = key.split('-').map(Number);
 222   return Math.round(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d) / 86400000);
 223 }
 224 
 225 function keyOfDay(n) {
 226   const d = new Date(n * 86400000);
 227   return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
 228 }
 229 
 230 // Semana que empieza el lunes (el 1 de enero de 1970 fue jueves).
 231 function weekKey(d = new Date()) {
 232   return 'w' + Math.floor((dayNum(dayKey(d)) + 3) / 7);
 233 }

 235 function hashStr(s) {
 236   let h = 2166136261;
 237   for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = Math.imul(h ^ s.charCodeAt(i), 16777619);
 238   return h >>> 0;
 239 }

 241 function prettyDate(key) {
 242   const [y, m, d] = key.split('-').map(Number);
 243   return `${d} ${MONTHS[m - 1]} ${y}`;
 244 }

 254 // Rangos (v1.3, como tu documento de juego v2): 6 rangos propios, solo en la Liga 3 vs 3 y desde el
 255 // nivel 10. Ganar suma 25 y perder resta 15. Almirante del Faro: en Roblox serán los 50 mejores; aquí,
 256 // sin servidores, desde 2.400 puntos.
 257 const RANKS = ['Recluta', 'Cabo', 'Sargento', 'Capitán', 'Comandante', 'Almirante del Faro'];
 258 const RANK_MIN = [0, 300, 700, 1200, 1800, 2400];
 259 const RANK_ICONS = ['R', 'C', 'S', 'Cp', 'Cm', 'A'];
 260 const RANK_WIN = 25;
 261 const RANK_LOSS = 15;
 262 const RANK_COLORS = ['#8a9aa6', '#b87333', '#c0c7cf', '#f2c94c', '#7fc8ff', '#f2ab38'];
 263 const RANKED_MODE = 'league';
 264 const RANKED_LEVEL = 10;
 265 // Temporadas (v1.3): de unos 2 meses. La 1 es noviembre-diciembre de 2026. Al empezar una nueva,
 266 // el pase vuelve a empezar y bajas 1 rango (no a cero).
 267 const SEASON_START = { y: 2026, m: 10 };
 268 const SEASON_MONTHS = 2;
 269 function seasonOf(d = new Date()) {
 270   const months = (d.getFullYear() - SEASON_START.y) * 12 + d.getMonth() - SEASON_START.m;
 271   const no = Math.max(0, Math.floor(months / SEASON_MONTHS)) + 1;
 272   const m0 = SEASON_START.m + (no - 1) * SEASON_MONTHS;
 273   const start = new Date(SEASON_START.y, m0, 1);
 274   const end = new Date(SEASON_START.y, m0 + SEASON_MONTHS, 1);
 275   return { no, start, end };
 276 }
 277 // Tabla de la Liga 3 vs 3 (v1.2): 20 comandantes bot con nombres propios. Sus puntos salen de tu
 278 // semilla y se mueven un poco con cada partida que juegas (no son jugadores reales).
 279 const LADDER_NAMES = ['Capitana Brisa', 'Coronel Basalto', 'Almirante Coral', 'Sargento Pino', 'Mariscal Ceniza', 'Teniente Ámbar',
 280   'Comandante Niebla', 'Capitán Granito', 'General Duna', 'Cabo Relámpago', 'Comodoro Marea', 'Brigadier Roble', 'Capitana Aurora',
 281   'Coronela Cobre', 'Mayor Tormenta', 'Teniente Alba', 'Almirante Faro', 'Sargenta Lava', 'General Escarcha', 'Capitán Bruma'];
 282 function ladderRows(P) {
 283   const rng = mulberry32((P.seed || 1) + 4242);
 284   const games = (P.ranked && P.ranked.games) || 0;
 285   const rows = LADDER_NAMES.map((name, i) => {
 286     const base = Math.round(60 + rng() * 2550);
 287     const drift = Math.round(Math.sin((games + 1) * 0.7 + i) * 18 + games * (rng() * 6 - 1));
 288     return { name, points: Math.max(0, base + drift), bot: true };
 289   });
 290   rows.push({ name: 'Tú', points: (P.ranked && P.ranked.points) || 0, me: true });
 291   return rows.sort((a, b) => b.points - a.points || (a.me ? -1 : 1)).map((r, i) => ({ ...r, pos: i + 1 }));
 292 }
 293 function rankIndex(points) {
 294   let i = 0;
 295   while (i + 1 < RANK_MIN.length && Math.max(0, points) >= RANK_MIN[i + 1]) i++;
 296   return i;
 297 }
 298 function rankName(points) {
 299   return RANKS[rankIndex(points)];
 300 }
 301 // Desde Sargento, los rivales de la Liga 3 vs 3 juegan en Difícil.
 302 function rankedDifficulty(points) {
 303   return rankIndex(points) >= 2 ? 'hard' : 'normal';
 304 }

 346 function weekNumber(d = new Date()) {
 347   return Math.floor((dayNum(dayKey(d)) + 3) / 7);

 349 function weeklyFor(d = new Date()) {
 350   const n = weekNumber(d);
 351   const ch = WEEKLY_CHALLENGES[n % WEEKLY_CHALLENGES.length];
 352   const next = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
 353   next.setDate(next.getDate() + ((8 - next.getDay()) % 7 || 7));
 354   return { ...ch, week: 'w' + n, seed: 90000 + n * 37, next };
 355 }

 357 // v1.4: Top jugadores (tu documento, pág. 20): tú y comandantes bot, por temporada.
 358 const TOP_PREFIX = ['Brisa', 'Coral', 'Roca', 'Marea', 'Ancla', 'Bruma', 'Duna', 'Ámbar', 'Lince', 'Ola'];
 359 const TOP_SUFFIX = ['Norte', 'Sur', 'Veloz', 'Real', 'Azul', 'Roja', 'Gris', 'Dorada', 'Firme', 'Alta'];
 360 function topRows(P, tab) {
 361   const S = seasonOf(Profile.now());
 362   const rng = mulberry32((P.seed || 1) + 777 + S.no * 13);
 363   const games = (P.ranked && P.ranked.games) || 0;
 364   const liga = ladderRows(P).filter((r) => r.bot);
 365   const extra = [];
 366   for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
 367     const name = `${TOP_PREFIX[Math.floor(rng() * 10)]}${TOP_SUFFIX[Math.floor(rng() * 10)]}_${10 + Math.floor(rng() * 89)}`;
 368     extra.push({ name, points: Math.max(0, Math.round(40 + rng() * 2500 + Math.sin(games + i) * 15)), bot: true });
 369   }
 370   const bots = [...liga, ...extra].map((r, i) => {
 371     const r2 = mulberry32((P.seed || 1) + 91 + i * 7 + S.no);
 372     const pct = 0.42 + Math.min(0.32, r.points / 8000) + r2() * 0.06;
 373     const ranked = Math.round(20 + r.points / 9 + r2() * 30);
 374     return { name: r.name, bot: true, points: r.points, pct, wins: Math.round(ranked * pct + r2() * 120), islands: Math.round(r2() * 900 + r.points / 6) };
 375   });
 376   const R = P.ranked;
 377   const me = { name: 'Tú', me: true, points: R.points, pct: R.games ? R.wins / R.games : 0, wins: P.stats.wins, islands: P.stats.islands };
 378   const key = tab === 'wins' ? 'wins' : tab === 'islands' ? 'islands' : 'points';
 379   return [...bots, me].sort((a, b) => b[key] - a[key] || (a.me ? -1 : 1)).map((r, i) => ({ ...r, pos: i + 1 }));
 380 }

 382 const Profile = {
 383   data: null,

 386   defaults() {
 387     return {
 388       v: 1, seed: (Math.random() * 1e9) | 0, since: dayKey(), xp: 0, crystals: 0,
 389       stats: { games: 0, wins: 0, islands: 0, cores: 0, kills: 0, trained: 0, faro: 0 },
 390       achievements: {}, weekly: {},
 391       owned: {}, equipped: { inf: null, veh: null, sea: null, core: null }, badges: {},
 392       tutorialDone: false, pass: {}, daily: { idx: 0, last: null, lost: 0 }, codes: {},
 393       missions: { day: null, daily: [], rerolled: false, week: null, weekly: [] },
 394       chests: { pity: 0, opened: 0 },
 395       play: { mode: 'conquest', mapKind: 'archipelago', difficulty: 'normal' },
 396       custom: { kind: 'conquest', players: 4, mapKind: 'archipelago', coins: START_COINS, difficulty: 'normal', teams: false, fog: false, turbo: false, strategic: false },
 397       creator: { on: true, instant: false },
 398       campaign: { done: {}, stars: {} },
 399       ranked: { points: 0, best: 0, games: 0, wins: 0, history: [], shield: false },
 400       fragments: 0, plans: {},
 401       season: { no: 0, passXp: 0, notice: null },
 402     };
 403   },
 404 
 405   // v1.7: perfil seguro. Tres casos: no hay nada guardado (perfil nuevo); lo guardado se entiende (se revisa dato por
 406   // dato y se repara solo lo que vino mal); o no se entiende (no se pisa: queda una copia, se avisa y no se guarda nada
 407   // encima hasta que el jugador elija «Empezar de nuevo» o cargue una copia).
 408   load() {
 409     const d = this.defaults();
 410     this.loadError = null;
 411     this.repaired = [];
 412     this.locked = false;
 413     let raw = null;
 414     try {
 415       raw = localStorage.getItem(PROFILE_KEY);
 416     } catch (err) {
 417       this.memoryOnly = true;
 418     }
 419     if (raw) {
 420       let saved;
 421       try { saved = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (err) { saved = undefined; }
 422       if (!saved || typeof saved !== 'object' || Array.isArray(saved) || saved.v !== 1) {
 423         this.loadError = 'unreadable';
 424         this.locked = true;
 425         try { localStorage.setItem(PROFILE_BAK_KEY, raw); } catch (err) { /* sin espacio para la copia */ }
 426       } else {
 427         this.merge(d, saved);
 428       }
 429     }
 430     // v1.4: logros; quien ya terminó el Tutorial tiene «Primer Faro».
 431     d.achievements = d.achievements || {};
 432     if (d.tutorialDone && !d.achievements.primer_faro) d.achievements.primer_faro = d.since || dayKey();
 433     // v1.3: la Clasificatoria aparte pasa a ser la Liga 3 vs 3.
 434     if (d.play.mode === 'ranked') d.play.mode = RANKED_MODE;
 435     if (!MODES[d.play.mode] || !MODES[d.play.mode].lobby) d.play.mode = 'conquest';
 436     if (!MAPS[d.play.mapKind]) d.play.mapKind = 'archipelago';
 437     if (!DIFFICULTY[d.play.difficulty]) d.play.difficulty = 'normal';
 438     this.data = d;
 439     this.refresh();
 440     return d;
 441   },
 442 
 443   // Copia lo guardado sobre los valores de fábrica, revisando el tipo de cada dato. Un dato con el tipo equivocado
 444   // (un número que llegó como texto, una lista que llegó como número…) se repara o vuelve a su valor de fábrica; el
 445   // resto se conserva. Los datos que este juego no conoce se dejan como están.
 446   merge(d, saved) {
 447     const fix = (path, def, val) => {
 448       if (typeof def === 'number') {
 449         if (typeof val === 'number' && Number.isFinite(val)) return val;
 450         const n = typeof val === 'string' && val.trim() !== '' ? Number(val) : NaN;
 451         this.repaired.push(path);
 452         return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : def;
 453       }
 454       if (typeof def === 'boolean') {
 455         if (typeof val === 'boolean') return val;
 456         this.repaired.push(path);
 457         return def;
 458       }
 459       if (Array.isArray(def)) {
 460         if (Array.isArray(val)) return val;
 461         this.repaired.push(path);
 462         return def;
 463       }
 464       if (def && typeof def === 'object') {
 465         if (!val || typeof val !== 'object' || Array.isArray(val)) {
 466           this.repaired.push(path);
 467           return def;
 468         }
 469         for (const k of Object.keys(val)) def[k] = k in def ? fix(path + '.' + k, def[k], val[k]) : val[k];
 470         return def;
 471       }
 472       if (typeof def === 'string' && typeof val !== 'string') {
 473         this.repaired.push(path);
 474         return def;
 475       }
 476       return val;
 477     };
 478     for (const k of Object.keys(saved)) d[k] = k in d ? fix(k, d[k], saved[k]) : saved[k];
 479   },
 480 
 481   // «Empezar de nuevo» después de un perfil que no se pudo leer: la copia queda guardada aparte.
 482   startFresh() {
 483     this.locked = false;
 484     this.loadError = null;
 485     this.data = this.defaults();
 486     this.refresh();
 487     this.save();
 488   },
 489 
 490   save() {
 491     // Mientras haya un perfil sin leer y el jugador no haya elegido, no se escribe nada encima.
 492     if (this.locked) return;
 493     try {
 494       localStorage.setItem(PROFILE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.data));
 495     } catch (err) {
 496       this.memoryOnly = true;
 497     }
 498   },
 499 
 500   level(xp = this.data.xp) {
 501     return 1 + Math.floor(xp / LEVEL_XP);
 502   },
 503 
 504   // v1.3: copia del progreso para llevarlo a otro iPad o navegador (sin servidores, no hay cuentas).
 505   // Código = «FARO1.» + suma de control + «.» + el perfil en base64.
 506   exportCode() {
 507     const json = JSON.stringify(this.data);
 508     const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(json);
 509     let bin = '';
 510     for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) bin += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
 511     return `FARO1.${hashStr(json).toString(36)}.${btoa(bin)}`;
 512   },
 513 
 514   importCode(code) {
 515     const m = String(code || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, '').match(/^FARO1\.([0-9a-z]+)\.([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)$/);
 516     if (!m) return { err: 'Ese texto no es una copia del progreso de Faro de Ámbar' };
 517     let json;
 518     try {
 519       const bin = atob(m[2]);
 520       const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
 521       for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
 522       json = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
 523     } catch (err) {
 524       return { err: 'La copia está incompleta: cópiala entera otra vez' };
 525     }
 526     if (hashStr(json).toString(36) !== m[1]) return { err: 'La copia está incompleta o cambiada: cópiala entera otra vez' };
 527     let data;
 528     try { data = JSON.parse(json); } catch (err) { return { err: 'La copia no se puede leer' }; }
 529     if (!data || data.v !== 1 || typeof data.xp !== 'number') return { err: 'La copia no es de este juego' };
 530     return { data };
 531   },
 532 
 533   restore(data) {
 534     this.locked = false;
 535     try { localStorage.setItem(PROFILE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data)); } catch (err) { this.memoryOnly = true; }
 536     if (this.memoryOnly) {
 537       this.data = data;
 538       return;
 539     }
 540     this.load();
 541   },
 542 
 543   // XP: el nivel cuenta toda la XP; el pase, solo la de esta temporada.
 544   addXp(n) {
 545     this.data.xp += n;
 546     this.data.season.passXp = (this.data.season.passXp || 0) + n;
 547   },
 548 
 549   now() {
 550     return new Date();
 551   },
 552 
 553   // Al empezar una temporada nueva: el pase vuelve a empezar y la Liga baja 1 rango (no a cero).
 554   checkSeason() {
 555     const P = this.data;
 556     const cur = seasonOf(this.now()).no;
 557     if (!P.season.no) {
 558       // Perfiles de antes de la v1.3: se quedan con lo que llevaban en el pase.
 559       P.season.no = cur;
 560       P.season.passXp = P.xp;
 561       return false;
 562     }
 563     if (P.season.no >= cur) return false;
 564     const R = P.ranked;
 565     const from = rankName(R.points);
 566     const idx = rankIndex(R.points);
 567     R.points = RANK_MIN[Math.max(0, idx - 1)];
 568     R.shield = false;
 569     P.pass = {};
 570     P.season.passXp = 0;
 571     P.season.notice = { no: cur, from, to: rankName(R.points) };
 572     P.season.no = cur;
 573     return true;
 574   },
 575 
 576   passTier() {
 577     return Math.min(PASS_TIERS, Math.floor((this.data.season.passXp || 0) / PASS_TIER_XP));
 578   },
 579 
 580   // Cambio de día o de semana: misiones nuevas y racha del premio diario.
 581   refresh() {
 582     const P = this.data;
 583     this.checkSeason();
 584     const today = dayKey();
 585     const M = P.missions;
 586     if (M.day !== today) {
 587       M.day = today;
 588       M.daily = this.pick(MISSIONS.daily, 3, 'd' + today).map((m) => ({ id: m.id, prog: 0, done: false }));
 589       M.rerolled = false;
 590     }
 591     const wk = weekKey();
 592     if (M.week !== wk) {
 593       M.week = wk;
 594       M.weekly = this.pick(MISSIONS.weekly, 3, wk).map((m) => ({ id: m.id, prog: 0, done: false }));
 595     }
 596     // Premio diario: si faltas un día, la racha baja 1 (por cada día que faltes).
 597     const D = P.daily;
 598     if (D.last) {
 599       const gap = dayNum(today) - dayNum(D.last);
 600       if (gap > 1) {
 601         const missed = gap - 1;
 602         D.lost = Math.min(D.idx, missed);
 603         D.idx = Math.max(0, D.idx - missed);
 604         D.last = keyOfDay(dayNum(today) - 1);
 605       }
 606     }
 607     this.save();
 608   },
 609 
 610   pick(pool, n, key) {
 611     const rng = mulberry32(hashStr(key) ^ this.data.seed);
 612     const list = pool.slice();
 613     for (let i = list.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 614       const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
 615       [list[i], list[j]] = [list[j], list[i]];
 616     }
 617     return list.slice(0, n);
 618   },
 619 
 620   rerollDaily(i) {
 621     const M = this.data.missions;
 622     const cur = M.daily[i];
 623     if (!cur || cur.done || M.rerolled) return false;
 624     const used = new Set(M.daily.map((m) => m.id));
 625     const options = MISSIONS.daily.filter((m) => !used.has(m.id));
 626     if (!options.length) return false;
 627     const next = options[Math.floor(Math.random() * options.length)];
 628     M.daily[i] = { id: next.id, prog: 0, done: false };
 629     M.rerolled = true;
 630     this.save();
 631     return true;
 632   },
 633 
 634   dailyClaimable() {
 635     return this.data.daily.last !== dayKey();
 636   },
 637 
 638   passClaimable() {
 639     let n = 0;
 640     for (let t = 1; t <= this.passTier(); t++) if (!this.data.pass[t]) n++;
 641     return n;
 642   },
 643 
 644   owns(id) {
 645     return !!this.data.owned[id] || (Creator.active() && !!SKIN_BY_ID[id]);
 646   },
 647 
 648   looks() {
 649     const out = {};
 650     for (const [slot, id] of Object.entries(this.data.equipped)) {
 651       if (id && SKIN_BY_ID[id] && this.owns(id)) out[slot] = SKIN_BY_ID[id].look;
 652     }
 653     return out;
 654   },
 655 };
 656 
 657 function passReward(t) {
 658   if (t % 10 === 0) return { chest: 'faro', text: 'Cofre del Faro' };
 659   if (t % 5 === 0) return { chest: 'isla', text: 'Cofre de Isla' };
 660   const n = 20 + 5 * Math.floor((t - 1) / 10);
 661   return { crystals: n, text: `${n} cristales` };
 662 }

 664 // ---------- modo creador (solo la cuenta dueña del juego) ----------
 665 // v1.8: zona de creadores con contraseña. Se guarda solo la huella SHA-256 (con sal) de la contraseña, nunca la contraseña.
 666 // Se pide otra vez cada vez que se abre el juego (queda abierta mientras la pestaña siga abierta). Tras 5 intentos fallidos,
 667 // hay que esperar 60 s. Ojo: en una página web esto frena a los jugadores, no a quien sepa leer el código; en Roblox la
 668 // contraseña se comprobará en el servidor.
 669 const CREATOR_PASS = { salt: 'faro-ambar|creadores|', hash: '4659ef1a787caaa20a5786b97d05eaa2ef23fc625f078fb571e1692d415f8f97', tries: 5, wait: 60 };
 670 const CREATOR_KEY = 'faro-creator-ok';
 671 
 672 const Creator = {
 673   owner: false,
 674   platform: false,
 675   byPass: false,
 676   checked: false,
 677 
 678   // La plataforma de Claude dice si quien abre el enlace es el dueño. Sin plataforma, nadie lo es.
 679   // v1.8: también es creador quien entró con la contraseña en esta pestaña.
 680   async detect() {
 681     try {
 682       if (window.claude && typeof window.claude.use === 'function') {
 683         const user = await window.claude.use('user');
 684         this.platform = !!(user && (await user.isOwner()));
 685       }
 686     } catch (err) {
 687       this.platform = false;
 688     }
 689     try { this.byPass = sessionStorage.getItem(CREATOR_KEY) === CREATOR_PASS.hash; } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
 690     this.owner = this.platform || this.byPass;
 691     this.checked = true;
 692     return this.owner;
 693   },
 694 
 695   // Segundos que faltan para poder volver a intentar (0 si se puede).
 696   lockLeft() {
 697     try {
 698       const until = Number(sessionStorage.getItem('faro-creator-lock') || 0);
 699       return Math.max(0, Math.ceil((until - Date.now()) / 1000));
 700     } catch (err) {
 701       return 0;
 702     }
 703   },
 704 
 705   // Devuelve null si la contraseña es correcta; si no, el motivo.
 706   tryPassword(pw) {
 707     const left = this.lockLeft();
 708     if (left > 0) return `Demasiados intentos. Espera ${left} s.`;
 709     const ok = sha256Hex(CREATOR_PASS.salt + String(pw || '').trim()) === CREATOR_PASS.hash;
 710     let fails = 0;
 711     try { fails = Number(sessionStorage.getItem('faro-creator-fails') || 0); } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
 712     if (!ok) {
 713       fails++;
 714       try {
 715         sessionStorage.setItem('faro-creator-fails', String(fails >= CREATOR_PASS.tries ? 0 : fails));
 716         if (fails >= CREATOR_PASS.tries) sessionStorage.setItem('faro-creator-lock', String(Date.now() + CREATOR_PASS.wait * 1000));
 717       } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
 718       return fails >= CREATOR_PASS.tries ? `Contraseña incorrecta. Espera ${CREATOR_PASS.wait} s para volver a intentar.`
 719         : `Contraseña incorrecta (${CREATOR_PASS.tries - fails} ${CREATOR_PASS.tries - fails === 1 ? 'intento' : 'intentos'} más).`;
 720     }
 721     this.byPass = true;
 722     this.owner = true;
 723     try {
 724       sessionStorage.setItem(CREATOR_KEY, CREATOR_PASS.hash);
 725       sessionStorage.removeItem('faro-creator-fails');
 726     } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
 727     return null;
 728   },
 729 
 730   // Cerrar la zona: deja de ser creador en esta pestaña (salvo el dueño confirmado por la plataforma).
 731   lock() {
 732     this.byPass = false;
 733     this.owner = this.platform;
 734     try { sessionStorage.removeItem(CREATOR_KEY); } catch (err) { /* sin almacenamiento */ }
 735     if (!this.owner && Profile.data) Profile.data.creator.on = false;
 736   },
 737 
 738   active() {
 739     return this.owner && !!(Profile.data && Profile.data.creator.on);
 740   },
 741 };
